words.ex: She read Baked Earth last summer.
words.ex_cn: 她去年夏天读了《炽热的地球》。
words.en: Clay that has been hardened by heat, used in making pottery or bricks.

words.ex: He checked his bank statement last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚查看了他的银行对账单。
words.en: A bank statement is a document that shows all the transactions that have occurred in a bank account over a specific period of time, usually a month.

words.tr: phrase. 银行间的转帐； 银行汇款
words.ex: He made a bank transfer to pay his rent.
words.ex_cn: 他通过银行转账支付了房租。
words.en: A bank transfer is a method of transferring money from one bank account to another.

words.ex: The city became a banking centre after the new financial district was built.
words.ex_cn: 新金融区建成后，这座城市成为了银行中心。
words.en: A banking center is a place where the business of banking is concentrated, typically in a city or area known for its financial institutions.

words.ex: The bar chart shows the number of students in each class.
words.ex_cn: 条形图显示了每个班级的学生人数。
words.en: A bar chart is a type of chart that presents categorical data with rectangular bars with heights or lengths proportional to the values that they represent.

words.ex: He scans the barcode with a small machine.
words.ex_cn: 他用一个小机器扫描条形码。
words.en: A bar code is a pattern of thick and thin black lines that is printed on things you buy. It contains information that a computer can read.

words.tr: phrase. 烧烤用具套装；包括烤架、夹子、刷子等烧烤工具的一套设备
words.ex: He bought a barbecue set for the weekend picnic.
words.ex_cn: 他为周末的野餐买了一套烧烤用具。
words.en: A collection of tools and equipment used for outdoor cooking over an open fire or grill.

words.tr: phrase. 贫瘠的土地；不毛之地
words.ex: The barren land cannot grow any crops.
words.ex_cn: 这片贫瘠的土地无法种植任何作物。
words.en: Land that is unproductive and unable to support plant life due to poor soil or lack of water.

words.tr: phrase. 贫瘠的矿井；荒芜的矿区
words.ex: The barren mine produced no gold for decades.
words.ex_cn: 这个贫瘠的矿井几十年来没有产出任何黄金。
words.en: A mine that has been exhausted of its valuable minerals or resources and is no longer profitable.

words.ex: He is taking a basic course in math.
words.ex_cn: 他正在上一门基础数学课程。
words.en: A basic course is an introductory course that covers the fundamental aspects of a subject.

words.tr: phrase. 基本规则；基本原则
words.ex: The basic rule is to add the numbers first.
words.ex_cn: 基本规则是先加数字。
words.en: A basic rule is a fundamental principle or guideline that serves as the foundation for behavior or procedure.

words.tr: phrase. 对某物过敏的；表示身体对某种物质产生不良免疫反应的状态
words.ex_cn: 他对花生过敏。
words.en: To have an adverse reaction to a substance, typically involving the immune system, which can cause symptoms such as sneezing, itching, or more severe reactions.

words.tr: phrase. 生气的；发脾气的；情绪不佳的
words.ex_cn: 他的咖啡凉了，所以他生气了。
words.en: To be in a bad mood or to be angry.

words.ex: She washed the bed sheet yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 她昨天洗了床单。
words.en: A bed sheet is a large piece of cloth used to cover a mattress, often used in pairs with one sheet below the sleeper and one sheet above.

words.tr: phrase. 床上用品；被单和枕套
words.ex: She bought new bed linen for her bedroom.
words.ex_cn: 她为卧室买了新的床单被套。
words.en: Sheets, pillowcases, and other items used on a bed.

words.ex: He is prone to making small mistakes.
words.ex_cn: 他容易犯小错误。
words.en: If someone is prone to something, they are likely to do it or experience it.

words.tr: phrase. 初级课程；入门课程
words.ex: He signed up for a beginning course in Spanish.
words.ex_cn: 他报名参加了一个西班牙语入门课程。
words.en: An introductory or initial level of study or instruction in a particular subject or field.

words.ex: He fastened his belts before leaving the house.
words.ex_cn: 他出门前系好了腰带。
words.en: Belts are strips of leather or other material worn around the waist to support clothes or for decoration. They can also refer to continuous bands of material used in machinery to transmit motion or convey materials.

words.ex: He feels tired because his biological clock says it is time to sleep.
words.ex_cn: 他感到疲倦，因为他的生物钟告诉他该睡觉了。
words.en: The biological clock is an innate mechanism that controls the physiological activities of living organisms, making them occur at approximately 24-hour intervals, even in the absence of external cues.

words.ex: He wears a black raincoat when it rains.
words.ex_cn: 天下雨时，他穿一件黑色雨衣。
words.en: A waterproof garment, typically dark in colour, worn over other clothing to protect from rain.

words.ex: She wears a black skirt to school.
words.ex_cn: 她穿一条黑色裙子去上学。
words.en: A garment for the lower body, typically knee-length or longer, made of fabric and worn as part of a woman's or girl's outfit.

words.ex: He drinks black tea every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上喝红茶。
words.en: Black tea is a type of tea that is more oxidized than oolong, green, and white teas. Black tea is generally stronger in flavor than the less oxidized teas.

words.ex: He wears black trousers to work.
words.ex_cn: 他穿黑色长裤去上班。
words.en: A garment for the lower body, covering each leg separately, typically worn by men or as part of formal attire.

words.tr: phrase. 黑色天鹅绒（一种柔软、有光泽的深黑色织物）；也指一种由黑啤酒和苹果酒混合而成的鸡尾酒
words.ex: She wore a black velvet dress to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一条黑色丝绒连衣裙去参加派对。
words.en: A rich, deep black fabric, often with a soft, plush texture, used for clothing, upholstery, or decoration.

words.tr: n. 街区；积木；砖；块；大楼；大厦；障碍物；“block”的复数； v. 阻塞；阻碍；
words.ex: He lives in the next blocks near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他住在公园旁边的街区。
words.en: Blocks can refer to solid pieces of material with flat surfaces, or to the act of preventing something from happening or moving.

words.ex: The doctor checked the blood flow in his leg.
words.ex_cn: 医生检查了他腿里的血流。
words.en: The movement of blood through the vessels of the body that is induced by the pumping action of the heart and serves to distribute nutrients and oxygen to and remove waste products from all parts of the body.

words.ex: The doctor took a blood sample from his arm.
words.ex_cn: 医生从他的手臂上取了一滴血样。
words.en: A blood sample is a small amount of blood taken from a person's body and tested in order to obtain information about their health.

words.tr: phrase. 花朵的盛开；花的绽放
words.ex: The garden has a bloom of flowers in spring.
words.ex_cn: 花园在春天有一片盛开的花朵。
words.en: The period when flowers open and develop, or the collective mass of flowers on a plant at a given time.

words.ex: He wears a blue sweater every Monday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周一都穿一件蓝色毛衣。
words.en: A knitted garment for the upper body, typically with long sleeves, made from wool or synthetic yarn.

words.ex: He lives in a boarding school far from home.
words.ex_cn: 他住在离家很远的寄宿学校。
words.en: A boarding school is a school where some or all pupils not only study but also live during term time, with their fellow students and possibly teachers.

words.ex: We went on a boat trip last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我们上周末去坐了船游。
words.en: A boat trip is a journey made by boat, especially for pleasure.

words.ex: We booked in advance to get good seats.
words.ex_cn: 我们提前预订了座位，以便得到好位置。
words.en: To arrange for something to be reserved or secured at a time before it is needed.

words.tr: phrase. 预订书籍；图书预约
words.ex: He made a book reservation at the library.
words.ex_cn: 他在图书馆预约了一本书。
words.en: n. A booking made in advance to ensure the availability of a book or other item.

words.ex: The dog buried the bones in the yard.
words.ex_cn: 狗把骨头埋在了院子里。
words.en: The hard parts inside a human or animal that make up its skeleton.

words.tr: phrase. 保龄球道；保龄球馆
words.ex: We went to the bowling alley last Saturday.
words.ex_cn: 我们上星期六去了保龄球道。
words.en: A bowling alley is a long, narrow building or room where people play the game of bowling.

words.tr: phrase. 植物园；专门用于种植和展示各种植物的园区
words.ex: We walked in the botanical garden and saw many flowers.
words.ex_cn: 我们在植物园里散步，看到了许多花。
words.en: A botanical garden is a place where plants are grown for scientific study and display to the public.

words.ex: He put a note on the bulletin board.
words.ex_cn: 他把一张便条贴在公告栏上。
words.en: A bulletin board is a board on a wall which notices can be pinned to.

words.ex: The view from the mountain is breathtaking.
words.ex_cn: 从山上看到的景色令人惊叹。
words.en: If you say that something is breathtaking, you mean that it is extremely beautiful or amazing.

words.ex: They breed fish in the pond to sell at the market.
words.ex_cn: 他们在池塘里繁殖鱼类以便在市场出售。
words.en: To raise and care for fish in a controlled environment, often for commercial purposes.

words.tr: 专有名词. 英国文化协会，负责推广英国文化、教育和语言在海外的机构
words.ex: He took the IELTS test at the British Council.
words.ex_cn: 他在英国文化协会参加了雅思考试。
words.en: The British Council is the United Kingdom's international organisation for cultural relations and educational opportunities.

words.tr: phrase. 英国国家图书馆，英国最大的图书馆，位于伦敦，收藏有数百万册图书、手稿和其他资料
words.ex: He borrowed a book from the British Library.
words.ex_cn: 他从大英图书馆借了一本书。
words.en: The British Library is the national library of the United Kingdom and one of the largest libraries in the world. It holds over 170 million items from many countries, in many languages and in many formats, both print and digital: books, manuscripts, journals, newspapers, magazines, sound and music recordings, videos, play-scripts, patents, databases, maps, stamps, prints, drawings.

words.tr: phrase. 不列颠博物馆(英国最大的综合性博物馆,在伦敦)
words.ex: We visited the British Museum last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我们上周末参观了大英博物馆。
words.en: The British Museum, located in London, is a public institution dedicated to human history, art, and culture. Its permanent collection of some eight million works is among the largest and most comprehensive in existence, having been widely sourced during the era of the British Empire.

words.tr: phrase. 拓宽视野；开阔眼界
words.ex: Traveling abroad can broaden one's horizon.
words.ex_cn: 出国旅行可以拓宽一个人的视野。
words.en: To expand one's understanding or experience, especially by encountering new ideas, cultures, or perspectives.

words.tr: phrase. 拓宽某人的视野；使某人的眼界更开阔
words.ex: Traveling helps broaden one's view.
words.ex_cn: 旅行有助于拓宽一个人的视野。
words.en: To broaden one's view means to expand one's understanding or perspective, especially by gaining new experiences or knowledge.

words.tr: phrase. 妻子的兄弟；丈夫的兄弟；姐妹的丈夫（泛指姻亲兄弟）
words.ex: My brother-in-law works as a teacher.
words.ex_cn: 我妻子的兄弟是一名教师。
words.en: A brother-in-law is the brother of your spouse or the husband of your sister.

words.ex: The buses arrive every ten minutes.
words.ex_cn: 公交车每十分钟到达一次。
words.en: A bus is a large motor vehicle which carries passengers from one place to another. Buses are usually public, meaning they are available for use by anyone who pays the fare.

words.tr: phrase. 公交车通行证；公共汽车乘车卡
words.ex: He uses his bus pass to ride the bus every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天用他的公交卡坐公交车。
words.en: A bus pass is a ticket that allows the holder to travel on buses, typically for a set period of time, such as a month or a year.

words.tr: phrase. 公交线路；公共汽车行驶的路线
words.ex: The new bus routes help people get to work faster.
words.ex_cn: 新的公交路线帮助人们更快地到达工作地点。
words.en: The paths or lines that buses follow to travel from one place to another within a city or area.

words.ex: He gave me his business card.
words.ex_cn: 他给了我他的名片。
words.en: A business card is a small card printed with one's name, occupation, company address, etc., used in business contexts.

words.ex: He flew in business class to save time.
words.ex_cn: 他乘坐商务舱飞行以节省时间。
words.en: Business class refers to a high-quality travel class available on some airlines and rail lines, offering more comfortable seating, better food, and more amenities than economy class.

words.tr: phrase. 商业文化；企业文化的总称，指企业在长期经营过程中形成的共同价值观、行为规范和工作方式
words.ex: He learns business culture in his new job.
words.ex_cn: 他在新工作中学习商业文化。
words.en: The set of values, beliefs, and practices that shape the behavior of individuals and groups within a business environment.

words.tr: phrase. 商业伦理；商业道德
words.ex: The company follows business ethics to treat customers fairly.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司遵守商业道德，以公平对待客户。
words.en: Business ethics refers to the moral principles that guide the way a business behaves. It involves considering the ethical implications of business decisions and actions, and striving to do what is right, not just what is profitable.

words.tr: phrase. 商学院；商业系（指大学中教授商业和管理学科的院系）
words.ex: He works in the business faculty at the university.
words.ex_cn: 他在大学的商学院工作。
words.en: The business faculty refers to the department within a university or college that focuses on the study of business and management.

words.ex: He is taking business studies at high school.
words.ex_cn: 他在高中学习商业研究。
words.en: Business studies is an academic subject that teaches the principles of business, management, and economics.

words.ex: He went on a business trip to Tokyo.
words.ex_cn: 他去东京出差了。
words.en: A business trip is a journey made for work purposes, typically involving travel to meet clients or attend meetings.

words.ex: The birds are kept in cages at the zoo.
words.ex_cn: 这些鸟被养在动物园的笼子里。
words.en: A cage is a structure of bars or wires in which birds or other animals are confined.

words.tr: phrase. 小屋的钥匙；舱室的钥匙
words.ex: He lost the cabin keys before the trip.
words.ex_cn: 他在旅行前弄丢了小木屋的钥匙。
words.en: A set of keys or keychain used to access or lock a cabin, typically for a specific room or building.

words.ex: The tourists rode the cable car up the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 游客们乘坐缆车上了山。
words.en: A cable car is a vehicle that is pulled by a moving cable and is used for transporting people up and down mountains.

words.ex: He returned the book at the circulation desk.
words.ex_cn: 他在借还书台归还了这本书。
words.en: The circulation desk is the place in a library where you can borrow and return books.

words.ex: He wrote his name on the call slip.
words.ex_cn: 他在借书单上写了名字。
words.en: A call slip is a form used in libraries to request a book or other material that is kept in closed stacks.

words.tr: phrase. 校园犯罪；指在大学或学校校园内发生的违法行为
words.ex: The campus crime rate increased last year.
words.ex_cn: 去年校园犯罪率上升了。
words.en: Campus crime refers to criminal activities that occur on a college or university campus.

words.ex: She lit the candles for a cozy dinner.
words.ex_cn: 她点燃了蜡烛，营造温馨的晚餐氛围。
words.en: A candle is a stick of wax with a string through the middle which you burn to give light.

words.tr: phrase. 无法在截止日期前完成
words.ex: He cannot meet the deadline because he is sick.
words.ex_cn: 他因为生病无法按时完成。
words.en: Unable to complete or fulfill a task by the specified or required time limit.

words.tr: phrase. 汽车型号；汽车款式
words.ex: He bought a new car model last month.
words.ex_cn: 他上个月买了一款新的汽车型号。
words.en: A car model refers to a specific version or design of a car, often distinguished by unique features, specifications, and styling.

words.tr: phrase. 汽车租赁；租车服务
words.ex: We booked a car rental for our trip.
words.ex_cn: 我们为旅行预订了汽车租赁。
words.en: The service of renting cars for a short period of time, usually ranging from a few hours to a few weeks.

words.ex: The car tyres are flat.
words.ex_cn: 汽车的轮胎是瘪的。
words.en: The rubber covering on a wheel of a car, which provides traction and absorbs shock.

words.ex: He uses a card index to store phone numbers.
words.ex_cn: 他用卡片索引来存储电话号码。
words.en: A card index is a system of organizing information on cards, which are stored in a box or cabinet and can be searched through easily.

words.tr: phrase. 卡片目录（用于图书馆中按卡片索引图书的系统）
words.ex: He found the book using the card catalogue.
words.ex_cn: 他通过卡片目录找到了这本书。
words.en: A card catalogue is a system for organizing information about the books and other materials in a library, consisting of cards with information on them that are arranged in a particular order.

words.ex: He filled out a comment card after the meal.
words.ex_cn: 他在用餐后填写了一张意见卡。
words.en: A card provided for customers or visitors to write their comments or feedback on a service or product.

words.ex: Plants take in carbon dioxide from the air.
words.ex_cn: 植物从空气中吸收二氧化碳。
words.en: Carbon dioxide is a gas that is produced when people and animals breathe out, or when carbon is burned in the air. It is used by plants in photosynthesis.

words.ex: He carved the meat with a sharp knife.
words.ex_cn: 他用一把锋利的刀切开了肉。
words.en: To carve means to cut into a hard material in order to produce an object, design, or inscription.

words.tr: 动名词短语. 雕刻木材；对木头进行雕刻的艺术或行为
words.ex: He is carving wood to make a bird.
words.ex_cn: 他正在雕刻木头来做一只鸟。
words.en: The art or process of shaping wood by cutting or chiseling it to create decorative or functional objects.

words.tr: phrase. 个案研究；案例分析；调查研究
words.ex: He did a case study on a small business.
words.ex_cn: 他做了一个关于小企业的案例研究。
words.en: A case study is a detailed examination of a particular case or situation, especially in order to understand its complexities or to test a theory.

words.ex: The teacher gave us two case studies to read.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我们两个案例研究来阅读。
words.en: Detailed examinations of a subject of study (such as a person, group, or event) over time, especially in business, medicine, or education, to analyze its development or outcomes.

words.tr: phrase. 设施的选择；可供选择的设施方案
words.ex: The school offers many choices for facilities.
words.ex_cn: 学校提供了多种设施选择。
words.en: Options available for amenities or services provided at a location, such as sports equipment, meeting rooms, or dining options.

words.tr: phrase. 盒式录音机；卡式录音机
words.ex: He uses cassette recorders to listen to old songs.
words.ex_cn: 他用卡式录音机听老歌。
words.en: A cassette recorder is a device that records and plays back sound on cassette tapes.

words.tr: phrase. 光盘播放器；CD 播放机
words.ex: He plays music on his CD player.
words.ex_cn: 他用他的CD播放器听音乐。
words.en: A device that plays audio CDs.

words.tr: abbr. 光盘只读存储器；光盘驱动器；“compact disc read-only memory”的缩写
words.ex: He uses a cd-rom to play games.
words.ex_cn: 他用光盘来玩游戏。
words.en: A CD-ROM is a CD on which a very large amount of information can be stored to be read by a computer. CD-ROM is an abbreviation for 'compact disc read-only memory'.

words.ex: He wears casual clothes to the park on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他周末穿便服去公园。
words.en: Clothes designed for informal occasions, emphasizing comfort and ease of wear.

words.ex: He wears casual wear to the weekend picnic.
words.ex_cn: 他穿便装去周末的野餐。
words.en: Clothes designed for informal occasions, characterized by comfort and ease.

words.tr: n. 费用；控告；指控；负荷；装载；电荷；收费；掌管；“charge”的复数；
words.ex: The hotel charges are very high.
words.ex_cn: 酒店的费用很高。
words.en: If you charge someone an amount of money, you ask them to pay that amount for something that you have sold to them or done for them. Charges are formal accusations that someone has committed a crime.

words.ex: The restaurant caters to vegetarians.
words.ex_cn: 这家餐厅迎合素食者的需求。
words.en: To cater to someone or something means to provide them with all the things they need or want.

words.tr: phrase. 餐饮设施；提供饮食服务的场所或设备
words.ex: The hotel has good catering facilities for guests.
words.ex_cn: 这家酒店为客人提供了良好的餐饮设施。
words.en: Catering facilities refer to the services and equipment provided for preparing and serving food and drinks, especially at events or in institutions.

words.tr: phrase. 餐饮服务人员；负责提供饮食服务的工作人员
words.ex: The catering staff served food at the party.
words.ex_cn: 餐饮工作人员在派对上提供了食物。
words.en: Catering staff refers to the group of people who are responsible for providing food and drink services at events, functions, or establishments.

words.ex: The students meet in the centre hall every morning.
words.ex_cn: 学生们每天早上在中央大厅集合。
words.en: A central hallway or corridor in a building, typically connecting other rooms or areas.

words.tr: phrase. 中心经理；负责管理某个中心或机构的人员
words.ex: The center manager helps students with their homework.
words.ex_cn: 中心经理帮助学生做作业。
words.en: A person responsible for overseeing the daily operations and staff of a specific center, such as a call center, retail outlet, or community facility.

words.ex: The house has central heating for winter.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子有中央供暖系统过冬。
words.en: A system that heats a building by sending hot water or steam through pipes to radiators in different rooms.

words.tr: phrase. 中央大道；中心街道
words.ex: He walks down central avenue every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都走过中央大道。
words.en: A main road in the center of a town or city, often lined with shops and businesses.

words.tr: phrase. 中央公园（通常指纽约市著名的中央公园）
words.ex: He walks his dog in Central Park every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上在中央公园遛狗。
words.en: A large public park in the center of Manhattan, New York City, known for its scenic beauty and recreational facilities.

words.tr: phrase. 中央车站；总发电站
words.ex: He waits for the train at the central station.
words.ex_cn: 他在中央车站等火车。
words.en: A central station is the main station in a city or town, where trains or other forms of transport arrive and depart.

words.tr: phrase. 儿童保育证明；托儿服务资格证书
words.ex: She got a certificate of childcare last month.
words.ex_cn: 她上个月获得了儿童保育证书。
words.en: A document that certifies an individual has completed training or education in the field of childcare, allowing them to work professionally with children.

words.ex: She volunteers at a charitable organization.
words.ex_cn: 她在一家慈善组织做志愿者。
words.en: A charitable organization is a non-profit organization that operates for purposes beneficial to the public or a specific group of people, often focusing on relief of the poor, the distressed, or the underprivileged.

words.tr: phrase. 慈善医院；由慈善机构资助的医院，通常为贫困人群提供免费或低价医疗服务
words.ex: The charity hospital gives free care to poor people.
words.ex_cn: 这家慈善医院为穷人提供免费治疗。
words.en: A charity hospital is a hospital that provides medical services free of charge or at a reduced cost to those who cannot afford to pay.

words.ex: He checks in at the hotel at 3 PM.
words.ex_cn: 他在下午三点办理入住。
words.en: To announce your arrival, especially at a hotel or an airport, by signing your name or showing your ticket.

words.ex: We checked out of the hotel after paying the bill.
words.ex_cn: 我们付完账后离开了酒店。
words.en: To check out means to leave a hotel after paying your bill, or to examine something or someone in order to be certain that everything is correct, safe, or satisfactory.

words.tr: n. 清单；检查表；备忘录；目录册；
words.ex: He made a checklist for his trip.
words.ex_cn: 他为旅行列了一份清单。
words.en: A checklist is a list of items required, things to be done, or points to be considered, used as a reminder.

words.tr: phrase. 胸部感染；指影响肺部或气道的感染，如支气管炎或肺炎
words.ex: He has a chest infection and can't breathe well.
words.ex_cn: 他得了胸部感染，呼吸不好。
words.en: A chest infection is an infection that affects your lungs, either in the larger airways (bronchitis) or in the smaller air sacs (pneumonia).

words.ex: He works in the chemistry lab after school.
words.ex_cn: 他放学后在化学实验室工作。
words.en: A chemistry lab is a facility that provides controlled conditions in which scientific or technological research, experiments, and measurement may be performed.

words.tr: phrase. 教堂路；通往教堂的道路
words.ex: He lives on Church Road near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他住在教堂路，靠近公园。
words.en: A road leading to or passing by a church, often found in towns or villages.

words.ex: He lost his chequebook last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周丢了支票簿。
words.en: A chequebook is a book of cheques which your bank gives you so that you can pay for things by cheque.

words.tr: phrase. 支票卡；借记卡（用于从银行账户直接付款的卡片）
words.ex: He used his check card to buy groceries.
words.ex_cn: 他用支票卡买了杂货。
words.en: A card used to pay for goods or services directly from a bank account, often with a debit function.

words.tr: phrase. 集中于； 专心于
words.ex: He must concentrate on his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他必须专心做作业。
words.en: To direct all your attention and effort towards a particular activity, subject, or problem.

words.tr: phrase. 马戏表演；在马戏团中进行的各种杂技、魔术、驯兽等娱乐演出
words.ex: The children watched a circus performance last night.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们昨晚观看了马戏表演。
words.en: A show featuring acrobats, clowns, and animal acts performed in a ring or arena, typically associated with traveling entertainment.

words.ex: The school has a party on children's day.
words.ex_cn: 学校在儿童节举行派对。
words.en: A day celebrating children, often marked by special events and activities.

words.tr: phrase. 奶酪的生产；奶酪制造
words.ex: The farm focuses on cheese production.
words.ex_cn: 这个农场专注于奶酪生产。
words.en: The process of making cheese from milk, involving the coagulation of the milk protein casein.

words.tr: phrase. 城市的扩张；城市扩展
words.ex: The city's expansion caused more traffic and noise.
words.ex_cn: 城市的扩张导致了更多的交通和噪音。
words.en: The process by which a city grows in size, population, or area, often involving the development of new residential, commercial, or industrial zones.

words.ex: The city council voted to build a new park.
words.ex_cn: 市议会投票决定建造一个新的公园。
words.en: The city council is the elected group of officials who govern a city.

words.tr: phrase. 城市的俯视图；从上方看到的城市景观
words.ex: The drone took a city overhead view at sunset.
words.ex_cn: 无人机在日落时拍摄了城市的俯瞰图。
words.en: A photograph or view of a city taken from above, showing its layout and structures.

words.ex: The commuters wait for the train every morning.
words.ex_cn: 通勤者每天早上等火车。
words.en: People who travel some distance to work on a regular basis.

words.ex: He is the class representative for Grade 8.
words.ex_cn: 他是八年级的班级代表。
words.en: A class representative is a student elected by their classmates to represent their interests and communicate with teachers and school administration.

words.ex: The conquerors took over the land long ago.
words.ex_cn: 这些征服者很久以前就占领了那片土地。
words.en: Conquerors are people who conquer a country or group of people.

words.tr: phrase. 清洁设备；清洁用具
words.ex: The school bought new cleaning equipment for the bathrooms.
words.ex_cn: 学校为洗手间买了新的清洁设备。
words.en: Tools and machinery used for cleaning, such as vacuums, mops, and scrubbers.

words.tr: phrase. 清洁材料；用于清洁的各种用品，如清洁剂、抹布、刷子等
words.ex: He bought cleaning materials for the kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 他为厨房买了清洁用品。
words.en: Substances used for cleaning, like detergents, soaps, and disinfectants.

words.tr: phrase. + n. 清晰的论点；清楚明确的论证
words.ex: He gave a clear argument in the debate.
words.ex_cn: 他在辩论中提出了清晰的论点。
words.en: A clear argument is one that is easy to understand and is supported by evidence or logic, making it persuasive to others.

words.ex: My classmates help me with homework.
words.ex_cn: 我的同学帮我做作业。
words.en: Your classmates are students who are in the same class as you at school or college.

words.tr: phrase. 粗糙的质地；粗粒的结构
words.ex: The bread has a coarse texture.
words.ex_cn: 这种面包的质地粗糙。
words.en: A rough or gritty surface, often felt by touch, like sandpaper or burlap.

words.tr: phrase. + n. 舒适的衣服；令人感到轻松自在的衣物
words.ex: He wears comfortable clothes to walk in the park.
words.ex_cn: 他穿舒服的衣服去公园散步。
words.en: Clothes that are comfortable are pleasant to wear because they fit well and feel nice against your skin.

words.ex: My colleagues helped me with the project.
words.ex_cn: 我的同事们帮我完成了这个项目。
words.en: Your colleagues are the people you work with, especially in a professional job.

words.ex: He looks at the clock every hour.
words.ex_cn: 他每小时看一次钟。
words.en: A clock is an instrument that shows the time, usually in hours and minutes.

words.ex: The books are on closed shelves.
words.ex_cn: 书在封闭的书架上。
words.en: Shelves that are enclosed with doors or panels to protect contents from dust.

words.tr: phrase. 闭卷考试（指考试时不允许查阅书籍或资料的考试形式）
words.ex: He took a close-book exam last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周参加了一次闭卷考试。
words.en: An examination where the examinee is not allowed to use textbooks, notes, or other materials to answer the questions.

words.ex: The book is in the closed reserve at the library.
words.ex_cn: 这本书在图书馆的闭架阅览区。
words.en: A state of being reserved or restrained, often due to shyness or caution.

words.ex: The store uses closed-circuit tv to watch customers.
words.ex_cn: 商店使用闭路电视来监控顾客。
words.en: A television system in which signals are transmitted over a closed circuit, such as within a building, for surveillance or security purposes.

words.ex: He drinks coffee at the coffee shop every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上在咖啡店喝咖啡。
words.en: A coffee shop is a small restaurant where drinks and snacks are sold.

words.tr: phrase. 工作中的休息时间；茶歇
words.ex: We took a coffee break at 10 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 我们在上午10点休息喝咖啡。
words.en: A short period of rest from work during which people drink coffee or other beverages.

words.ex: He uses the coffee machine every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都用咖啡机。
words.en: A coffee machine is a device used to brew coffee. It can range from a simple manual device to a complex automatic machine.

words.ex: The rainwater flows into the collection tank.
words.ex_cn: 雨水流入收集罐。
words.en: A container for collecting and storing liquids, often used in industrial or agricultural settings.

words.ex: He collects old coins and keeps them in collections.
words.ex_cn: 他收集旧硬币并把它们保存成收藏品。
words.en: A group of objects or works to be seen, studied, or kept together.

words.tr: phrase. 大学特写；对大学生活的详细观察或近距离描绘
words.ex: The magazine published a college close-up of student life at Harvard.
words.ex_cn: 杂志刊登了一篇关于哈佛大学学生生活的特写。
words.en: A detailed, close-up shot of a college campus or building, focusing on specific features.

words.tr: phrase. 共同住所；共同居住地
words.ex: They share a common residence in the city.
words.ex_cn: 他们在城里共享一个住所。
words.en: A place where two or more people live together, often used in legal contexts to establish domicile or eligibility for certain benefits.

words.ex: The students relax in the common room after class.
words.ex_cn: 学生们下课后在公共休息室休息。
words.en: A common room is a room in a school, college, or university where students can relax and socialize.

words.ex: He used common sense to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他用常识解决了这个问题。
words.en: Common sense is the natural ability to make good judgments and to behave in a practical and sensible way.

words.ex: He improved his communication skills at work.
words.ex_cn: 他在工作中提高了沟通技能。
words.en: Communication skills refer to the ability to convey information to another effectively and efficiently.

words.tr: phrase. 交流策略；沟通技巧；为实现有效沟通而采取的方法或计划
words.ex: They use simple communication strategies to understand each other.
words.ex_cn: 他们使用简单的沟通策略来互相理解。
words.en: Communication strategies refer to the plans and methods used to effectively convey information and ideas between individuals or groups.

words.tr: phrase. 通信技术；用于传递信息的技术，如电话、互联网、广播等
words.ex: He uses communication technology to talk with his friends far away.
words.ex_cn: 他使用通信技术与远方的朋友交谈。
words.en: Communication technology refers to the tools and systems that enable the transmission of information over distances for the purpose of communication.

words.tr: 名词短语。会议报告；研讨会报告；学术会议论文集
words.ex: He read the conference reports last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周读了会议报告。
words.en: Documents or summaries that detail the proceedings, discussions, and outcomes of a conference.

words.tr: phrase. 联系人列表；通讯录
words.ex: He checked his contact list before calling.
words.ex_cn: 他在打电话前查看了他的联系人列表。
words.en: A contact list is a collection of screen names, and other information about people you communicate with using a computer or mobile device.

words.tr: phrase. 公司行为；企业行动（指公司采取的各类管理、经营或战略举措）
words.ex: The company actions changed the market quickly.
words.ex_cn: 公司的行动迅速改变了市场。
words.en: Activities or decisions made by a business or organization, often referring to its operations or strategies.

words.ex: Math is a compulsory course for all students.
words.ex_cn: 数学是所有学生的必修课。
words.en: A compulsory course is a subject that students are required to take as part of their curriculum.

words.tr: phrase. 计算机模型；用计算机模拟的系统或过程的数学表示
words.ex: The scientist uses a computer model to predict weather.
words.ex_cn: 科学家使用计算机模型来预测天气。
words.en: A computer model is a program designed to simulate what might or what did happen in a situation. They are used in many ways including in astronomy, economics and sciences such as physics and biology.

words.ex: He is a computer programmer who writes code every day.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名计算机程序员，每天写代码。
words.en: A computer programmer is a person who writes computer programs.

words.tr: phrase. 计算机声卡，一种用于处理音频信号的硬件设备，使计算机能够输入、输出和处理声音
words.ex: The computer sound card makes music play clearly.
words.ex_cn: 电脑声卡让音乐播放得很清晰。
words.en: A hardware component in a computer that processes and produces audio signals for speakers or headphones.

words.ex: The computer system stopped working yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 昨天电脑系统停止工作了。
words.en: A computer system is a set of integrated devices that input, output, process, and store data and information. Computer systems are currently built around at least one digital processing device.

words.tr: phrase. 转接班机；中转飞行
words.ex: I have a connecting flight in Dubai.
words.ex_cn: 我在迪拜有转机航班。
words.en: A connecting flight is a flight that requires passengers to change planes at an intermediate stop before reaching their final destination.

words.ex: They went to the concert hall to hear the orchestra.
words.ex_cn: 他们去音乐厅听交响乐。
words.en: A concert hall is a building designed for the performance of concerts and other musical events.

words.ex: They practice music in the concert room.
words.ex_cn: 他们在音乐厅里练习音乐。
words.en: A room designed for the performance of concerts, typically equipped with seating for an audience and designed with good acoustics.

words.ex: He listens to classical music every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上听古典音乐。
words.en: Classical music refers to the art music produced or rooted in the traditions of Western culture, including both liturgical (religious) and secular music.

words.ex: He wears contact lenses to see clearly.
words.ex_cn: 他戴隐形眼镜来看清东西。
words.en: Contact lenses are small, thin lenses that are placed directly on the surface of the eyes to correct vision, as an alternative to glasses.

words.tr: phrase. 合作的研究要素；指在科研项目中协同工作的各个组成部分或单位
words.ex: The two universities are sharing cooperating research elements to solve climate problems.
words.ex_cn: 这两所大学正在分享合作的研究要素以解决气候问题。
words.en: Collaborative components or factors in a research project that work together to achieve a common goal.

words.tr: 短语动词. 应对压力；处理紧张情绪
words.ex: He learns simple ways to cope with stress at work.
words.ex_cn: 他学习了一些简单的方法来应对工作中的压力。
words.en: The process of managing or dealing with stress in a way that reduces its negative impact.

words.ex: The company got a corporate loan to expand its business.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司获得了一笔企业贷款来扩展业务。
words.en: A corporate loan is a loan made to a business rather than an individual, typically for the purpose of expansion, equipment purchase, or working capital.

words.tr: phrase. 性价比较高的；本轻利厚的
words.ex: This bike is cost effective for daily travel.
words.ex_cn: 这辆自行车用于日常出行很划算。
words.en: Something that is cost effective gives the best possible profit or benefits in comparison with the money that is spent.

words.ex: The cost of living in New York is very high.
words.ex_cn: 纽约的生活成本很高。
words.en: The amount of money that is needed to pay for basic needs such as food, housing, and clothes in a particular place.

words.tr: phrase. 化装舞会；化妆派对
words.ex: We wore costumes to the costume party.
words.ex_cn: 我们穿着服装去参加化装派对。
words.en: A costume party is a social gathering where guests are expected to wear costumes, often representing a specific theme or character.

words.tr: phrase. 止咳糖浆；治咳嗽的混合药剂
words.ex: He drank cough mixture to feel better.
words.ex_cn: 他喝了止咳糖浆以感觉好些。
words.en: A cough mixture is a liquid medicine that is taken to relieve coughing.

words.ex: He listens to country music every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上听乡村音乐。
words.en: A genre of popular music that originated in the rural regions of the Southern United States, blending traditional folk music with elements of blues and gospel.

words.ex: The course fee is fifty dollars.
words.ex_cn: 这门课的费用是五十美元。
words.en: The amount of money that must be paid to enroll in a course or program of study.

words.tr: phrase. 课程及教材；指学习过程中所使用的教学内容和相关材料
words.ex: The course and materials are available online.
words.ex_cn: 课程及教材可以在线获取。
words.en: A set of lessons and the items needed for them, such as books or tools.

words.tr: phrase. 课程负责人；教学主管
words.ex: The course director gives us the syllabus.
words.ex_cn: 课程主任给我们发课程大纲。
words.en: A course director is a person who is responsible for the planning and management of a course of study.

words.tr: 短语动词. 支付费用；承担成本
words.ex: He works hard to cover the cost of his books.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作来支付书本的费用。
words.en: To pay for something, especially when the amount is large or unexpected.

words.tr: phrase. 手工艺品；手工制作的商品
words.ex: She sells hand-made craft goods at the market.
words.ex_cn: 她在市场上出售手工工艺品。
words.en: Goods that are made by hand, often with traditional methods and skills.

words.ex: He uses a credit card to buy food.
words.ex_cn: 他用信用卡买食物。
words.en: A credit card is a small plastic card that you use to buy things on credit or to borrow money.

words.ex: The children play near the creeks after school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们放学后在小溪边玩耍。
words.en: A creek is a small stream or a minor tributary of a river.

words.tr: phrase. 对犯罪的认识；犯罪意识
words.ex: The school teaches crime awareness to help students stay safe.
words.ex_cn: 学校教授对犯罪的认识，以帮助学生保持安全。
words.en: The understanding or knowledge of the existence and impact of criminal activities.

words.ex: The crime rate in this city is low.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市的犯罪率很低。
words.en: The crime rate is the number of crimes that are committed in a particular area during a particular period of time.

words.ex: The workers found a cross passage between the two tunnels.
words.ex_cn: 工人们发现两条隧道之间有一条通道。
words.en: A cross passage is a pathway or corridor that connects two or more separate areas or buildings, facilitating movement between them.

words.tr: phrase. 文化差异；不同文化之间的区别和多样性
words.ex: They learned about cultural differences during their trip abroad.
words.ex_cn: 他们在国外旅行期间了解了文化差异。
words.en: Cultural differences refer to the various beliefs, behaviors, languages, practices, and expressions considered unique to members of a specific ethnicity, race, or national origin.

words.ex: He felt culture shock when he moved to Japan.
words.ex_cn: 当他搬到日本时，他感受到了文化冲击。
words.en: Culture shock is the feeling of disorientation experienced by someone when they are suddenly subjected to an unfamiliar culture, way of life, or set of attitudes.

words.tr: phrase. 曲线图；用曲线表示数据变化的图表
words.ex: He drew a curve chart to show the temperature change.
words.ex_cn: 他画了一个曲线图来显示温度变化。
words.en: A graph that shows how data is distributed, often with a line that rises and falls.

words.tr: phrase. 货币形式；流通货币的样式或类型
words.ex: The currency form of this country is the dollar.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家的货币形式是美元。
words.en: A specific type or format of money used in a particular country or system.

words.tr: phrase. 活期存款帐户；活期存折；来往户头
words.ex: He checks his current account every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周检查他的活期账户。
words.en: A current account is a type of bank account that allows you to deposit and withdraw money frequently, and often comes with a cheque book and a debit card.

words.tr: phrase. 自行车道；骑行路线
words.ex: He rides his bike on a quiet cycling route.
words.ex_cn: 他骑自行车在一条安静的骑行路线上传。
words.en: A designated path or course for bicycles, often marked and maintained for safety and convenience.

words.tr: phrase. 海关服务；负责监管进出口货物、征收关税及防止走私的政府服务部门
words.ex: The customs service checked his luggage at the airport.
words.ex_cn: 海关人员在机场检查了他的行李。
words.en: The department or agency responsible for collecting duties and controlling the flow of goods into and out of a country.

words.tr: phrase. 经过切割和抛光的（常用于描述宝石或石材表面光滑、精致）
words.ex: The diamond is cut and polished to shine brightly.
words.ex_cn: 这颗钻石被切割和抛光以闪耀明亮。
words.en: Processed and shaped, typically referring to gemstones or wood that have been refined.

words.tr: v. 损伤；毁坏； n. “damage”的复数；
words.ex: The storm damages the roof.
words.ex_cn: 风暴损坏了屋顶。
words.en: Money that a court orders you to pay to someone because you have harmed them or their property.

words.tr: phrase. 深色的衣服；暗色系的服装
words.ex: He wears dark clothes to work every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天穿深色衣服去上班。
words.en: Clothing that is of a dark color, typically black, navy, or dark grey, often worn for formal occasions or to create a slimming effect.

words.ex: He wears dark trousers to work every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天穿深色长裤去上班。
words.en: Trousers that are black or very dark in colour, often worn for formal occasions.

words.ex: The dateline divides the Earth into two calendar days.
words.ex_cn: 日界线将地球分为两个日历日。
words.en: A dateline is a line at the beginning of a news article giving the date and place of origin of the news dispatch.

words.ex: He does data analysis for his job.
words.ex_cn: 他工作做数据分析。
words.en: The process of systematically applying statistical and/or logical techniques to describe and illustrate, condense and recap, and evaluate data.

words.tr: phrase. 数据评估；对数据的质量、完整性、相关性等进行分析和判断的过程
words.ex: The teacher did a data assessment to check student progress.
words.ex_cn: 老师做了数据评估来检查学生的进步。
words.en: The process of examining information to understand its meaning or quality.

words.ex: His date of birth is June 5, 2000.
words.ex_cn: 他的出生日期是2000年6月5日。
words.en: The day, month, and year on which someone was born.

words.tr: phrase. 终止日期；借书期限
words.ex: The date of expiry is tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 到期日期是明天。
words.en: The date on which something, especially a contract, agreement, or product, is no longer valid or usable.

words.tr: phrase. 期限；（图书馆）借书卡
words.ex: The date slip for the project is next Friday.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目的期限是下周五。
words.en: A small piece of paper or a label that indicates a date, often used in libraries to show when a book is due back.

words.tr: phrase. 只是白天来上课的学生
words.ex: He is a day pupil at the local school.
words.ex_cn: 他是当地学校的一名走读生。
words.en: A day pupil is a student who attends school during the day but does not live at the school.

words.tr: phrase. 走读学校（学生白天上课，不住宿）
words.ex: He goes to day school every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上上日校。
words.en: A day school is a school which students attend during the day and return home in the evening, as opposed to a boarding school where students live on campus.

words.tr: phrase. 白班；日班（指在白天工作的轮班）
words.ex: He works the day shift at the hospital.
words.ex_cn: 他在医院上白班。
words.en: A day shift refers to a period of time during the day, typically from early morning to late afternoon, when a person is scheduled to work.

words.ex: He has many debts to pay.
words.ex_cn: 他有很多债务要还。
words.en: Money that is owed or due.

words.tr: n. 数十年；几十年（decade的复数形式）
words.ex: He has lived in this city for decades.
words.ex_cn: 他在这座城市生活了几十年。
words.en: A decade is a period of ten years, especially one that begins with a year ending in 0, for example 1980 to 1989.

words.ex: He has decayed teeth from eating too much sugar.
words.ex_cn: 他因为吃太多糖而有了蛀牙。
words.en: Teeth that have been damaged by decay.

words.tr: phrase. 装饰用的气球；用于庆典或活动布置的彩色气球
words.ex: She bought decoration balloons for the party.
words.ex_cn: 她为派对买了装饰气球。
words.en: Balloons used for parties or events, often decorated with patterns or colours.

words.tr: 短语动词. 发表演讲；发表讲话
words.ex: He will deliver a speech at the school meeting tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他将在学校的会议上发表演讲。
words.en: To give a formal talk or presentation to an audience.

words.ex: He returned the book at the delivery desk.
words.ex_cn: 他在借书台还了书。
words.en: A place in a building where you can collect or arrange for the delivery of items.

words.tr: phrase. 部门大楼；系楼（通常指学校或机构中某个部门或院系所在的建筑物）
words.ex: The department building is next to the library.
words.ex_cn: 系楼在图书馆旁边。
words.en: A building that houses the offices, classrooms, and facilities of a particular department within a university or organization.

words.tr: phrase. 百货商店；百货公司
words.ex: She bought a dress at the department store.
words.ex_cn: 她在百货商店买了一条裙子。
words.en: A large shop divided into several different areas, each of which sells different types of goods.

words.tr: phrase. 部门的地址；与部门相关的通信地址
words.ex: Please send the letter to the departmental address.
words.ex_cn: 请把信寄到部门的地址。
words.en: The specific location or contact information for a particular department within an organization.

words.tr: phrase. 学习的愿望；求知欲
words.ex: He has a desire to learn new things every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都有学习新事物的愿望。
words.en: A strong wish or motivation to gain knowledge or skills.

words.ex: He turns on the desk lamp to read at night.
words.ex_cn: 他打开台灯晚上读书。
words.en: A desk lamp is a lamp that is placed on a desk to provide light for reading or working.

words.tr: n. 细节；“detail”的复数； v. 详细说明；
words.ex: Can you give me the details of the meeting?
words.ex_cn: 你能给我会议的细节吗？
words.en: The word 'details' refers to the individual facts or elements that make up a larger whole. It is often used to describe the specific aspects or components of a subject that are important for understanding it fully.

words.ex: He likes to watch detective film on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在周末看侦探电影。
words.en: A detective film is a genre of film that focuses on the investigation and solving of a crime, often featuring a detective as the main character.

words.ex: He bought a digital camera last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周买了一台数码相机。
words.en: A digital camera is a camera that encodes digital images and videos digitally and stores them for later reproduction.

words.ex: The digital system shows the time on the screen.
words.ex_cn: 这个数字系统在屏幕上显示时间。
words.en: A digital system is a system that uses discrete values, often binary numbers, for input, processing, transmission, storage, or display, as opposed to an analog system which uses continuous signals.

words.tr: phrase. + n. 不同的层次；不同的水平
words.ex: The students are at different levels in math.
words.ex_cn: 学生们在数学上的水平不同。
words.en: Different levels refer to varying degrees or stages of something, such as skill, difficulty, or hierarchy.

words.ex: We eat lunch in the dining hall.
words.ex_cn: 我们在食堂吃午饭。
words.en: A dining hall is a large room in a institution where meals are served to a large number of people.

words.ex: We eat dinner in the dining room.
words.ex_cn: 我们在餐厅吃晚饭。
words.en: A dining room is a room in a house where people eat their meals.

words.ex: Many diseases can be prevented with clean water.
words.ex_cn: 许多疾病可以通过干净的水来预防。
words.en: A disease is an illness which affects people, animals, or plants, for example one which is caused by bacteria or infection.

words.tr: phrase. + n. 遥远的截止日期；指距离当前时间还很远的完成任务的最后期限
words.ex: He has a distant deadline for his project.
words.ex_cn: 他的项目有一个遥远的截止日期。
words.en: A distant deadline is a due date that is far in the future, allowing ample time for completion.

words.ex: He is doing distance learning at home.
words.ex_cn: 他正在家里进行远程学习。
words.en: Distance learning is a way of studying where tuition is carried out over the internet or by post, so that you do not need to attend a college or university.

words.ex: The divorce rate has increased in the last ten years.
words.ex_cn: 过去十年里，离婚率有所上升。
words.en: The number of divorces per thousand of the population in a given year.

words.tr: phrase. 区别性特征；显著特点；辨别标志
words.ex: The distinguishing feature of this phone is its long battery life.
words.ex_cn: 这款手机的显著特点是电池续航时间长。
words.en: A distinguishing feature is a characteristic that makes someone or something different from others.

words.tr: phrase. 人口分布，指某一地区内人口在地理空间上的分布状况
words.ex: The distribution of population is uneven in this country.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家的人口分布不均。
words.en: The way in which people are spread across a particular area.

words.tr: phrase. 下降趋势；下行走势
words.ex: The temperature shows a downward trend this week.
words.ex_cn: 这周气温呈下降趋势。
words.en: A downward trend refers to a situation in which something is decreasing or getting worse over a period of time.

words.ex: He does training courses to improve his skills.
words.ex_cn: 他参加培训课程来提高自己的技能。
words.en: To do training courses means to participate in educational programs designed to develop skills or knowledge.

words.ex: He earned his doctor's degree in physics after five years of research.
words.ex_cn: 他经过五年的研究获得了物理学博士学位。
words.en: A doctor's degree is the highest level of academic degree awarded by universities, signifying the completion of advanced studies and research in a specific field.

words.tr: phrase. 国内的因素；家庭因素
words.ex: Domestic factors affect the country's economy.
words.ex_cn: 国内因素影响国家的经济。
words.en: Domestic factors refer to the internal elements within a country that affect its economic, political, or social conditions.

words.tr: phrase. 本国学生；国内学生（指在本国接受教育而非国际或外国学生）
words.ex: The domestic student lives on campus.
words.ex_cn: 这名本国学生住在校园里。
words.en: A student who is a citizen or permanent resident of the country where they are studying, as opposed to an international student.

words.ex: He called the police because of domestic violence.
words.ex_cn: 他因为家庭暴力报了警。
words.en: Domestic violence refers to violent or aggressive behavior within the home, typically involving the violent abuse of a spouse or partner.

words.ex: He lost his door key and could not get inside.
words.ex_cn: 他丢了门钥匙，进不去屋。
words.en: A door key is a metal instrument specially cut to fit into a lock and move its bolt.

words.ex: The company offers door-to-door service for all packages.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司提供上门取送所有包裹的服务。
words.en: A service that involves going directly to a customer's home or business to deliver or collect something.

words.ex: The doctor prescribed drugs for his headache.
words.ex_cn: 医生给他开了治疗头痛的药物。
words.en: A drug is a substance which is used to treat an illness, relieve a symptom, or modify a chemical process in the body for a specific purpose.

words.ex: He uses a double lock on the door.
words.ex_cn: 他给门上了双重锁。
words.en: To lock something with two locks or to lock something in two different ways.

words.ex: We booked a double room for our trip.
words.ex_cn: 我们为旅行预订了一间双人房。
words.en: A room intended for two people, typically containing a double bed.

words.tr: phrase. 双层烧烤架；双面烧烤炉
words.ex: He uses a double grill to cook meat and vegetables at the same time.
words.ex_cn: 他用双层烤架同时烤肉和蔬菜。
words.en: A double grill is a cooking appliance with two separate grilling surfaces, often used for simultaneous cooking.

words.tr: phrase. 戏剧剧场；戏剧演出场所
words.ex: He acts in a drama theater every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每个周末都在戏剧剧院表演。
words.en: A drama theater is a venue where dramatic performances are staged, typically involving actors performing in front of an audience.

words.ex: The school hosts a drama festival every year.
words.ex_cn: 学校每年举办一场戏剧节。
words.en: A drama festival is an event where various plays and performances are showcased, often involving competition among participants.

words.tr: phrase. 戏剧老师；教授戏剧课程的教师
words.ex: He is a drama teacher at a high school.
words.ex_cn: 他是一所高中的戏剧老师。
words.en: A drama teacher is a person who teaches drama, the art of acting and producing plays, to students.

words.ex: He drew a conclusion after the experiment.
words.ex_cn: 他在实验后得出结论。
words.en: To come to a judgment or decision after considering the facts.

words.tr: phrase. 残疾人通道；无障碍通道
words.ex: The building has disabled access for wheelchairs.
words.ex_cn: 这座建筑有供轮椅使用的无障碍通道。
words.en: Facilities or measures that allow people with disabilities to enter and use a building or service.

words.ex: The drop-out rate in this school is high.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校的辍学率很高。
words.en: The percentage of students who leave school or a course of study before completing it.

words.ex: The school has a strict dress code.
words.ex_cn: 学校有严格的着装规定。
words.en: A set of rules specifying the attire that is appropriate for a particular place or event.

words.ex: The actors had a dress rehearsal before the show.
words.ex_cn: 演员们在演出前进行了全装彩排。
words.en: A dress rehearsal is the final rehearsal of a play or other performance, using the costumes and scenery that will be used for the actual performance.

words.ex: They have many disputes about money.
words.ex_cn: 他们经常为钱发生争执。
words.en: A dispute is a disagreement or argument about something important.

words.tr: phrase. 饮水机；喝酒厉害的人（非正式用语，指能大量饮酒的人）
words.ex: There is a drinking machine in the office hallway.
words.ex_cn: 办公室走廊里有一台饮水机。
words.en: A drinking machine is a device that dispenses water, typically for drinking purposes, and is commonly found in offices, schools, and public places.

words.ex: He bought drinks and snacks at the store.
words.ex_cn: 他在商店买了饮料和小吃。
words.en: Drinks and snacks refer to beverages and light food items that are consumed between meals.

words.tr: 短语动词. 少喝咖啡
words.ex: He drinks less coffee to sleep better.
words.ex_cn: 他少喝咖啡以便睡得更好。
words.en: To drink less coffee means to reduce the amount of coffee consumed, often for health or sleep reasons.

words.ex: He got his driver's license last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周拿到了驾照。
words.en: An official document permitting a person to drive a motor vehicle.

words.ex: He got his driving license last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周拿到了驾照。
words.en: A driving license is an official document which shows that you have passed the necessary tests and are allowed to drive a vehicle.

words.ex: The directors voted to increase the company's profits.
words.ex_cn: 董事们投票决定增加公司利润。
words.en: Directors are people who are in charge of managing a company or organization, or who are responsible for the artistic aspects of a film, play, or similar production.

words.tr: phrase. 投放点；下车点；垃圾投放处
words.ex: The drop-off site is near the park.
words.ex_cn: 丢弃点在公园附近。
words.en: A designated location where items can be left or delivered, often for recycling, donation, or collection purposes.

words.ex: The sales had a sudden drop-off last month.
words.ex_cn: 上个月销售额急剧下降。
words.en: A drop-off is a decrease in the amount, level, or number of something, or a place where something or someone is left.

words.tr: phrase. 厄尔尼诺现象（太平洋赤道地区海水异常变暖的现象）
words.ex: El Nino causes heavy rain in South America.
words.ex_cn: 厄尔尼诺现象导致南美洲暴雨频发。
words.en: A climate pattern characterized by unusually warm ocean temperatures in the Equatorial Pacific, affecting global weather.

words.tr: phrase. 鹰路（常用于地名，指以鹰命名的道路）
words.ex: The eagle road is quiet and empty.
words.ex_cn: 鹰路安静而空旷。
words.en: Eagle Road is a proper noun, typically a street name, and not a standard English phrase with a general definition.

words.tr: phrase. 东部的海滩；指位于某个地区东侧的海滩，常用于地名
words.ex: We walked along the eastern beach at sunset.
words.ex_cn: 我们在日落时沿着东边的海滩散步。
words.en: A beach located in the eastern part of a region, known for its scenic beauty and recreational activities.

words.tr: 动词短语，吃掉有害昆虫
words.ex: Bats eat harmful insects at night.
words.ex_cn: 蝙蝠在晚上吃有害的昆虫。
words.en: To eat harmful insects means to consume insects that are dangerous or toxic, which is generally not advisable.

words.ex: The country shows strong economic growth this year.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家今年显示出强劲的经济增长。
words.en: Economic growth refers to the increase in the inflation-adjusted market value of the goods and services produced by an economy over time. It is conventionally measured as the percent rate of increase in real gross domestic product, or real GDP.

words.tr: phrase. 经济史；对历史上经济制度、活动与发展变化的研究
words.ex: He is learning economic history at university.
words.ex_cn: 他正在大学学习经济史。
words.en: Economic history is a field of study that examines the development of economies over time, including the factors that have influenced their growth and decline.

words.ex: He booked an economy class ticket for the flight.
words.ex_cn: 他为航班预订了经济舱机票。
words.en: Economy class is the cheapest type of seats in a plane or train.

words.tr: phrase. 教育展览；展示教育成果或教育资源的展览活动
words.ex: There is an education exhibition at the school hall.
words.ex_cn: 学校礼堂有一个教育展览。
words.en: An event where educational institutions and organizations display their programs, achievements, and innovations to the public.

words.ex: The education officer helps students with their school plans.
words.ex_cn: 教育官员帮助学生制定学习计划。
words.en: An education officer is a professional responsible for overseeing and improving educational standards and practices within schools or educational institutions.

words.tr: phrase. 教育标准；指教育体系中规定的教学内容、水平和质量的规范或准则
words.ex: The education standard in this country is high.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家的教育标准很高。
words.en: Education standard refers to the level of quality that education is expected to achieve, often set by educational authorities or institutions.

words.tr: phrase. 教育系统；教育体制
words.ex: The education system in this country is very strict.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家的教育制度非常严格。
words.en: The structured framework within which educational activities are organized and conducted, including the policies, institutions, and practices that guide teaching and learning.

words.tr: phrase. 电子指挥官；电子导向装置
words.ex: The electronic director controls the robot's movements.
words.ex_cn: 电子指挥官控制机器人的动作。
words.en: An electronic director is a device or system that provides guidance or control, typically in a technological or mechanical context, by electronic means.

words.ex: He turns on the electric fan to cool the room.
words.ex_cn: 他打开电风扇来让房间凉快。
words.en: An electric fan is a device with rotating blades that creates a current of air for cooling or ventilation.

words.ex: He paid the electricity bill yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天交了电费。
words.en: A bill for the amount of electricity used in a particular period, typically sent monthly.

words.ex: He paid the electricity fee last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周交了电费。
words.en: The amount of money charged for the use of electrical power.

words.ex: He uses an electronic dictionary to find word meanings.
words.ex_cn: 他使用电子词典查找单词的意思。
words.en: An electronic dictionary is a device or software that contains a database of words and their meanings, designed to assist in language learning or translation.

words.tr: phrase. 电子邮件附件；随电子邮件发送的附加文件
words.ex: He sent me an email attachment with the report.
words.ex_cn: 他给我发了一封带有报告的电子邮件附件。
words.en: A file that is sent along with an email message.

words.tr: phrase. 电子邮件账户；用于发送和接收电子邮件的账户
words.ex: He forgot his email account password.
words.ex_cn: 他忘记了邮箱账户的密码。
words.en: An email account is a user account on an email server that allows an individual to send and receive emails.

words.ex: He wrote his email address on the form.
words.ex_cn: 他把他的电子邮件地址写在了表格上。
words.en: An email address is a unique identifier for an email account. It is used to send and receive emails over the Internet.

words.tr: phrase. 紧急联系人；在紧急情况下可联系的人员
words.ex: He wrote his emergency contact person on the form.
words.ex_cn: 他在表格上写了紧急联系人。
words.en: A person designated to be contacted in case of an emergency, such as a family member or close friend.

words.ex: He called the emergency telephone number when the car crashed.
words.ex_cn: 当汽车撞车时，他拨打了紧急电话号码。
words.en: An emergency telephone number is a dedicated hotline, like 911 or 112, for contacting immediate assistance in crises.

words.tr:
n. 刻度盘；
v. 拨；
words.ex: He looked at the clock's dial to check the time.
words.ex_cn: 他看着钟的刻度盘来查看时间。
words.en: A dial is the face of a clock or watch, or a similar control on a piece of equipment, which shows you the time or other information. As a verb, to dial means to call a telephone number by pressing the buttons on a telephone.

words.tr: phrase. 情感与情绪：emotion 指强烈的感情反应，如喜悦、愤怒、悲伤等；mood 指持续一段时间的心理状态，如愉快、沮丧、焦虑等
words.ex: She felt a strong emotion and a calm mood after the music.
words.ex_cn: 听完音乐后，她感受到了强烈的情感和平静的心境。
words.en: Emotion and mood refer to feelings: emotions are intense, short-term reactions, while moods are longer-lasting, less specific states.

words.ex: The test is at the end of term.
words.ex_cn: 考试在学期末。
words.en: The period at the end of an academic term, typically marked by examinations and the conclusion of courses.

words.ex: Pandas are endangered species.
words.ex_cn: 熊猫是濒危物种。
words.en: An endangered species is a type of organism that is at risk of extinction due to a rapid decrease in its population or a loss of its critical habitat.

words.tr: phrase. 能源产业；能源工业
words.ex: He works in the energy industry.
words.ex_cn: 他在能源行业工作。
words.en: The sector of the economy involved in the production and sale of energy, including fuel extraction, manufacturing, refining and distribution.

words.ex: The engineers built a new bridge over the river.
words.ex_cn: 工程师们在河上建了一座新桥。
words.en: A person who designs, builds, or maintains engines, machines, or public works.

words.tr: phrase. 工程室；机房；设备间（通常指船舶或建筑物中安置机械设备的房间）
words.ex: The students work in the engineering room.
words.ex_cn: 学生们在工程室工作。
words.en: A room where engineering work is carried out, especially in a ship or factory.

words.ex: He engraves his name on the ring.
words.ex_cn: 他把名字刻在戒指上。
words.en: To engrave means to cut or carve a design or letters into a hard surface, or to be strongly impressed in someone's memory.

words.ex: He paid the enrollment fee to join the class.
words.ex_cn: 他支付了注册费以加入课程。
words.en: A fee charged for registering or enrolling in a course, program, or institution.

words.ex: The entrance fee is five dollars.
words.ex_cn: 入场费是五美元。
words.en: An entrance fee is a sum of money that you pay to enter a place such as a museum or a park.

words.ex: The environment agency checks the river for pollution.
words.ex_cn: 环保局检查河流是否有污染。
words.en: The Environment Agency is a public body in England and Wales, established in 1996, responsible for protecting and improving the environment.

words.tr: phrase. 环境破坏；对自然环境造成的损害
words.ex: The factory caused environmental damage.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂造成了环境破坏。
words.en: Environmental damage refers to the harm or destruction caused to the natural environment by human activities, such as pollution, deforestation, and overfishing, which can lead to the loss of biodiversity and adverse effects on ecosystems.

words.tr: phrase. 环境问题；与自然环境相关的各种问题，如污染、气候变化、资源枯竭等
words.ex: Many people care about environmental issues.
words.ex_cn: 许多人关心环境问题。
words.en: Environmental issues refer to problems related to the natural world and the impact of human activity on its condition.

words.ex: He is learning environmental science at school.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校学习环境科学。
words.en: Environmental science is the study of the effects of human activity on the environment, aiming to develop solutions to environmental problems.

words.tr: phrase. 环境研究（一门跨学科的学科，研究人类与自然环境之间的相互关系）
words.ex: I am taking environmental studies this semester.
words.ex_cn: 我这学期选修环境研究。
words.en: Environmental studies is an interdisciplinary academic field which systematically studies human interaction with the environment in the interests of solving complex problems.

words.ex: She uses an environmentally-friendly bag to shop.
words.ex_cn: 她用一个环保的袋子购物。
words.en: Not harmful to the environment.

words.ex: He watches the evening news every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上看晚间新闻。
words.en: The evening news is a television or radio broadcast of news reports that occurs in the evening.

words.tr: phrase. 晚间的约会或预约
words.ex: I have an evening appointment at 7 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 我晚上七点有一个预约。
words.en: An evening appointment is a scheduled meeting or consultation that takes place in the late afternoon or night.

words.tr: phrase. 锻炼某人的肌肉；展示力量或权力
words.ex: He exercises his muscles every morning by doing push-ups.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上通过做俯卧撑来锻炼肌肉。
words.en: To engage in physical activity to strengthen and condition the muscles.

words.tr: 名词短语。乐器的展览；仪器的展示
words.ex: The museum has an exhibition of instruments from the 1800s.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆展出了19世纪的乐器。
words.en: A public display or presentation of musical or scientific instruments.

words.tr: phrase. 用于建筑的实验性（的）
words.ex: The team used experimental for construction materials to test their strength.
words.ex_cn: 该团队使用了用于建筑的实验性材料来测试其强度。
words.en: Relating to or based on trial and error in the context of building or engineering.

words.tr: phrase. 实验设施；试验设备
words.ex: The lab has new experimental facilities.
words.ex_cn: 实验室有新的实验设施。
words.en: Experimental facilities refer to the physical locations equipped with tools and equipment necessary for conducting experiments, often in scientific, educational, or industrial contexts.

words.tr: phrase. 预期持续时间；预计的持续时长
words.ex: The expected duration of the trip is two weeks.
words.ex_cn: 这次旅行的预计时长是两周。
words.en: The period of time that is anticipated or predicted to last.

words.ex: The express train arrives in 10 minutes.
words.ex_cn: 特快列车10分钟后到达。
words.en: An express train is a fast train that stops at few stations and is intended for passengers who wish to travel quickly between major cities.

words.ex: He drives on the expressway every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都走高速公路。
words.en: An expressway is a wide road that allows traffic to move quickly from one place to another, especially between cities.

words.ex: Please call me at this extension number.
words.ex_cn: 请拨打这个分机号找我。
words.en: An extension number is a short sequence of digits that is added to a main telephone number to reach a specific person or department within an organization.

words.tr: phrase. 广泛的写作；大量的书写工作
words.ex: He has extensive writing experience in journalism.
words.ex_cn: 他在新闻业有广泛的写作经验。
words.en: Writing that is lengthy, detailed, and covers a wide range of topics.

words.tr: phrase. 交换草案；票据交换
words.ex: They exchange drafts before submitting the report.
words.ex_cn: 他们在提交报告前交换草稿。
words.en: Exchange drafts refer to the process or documents used in the exchange of bills of exchange, especially in international trade, to facilitate payment between parties in different countries.

words.ex: There is an extra charge for late payment.
words.ex_cn: 迟交款项会收取额外费用。
words.en: An additional amount of money that is required to be paid for a service or product beyond the standard or advertised price.

words.ex: He has extra workload this week.
words.ex_cn: 他这周有额外的工作量。
words.en: An amount of work that exceeds what is normally expected or manageable.

words.ex: He made an ethical film about animal rights.
words.ex_cn: 他拍摄了一部关于动物权利的道德影片。
words.en: A film that explores moral principles, dilemmas, or social responsibility.

words.ex: He visited an eye doctor for a checkup.
words.ex_cn: 他去看眼科医生做检查。
words.en: A medical professional specializing in the diagnosis and treatment of eye disorders and diseases.

words.ex: They smiled and made eye contacts during the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他们在会议期间微笑并进行了眼神交流。
words.en: The act of looking directly into another's eyes during communication.

words.tr: phrase. 论文计划；文章提纲
words.ex: He wrote an essay plan before starting his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他在开始写作业前写了一个文章提纲。
words.en: A structured outline or framework designed to guide the writing of an essay, detailing the main points and arguments to be covered.

words.ex: Dinosaurs are extinct species.
words.ex_cn: 恐龙是已灭绝的物种。
words.en: An extinct species is a species that no longer exists.

words.tr: phrase. 面对面的面试；当面访谈
words.ex: I have a face-to-face interview tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我明天有一个面对面的面试。
words.en: A face-to-face interview is a meeting in which someone is asked questions to see if they are suitable for a job or course.

words.tr: phrase. 故障率；失败率，指在特定时间内某系统、设备或组件发生故障的频率
words.ex: The failure rate of this test is very high.
words.ex_cn: 这个测试的失败率非常高。
words.en: The frequency with which a component, device, or system fails to perform its required function under specified conditions for a specified period of time.

words.tr: phrase. 家族病史；指一个家庭中成员所共有的疾病或健康状况的历史记录
words.ex: The doctor asked about his family medical history.
words.ex_cn: 医生问他家族的病史。
words.en: The record of health information about a person and his or her close relatives. A complete record includes information from three generations of relatives, including children, brothers and sisters, parents, aunts and uncles, nieces and nephews, grandparents, and cousins.

words.ex: He is familiar with basic math.
words.ex_cn: 他熟悉基础数学。
words.en: Having a good knowledge of or being well acquainted with something or someone.

words.tr: phrase. 家庭虐待；家庭暴力（指在家庭成员之间发生的身体、情感或心理上的伤害行为）
words.ex: He left home because of family abuse.
words.ex_cn: 他因为家庭虐待离开了家。
words.en: The term 'family abuse' refers to the mistreatment of one family member by another, which can include physical, emotional, or sexual abuse.

words.ex: We bought a family ticket for the zoo.
words.ex_cn: 我们买了一张家庭票去动物园。
words.en: A family ticket is a type of admission ticket that allows a group of people, typically consisting of two adults and a certain number of children, to enter an event or venue at a reduced rate compared to purchasing individual tickets.

words.ex: My family name is Li.
words.ex_cn: 我的姓是李。
words.en: Your family name is the name that you share with other members of your family. In English-speaking countries, it is often called the 'last name' or 'surname'.

words.ex: He talks about his family relationship with his sister every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都会谈论他和妹妹的亲属关系。
words.en: The connection or association between members of a family.

words.tr: phrase. 化装舞会所穿着的服装
words.ex: The children wore fancy dress to the party.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们穿着奇装异服去参加派对。
words.en: Clothing worn to impersonate someone or something, often at a party or event.

words.tr: phrase. 盛装舞会；豪华舞会
words.ex: They went to a fancy ball in glittering dresses.
words.ex_cn: 他们穿着闪亮的礼服去参加了一场盛大的舞会。
words.en: A fancy ball is a formal dance party where guests wear costumes or formal attire.

words.tr: phrase. 化装舞会；装扮派对（参加者穿着奇装异服的聚会）
words.ex: We went to a fancy dress party last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我们上周末去参加了一个化装派对。
words.en: A party at which people wear unusual or amusing clothes, often to look like a famous person, character, or type of person.

words.ex: Falcons fly high in the sky.
words.ex_cn: 猎鹰在天空中高飞。
words.en: A falcon is a bird of prey that is known for its speed and ability to dive at high speeds to catch its prey.

words.ex: We had a farewell party for Tom last Friday.
words.ex_cn: 我们上周五为汤姆举办了告别派对。
words.en: A farewell party is a social gathering held to say goodbye to someone who is leaving, often involving food, drinks, and speeches.

words.ex: The market sells fresh farming products every morning.
words.ex_cn: 市场每天早上出售新鲜的农产品。
words.en: Farming products refer to the goods produced by agriculture, including crops, livestock, and other agricultural commodities.

words.tr: phrase. 对失业的恐惧；担心失去工作的忧虑
words.ex: He has a fear of unemployment after the factory closed.
words.ex_cn: 工厂关闭后，他害怕失业。
words.en: The anxiety or worry about losing one's job and not being able to find another one.

words.ex: The doctor feels his patient's pulse every morning.
words.ex_cn: 医生每天早上都摸病人的脉搏。
words.en: To feel someone's pulse is to check their heart rate by pressing on their wrist, or to try to find out someone's opinions or feelings about something.

words.ex: The scientist conducts female corpse study to understand aging in women.
words.ex_cn: 这位科学家进行女性尸体研究，以了解女性的衰老过程。
words.en: The scientific study of the female body after death, typically for medical or forensic purposes.

words.tr: phrase. 现场方法；实地方法（指在自然环境中进行观察或研究的方法）
words.ex: The scientist uses a field method to collect data.
words.ex_cn: 科学家使用田野方法收集数据。
words.en: A practical approach or technique used for collecting data or conducting research in a real-world setting.

words.tr: phrase. 田制；耕地制度；农田系统
words.ex: The farmer uses a field system to grow crops.
words.ex_cn: 农民使用田地系统来种植作物。
words.en: A method or arrangement of fields, especially in agriculture, designed to optimize production or management.

words.ex: We went on a field trip to the zoo.
words.ex_cn: 我们去动物园进行了实地考察。
words.en: An excursion or journey made by a group of people, especially students, for the purpose of learning or research outside the classroom.

words.tr: phrase. 野外工作；实地考察
words.ex: The biologists did field work in the rainforest.
words.ex_cn: 生物学家在雨林中进行了野外工作。
words.en: Field work refers to practical work conducted by a researcher in the natural environment, rather than in a laboratory or office.

words.ex: He went to the film festival last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周去了电影节。
words.en: A film festival is an organized, extended presentation of films in one or more cinemas or screening venues, usually in a single city or region.

words.ex: He works at a film studio in Los Angeles.
words.ex_cn: 他在洛杉矶的一家电影制片厂工作。
words.en: A film studio is a company that makes films, or the buildings and facilities used by such a company.

words.tr: 名词短语. 财务建议；理财建议
words.ex: He gave me financial advice about saving money.
words.ex_cn: 他给了我关于存钱的财务建议。
words.en: Financial advice refers to guidance given to individuals or businesses on how to manage their money and financial resources effectively.

words.ex: He manages his financial affairs carefully.
words.ex_cn: 他小心地管理自己的财务事务。
words.en: Matters related to the management of money, assets, and investments.

words.ex: He plans his financial budget every month.
words.ex_cn: 他每个月都规划他的财务预算。
words.en: A financial budget is a detailed plan of the financial resources and expenditures of an organization for a specific period of time, aiming to control costs and allocate resources effectively.

words.tr: phrase. 财务部门；负责组织财务管理和会计事务的部门
words.ex: He works in the financial department of a big company.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家大公司的财务部门工作。
words.en: The division within an organization responsible for managing budgets, accounting, and financial planning.

words.tr: phrase. 财务主管；金融高管，指在企业或组织中负责财务管理和决策的高级管理人员
words.ex: He is a financial executive at a big company.
words.ex_cn: 他是大公司的一名财务高管。
words.en: A financial executive is a person in a company who is responsible for managing the financial actions of the company. This includes tasks like tracking cash flow, analyzing strengths and weaknesses to propose corrective actions, and preparing financial reports.

words.tr: phrase. 财务目标；指个人或组织在财务方面希望实现的具体目的，如储蓄、投资或减少债务
words.ex: He sets financial goals to save money.
words.ex_cn: 他设定财务目标来存钱。
words.en: Financial goals refer to the monetary objectives that a person or organization aims to achieve within a certain period of time. These goals can include saving for retirement, buying a home, or paying off debt.

words.tr: phrase. 金融市场；进行金融资产（如股票、债券等）交易的市场
words.ex: The financial market went down yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 昨天金融市场下跌了。
words.en: A financial market is a market in which people trade financial securities, commodities, and other fungible items of value at low transaction costs and at prices that reflect supply and demand.

words.tr: phrase. 金融机构；金融组织（指从事金融活动，如银行、保险公司、投资公司等的组织）
words.ex: The financial organisation gave her a loan.
words.ex_cn: 这家金融机构给了她一笔贷款。
words.en: A financial organisation is an entity that provides financial services, such as banks, investment firms, and insurance companies.

words.tr: phrase. 财政政策；金融政策，指政府或机构在财政收支、货币供应、利率等方面所采取的管理经济的措施
words.ex: The government changed its financial policy last year.
words.ex_cn: 政府去年改变了它的财政政策。
words.en: A financial policy is a course of action intended to influence or control the behavior of the economy. This includes decisions about government spending and taxation, the supply of money, and interest rates.

words.tr: phrase. 财务问题；经济困难
words.ex: He has financial problems and cannot pay his bills.
words.ex_cn: 他有财务问题，付不起账单。
words.en: Issues related to money, especially the lack of it, that affect an individual or organization.

words.tr: phrase. 资金短缺；财政不足
words.ex: He faced a financial shortage and could not pay his rent.
words.ex_cn: 他面临资金短缺，付不起房租。
words.en: A situation where there is not enough money available for a particular purpose.

words.tr: phrase. 财务来源；资金来源
words.ex: He found a new financial source to pay for his education.
words.ex_cn: 他找到了一个新的资金来源来支付他的教育费用。
words.en: A financial source refers to the origin or provider of funds for a project, business, or individual.

words.tr: phrase. 美术；纯艺术（如绘画、雕塑、音乐、舞蹈等）
words.ex: He loves painting in the fine arts class.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在美术课上画画。
words.en: The term 'fine arts' refers to art forms developed primarily for aesthetics and/or concept rather than utility.

words.tr: phrase. 质地细腻的；纹理精细的
words.ex: The fabric has a fine texture.
words.ex_cn: 这种布料质地细腻。
words.en: A smooth, dense, or delicate quality in a material or fabric, often referring to its surface or composition.

words.ex: The fire alarm rang loudly at night.
words.ex_cn: 深夜里，火警警报大声响了起来。
words.en: A device that makes a loud noise to warn people of a fire.

words.ex: He used a fire blanket to put out the small flame.
words.ex_cn: 他用灭火毯扑灭了小火。
words.en: A fire blanket is a safety device made of fire-resistant material and designed to extinguish small fires.

words.ex: The school had a fire drill this morning.
words.ex_cn: 学校今天早上进行了消防演习。
words.en: A fire drill is a practice of the emergency procedures to be used in case of fire.

words.tr: phrase. 火灾管理；用火管理；指对火灾的预防、控制和扑救等综合管理措施
words.ex: The park uses fire management to protect the forest.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园使用火情管理来保护森林。
words.en: The process of planning, preventing, and fighting fires, especially in wildland areas, to protect people, property, and the environment.

words.tr: phrase. 一楼（在英式英语中指二楼，美式英语中指地面层以上的第一层）
words.ex: My office is on the first floor.
words.ex_cn: 我的办公室在一楼。
words.en: In British English, the first floor is the floor of a building which is one level above the ground floor. In American English, the first floor is the same as the ground floor.

words.ex: My first name is Tom.
words.ex_cn: 我的名字是汤姆。
words.en: Your first name is the name that was given to you when you were born and that comes before your family name.

words.ex: He keeps a first-aid kit in his car.
words.ex_cn: 他把急救包放在车里。
words.en: A first-aid kit is a collection of supplies and equipment that is used to give medical treatment.

words.tr: phrase. 一年级学生；大一新生
words.ex: He is a first-year student at the university.
words.ex_cn: 他是大学里的一年级学生。
words.en: A first-year student is someone who is in their first year of study at a college or university.

words.tr: phrase. 鱼饼（一种用鱼肉和调料制成的油炸或煎制食品）
words.ex: He ate fish cakes for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午餐吃了鱼饼。
words.en: Fish cakes are a type of food made from fish that has been mixed with other ingredients, shaped into a patty, and then fried or baked.

words.tr: phrase. 鱼缸；养鱼的水族箱
words.ex: He puts fish in the fish tank.
words.ex_cn: 他把鱼放在鱼缸里。
words.en: A fish tank is a container, typically made of glass or plastic, filled with water in which fish and other aquatic animals are kept.

words.ex: The fishing boat returns to shore at sunset.
words.ex_cn: 渔船在日落时返回岸边。
words.en: A fishing boat is a boat used for catching fish in the sea, or on a lake or river.

words.ex: The fishing industry provides food for many coastal towns.
words.ex_cn: 渔业为许多沿海城镇提供食物。
words.en: The sector of the economy involved in the catching, processing, and selling of fish and other seafood.

words.ex: He goes to the fitness centre every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上去健身中心。
words.en: A fitness centre is a place where people go to do physical exercise and keep fit, often equipped with various gym equipment.

words.tr: phrase. 健身俱乐部；健身中心
words.ex: He goes to the fitness club every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上去健身俱乐部。
words.en: A facility where people go to exercise, use gym equipment, and participate in fitness classes, often requiring a membership fee.

words.tr: phrase. 健身水平；体能状况
words.ex: His fitness level improved after running every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天跑步后，体能水平提高了。
words.en: The degree to which someone is physically fit and healthy.

words.tr: phrase. 健身训练；体能锻炼
words.ex: He does fitness training every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上进行健身训练。
words.en: Fitness training refers to physical exercises and activities designed to improve health, strength, and endurance.

words.tr: phrase. 固定开支；固定费用（指每月金额相对不变的支出，如房租、贷款、保险等）
words.ex: He pays fixed expenses every month.
words.ex_cn: 他每个月都支付固定开支。
words.en: Fixed expenses are costs that do not change with the level of goods or services produced by the business. They are often contractual and must be paid regardless of the business's performance.

words.tr: phrase. 灵活的工作时间；可根据个人需求调整的上班时段
words.ex: The company offers flexible working time so employees can choose their hours.
words.ex_cn: 公司提供灵活的工作时间，员工可以自行选择工作时段。
words.en: A system of working a set number of hours with the starting and finishing times chosen within agreed limits by the employee.

words.ex: The flight number is 234.
words.ex_cn: 航班号是234。
