words.en: A flight number is the specific code assigned to a particular flight by an airline, consisting of the airline's code followed by a numerical identifier.

words.tr: phrase. 花的味道；花朵的风味
words.ex: The flowers' taste is sweet and mild.
words.ex_cn: 花的味道甜美而温和。
words.en: A subtle, often sweet or delicate flavor reminiscent of flowers, commonly found in certain teas, desserts, or beverages.

words.ex: The flying craft moved slowly across the sky.
words.ex_cn: 飞行器缓慢地飞过天空。
words.en: A flying craft is any vehicle that is capable of flight, especially one that is designed for travel through the air.

words.ex: The bird's flying speed is very fast.
words.ex_cn: 这只鸟的飞行速度非常快。
words.en: The speed at which an aircraft travels through the air.

words.ex: The factory does food processing for supermarkets.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂为超市进行食品加工。
words.en: Food processing is the transformation of raw ingredients, by physical or chemical means into food, or of food into other forms. Food processing combines raw food ingredients to produce marketable food products that can be easily prepared and served by the consumer.

words.ex: The price of food and oil went up last month.
words.ex_cn: 上个月食品和石油的价格上涨了。
words.en: A phrase referring to essential commodities, typically used in economic or political contexts to denote basic necessities for survival and industry.

words.ex: The lion is at the top of the food chain.
words.ex_cn: 狮子处于食物链的顶端。
words.en: A food chain is a series of organisms each dependent on the next as a source of food.

words.tr: phrase. 集中（精力；注意力等）于
words.ex: He focuses on his homework every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上专心做作业。
words.en: to direct your attention or effort towards something specific

words.ex: He plays for a football club in his town.
words.ex_cn: 他效力于他家乡的一家足球俱乐部。
words.en: A football club is an organization that fields a team in football matches, often part of a league.

words.ex: He watches a football match every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每周末看一场足球比赛。
words.en: A football match is a game of football, especially one that is part of a competition.

words.ex: The bike is for sale.
words.ex_cn: 这辆自行车待售。
words.en: If something is for sale, it is being offered to people to buy.

words.ex: The forestry industry provides wood for houses.
words.ex_cn: 林业为房屋提供木材。
words.en: The sector of the economy concerned with the management, conservation, and utilization of forests and the resources they contain.

words.tr: phrase. 正式服装；礼服，指在正式场合穿着的庄重服饰
words.ex: He wears formal clothes to the wedding.
words.ex_cn: 他穿正装去参加婚礼。
words.en: Clothing that is suitable for formal occasions, such as suits for men and evening dresses for women.

words.ex: He stayed in the hotel for four nights.
words.ex_cn: 他在酒店住了四个晚上。
words.en: A period of four consecutive nights, typically used to specify the duration of an event or stay.

words.ex: He visits his grandparents every fortnight.
words.ex_cn: 他每两周拜访一次祖父母。
words.en: A fortnight is a period of two weeks.

words.tr: phrase. 大四学生；四年级学生
words.ex: He is a fourth-year student at the university.
words.ex_cn: 他是大学的四年级学生。
words.en: A student in their fourth year of study at a college or university.

words.tr: phrase. 可自由用于加热的；无需额外费用即可用于加热的
words.ex: The wood is free for heating.
words.ex_cn: 这木头可以自由用于加热。
words.en: Available for use as a heat source without any cost or charge.

words.ex: The library gives books free of charge.
words.ex_cn: 图书馆免费提供书籍。
words.en: If something is free of charge, it does not cost anything.

words.tr: phrase. 免费交通；免费运输
words.ex: The school provides free transportation for students.
words.ex_cn: 学校为学生提供免费交通。
words.en: Transportation services provided without charge to the user.

words.ex: He drinks fruit juice every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上喝果汁。
words.en: A drink made from the liquid obtained from fruits.

words.ex: He planted fruit trees in his backyard.
words.ex_cn: 他在后院种了果树。
words.en: Trees that bear fruit, cultivated for their edible produce.

words.tr: phrase. 功能与场所；职能与地点
words.ex: The functions and places of the park are designed for families.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园的功能与场所是为家庭设计的。
words.en: A set of roles or responsibilities and the locations where they are carried out.

words.ex: He works full time at a grocery store.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家杂货店全职工作。
words.en: Relating to or involving all the hours of a day or week that are normally used for work; working or operating the customary number of hours in a day, week, or month.

words.ex: Please write your full name on the form.
words.ex_cn: 请在表格上写下你的全名。
words.en: The complete name of a person, including their first name and surname, and sometimes any middle names.

words.tr: phrase. 毛皮贸易；皮草交易
words.ex: The fur trade was common in Canada long ago.
words.ex_cn: 很久以前，毛皮贸易在加拿大很普遍。
words.en: The exchange of animal pelts and furs for goods and money, especially between indigenous peoples and European settlers in North America.

words.tr: phrase. 继续教育；进修；深造
words.ex: He wants to pursue further education after high school.
words.ex_cn: 他想在高中毕业后继续深造。
words.en: Further education refers to education or training that is taken after secondary school, but not at degree level, often aimed at providing specific skills or qualifications.

words.tr: phrase. 花园大厅；常指用于活动或展览的园内建筑
words.ex: The wedding party was held in the garden hall.
words.ex_cn: 婚礼派对在花园大厅举行。
words.en: A large room or building used for social events, exhibitions, or gatherings, often with a garden or park-like setting attached or adjacent.

words.ex: He bought new garden tools to clean the yard.
words.ex_cn: 他买了新的园艺工具来清理院子。
words.en: Tools used in gardening for various tasks such as planting, pruning, and weeding.

words.ex: Wind turbines help in the generation of electricity.
words.ex_cn: 风力涡轮机有助于发电。
words.en: The process of producing electrical power from other forms of energy.

words.ex: He stopped at the gas station to fill his car.
words.ex_cn: 他停在加油站给车加油。
words.en: A gas station is a place where fuel is sold for motor vehicles.

words.ex: He will vote in the general election next month.
words.ex_cn: 他下个月将参加大选投票。
words.en: A general election is an election in which all or most members of a given political body are chosen. These are usually held for a nation's primary legislative body, as distinguished from by-elections and local elections.

words.tr: phrase. 通用英语；普通英语（指非专业性、基础性的英语）
words.ex: He is learning general English to talk with tourists.
words.ex_cn: 他正在学习通用英语以便与游客交流。
words.en: The everyday language used in casual conversation and general communication.

words.tr: phrase. 通用英语练习；日常英语技能的综合训练
words.ex: He does general English practice every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上进行通用英语练习。
words.en: A systematic approach to improving overall English language skills, including reading, writing, listening, and speaking, often through exercises and tests designed for learners at various proficiency levels.

words.tr: phrase. 整体健康状况；一般健康
words.ex: He eats well to improve his general health.
words.ex_cn: 他饮食健康以改善整体健康。
words.en: The overall condition of the body in relation to disease and wellness.

words.tr: phrase. 一般概念；总体想法；普遍观念
words.ex: He shared some general ideas about the project.
words.ex_cn: 他分享了关于这个项目的一些大致想法。
words.en: General ideas refer to concepts or thoughts that are not specific or detailed, but rather broad and applicable to many situations.

words.tr: phrase. 通用方法；普遍适用的方法
words.ex: He uses a general method to solve math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他用一种通用的方法来解决数学问题。
words.en: A standard or common approach used for a particular purpose or in a particular field.

words.tr: phrase. 普通科学；综合科学（涵盖物理、化学、生物等基础科学知识的综合性学科）
words.ex: He likes general science because it covers many topics.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢综合科学，因为它涵盖很多主题。
words.en: General science refers to the basic principles and concepts of science that are taught at a beginner level, covering a broad range of scientific disciplines without specializing in any particular area.

words.tr: phrase. 地理考察旅行；地理课外实地考察活动
words.ex: We went on a geography trip to the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 我们去山区进行了一次地理考察。
words.en: An educational or recreational journey to study or observe geographical features and locations.

words.tr: phrase. 地理位置；地理坐标
words.ex: The geographic location of the town is near the river.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇的地理位置在河边。
words.en: A geographic location refers to a specific point or area on the Earth's surface, determined by its latitude and longitude.

words.tr: phrase. 地理价值；指某一地区在地理位置、自然资源、战略地位等方面所具有的重要性或意义
words.ex: The island has little geographical value.
words.ex_cn: 这个岛屿几乎没有地理价值。
words.en: The importance or worth of a place or region in terms of its physical features, climate, resources, and its impact on human activities and the environment.

words.tr: 短语动词. 解雇某人；炒某人鱿鱼（通常指因工作表现不佳而被解雇）
words.ex: The boss gave him a sack for being late too often.
words.ex_cn: 老板因为他经常迟到而解雇了他。
words.en: To dismiss someone from their job, especially abruptly or unfairly.

words.tr: phrase. （对姓而言的）名字；（受洗礼时起的）教名
words.ex: His given name is Tom.
words.ex_cn: 他的名字是汤姆。
words.en: A given name is the name that is chosen for you at birth and is not your family name.

words.ex: The doctor gave a prescription for medicine.
words.ex_cn: 医生开了药方。
words.en: To issue a written order for medication or treatment from a doctor.

words.ex: He gave up smoking last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年戒烟了。
words.en: If you give up something, you stop doing it or having it.

words.tr: 短语动词. 发表演讲；做演讲
words.ex: He will give a speech tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天要发表演讲。
words.en: To deliver a formal address or talk to an audience.

words.tr: phrase. 给予确认；提供证明
words.ex: He will give confirmation after the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他会在会议后给予确认。
words.en: To provide assurance or verification that something is true or correct.

words.tr: 短语动词. 获得反馈；得到回应
words.ex: He gets feedback from his teacher after the test.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试后从老师那里得到反馈。
words.en: To receive information or opinions about one's performance or a product's effectiveness.

words.tr: phrase. 指南书；旅游手册；导览书
words.ex: He uses a guide book to find the museum.
words.ex_cn: 他用一本指南书找博物馆。
words.en: A guide book is a book that provides information for tourists or visitors about a place, including maps, recommendations, and tips.

words.tr: phrase. 有导游的观光旅游
words.ex: We took a guided tour of the museum.
words.ex_cn: 我们参加了博物馆的导览。
words.en: A guided tour is a tour of a place that is led by a guide who provides information about the place.

words.ex: He had to go to hospital after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他出事故后不得不住院。
words.en: To visit a hospital for medical treatment or consultation.

words.tr: phrase. 全球倾听；指在全球范围内关注和理解不同文化、观点和声音的能力或实践
words.ex: The company practices global listening to understand customers worldwide.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司通过全球倾听来了解世界各地的客户。
words.en: Global listening refers to the ability to understand and interpret spoken language from a wide range of accents, dialects, and speaking styles across the world.

words.ex: Global warming is making the Earth hotter.
words.ex_cn: 全球变暖正在让地球变得更热。
words.en: Global warming refers to the long-term increase in Earth's average surface temperature due to human activities, primarily fossil fuel burning, which increases heat-trapping greenhouse gas levels in Earth's atmosphere.

words.ex: He won a gold medal in the Olympics.
words.ex_cn: 他在奥运会上赢得了一枚金牌。
words.en: A gold medal is a medal made of gold, or a medal of the color gold, that is awarded as the highest prize in a competition or event.

words.tr: phrase. 金街；黄金街道（常用于地名或商业区名称）
words.ex: He walks down gold street every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都走过金街。
words.en: A street or area known for gold trading or jewelry shops.

words.tr: phrase. 高尔夫球杆；高尔夫俱乐部
words.ex: He bought a new golf club last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周买了一个新的高尔夫球杆。
words.en: A golf club is a long, thin, metal stick with a piece of wood or metal at one end that you use to hit the ball in golf. It is also a place where golf is played and where people who play golf can meet socially.

words.tr: phrase. 良好的视力；视觉敏锐
words.ex: He has good eyesight and can read small letters.
words.ex_cn: 他视力很好，能看清小字。
words.en: The ability to see well, without the need for glasses or contact lenses.

words.tr: phrase. + n. 好的鞋子；质量优良的鞋
words.ex: He wears good shoes to walk every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天穿好鞋子走路。
words.en: Footwear that is comfortable, durable, and appropriate for its intended use.

words.tr: phrase. 良好的转向性能；操控性好的
words.ex: The car has good steering.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车转向很好。
words.en: The ability to guide or control a vehicle or situation effectively and smoothly.

words.tr: phrase. 告别派对；送别聚会
words.ex: We had a goodbye party for Tom last Friday.
words.ex_cn: 我们上星期五为汤姆举办了告别派对。
words.en: A social gathering or celebration held to bid farewell to someone who is leaving.

words.ex: The government policy helps poor families.
words.ex_cn: 政府政策帮助贫困家庭。
words.en: A government policy is a course or principle of action adopted or proposed by a government.

words.ex: The school is government-funded.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校是由政府资助的。
words.en: Provided with financial resources by the government.

words.tr: phrase. 理解关键词；掌握关键词
words.ex: He can grasp keywords quickly in reading.
words.ex_cn: 他在阅读时能快速掌握关键词。
words.en: To understand the main ideas or essential points of a text or topic.

words.ex: He wants to go to graduate school after college.
words.ex_cn: 他想在大学毕业后读研究生院。
words.en: A graduate school is a school that awards advanced academic degrees (such as master's and doctoral degrees) with the general requirement that students must have earned a previous undergraduate (bachelor's) degree.

words.tr: phrase. 毕业公告；毕业通知（用于告知他人某人已完成学业并取得学位的正式通知或卡片）
words.ex: They sent graduation announcements to their friends and family.
words.ex_cn: 他们给朋友和家人寄了毕业通知。
words.en: Formal notices sent to inform people of a graduation ceremony.

words.tr: phrase. 木材的纹理图案；指木材中纤维的排列方式所形成的自然条纹或图案
words.ex: The grain pattern of timber shows natural lines.
words.ex_cn: 木材的纹理显示出自然的纹路。
words.en: The natural arrangement of lines and textures in wood, often visible on its surface.

words.tr: phrase. 木纹图案；纹理样式（指木材、皮革等材料表面的天然纹理走向和排列方式）
words.ex: The wood shows a beautiful grain pattern.
words.ex_cn: 木材显示出美丽的木纹。
words.en: The natural arrangement of the fibers in wood, which gives it a characteristic appearance.

words.tr: phrase. 非常喜欢的人或事物；特别喜爱的东西
words.ex: Dogs and cats are great favourites among children.
words.ex_cn: 狗和猫是孩子们最喜爱的动物。
words.en: Items or people that are very popular or well-liked by many.

words.tr: phrase. 一楼；底层；有利地位
words.ex: The shop is on the ground floor.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店在底层。
words.en: The ground floor of a building is the floor that is level or almost level with the ground outside.

words.ex: The city collects green waste every Friday.
words.ex_cn: 城市每周五收集绿色废弃物。
words.en: Green waste refers to organic waste that can be composted, such as garden waste, food waste, and plant material.

words.tr: phrase. 灰狗巴士（美国著名的长途客运汽车服务）
words.ex: He took a greyhound bus to New York.
words.ex_cn: 他乘坐灰狗巴士去了纽约。
words.en: A Greyhound bus is a type of long-distance bus service in the United States, known for its affordability and extensive network.

words.ex: They had a group discussion about homework.
words.ex_cn: 他们就作业进行了一次小组讨论。
words.en: A group discussion is a conversation among a group of people on a specific topic, where everyone is encouraged to contribute their ideas and opinions.

words.tr: phrase. 健身房会员资格；指加入健身房并享有使用其设施的权利
words.ex: He bought a gym membership last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周办了一张健身房会员卡。
words.en: A gym membership is a formal agreement which allows you to use the facilities of a gym.

words.ex: The hens lay eggs every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这些母鸡每天早上下蛋。
words.en: A hen is a female bird, especially of a domestic fowl.

words.ex: The high wind broke the tree branch.
words.ex_cn: 大风把树枝吹断了。
words.en: A strong current of air moving across the earth's surface.

words.ex: The myth says he is half human.
words.ex_cn: 这个传说说他是半人半神。
words.en: Partly human in nature or appearance; having both human and non-human qualities.

words.tr: phrase. 期中假期；学期中途的短假期（尤指英国学制中的寒假或暑假前的中期假期）
words.ex: We will have a break during half term.
words.ex_cn: 我们在学期中段会放假。
words.en: In British schools, a short holiday in the middle of each term.

words.tr: phrase. 蹄坚硬的动物，有硬蹄的哺乳动物，如牛、马、鹿等
words.ex: Horses are hard-hoofed animals.
words.ex_cn: 马是硬蹄动物。
words.en: Animals with hard hooves, typically referring to certain types of ungulates.

words.tr: phrase. 学生宿舍；大学宿舍
words.ex: He lives in the hall of residence near the library.
words.ex_cn: 他住在图书馆附近的宿舍楼里。
words.en: A hall of residence is a building where students live at a university or college.

words.tr: phrase. 学生宿舍；大学宿舍（供学生住宿的房屋或建筑群）
words.ex: The students live in the halls of residence near the campus.
words.ex_cn: 学生们住在校园附近的宿舍楼里。
words.en: Halls of residence are buildings where students live, typically provided by a university or college.

words.ex: He uses a hand pump to get water from the well.
words.ex_cn: 他用手动泵从井里取水。
words.en: A hand pump is a device that is operated by hand to move liquids or gases from one place to another, typically used to draw water from a well or to inflate tires.

words.tr: phrase. 手部受伤的；手骨折的
words.ex: The child had hands broken after falling from the swing.
words.ex_cn: 孩子从秋千上摔下来后，双手受伤了。
words.en: Injured or damaged hands, often implying they are unusable or painful.

words.tr: phrase. 使用；接近；可以利用
words.ex: Students have access to the library after school.
words.ex_cn: 学生放学后可以使用图书馆。
words.en: To have the right or opportunity to use or see something.

words.ex: Farmers use natural methods to kill harmful insects.
words.ex_cn: 农民使用自然方法杀死有害昆虫。
words.en: Insects that cause damage to crops, plants, or are a nuisance to humans and animals.

words.tr: phrase. 对人类有害的；对人有伤害作用的
words.ex: Smoking is harmful to humans.
words.ex_cn: 吸烟对人类有害。
words.en: Causing damage, injury, or negative effects to people.

words.ex: Runners have strong hearts and lungs.
words.ex_cn: 跑步者心脏和肺部很强健。
words.en: Possessing robust cardiovascular and respiratory systems, often implying physical resilience.

words.ex: He will have an operation next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周要做手术。
words.en: Undergo a medical procedure performed by a surgeon.

words.tr: 短语. 在地理学方面具有较高的地位或排名
words.ex: He has high rank in geography.
words.ex_cn: 他在地理方面排名很高。
words.en: Hold a senior position in the academic discipline of geography, such as a professor or department head.

words.tr: 短语. 拥有强大的财务实力；经济实力雄厚
words.ex: The company has strong financial muscles to expand globally.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司财力雄厚，能够全球扩张。
words.en: To possess significant financial resources or strength, enabling the ability to undertake large investments or withstand financial challenges.

words.ex: The help desk gave me a new password.
words.ex_cn: 帮助台给了我一个新密码。
words.en: A help desk is a service provided by a company or organization to give assistance and information, usually for users of its products or services.

words.ex: The headmaster welcomed the new students.
words.ex_cn: 校长欢迎新生。
words.en: A headmaster is the man who is the head teacher of a school.

words.ex: The head office is in New York.
words.ex_cn: 总部在纽约。
words.en: The main office or center of control of a business or organization, where the most important decisions are made.

words.ex: The government wants to improve healthcare for everyone.
words.ex_cn: 政府希望为所有人改善医疗保健。
words.en: Healthcare refers to the organized provision of medical care to individuals or a community.

words.ex: You should have a health check every year.
words.ex_cn: 你应该每年做一次健康检查。
words.en: A health check is a medical examination to test your general state of health.

words.ex: He goes to the health club every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都去健身俱乐部。
words.en: A health club is a place where people go to exercise and improve their physical fitness.

words.ex: He had a heart attack last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周心脏病发作。
words.en: A heart attack occurs when the flow of blood to the heart is blocked, usually by a blood clot.

words.ex: The baby's heartbeats are strong and steady.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿的心跳强劲而平稳。
words.en: The regular movement or sound made by the heart as it sends blood around the body.

words.ex: He has heart disease and must eat healthy food.
words.ex_cn: 他患有心脏病，必须吃健康的食物。
words.en: A condition that affects the heart and blood vessels, often leading to serious health issues.

words.ex: The heat indicator shows when the pan is hot.
words.ex_cn: 热指示器显示锅是否热了。
words.en: A device or scale used to measure and display temperature levels.

words.ex: The brush is made of horse hair.
words.ex_cn: 这把刷子是用马毛做的。
words.en: Horse hair refers to the hair from the mane or tail of a horse, used for various purposes such as in brushes, upholstery, and musical instruments.

words.ex: He enjoys horse riding every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每个周末都喜欢骑马。
words.en: The activity of riding a horse, especially for pleasure or sport.

words.tr: phrase. 草本茶；香草茶（不含茶叶的植物性冲泡饮品）
words.ex: She drinks herb tea every morning.
words.ex_cn: 她每天早上喝草本茶。
words.en: A drink made by pouring boiling water onto dried flowers, leaves, or herbs, which is then left to infuse.

words.ex: A herd of cattle grazes near the farm.
words.ex_cn: 一群牲畜在农场附近吃草。
words.en: A group of cattle kept together for breeding, milk, or meat production.

words.tr: phrase. 寄宿家庭；接待留学生的家庭
words.ex: I live with a host family in Canada.
words.ex_cn: 我在加拿大和一个寄宿家庭住在一起。
words.en: A family that provides accommodation and meals for a student or traveler, often in exchange for payment or as part of a cultural exchange program.

words.tr: phrase. 高等级；高职位；高级别
words.ex: He has a high rank in the army.
words.ex_cn: 他在军队中军衔很高。
words.en: A senior position or status in an organization or hierarchy.

words.tr: phrase. + n. 高度训练有素的员工
words.ex: The hospital has highly-trained staff.
words.ex_cn: 这家医院有训练有素的员工。
words.en: Employees who have received extensive and specialized training.

words.ex: He wants to go to higher education after high school.
words.ex_cn: 他想在高中后接受高等教育。
words.en: Higher education refers to the level of study that is undertaken at universities, colleges, and institutes of technology, beyond the level of secondary education.

words.tr: phrase. 高层建筑；高楼大厦
words.ex: Many high-rise buildings are in the city center.
words.ex_cn: 许多高楼位于市中心。
words.en: High-rise buildings are tall buildings, typically residential or office buildings, that have multiple floors. They are a common feature of urban landscapes, especially in cities where land is scarce.

words.ex: He bought a high-quality camera for his trip.
words.ex_cn: 他为旅行买了一台高质量的相机。
words.en: A high-quality camera refers to a camera that produces images of superior quality, often used by professionals or enthusiasts who require high-resolution and detailed photographs.

words.ex: They stayed in a honeymoon suite after their wedding.
words.ex_cn: 他们结婚后住在蜜月套房里。
words.en: A special hotel room or suite, often more luxurious and expensive, reserved for newlyweds on their honeymoon.

words.ex: We visited a historical museum last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我们上周末参观了一座历史博物馆。
words.en: A historical museum is a museum that collects, preserves, and displays objects of historical interest or significance.

words.tr: phrase. 学校的历史；教育机构的发展历程
words.ex: He is learning the history of school in his class.
words.ex_cn: 他正在课堂上学习学校的历史。
words.en: The record of events and development of a school over time.

words.ex: He found old historical maps in the library.
words.ex_cn: 他在图书馆找到了旧的历史地图。
words.en: Maps that depict places, boundaries, or events from past eras, used for study or reference.

words.ex: He watches horror films on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他周末看恐怖电影。
words.en: A horror film is a movie that seeks to elicit fear or disgust in its audience for entertainment purposes.

words.tr: phrase. 热狗（面包夹熏红肠）
words.ex: He eats a hot dog at the park.
words.ex_cn: 他在公园里吃热狗。
words.en: A hot dog is a cooked sausage, traditionally grilled or steamed and served in a sliced bun as a sandwich.

words.ex: He ate a hot meal after work.
words.ex_cn: 他下班后吃了一顿热饭。
words.en: A hot meal is food that has been cooked and is served warm, providing comfort and nourishment.

words.ex: The hothouse effect is making the Earth hotter.
words.ex_cn: 温室效应正在使地球变暖。
words.en: The hothouse effect refers to the trapping of the sun's warmth in a planet's lower atmosphere due to the greater transparency of the atmosphere to visible radiation from the sun than to infrared radiation emitted from the planet's surface.

words.tr: phrase. 酒店犯罪；发生在酒店内的违法行为
words.ex: The hotel crime was reported to the police.
words.ex_cn: 这家酒店的犯罪行为被报告给了警方。
words.en: Criminal activities that occur within or are related to hotels.

words.ex: They go to the forest to hunt for food.
words.ex_cn: 他们去森林里寻找食物。
words.en: To search for something or someone very carefully and thoroughly.

words.ex: I need to buy house insurance.
words.ex_cn: 我需要购买房屋保险。
words.en: Insurance that provides compensation for damage or loss to a house and its contents.

words.ex: I lost my house key yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 我昨天弄丢了我家的钥匙。
words.en: A house key is a key that is used to unlock the door of a house.

words.tr: phrase. 住房机构；负责提供或管理住房的政府或私人机构
words.ex: He called the housing agency to find a flat.
words.ex_cn: 他打电话给住房机构找一套公寓。
words.en: An organization that provides housing or manages housing projects, often for those in need.

words.ex: Human beings need water to live.
words.ex_cn: 人类需要水来生存。
words.en: Human beings are members of the species Homo sapiens, characterized by their superior intelligence, articulate speech, and upright stance.

words.tr: phrase. 供人类食用；人类消费
words.ex: This water is safe for human consumption.
words.ex_cn: 这种水适合人类饮用。
words.en: The act of consuming goods and services by humans.

words.tr: phrase. 人类种族；人类整体
words.ex: The human race must protect the environment.
words.ex_cn: 人类必须保护环境。
words.en: The human race refers to all the people who live on the Earth, considered as a group.

words.tr: phrase. 人力资源；人事部门
words.ex: The company hires new workers through human resources.
words.ex_cn: 公司通过人力资源部门招聘新员工。
words.en: Human resources is the department of a company that deals with the hiring, administration, and training of staff.

words.tr: phrase. 冰上冰壶运动；在冰面上进行的投掷石壶的团队竞技项目
words.ex: He loves playing ice curling in winter.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在冬天玩冰上冰壶运动。
words.en: A sport played on ice, in which heavy stones with handles are slid towards a target area which is segmented into concentric circles.

words.ex: He put an ice pack on his knee after the injury.
words.ex_cn: 他在膝盖受伤后敷了一个冰袋。
words.en: A bag filled with ice or a gel that can be frozen, used to cool an injury or to keep food cold.

words.tr: phrase. 滑冰；溜冰（指在冰面上穿着冰鞋滑行的运动或活动）
words.ex: He loves ice skating in winter.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在冬天滑冰。
words.en: the activity or sport of moving on ice using ice skates

words.ex: He lost his identities when he moved to a new country.
words.ex_cn: 当他搬到一个新国家时，他失去了自己的身份。
words.en: The fact of being who or what a person or thing is; the characteristics determining who or what a person or thing is.

words.ex: He showed his identity card at the airport.
words.ex_cn: 他在机场出示了他的身份证。
words.en: An identity card is a card with a person's name, photograph, date of birth, and other information on it that proves who they are.

words.tr: phrase. 非法利润；违法所得
words.ex: He was fined for making illegal profits.
words.ex_cn: 他因获得非法利润而被罚款。
words.en: Profits obtained through activities that are against the law.

words.tr: phrase. 在可见视野中；处于可见范围
words.ex: The bird is in visible view near the tree.
words.ex_cn: 这只鸟在树附近可见的视野中。
words.en: Within sight; able to be seen.

words.ex: The immune system fights germs in the body.
words.ex_cn: 免疫系统在体内对抗细菌。
words.en: The immune system is the body's defense against infectious organisms and other invaders. Through a series of steps called the immune response, the immune system attacks organisms and substances that invade body systems and cause disease.

words.ex: Please pay in advance.
words.ex_cn: 请提前付款。
words.en: Before a particular time, or before doing a particular thing.

words.ex: Students work in chemistry lab every week.
words.ex_cn: 学生们每周在化学实验室做实验。
words.en: In a laboratory setting where chemical experiments are conducted.

words.tr: phrase. 在原地兜圈子；毫无进展地；反复做同样的事
words.ex: He walked in circles around the house.
words.ex_cn: 他在房子周围转圈。
words.en: If you say that someone is going around in circles, you mean that they are not achieving anything because they keep coming back to the same point or problem.

words.tr: phrase. 在流通中；在从事社交活动中；在书库里
words.ex: The coins are in circulation now.
words.ex_cn: 这些硬币现在正在流通。
words.en: If something such as money is in circulation, it is being used by the public. If an idea or story is in circulation, it is being passed around among a group of people.

words.ex: The fisherman sails on the Indian Ocean.
words.ex_cn: 渔夫在印度洋上航行。
words.en: The Indian Ocean is the third largest of the world's oceanic divisions, covering approximately 20% of the water on the Earth's surface. It is bounded by Asia to the north, Africa to the west, Australia to the east, and the Southern Ocean to the south.

words.ex: He ignored the incoming calls.
words.ex_cn: 他忽略了来电。
words.en: Incoming calls refer to telephone calls that are being received by a person or an organization.

words.tr: phrase. 独立日（美国国庆日，7月4日）
words.ex: They watch fireworks on Independence Day.
words.ex_cn: 他们在独立日观看烟花。
words.en: Independence Day is a day on which a country celebrates its independence from another country that used to rule it.

words.tr: phrase. 工业材料；用于制造、建筑或生产的原材料或半成品
words.ex: The factory uses industrial material to make machines.
words.ex_cn: 工厂使用工业材料来制造机器。
words.en: A substance used in manufacturing or industrial processes.

words.tr: phrase. 信息牌；公告栏；指示牌
words.ex: The information board shows the train schedule.
words.ex_cn: 信息牌显示了火车时刻表。
words.en: A board that displays information, such as schedules, notices, or announcements, in public places like train stations, airports, or schools.

words.tr: phrase. 信息视频；介绍性视频
words.ex: He watched an information video about recycling.
words.ex_cn: 他看了一段关于回收利用的科普视频。
words.en: A video that provides facts, data, or explanations.

words.ex: He asked for help at the information desk.
words.ex_cn: 他在信息台寻求帮助。
words.en: A place in a public building where you can go to get information.

words.ex: The website has an information page for visitors.
words.ex_cn: 这个网站有一个给访客的信息页面。
words.en: A section of a document or website containing factual details.

words.tr: phrase. 信息行业；信息产业
words.ex: The information sector grows fast in this country.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家的信息产业增长很快。
words.en: The part of the economy that involves the production, processing, and distribution of information.

words.ex: The farmers live in an inland region far from the sea.
words.ex_cn: 这些农民住在远离海洋的内陆地区。
words.en: An inland region refers to an area that is located away from the coast or any borders, often characterized by its geographical and climatic conditions.

words.tr: phrase. 初始迁移；首次迁徙；最初移民
words.ex: The initial migration happened in spring.
words.ex_cn: 最初的迁徙发生在春天。
words.en: The first movement of people from one place to settle in another.

words.tr: phrase. 疫苗注射；接种疫苗
words.ex: The nurse gave an injection of vaccine to the child.
words.ex_cn: 护士给小孩注射了疫苗。
words.en: The administration of a vaccine into the body, typically via a needle.

words.tr: n. 研究所；学院（institute 的复数形式）；
words.ex: The government funds several institutes for scientific research.
words.ex_cn: 政府资助了几个科学研究机构。
words.en: An institute is an organization set up to do a particular type of work, especially research or teaching. It can also refer to the act of starting something such as a system or rule.

words.ex: The institutions help students learn math.
words.ex_cn: 这些机构帮助学生学习数学。
words.en: An institution is a large important organization such as a university, church, or bank.

words.ex: The cabin is in a place where insects haunting the woods at night.
words.ex_cn: 小木屋位于夜晚有虫蚊出没的树林里。
words.en: Insects that are frequently present in a place, often causing annoyance or damage.

words.ex: The instructors taught the kids how to swim.
words.ex_cn: 教练们教孩子们如何游泳。
words.en: An instructor is a person whose job is to teach a practical skill or subject.

words.tr: phrase. 手册中的说明；手册指引
words.ex: The instruction of handbook shows how to use the machine.
words.ex_cn: 手册中的说明展示了如何使用这台机器。
words.en: The act of teaching or explaining the contents and use of a manual or guidebook.

words.ex: He drinks instant coffee every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上喝速溶咖啡。
words.en: Instant coffee is a beverage derived from brewed coffee beans that enables people to quickly prepare hot coffee by adding hot water or milk to the powder or concentrated liquid and stirring.

words.tr: phrase. 人际交往能力；人际沟通技巧
words.ex: He has good interpersonal skills.
words.ex_cn: 他有良好的人际交往能力。
words.en: The ability to communicate or interact well with other people.

words.tr: phrase. 保险公司；承保各类风险并收取保费的企业机构
words.ex: Insurance companies pay money when you have an accident.
words.ex_cn: 当你发生事故时，保险公司会支付钱。
words.en: Insurance companies are businesses that provide insurance policies to individuals or other businesses, covering risks such as accidents, illness, or property damage in exchange for premiums.

words.ex: He works for an insurance company.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家保险公司工作。
words.en: A company that provides insurance policies to individuals or businesses to protect against financial loss.

words.tr: phrase. 强化课程；集中培训班
words.ex: He took an intensive course to learn English quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他参加了一个密集课程来快速学习英语。
words.en: An intensive course is a course of study that covers a lot of material in a short period of time, requiring a high level of effort and concentration from the students.

words.tr: phrase. 深入研究；强化学习；密集式学习
words.ex: He did intensive study for the exam last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周为考试进行了密集学习。
words.en: Intensive study refers to a concentrated and thorough examination or analysis of a subject or topic.

words.ex: The library offers an inter-library service to borrow books from other libraries.
words.ex_cn: 图书馆提供馆际服务，可以从其他图书馆借书。
words.en: A service that allows libraries to borrow books and other materials from each other.

words.tr: phrase. 中级课程；中等水平课程
words.ex: He is taking an intermediate course in math.
words.ex_cn: 他正在上一门中级数学课程。
words.en: A course of study or training that is between beginner and advanced levels.

words.ex: The bird knows when to fly south by its internal clock.
words.ex_cn: 鸟通过它的生物钟知道何时飞往南方。
words.en: An internal clock is a natural mechanism within living organisms that regulates the timing of physiological processes and behaviors, such as sleep cycles, in accordance with the environment.

words.tr: phrase. 国际俱乐部；跨国俱乐部
words.ex: He joins the international club to meet people from other countries.
words.ex_cn: 他加入国际俱乐部，以结识来自其他国家的人。
words.en: An international club is an organization that brings together people from different countries to promote cultural exchange and understanding.

words.tr: phrase. 国际之夜；国际交流晚会（通常指展示多国文化、美食或艺术的社交活动）
words.ex: We had an international evening at school.
words.ex_cn: 我们在学校举办了一场国际之夜。
words.en: An event held in the evening that celebrates or showcases the cultures, traditions, and cuisines of different countries, often featuring performances, food, and displays from around the world.

words.tr: phrase. 国际学生卡；供留学生在海外享受交通、住宿、景点折扣的官方身份证明
words.ex: He uses his international student card to get discounts.
words.ex_cn: 他用他的国际学生证享受折扣。
words.en: An international student card is a form of identification that is recognized around the world, allowing students to prove their status and access various discounts and benefits.

words.ex: The international student lives in the dormitory.
words.ex_cn: 这位国际学生住在宿舍里。
words.en: A student from a country other than the one in which they are studying.

words.tr: phrase. 互联网接入；上网权限；网络连接
words.ex: He has internet access at home.
words.ex_cn: 他在家有网络访问。
words.en: The ability to connect to the internet, allowing users to browse websites, send emails, and use online services.

words.ex: He uses the internet cafe to check his email.
words.ex_cn: 他使用网吧来查看他的邮件。
words.en: An internet cafe is a place where you can pay to use a computer with internet access, usually by the hour.

words.ex: The internet system works slowly today.
words.ex_cn: 今天的互联网系统运行得很慢。
words.en: An internet system refers to the global system of interconnected computer networks that use the Internet protocol suite (TCP/IP) to link devices worldwide.

words.ex: The investigators found the truth quickly.
words.ex_cn: 调查人员很快找到了真相。
words.en: People who investigate something, especially to find out the truth about it.

words.tr: phrase. 可灌溉土地；具备灌溉条件的耕地
words.ex: The farmers planted crops on irrigable land.
words.ex_cn: 农民们在可灌溉的土地上种植庄稼。
words.en: Land that is capable of being irrigated to support agricultural production.

words.tr: phrase. 偏僻的地点；与世隔绝之处；孤立的小点
words.ex: He sat in an isolated spot by the lake.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在湖边一个偏僻的地方。
words.en: A place that is far from others and not easily reached or accessed.

words.tr: phrase. 求职面试；工作面试；招聘面谈
words.ex: He will have a job interview tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天将参加一场工作面试。
words.en: A job interview is a formal meeting in which an applicant is asked questions to determine their suitability for a particular job.

words.ex: The shark opened its jaws wide.
words.ex_cn: 鲨鱼张开了它的颚。
words.en: The jaws are the two bones in your head between which your teeth are fixed, or the parts at the sides of your mouth that you can move when you eat or speak.

words.tr: phrase. 联合会员资格；共同会员身份
words.ex: They have a joint membership at the gym.
words.ex_cn: 他们有一张共同的健身房会员卡。
words.en: Joint membership refers to the status or condition of being a member of two or more organizations, clubs, or groups simultaneously, often with shared benefits or privileges.

words.ex: The keepers feed the animals every morning.
words.ex_cn: 饲养员每天早上喂动物。
words.en: A keeper is someone who is responsible for looking after something, especially something valuable or important.

words.ex: He tried to jump the queue, but others shouted at him.
words.ex_cn: 他想插队，但其他人对他大声喊叫。
words.en: To move ahead of others in a line or sequence without waiting for one's turn.

words.tr: phrase. 插队；加塞儿；不按顺序抢先
words.ex: He jumped the line at the ticket counter.
words.ex_cn: 他在售票处插队了。
words.en: To move ahead of others in a queue or line without waiting for one's turn, often considered rude or unfair.

words.ex: Killer whales swim in the ocean near Alaska.
words.ex_cn: 虎鲸在阿拉斯加附近的海洋中游动。
words.en: Killer whales, also known as orcas, are large marine mammals that are the largest members of the dolphin family. They are found in all oceans, from the frigid Arctic and Antarctic regions to tropical seas.

words.ex: He watches kungfu film every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每周末看功夫电影。
words.en: A genre of film that features martial arts as a central theme or plot device, often showcasing the physical prowess and skill of the characters.

words.tr: phrase. 巨藻林；海藻森林（由大型褐藻形成的密集水下生态系统）
words.ex: Fish live in the kelp forest near the shore.
words.ex_cn: 鱼生活在靠近岸边的海藻森林里。
words.en: A kelp forest is an underwater area with a high density of kelp. They are recognized as one of the most productive and dynamic ecosystems on Earth.

words.tr: phrase. 关键方法；主要途径；核心手段
words.ex: The key approach is to practice every day.
words.ex_cn: 关键的方法是每天练习。
words.en: A fundamental or primary method for dealing with a problem or situation.

words.tr: phrase. 接待处的钥匙；接待的关键
words.ex: This card is the key to reception, please return it when you leave.
words.ex_cn: 这张卡是接待处的钥匙，请离开时归还。
words.en: The essential factor or solution for gaining entry or acceptance.

words.ex: He wrote down the keywords for his essay.
words.ex_cn: 他写下了论文的关键词。
words.en: A word or concept of great significance.

words.tr: phrase. 把某人开除；解雇某人
words.ex: He kicked him out of work because he was late.
words.ex_cn: 他因为他迟到而把他赶出了工作。
words.en: To dismiss someone from their job.

words.tr: phrase. 特大号床（通常宽 76 英寸/193 厘米，长 80 英寸/203 厘米）
words.ex: He sleeps on a king-sized bed.
words.ex_cn: 他睡在一张特大号床上。
words.en: A king-sized bed is a large bed that is wider and longer than a standard double bed, providing more space for sleeping.

words.tr: phrase. 国王套房；豪华套房（通常指酒店中最高级的套房，配有独立卧室、起居室及高端设施）
words.ex: They stayed in the king's suite at the hotel.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在酒店的国王套房里。
words.en: A luxurious, private set of rooms reserved for a monarch or person of high rank.

words.ex: The knives on the table are sharp.
words.ex_cn: 桌上的刀很锋利。
words.en: Knives are tools or weapons with a blade and a handle, used for cutting or as a weapon.

words.tr: phrase. 厨房餐桌；厨房用桌
words.ex: I put the food on the kitchen table.
words.ex_cn: 我把食物放在厨房餐桌上。
words.en: A kitchen table is a table located in the kitchen, typically used for preparing and eating meals.

words.ex: She washed the kitchen utensils after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 她晚饭后洗了厨房用具。
words.en: Tools or implements used in the kitchen for preparing, cooking, and serving food.

words.ex: The lamps in the room are bright.
words.ex_cn: 房间里的灯很亮。
words.en: A lamp is a device that produces light by the flow of electrical current, or by burning oil or gas.

words.tr: phrase. 听力文本；听力录音的文字稿
words.ex: The teacher played the listening transcript for the students.
words.ex_cn: 老师给学生们播放了听力文本。
words.en: A written record of what was said during a spoken conversation or presentation.

words.tr: phrase. 实验室设备；实验器材
words.ex: The teacher checked the lab equipment before the experiment.
words.ex_cn: 老师在实验前检查了实验室设备。
words.en: Lab equipment refers to the various tools and machines used in a laboratory setting for conducting experiments and research.

words.tr: phrase. 缺乏信心；没有自信
words.ex: He lacks confidence when speaking English.
words.ex_cn: 他讲英语时缺乏自信。
words.en: The state of not having enough belief in one's abilities or qualities.

words.ex: He avoids speaking because of lack of confidence.
words.ex_cn: 他因为缺乏自信而不敢说话。
words.en: The state of not having confidence in oneself or one's abilities.

words.ex: The invention of the wheel was a landmark in human history.
words.ex_cn: 轮子的发明是人类历史上的一个里程碑。
words.en: A landmark is a building or feature of a landscape that is easily seen and recognized from a distance, especially one that enables someone to establish their location.

words.tr: phrase. 大型滑梯；大型幻灯片；大型滑动
words.ex: The child loves to go down the large slide.
words.ex_cn: 孩子喜欢从大滑梯上滑下来。
words.en: A large, transparent sheet used with an overhead projector to display images or information.

words.ex: The government built large-scale housing for poor families.
words.ex_cn: 政府为贫困家庭建设了大规模住房。
words.en: Large-scale housing refers to the development of a significant number of residential units or housing projects, typically undertaken to meet the housing needs of a large population.

words.ex: The students walk to the lecture hall for class.
words.ex_cn: 学生们走向礼堂上课。
words.en: A large room in a college or university where lectures are given.

words.tr: phrase. 激光打印；利用激光束在感光鼓上形成图像并转印到纸张上的打印技术
words.ex: He uses laser printing for his documents.
words.ex_cn: 他用激光打印他的文件。
words.en: A method of printing in which a laser beam is used to produce an image on a photosensitive drum, which is then transferred to paper using toner.

words.tr: phrase. 最后但同样重要的
words.ex: Last but not least, don't forget to bring your ID.
words.ex_cn: 最后但同样重要的是，别忘了带你的身份证。
words.en: used to say that the last person or thing mentioned is as important as the others

words.ex: His last name is Smith.
words.ex_cn: 他的姓是史密斯。
words.en: Your last name is the name that you share with other members of your family. In English-speaking countries, it is usually at the end of your full name.

words.ex: The lawyers are helping the client in court.
words.ex_cn: 律师们正在法庭上帮助客户。
words.en: A lawyer is a person who practices or studies law, especially (in the UK) a solicitor or a barrister or (in the US) an attorney.

words.tr: phrase. 简历的排版；简历的布局
words.ex: He improved the layout of his resume for the job interview.
words.ex_cn: 他为了求职面试改进了简历的排版。
words.en: The structured arrangement and organization of sections in a professional CV or résumé.

words.tr: phrase. 学习策略；学习方法
words.ex: He uses good learning strategies to remember new words.
words.ex_cn: 他使用好的学习策略来记住新单词。
words.en: Methods or techniques used to acquire knowledge effectively.

words.ex: Different students have different learning styles.
words.ex_cn: 不同的学生有不同的学习方式。
words.en: Learning styles refer to the preferred ways in which individuals absorb, process, comprehend, and retain information.

words.tr: phrase. 休闲服；便装；适合非正式场合穿着的舒适衣物
words.ex: He wears leisure wear on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他在周末穿休闲服。
words.en: Clothes designed to be worn in informal or casual settings, emphasizing comfort and ease.

words.ex: He enjoys leisure activities on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他周末喜欢从事休闲活动。
words.en: Leisure activities refer to activities done for enjoyment when one is not working.

words.tr: phrase. 成熟程度；成熟度水平
words.ex: He shows a high level of maturity for his age.
words.ex_cn: 他这个年纪表现出很高的成熟度。
words.en: The stage of development or growth that something or someone has reached, indicating how developed or advanced they are.

words.ex: I have a lemon tree in my garden.
words.ex_cn: 我的花园里有一棵柠檬树。
words.en: A lemon tree is a small evergreen tree native to Asia, known for its yellow fruit which is used for its juice and zest in cooking and baking.

words.ex: He asked his teacher for a letter of recommendation.
words.ex_cn: 他请老师写一封推荐信。
words.en: A letter of recommendation is a letter in which the writer describes the qualities, skills, and achievements of a person they know well, with the purpose of supporting that person's application for a job, admission to a school, or other opportunities.

words.ex: He uses his library card to borrow books.
words.ex_cn: 他用他的借书证借书。
words.en: A library card is a card issued by a library to individuals, entitling them to borrow books and other materials.

words.tr: phrase. 图书馆资源；馆藏资源；图书馆可提供的资料与服务
words.ex: The library resource helps students find books.
words.ex_cn: 图书馆资源帮助学生找到书籍。
words.en: Materials or services available in a library for research or study.

words.ex: He wants to study life science in university.
words.ex_cn: 他想在大学学习生命科学。
words.en: Life science is a branch of science that deals with the study of living organisms and their vital processes.

words.tr: phrase. 生活周期；存在周期
words.ex: The life cycle of a butterfly includes egg, larva, pupa, and adult.
words.ex_cn: 蝴蝶的生活周期包括卵、幼虫、蛹和成虫。
words.en: The series of changes that a living thing goes through from the beginning of its life until death.

words.tr: phrase. 预期寿命；平均寿命
words.ex: Life expectancy has increased in many countries.
words.ex_cn: 许多国家的预期寿命已经增加。
words.en: The average period that a person may expect to live.

words.tr: phrase. 人寿保险；人身保险
words.ex: He bought life insurance for his family.
words.ex_cn: 他为家人买了人寿保险。
words.en: Life insurance is a contract between an insurance policy holder and an insurer, where the insurer promises to pay a designated beneficiary a sum of money in exchange for a premium, upon the death of an insured person.

words.tr: n. 灯；“light”的复数； v. 点燃；照亮；
words.ex: The lights in the room are bright.
words.ex_cn: 房间里的灯很亮。
words.en: Plural form of light, which refers to the natural agent that stimulates sight and makes things visible.

words.ex: The website links to a video tutorial.
words.ex_cn: 这个网站连接到一个视频教程。
words.en: A connection or reference to something else, often a website or document.

words.ex: He likes to watch literary film on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在周末看文艺电影。
words.en: A literary film is a film that is based on a literary work, such as a novel, play, or short story, and often emphasizes narrative complexity, character development, and thematic depth.

words.tr: phrase. 标题列表；目录标题；章节标题清单
words.ex: The book has a list of headings at the start.
words.ex_cn: 这本书开头有一份标题列表。
words.en: A series of titles or headings used to organize content or navigate a text.

words.tr: phrase. 目标清单；目的列表；任务目标一览
words.ex: He wrote a list of objectives for the project.
words.ex_cn: 他为这个项目写了一份目标清单。
words.en: A set of goals or aims that outline what is to be achieved.

words.ex: The students went to the lecture theatre for biology class.
words.ex_cn: 学生们去讲堂上生物课。
words.en: A large room or hall used for lectures, typically with tiered seating for the audience.

words.tr: phrase. 生活费用；日常开销
words.ex: The living cost in the city is high.
words.ex_cn: 城市里的生活成本很高。
words.en: The amount of money needed to sustain a certain standard of living, including basics such as housing, food, taxes, and healthcare.

words.tr: phrase. 生活费用；日常开销
words.ex: He works part-time to cover his living expenses.
words.ex_cn: 他做兼职来支付生活开销。
words.en: The costs incurred by a person or family for the necessities of life, such as food, shelter, and clothing.

words.ex: He took out two loans to buy a car.
words.ex_cn: 他贷了两笔款来买一辆车。
words.en: Loans are sums of money that are borrowed, often from a bank, and are expected to be paid back with interest.

words.tr: phrase. 本地徒步俱乐部；当地健行社团
words.ex: He joins the local walking club every Saturday.
words.ex_cn: 他每个星期六都参加当地的步行俱乐部。
words.en: An organization or group in the community that arranges group walks.

words.ex: He loves learning local history in his town.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢了解自己小镇的本地历史。
words.en: Local history refers to the historical study of a particular community, area, or region, often focusing on the people, events, and developments that have shaped its identity over time.

words.tr: phrase. 地方工业；本地产业
words.ex: The local industry makes toys for children.
words.ex_cn: 当地工业为儿童制造玩具。
words.en: Local industry refers to the manufacturing or production sector within a specific area, contributing to the local economy.

words.tr: phrase. 本地宠物店；当地宠物商店
words.ex: I bought a fish from the local pet shop.
words.ex_cn: 我从当地的宠物店买了一条鱼。
words.en: A shop in the nearby area that sells pets, food, and accessories.

words.tr: phrase. 本地产品；土特产；地方特产
words.ex: He bought a local product at the market.
words.ex_cn: 他在市场上买了一件本地产品。
words.en: A product that is made or grown in the local area, often emphasizing its origin and quality.

words.ex: The local resident walks his dog every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这位当地居民每天早上都遛狗。
words.en: A local resident is someone who lives in a particular area or community.

words.tr: phrase. 本地学校；当地学校
words.ex: He walks to the local school every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上步行去附近的学校。
words.en: An educational institution in the immediate community or area.

words.tr: phrase. 本地商店；社区小店
words.ex: I buy milk from the local shop every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我每天早上从附近的商店买牛奶。
words.en: A local shop is a retail establishment that is owned and operated locally, often serving the immediate community with a variety of goods and services.

words.tr: phrase. 本地学生；当地学生
words.ex: The local student walks to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 这名本地学生每天步行上学。
words.en: A student who is from or lives in the area near the institution they attend, as opposed to an international or out-of-state student.

words.ex: The local tribes live near the forest.
words.ex_cn: 当地的部落住在森林附近。
words.en: Indigenous communities living in a specific geographical area.

words.ex: We stopped at the lookout points to see the valley.
words.ex_cn: 我们在观景点停了下来，看山谷。
words.en: Places from which a wide view can be seen, often for observation.

words.ex: Please lock all windows before you leave the house.
words.ex_cn: 离开房子前请锁上所有窗户。
words.en: To secure all windows by fastening them to prevent entry or movement.

words.ex: He took a long-term loan to buy a house.
words.ex_cn: 他申请了一笔长期贷款来买房。
words.en: A long-term loan is a type of loan that is scheduled to be repaid over a period of more than one year, typically used for major purchases or investments.

words.tr: phrase. 土壤流失；土壤丧失
words.ex: The farm suffered loss of soil after heavy rain.
words.ex_cn: 这场大雨之后，农场出现了土壤流失。
words.en: The erosion or removal of the top layer of earth, often due to water, wind, or farming practices.

words.ex: He loses temper when he hears loud noises.
words.ex_cn: 他听到大声噪音时会发脾气。
words.en: If you lose your temper, you become very angry.

words.ex: The teacher used a loudspeaker to talk to the students.
words.ex_cn: 老师用扬声器对学生们讲话。
words.en: A loudspeaker is a piece of electronic equipment that makes sounds louder so that they can be heard at a greater distance.

words.ex: They watched a romantic love story on TV last night.
words.ex_cn: 他们昨晚在电视上看了一个爱情片。
words.en: A narrative about the romantic involvement between characters, often focusing on their emotional journey and the development of their relationship.

words.ex: The child has low nutrition because he eats few vegetables.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子营养不良，因为他吃很少的蔬菜。
words.en: A state where the body does not receive enough nutrients to maintain health.

words.tr: phrase. 低频噪声；低频噪音
words.ex: The machine produces low-frequency noise at night.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器在晚上产生低频噪音。
words.en: Noise that is characterized by low frequencies, typically below 200 Hz.

words.ex: He lives in a low income family.
words.ex_cn: 他住在一个低收入家庭。
words.en: Low income refers to a level of earnings that is significantly below the average income, often making it difficult for individuals or families to meet their basic needs.

words.ex: He reads magazines and journals every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每个周末都读杂志和期刊。
words.en: Periodical publications, with 'magazines' typically being general interest and 'journals' being academic or professional.

words.tr: phrase. 魔法动物；具有神奇能力的动物；奇幻生物
words.ex: Children love stories about magical animals.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们喜欢关于神奇动物的故事。
words.en: Creatures with supernatural or extraordinary abilities, often found in fantasy literature and folklore.

words.tr: phrase. 机器与机器人；泛指各类机械装置及自动化设备
words.ex: Machines and robots help people do hard work.
words.ex_cn: 机器和机器人帮助人们做繁重的工作。
words.en: Mechanical devices, with 'machines' being general-purpose and 'robots' being programmable, often autonomous, machines.

words.ex: He practices martial art every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上练习武术。
words.en: A martial art is one of the methods of fighting, often without weapons, that come from the Far East, for example kung fu, karate, or judo.

words.ex: The maid cleans the house every morning.
words.ex_cn: 女仆每天早上打扫房子。
words.en: A maid is a woman who works as a servant in a hotel or in someone's home.

words.ex: I check my mails every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我每天早上查看我的邮件。
words.en: Mails refer to letters, packages, or other items sent through the postal system. It can also mean the act of sending such items.

words.ex: He joined the mailing list for news updates.
words.ex_cn: 他加入了获取新闻更新的邮件列表。
words.en: A mailing list is a collection of names and addresses used by an individual or an organization to send material to multiple recipients.

words.tr: phrase. 主修护理学；以护理为专业
words.ex: He plans to major in nursing at university.
words.ex_cn: 他计划在大学主修护理。
words.en: To choose nursing as one's main subject of study in college or university.

words.ex: He ordered steak as the main course.
words.ex_cn: 他点了牛排作为主菜。
words.en: The main course is the principal dish of a meal, usually following the starter or soup.

words.tr: phrase. 主要入口；正门入口
words.ex: The main entrance is open from 6 a.m. to 10 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 主入口早上6点到晚上10点开放。
words.en: The main entrance is the principal entrance to a building or area, often designed for the primary flow of people.

words.ex: The children are playing in the main hall.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们正在主厅里玩耍。
words.en: The principal or largest room in a building, used for gatherings or events.

words.ex: She cooks dinner in the main kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 她在主厨房做晚饭。
words.en: The primary or central area in a home where food is prepared and cooked.

words.tr: phrase. 主图书馆；总图书馆
words.ex: He reads books in the main library.
words.ex_cn: 他在主图书馆读书。
words.en: The principal library of an institution, especially a university, where the majority of the collection is housed.

words.ex: I will make an appointment with the doctor tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我明天要预约医生。
words.en: To arrange a meeting or consultation at a specific time.

words.ex: They make plans to go to the park.
words.ex_cn: 他们制定去公园的计划。
words.en: To think about and decide what you are going to do or how you are going to do something.

words.tr: phrase. 洞穴地图；洞穴示意图
words.ex: The explorer used a map of cave to find the hidden tunnel.
words.ex_cn: 探险家使用洞穴地图找到了隐藏的隧道。
words.en: A visual representation or diagram showing the layout and passages of a cave system.

words.tr: phrase. 更好地管理时间；更有效地安排时间
words.ex: He wants to manage time better to finish his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他想更好地管理时间来完成作业。
words.en: To improve one's ability to organize and allocate time efficiently to complete tasks.

words.ex: The manmade dam holds back the river water.
words.ex_cn: 这个人造水坝拦住了河水。
words.en: A manmade dam is a barrier constructed to hold back water and raise its level, forming a reservoir used to generate electricity or as a water supply.

words.tr: phrase. 人工设施；手工设备；手动装置
words.ex: The old building has manual facilities like hand pumps.
words.ex_cn: 这栋老建筑有手动设施，比如手压泵。
words.en: Facilities or equipment that require physical effort or skill to operate, as opposed to automated ones.

words.tr: phrase. 市场调研；市场研究（指通过调查分析消费者需求、市场趋势等以支持商业决策）
words.ex: The company did market research before launching the new product.
words.ex_cn: 公司在推出新产品之前做了市场调研。
words.en: Market research is the process of gathering, analyzing, and interpreting information about a market, about a product or service to be offered for sale in that market, and about the past, present, and potential customers for the product or service.

words.tr: phrase. 市场周期；指市场价格和经济活动在扩张与收缩之间反复波动的过程，通常包括繁荣、衰退、萧条和复苏四个阶段
words.ex: The market cycle goes up and down every few years.
words.ex_cn: 市场周期每隔几年就会上下波动。
words.en: A market cycle is the natural fluctuation of the economy between periods of expansion (growth) and contraction (recession).

words.ex: He lives in a country with a market economy.
words.ex_cn: 他生活在一个具有市场经济的国家。
words.en: An economic system in which the decisions regarding investment, production, and distribution are guided by the price signals created by the forces of supply and demand.

words.ex: He is learning marketing management at university.
words.ex_cn: 他正在大学学习市场营销管理。
words.en: Marketing management is the organizational discipline which focuses on the practical application of marketing orientation, techniques and methods inside enterprises and organizations and on the management of a firm's marketing resources and activities.

words.ex: The company did marketing research to understand customers.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司做了市场调研以了解客户。
words.en: Marketing research involves gathering, analyzing, and interpreting information about a market, about a product or service to be offered for sale in that market, and about the past, present, and potential customers for the product or service.

words.tr: phrase. 营销技巧；市场推广手段；营销策略
words.ex: The company uses simple marketing techniques to attract customers.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司使用简单的营销技巧来吸引顾客。
words.en: Marketing techniques refer to the strategies and methods used to promote and sell products or services, including market research, advertising, and sales strategies.

words.tr: phrase. 市场营销研讨会；营销专题研讨会
words.ex: He attended a marketing seminar last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周参加了一个营销研讨会。
words.en: A marketing seminar is a meeting or conference for discussion or training on marketing strategies, techniques, and trends.

words.tr: phrase. 营销策略；市场推广策略
words.ex: The company uses simple marketing strategies to sell more products.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司使用简单的营销策略来销售更多产品。
words.en: Marketing strategies refer to the plans and methods used to promote and sell products or services, including market research, advertising, and distribution.

words.ex: The mass media shows news every day.
words.ex_cn: 大众媒体每天播放新闻。
words.en: The mass media refers to the various means by which information is communicated to large numbers of people, including newspapers, magazines, television, and the internet.

words.tr: phrase. 思维导图；心智图；用图形方式整理信息的可视化工具
words.ex: He drew a mind map to remember the words.
words.ex_cn: 他画了一个思维导图来记住这些单词。
words.en: A mind map is a diagram used to visually organize information, often created around a single concept, drawn as an image in the center of a blank page, to which associated representations of ideas such as images, words and parts of words are added.

words.ex: He earned a master's degree in engineering.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了工程学的硕士学位。
words.en: A master's degree is an advanced academic degree awarded by universities or colleges upon completion of a course of study demonstrating mastery or a high-order overview of a specific field of study or area of professional practice.

words.ex: He uses a master card to buy groceries.
words.ex_cn: 他用万事达卡买杂货。
words.en: A Master Card is an internationally accepted credit card that offers a range of financial services to its users.

words.ex: He eats meat and cheese every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天吃肉和奶酪。
words.en: Edible animal flesh and dairy product made from milk, commonly consumed together in meals.

words.tr: phrase. 数学公式；数学方程式
words.ex: The mathematic formula for area is length times width.
words.ex_cn: 面积的数学公式是长度乘以宽度。
words.en: A mathematic formula is a combination of symbols that expresses a mathematical relationship or rule.

words.tr: phrase. 成年学生；大龄学生（通常指年龄超过传统大学入学年龄、重返校园或首次进入高等教育的学生）
words.ex: Mature students often work while they study.
words.ex_cn: 成年学生常常一边工作一边学习。
words.en: Mature students are students who begin their studies at a university or college after a period of time spent working or doing something else, rather than going straight from school.

words.ex: He is taking media studies at school.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校学习媒体研究。
words.en: The academic discipline that deals with the content, history, and effects of various media; in particular, the mass media.

words.ex: We watch movies in the media centre.
words.ex_cn: 我们在媒体中心看电影。
words.en: A media centre is a place equipped with technology for the creation, editing, and distribution of digital media.

words.ex: We watch movies in the media room.
words.ex_cn: 我们在多媒体室看电影。
words.en: A room designed for entertainment purposes, equipped with audio and video equipment.

words.ex: He works in medical science at the hospital.
words.ex_cn: 他在医院从事医学科学工作。
words.en: Medical science is the science of diagnosing, treating, and preventing disease and damage to the body or mind.

words.ex: He went to the medical centre for a check-up.
words.ex_cn: 他去医疗中心做检查。
words.en: A medical centre is a building or group of buildings where medical services are provided to the public.

words.tr: phrase. 病史；病历；既往病史
words.ex: The doctor asked about his medical history.
words.ex_cn: 医生询问了他的病史。
words.en: A record of information about a person's health, including illnesses, treatments, and tests.

words.ex: He wrote down the booklist for his class.
words.ex_cn: 他把课程的书单写了下来。
words.en: A list of books, especially one that is recommended or required for a particular course of study.

words.tr: phrase. 会员顾问；负责招募会员、提供入会咨询并维护会员关系的专业人员
words.ex: The membership consultant helped him join the gym.
words.ex_cn: 会员顾问帮他办理了健身房入会。
words.en: A membership consultant is someone whose job is to advise people about joining an organization or club, or to help them with any issues related to their membership.

words.tr: phrase. 俱乐部会员资格；成为俱乐部成员的身份
words.ex: He joined the membership of a club last month.
words.ex_cn: 他上个月加入了俱乐部的会员。
words.en: The status of being an official member of an organization or group, granting specific rights and privileges.

words.ex: He shows strong mental ability in solving math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他在解决数学问题时表现出很强的思维能力。
words.en: The capacity of an individual to perform the higher mental processes of reasoning, remembering, understanding, and problem solving.

words.tr: phrase. 心理教育；心智教育；精神教育
words.ex: He focuses on mental education for children.
words.ex_cn: 他关注儿童的心理教育。
words.en: Mental education refers to the process of educating individuals about psychological health, emotional well-being, and cognitive development.

words.ex: He heats food in a microwave oven.
words.ex_cn: 他用微波炉加热食物。
words.en: A microwave oven is an oven that uses microwaves to cook or heat food.

words.ex: We eat mooncakes during the mid-autumn festival.
words.ex_cn: 我们在中秋节吃月饼。
words.en: The Mid-Autumn Festival, also known as the Moon Festival, is a traditional festival celebrated by Chinese and Vietnamese people. It is held on the 15th day of the 8th month of the lunar calendar with a full moon at night, symbolizing reunion and harvest.

words.tr: phrase. 上午中途的小食；上午加餐
words.ex: Children eat midmorning snacks at school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在学校吃上午的零食。
words.en: Snacks eaten in the middle of the morning, typically between breakfast and lunch.

words.ex: He bought a mid-range phone for his son.
words.ex_cn: 他为儿子买了一部中档手机。
words.en: Mid-range refers to something that is of average or medium quality, size, or price, not being the highest or lowest in its category.

words.ex: He felt tired after the mid-semester test.
words.ex_cn: 期中考试后他感到很累。
words.en: Mid-semester refers to the middle of an academic semester, often a time when students face significant assessments or projects.

words.ex: Birds change their migration patterns with the seasons.
words.ex_cn: 鸟类随着季节变化它们的迁徙模式。
words.en: Migration patterns refer to the regular movements of animals or people from one region to another, often in response to seasonal changes.

words.tr: phrase. 里程票；用累积飞行里程兑换的机票
words.ex: He used a mileage ticket to fly to New York.
words.ex_cn: 他用里程票飞到了纽约。
words.en: A ticket that allows unlimited travel within a specified distance or time period.

words.tr: n. 英里（mile 的复数形式）
words.ex: He runs five miles every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上跑五英里。
words.en: A unit of linear measure equal to 5,280 feet or approximately 1.609 kilometers.

words.ex: We visited a military museum last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我们上周末参观了一个军事博物馆。
words.en: A museum that displays objects related to military history, including weapons, uniforms, and war memorabilia.

words.w: mill the grain on the ground
words.tr: phrase. 在地面上碾磨谷物
words.ex: They mill the grain on the ground to make flour.
words.ex_cn: 他们在地上磨谷物来制作面粉。
words.en: To grind grain into flour using a mill on the ground, typically for food production.

words.tr: phrase. 成百万的；许许多多的
words.ex: Millions of people watch the game every year.
words.ex_cn: 每年有数百万人观看这场比赛。
words.en: used to emphasize a very large number of things or people.

words.ex: The hikers walked through the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 徒步旅行者穿过了群山。
words.en: Large natural elevations of the earth's surface, often forming a range.

words.ex: He drinks mineral water every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天喝矿泉水。
words.en: Water that contains dissolved mineral salts, especially carbonates, sulfates, and phosphates of calcium, magnesium, sodium, and iron, and is often effervescent.

words.tr: phrase. 最低资格；基本资格；最低任职要求
words.ex: The minimum qualification for the job is a high school diploma.
words.ex_cn: 这份工作的最低要求是高中文凭。
words.en: The least amount of qualifications or credentials required for a particular position or task.

words.ex: Many people work in the mining industry.
words.ex_cn: 许多人在采矿业工作。
words.en: The sector of the economy involved in the extraction of minerals from the earth.

words.ex: He uses a mobile phone to call his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他用手机给朋友打电话。
words.en: A mobile phone is a telephone that you can carry with you and use to make or receive calls wherever you are.

words.tr: phrase. 现代语言（尤指在欧洲作为外语教授的当代欧洲语言，如法语、德语、西班牙语等）
words.ex: He learns modern languages at school.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校学习现代语言。
words.en: Modern languages refer to languages that are currently in widespread use across the globe, as opposed to classical languages which are no longer spoken in their original form.

words.tr: phrase. 现代管理酒店；采用现代管理模式的酒店
words.ex: The modern management hotel uses smart systems for guest service.
words.ex_cn: 这家现代化管理的酒店用智能系统为客人提供服务。
words.en: A hotel that employs contemporary business strategies and operational methods.

words.ex: The school has modern sports facilities.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校有现代化的体育设施。
words.en: Up-to-date facilities designed for athletic activities and sports training.

words.tr: phrase. 金钱日记；收支记录；个人财务流水账
words.ex: He writes down his money diary every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上记录他的金钱日记。
words.en: A record or journal where one tracks their financial transactions and spending habits.

words.ex: The money lender gave him a loan with high interest.
words.ex_cn: 放贷人给了他一笔高利息的贷款。
words.en: A money lender is a person or organization whose business is lending money to people who then pay back the money with interest.

words.ex: He learns money management from his dad.
words.ex_cn: 他从他爸爸那里学习理财。
words.en: Money management refers to the process of budgeting, saving, investing, spending or otherwise overseeing the capital usage of an individual or group.

words.ex: He sent the payment by money order.
words.ex_cn: 他通过汇票支付了款项。
words.en: A money order is a printed order for payment of a specified sum, issued by a bank or post office.

words.tr: phrase. 教育垄断；对教育的独家控制
words.ex: The government has a monopoly of education in this country.
words.ex_cn: 在这个国家，政府垄断了教育。
words.en: The exclusive control or possession of education by a single entity, often leading to limited choices and innovation in educational methods and content.

words.ex: He sleeps under a mosquito net at night.
words.ex_cn: 他晚上睡在蚊帐里。
words.en: A mosquito net is a fine net or curtain placed around a bed or a sleeping area, designed to keep out mosquitoes and other insects.

words.ex: My mother-in-law lives next door.
words.ex_cn: 我的岳母住在隔壁。
words.en: The mother of one's spouse.

words.ex: He bought a movie poster of his favorite film.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一张他最爱电影的海报。
words.en: A movie poster is a poster used to promote and advertise a film. It typically contains imagery and text related to the film, including the title, main actors, and release date.

words.tr: phrase. 肌肉运动；肌肉的收缩与舒张活动
words.ex: The movement of muscle helps us walk.
words.ex_cn: 肌肉的运动帮助我们行走。
words.en: The physical action or contraction of a muscle, enabling movement.

words.tr: phrase. 音乐设备；音响器材；乐器及配套装置
words.ex: He bought new music equipment for his home studio.
words.ex_cn: 他为自己的家庭录音室买了新的音乐设备。
words.en: Devices and instruments used for creating, reproducing, or amplifying sound.

words.ex: He plays a music instrument every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上都演奏一种乐器。
words.en: A music instrument is a device created or adapted to make musical sounds. In principle, any object that produces sound can be considered a musical instrument—it is through purpose that the object becomes a musical instrument.

words.ex: The notice board has a new message.
words.ex_cn: 公告板上有一条新消息。
words.en: A board on which notices are posted; a bulletin board.

words.ex: He wears a name badge at work.
words.ex_cn: 他在工作中佩戴姓名牌。
words.en: A name badge is a small card or label that you wear, which shows your name and sometimes your job title or the organization you belong to.

words.tr: phrase. 本土动物；本地动物；原生动物
words.ex: The park protects native animals like kangaroos and koalas.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园保护袋鼠和考拉等本土动物。
words.en: Animals that are indigenous to a particular place.

words.ex: The drug has a negative effect on his health.
words.ex_cn: 这种药物对他的健康有负面影响。
words.en: A negative effect is an adverse or unfavorable outcome or impact that results from a particular action, event, or situation.

words.ex: He uses natural medicine to feel better.
words.ex_cn: 他使用天然药物来感觉好些。
words.en: Natural medicine refers to a system of healthcare that uses natural remedies and the body's vital ability to heal and maintain itself. It includes a variety of treatments, such as herbal medicine, acupuncture, and dietary changes.

words.ex: We visited the natural museum last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我们上周末参观了自然博物馆。
words.en: A museum dedicated to the display and study of objects related to natural history, including plants, animals, fossils, and minerals.

words.ex: She wears a dress made of natural fibre.
words.ex_cn: 她穿一件由天然纤维制成的裙子。
words.en: A natural fibre is a type of fibre that is obtained from natural sources, such as plants or animals, and is used in the manufacture of textiles and other products.

words.ex: New technologies help people work faster.
words.ex_cn: 新技术帮助人们更快地工作。
words.en: Recent advancements in scientific and engineering fields that improve functionality.

words.ex: The stars are bright on cold nights.
words.ex_cn: 在寒冷的夜晚，星星很明亮。
words.en: The period of darkness in each twenty-four hours; the time from sunset to sunrise.

words.ex: He works the night shift at the hospital.
words.ex_cn: 他在医院上夜班。
words.en: A night shift is a period of work that occurs during the night, typically from late evening to early morning, in various industries and services.

words.tr: phrase. 无过敏；没有过敏反应
words.ex: He has no allergy to peanuts.
words.ex_cn: 他对花生不过敏。
words.en: A condition where an individual does not have an allergic reaction to a substance.

words.ex: There is no charge for parking here.
words.ex_cn: 这里停车免费。
words.en: If there is no charge for something, it means that you do not have to pay for it.

words.ex: He eats no nuts because he is allergic.
words.ex_cn: 他不吃任何坚果，因为他过敏。
words.en: Indicates that a product or food item does not contain any nuts, often to prevent allergic reactions.

words.ex: He bought non-medicine items like soap and toothpaste.
words.ex_cn: 他买了肥皂和牙膏等非药品物品。
words.en: Items that are not classified as medicines or pharmaceuticals, including a wide range of products such as cosmetics, personal care items, and household goods.

words.ex: He took a non-stop flight to New York.
words.ex_cn: 他乘坐了一趟直达纽约的航班。
words.en: A non-stop flight is a flight that travels directly from one place to another without any stops.

words.tr: phrase. 不核对身份；不查验身份信息
words.ex: He does not check identities at the door.
words.ex_cn: 他不在门口核对身份。
words.en: To fail to verify the identities of people, often in a security context.

words.ex: This document is not for circulation.
words.ex_cn: 这份文件不得外传。
words.en: This term is used to denote items, especially currency or documents, that are not intended for general distribution or use among the public.

words.tr: phrase. 曝光次数；暴露数量；接触次数
words.ex: The photo had a high number of exposure under the sun.
words.ex_cn: 这张照片在阳光下有很高的曝光次数。
words.en: The count of times something has been observed, tested, or subjected to influence.

words.tr: phrase. 乘员人数；占用者数量；居住人数
words.ex: The number of occupants in the house is five.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子里的居住人数是五人。
words.en: The total count of people living or staying in a particular place.

words.ex: The nurse provides nursing care to the old man every day.
words.ex_cn: 护士每天为这位老人提供护理。
words.en: The provision of care by nurses or other qualified healthcare professionals to individuals who are unable to care for themselves due to illness, injury, or disability.

words.tr: phrase. 护理文凭；护理专科毕业证书
words.ex: He earned a nursing diploma last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年获得了护理文凭。
words.en: A nursing diploma is a certificate awarded by educational institutions to students who have completed a nursing program, qualifying them to work as nurses.

words.tr: phrase. 职业因素；与工作相关的各种条件或要素（如工作环境、任务要求、暴露风险等）
words.ex: Heavy lifting is an occupational factor for truck drivers.
words.ex_cn: 重物搬运是卡车司机的职业因素。
words.en: Occupational factors refer to the various elements related to one's job or profession that can influence their health, well-being, and performance.

words.ex: The children play at Nursery 796.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在796号托儿所玩耍。
words.en: A nursery is a place where young children are cared for during the day while their parents are at work.

words.ex: He goes to nursery school every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上上幼儿园。
words.en: A nursery school is a school for children between the ages of about two and five.

words.ex: Math is an obligatory course for all students.
words.ex_cn: 数学是所有学生的必修课。
words.en: A course that is required to be taken by students as part of their curriculum.

words.ex: He wants to be self-sufficient by growing his own food.
words.ex_cn: 他想通过自己种食物来实现自给自足。
words.en: A self-sufficient person or thing is able to provide for themselves without outside assistance.

words.ex: He lives off campus near the bus stop.
words.ex_cn: 他住在校外，靠近公交车站。
words.en: Off campus refers to activities or locations that are situated away from the university or college grounds.

words.ex: He works as an office assistant in a small company.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家小公司担任办公室助理。
words.en: An office assistant is a person who helps to manage the day-to-day operations of an office, performing tasks such as answering phones, scheduling appointments, and organizing files.

words.ex: He overfilled the cup with water.
words.ex_cn: 他把杯子装得水都溢出来了。
words.en: To fill something beyond its capacity or beyond what is necessary.

words.tr: phrase. 石油爆炸；燃油爆炸
words.ex: The oil explosion destroyed the factory.
words.ex_cn: 石油爆炸摧毁了工厂。
words.en: An oil explosion refers to a sudden and violent release of energy caused by the ignition of oil or oil-based products, leading to significant damage and potential loss of life.

words.ex: He cooks with olive oil every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都用橄榄油做饭。
words.en: Olive oil is a liquid fat obtained from olives, a traditional tree crop of the Mediterranean Basin. It is commonly used in cooking, for frying foods or as a salad dressing.

words.ex: They shouted, 'Welcome home!' when he walked through the door.
words.ex_cn: 当他走进门时，他们大喊：‘欢迎回家！’
words.en: A greeting used to express pleasure at someone's return to their home.

words.ex: He lives on campus near the library.
words.ex_cn: 他住在校园里，靠近图书馆。
words.en: On campus refers to being within the area of land that a college or university occupies, including its buildings and grounds.

words.ex: He goes to school on foot.
words.ex_cn: 他步行去学校。
words.en: By walking.

words.ex: The shoes are on sale this week.
words.ex_cn: 这周鞋子在出售。
words.en: If products in a shop are on sale, they can be bought for less than their normal price.

words.tr: phrase. 小规模地；在小范围内
words.ex: The company produces toys on small scale.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司小规模地生产玩具。
words.en: In a limited or restricted manner; not extensively or broadly.

words.ex: He bought a one-way ticket to New York.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一张去纽约的单程票。
words.en: A ticket for travel from one place to another but not back again.

words.tr: adj. 单程的；单行道的；单方面的
words.ex: This is a one-way street.
words.ex_cn: 这是一条单行道。
words.en: A one-way trip or ticket is for travel to a place only, not for going and coming back.

words.ex: He likes online shopping for clothes.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在网上买衣服。
words.en: The activity of buying goods or services over the internet.

words.ex: The college has open admission for all high school graduates.
words.ex_cn: 这所大学对所有高中毕业生实行开放录取。
words.en: Open admission refers to a policy or practice in educational institutions where all applicants are accepted without considering their academic records or qualifications.

words.ex: The library has open shelves for easy access to books.
words.ex_cn: 图书馆设有开架书库，方便读者取阅书籍。
words.en: A system in a library where books are placed on open shelves, allowing readers to access them freely without the need for assistance.

words.tr: phrase. 开卷考试（允许查阅教材或笔记的考试）
words.ex: He took an open-book exam in math class.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学课上参加了一次开卷考试。
words.en: An open-book exam is a test where students are allowed to use textbooks, notes, and other materials. It assesses the ability to apply knowledge rather than memorize information.

words.tr: phrase. 眼科检查；视力检查
words.ex: He had an optic examination last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周做了视力检查。
words.en: A medical assessment of the eyes and visual system, often involving tests for acuity, pressure, and disease.

words.ex: She took an optional course in photography.
words.ex_cn: 她选了一门摄影的选修课。
