words.en: The people who are employed in a company or organization.

words.tr: n. 陶器；制陶手艺；陶器作坊；
words.ex: He makes pottery in his backyard studio.
words.ex_cn: 他在后院的工作室制作陶器。
words.en: Objects such as pots, dishes, and vases that are made out of clay and then baked at high temperatures to make them hard.

words.tr:
n. 工序；过程；
v. 处理；加工；
words.ex: The factory improved the production process.
words.ex_cn: 工厂改进了生产工序。
words.en: A process is a series of actions which are carried out in order to achieve a particular result.

words.tr: n. 处理；加工； v. 处理；加工；“process”的现在分词；
words.ex: The processing of data takes a long time.
words.ex_cn: 数据的处理需要很长时间。
words.en: The act of treating or preparing something by a special method.

words.ex: His profession is a teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他的职业是教师。
words.en: A profession is a type of job that requires advanced education or training.

words.ex: The professor teaches physics at the university.
words.ex_cn: 这位教授在大学教物理。
words.en: A professor is a senior teacher in a college or university.

words.ex: The teacher gave us a questionnaire about our habits.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我们一份关于我们习惯的问卷。
words.en: A questionnaire is a written list of questions which are answered by a lot of people in order to provide information for a report or a survey.

words.ex: There is a possibility of rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 明天有可能下雨。
words.en: A possibility is a situation that might happen or something that might be true.

words.ex: He looks for new opportunities every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都在寻找新的机会。
words.en: A time or set of circumstances that makes it possible to do something.

words.ex: The robber stole a wallet from the man.
words.ex_cn: 劫匪从那个人那里偷了一个钱包。
words.en: A robber is a person who steals from another person or place, especially by using force or threats.

words.ex: The otter swam quickly in the river.
words.ex_cn: 水獭在河里快速游动。
words.en: An otter is a furry aquatic mammal that is known for its playful behavior and ability to swim gracefully.

words.ex: He threw the rubbish into the bin.
words.ex_cn: 他把垃圾扔进了垃圾桶。
words.en: Waste material; refuse or litter.

words.ex: He lives in Russia.
words.ex_cn: 他住在俄罗斯。
words.en: A country in Eastern Europe and Northern Asia, known for its vast territory and rich history.

words.ex: My brother goes to school every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我弟弟每天早上上学。
words.en: A school is an institution where children are educated.

words.ex: The kangaroo jumps high in the Australian wild.
words.ex_cn: 袋鼠在澳大利亚的野外跳得很高。
words.en: A kangaroo is a large Australian animal which moves by jumping on its back legs. Female kangaroos carry their babies in a pouch on their stomach.

words.tr: adj. 苏格兰的；苏格兰人的；
words.ex: He wears a Scottish kilt on St. Andrew's Day.
words.ex_cn: 他在圣安德鲁日穿苏格兰短裙。
words.en: Of or relating to Scotland, its people, or its language.

words.tr:
n. 屏幕；屏风；掩蔽物；
v. 筛查；掩蔽；
words.ex: The movie is playing on the screen.
words.ex_cn: 电影正在屏幕上播放。
words.en: A screen is a flat surface on which pictures or words are shown, such as the one on a television or computer. It can also refer to a partition used to divide or protect an area. As a verb, to screen means to examine something in order to decide whether it is suitable for a particular purpose, or to protect someone or something from something harmful or unpleasant.

words.tr: n. 海产食物（如海鱼、贝类等）；
words.ex: We ate fresh seafood at the seaside restaurant.
words.ex_cn: 我们在海边的餐厅吃了新鲜的海产食物。
words.en: Seafood refers to fish and shellfish from the sea that are eaten as food.

words.tr: n. 定居点；定居（过程）；协议；
words.ex: The small settlement near the river has five houses.
words.ex_cn: 河边的小定居点有五所房子。
words.en: A settlement is an official agreement intended to resolve a dispute or conflict.

words.tr: n. 往返移动之物；航天飞机；
words.ex: The bus is a shuttle between the hotel and the airport.
words.ex_cn: 这辆巴士是酒店和机场之间的往返交通工具。
words.en: A shuttle is a vehicle that travels frequently between two places. In weaving, a shuttle is a device used to carry the weft thread back and forth across the loom.

words.ex: I went shopping for groceries yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 我昨天去购物买杂货了。
words.en: The activity of buying things from shops.

words.tr: n. 游泳；游泳运动； v. “swim”的现在分词；
words.ex: Swimming is good for your health.
words.ex_cn: 游泳对健康有益。
words.en: the sport or activity of moving through water by moving your arms and legs

words.tr: n. 滑雪（运动）； v. “ski”的现在分词；
words.ex: He loves skiing in the mountains during winter.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在冬天去山上滑雪。
words.en: The activity or sport of moving over snow on skis.

words.tr: v. 设置；放；“set”的现在分词； n. 环境；背景；
words.ex: He is setting the alarm for 6 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 他正在把闹钟设置为早上6点。
words.en: The context and environment in which something is set or takes place.

words.ex: The bridge is made of steel.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥是用钢建造的。
words.en: Steel is a very strong metal made mainly from iron. It is used for making many things such as bridges, buildings, and vehicles.

words.tr: n. 转向；操纵；掌舵； v. 操纵；“steer”的现在分词；
words.ex: The steering of the car is very smooth.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车的转向非常顺畅。
words.en: The act of directing the course of a vehicle or vessel.

words.tr:
n. 压力；强调；
v. 着重；强调；
words.ex: He feels stress from too much work.
words.ex_cn: 他因为工作太多而感到压力。
words.en: Stress is a state of mental or emotional strain or tension resulting from adverse or demanding circumstances.

words.ex: The exam was stressful for all students.
words.ex_cn: 这次考试对所有学生来说压力很大。
words.en: If a situation or experience is stressful, it makes you feel worried and tense because of difficulties or problems.

words.ex: His neck was stiff after sleeping wrong.
words.ex_cn: 他睡姿不对，脖子变得僵硬。
words.en: If something is stiff, it is firm and does not bend easily. It can also describe a person who is not relaxed or friendly.

words.ex: The staff at the hotel are very friendly.
words.ex_cn: 酒店的职员非常友好。
words.en: The people who work for a particular organization or company, or a group of officers assisting a commanding officer.

words.tr:
n. 东西；原料；
v. 塞；填充；
words.ex: I need to clean up all this stuff.
words.ex_cn: 我需要清理这些东西。
words.en: If you stuff something somewhere, you push it there quickly and roughly. If you stuff a container or space with something, you fill it completely with that thing.

words.ex: The hiker stood at the edge of the cliff.
words.ex_cn: 徒步者站在悬崖边上。
words.en: A cliff is a high area of rock with a very steep side, often at the edge of the sea or a river.

words.ex: Her hard work led to success.
words.ex_cn: 她的努力带来了成功。
words.en: The achievement of something desired, planned, or attempted.

words.ex: He is a successful businessman.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位成功的商人。
words.en: Achieving the results wanted or hoped for.

words.tr: n. 一段时间；会议；会期；开庭；学年；
words.ex: We had a long session of studying together.
words.ex_cn: 我们一起学习了一段时间。
words.en: A session is a meeting of a court, parliament, or other official group, or a period of time used for a particular activity, especially by a group of people.

words.ex: He bought a concession ticket for the movie.
words.ex_cn: 他买了电影的减价票。
words.en: A concession is a point or principle that is granted or acknowledged in the course of an argument or negotiation, often as a compromise or to facilitate agreement.

words.ex: He gave a summary of the story at the end.
words.ex_cn: 他在结尾对故事做了总结。
words.en: A summary is a brief statement or account of the main points of something.

words.ex: I love swimming in the sea during summer.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢在夏天去海里游泳。
words.en: Summer is the season between spring and autumn when the weather is usually warm or hot.

words.ex: The climbers reached the summit of the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 登山者到达了山顶。
words.en: The highest point of a hill or mountain; a meeting between heads of government.

words.tr: adj. 增补性的；补充性的；
words.ex: The teacher gave supplementary notes for the lesson.
words.ex_cn: 老师为这节课提供了增补性的笔记。
words.en: Supplementary things are added to something in order to improve it or make it more complete.

words.tr:
n. 供应；供给；
v. 供给；
words.ex: The city needs a steady supply of water.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市需要稳定的供水。
words.en: If you supply someone with something that they want or need, you give them a quantity of it.

words.tr:
v. 支持；支撑；
n. 拥护；帮助；
words.ex: My friends support me when I feel sad.
words.ex_cn: 当我感到难过时，我的朋友们支持我。
words.en: If you support someone or their ideas or aims, you agree with them, and perhaps help them because you want them to succeed.

words.tr: adj. 支持的；支援的；给予帮助的；
words.ex: My parents are supportive when I study hard.
words.ex_cn: 当我努力学习时，我的父母总是支持我。
words.en: If you are supportive, you are kind and helpful to someone at a difficult or unhappy time in their life.

words.ex: He plays tennis every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每周末打网球。
words.en: Tennis is a game played by two or four players on a rectangular court, in which a ball is hit back and forth over a net using rackets.

words.ex: The train went through a long tunnel.
words.ex_cn: 火车通过了一条长长的隧道。
words.en: A tunnel is a long passage which has been made under or through the ground, usually through a hill or under a river, to allow people or vehicles to travel through it.

words.ex: He has a toothache and cannot eat.
words.ex_cn: 他牙疼，不能吃东西。
words.en: A toothache is a pain in or around a tooth.

words.ex: The traffic on the highway was very heavy this morning.
words.ex_cn: 今天早上高速公路上的交通非常拥堵。
words.en: Traffic refers to the movement of vehicles or people along roads, or to the movement of aircraft, ships, or trains. It can also refer to the trade or exchange of goods or services, especially illegal ones.

words.ex: The small house is a terraced home with a garden on the roof.
words.ex_cn: 这栋小房子是一栋有屋顶露台的联排房屋。
words.en: A terraced area or building is one that is built in a series of levels or steps on a slope.

words.ex: The terrestrial animals live on land.
words.ex_cn: 陆地动物生活在陆地上。
words.en: Of, on, or relating to the earth.

words.ex: He got a vaccine last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周打了疫苗。
words.en: A vaccine is a substance containing a virus or bacterium in a form that is not harmful, given to a person or animal to prevent them from getting the disease that the virus or bacterium causes.

words.tr:
n. 真空；空虚；
v. 用真空吸尘器打扫；
words.ex: The vacuum in space keeps no air.
words.ex_cn: 太空中的真空没有空气。
words.en: A vacuum is a space that contains no air or other gas, or a space from which most of the air or gas has been removed. It can also refer to a device that cleans floors and surfaces by sucking up dirt and dust.

words.ex: The waitress brought us water and menus.
words.ex_cn: 女服务员给我们端来了水和菜单。
words.en: A waitress is a woman who works in a restaurant, serving food and drink to customers.

words.ex: The willow grows near the river.
words.ex_cn: 柳树长在河边。
words.en: A willow is a type of tree with long, thin branches and narrow leaves that grows near water.

words.tr:
n. 杂草；野草；
v. 除草；铲除；
words.ex: The garden is full of weeds.
words.ex_cn: 花园里长满了杂草。
words.en: A weed is a wild plant that grows in gardens or fields of crops and is not wanted because it harms the plants that are being grown.

words.ex: The house is built with wood.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子是用木材建造的。
words.en: Wood is the material which forms the trunks and branches of trees. It is used for building and making things.

words.ex: The children played in the woods after school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们放学后在树林里玩耍。
words.en: Woods are areas of land covered with trees, often used for walking or enjoying nature.

words.ex: We visited the zoo to see the lions.
words.ex_cn: 我们去动物园看狮子。
words.en: A place where live animals are kept so that people can go to look at them.

words.ex: They parked the caravan by the lake for the weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他们把旅行拖车停在湖边过周末。
words.en: A caravan is a group of people, especially traders or pilgrims, traveling together across a desert in Asia or North Africa.

words.ex: The ship uses GPS for navigation.
words.ex_cn: 这艘船使用GPS进行导航。
words.en: The process or activity of accurately ascertaining one's position and planning and following a route.

words.ex: The teacher gave a demonstration of how to solve the math problem.
words.ex_cn: 老师演示了如何解这道数学题。
words.en: A demonstration is a public meeting or march in which people show their opposition to something or their support for something.

words.ex: She lit the candles for a cozy dinner.
words.ex_cn: 她点燃了蜡烛，营造温馨的晚餐氛围。
words.en: A candle is a stick of wax with a string through the middle which you burn to give light.

words.ex: He buys lunch in the school canteen.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校食堂买午餐。
words.en: A canteen is a place in a factory, office, or school where meals are served, often at a lower cost than in restaurants. It can also refer to a small container for carrying water or other drinks.

words.ex: He is an intermediate student in English.
words.ex_cn: 他是英语的中级学生。
words.en: An intermediate stage, level, or position is one that occurs between two other stages, levels, or positions.

words.tr:
n. 素食者；食草动物；
adj. 素食者的；素菜的；
words.ex: He is a vegetarian and doesn't eat meat.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名素食者，不吃肉。
words.en: A vegetarian is someone who does not eat meat or fish, and sometimes other animal products, especially for moral, religious, or health reasons.

words.ex: We set up our tent at the campsite near the lake.
words.ex_cn: 我们在湖边的野营地搭了帐篷。
words.en: A campsite is a place where people who are camping can stay, often with facilities such as toilets and showers.

words.ex: The helicopter flew over the city.
words.ex_cn: 直升机飞过了城市。
words.en: A helicopter is a type of aircraft that derives both lift and propulsion from one or more sets of horizontally revolving overhead rotors. It is capable of moving vertically and horizontally, the direction of motion being controlled by the pitch of the rotor blades.

words.ex: The school received many donations from local businesses.
words.ex_cn: 学校收到了许多来自当地企业的捐献。
words.en: Gifts of money or goods to a charitable organization or cause.

words.tr:
n. 月光
v. 兼职；（尤在夜间）从事第二职业
words.ex: She works as a waitress at night to moonlight.
words.ex_cn: 她晚上当服务员来兼职。
words.en: The light that comes from the moon at night.

words.ex: He bought a mid-range phone for his son.
words.ex_cn: 他为儿子买了一部中档手机。
words.en: Mid-range refers to something that is of average or medium quality, size, or price, not being the highest or lowest in its category.

words.ex: The boxes are stored in the warehouse.
words.ex_cn: 这些箱子存放在仓库里。
words.en: A warehouse is a large building where raw materials or manufactured goods may be stored before their export or distribution for sale.

words.ex: He uses a double-grill to cook burgers and chicken at the same time.
words.ex_cn: 他用双层烤架同时烤汉堡和鸡肉。
words.en: To cook something by grilling it on both sides.

words.ex: The researcher studies how plants grow.
words.ex_cn: 这位研究人员研究植物是如何生长的。
words.en: A researcher is someone who conducts research, especially as a job.

words.ex: He visits the website every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天访问这个网站。
words.en: A website is a set of related web pages located under a single domain name, typically produced by a single person or organization.

words.tr:
n. 收费；负责；指控；
v. 收费；充电；
words.ex: The hotel charge is $50 per night.
words.ex_cn: 酒店的收费是每晚50美元。
words.en: If you charge someone, you ask them to pay an amount of money for something that you have sold to them or done for them.

words.tr:
n. 接触（的机会或权利）；进入；通道；
v. 获取；使用；接近；
words.ex: Students need access to the library.
words.ex_cn: 学生需要有接触图书馆的机会。
words.en: If you have access to a building or other place, you are able to enter it or use it.

words.ex: He pays his bills every Friday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周五支付账单。
words.en: A bill is a written statement of money that you owe for goods or services.

words.ex: The waitress brought us water and menus.
words.ex_cn: 女服务员给我们端来了水和菜单。
words.en: A waitress is a woman who works in a restaurant, serving food and drink to customers.

words.ex: We went on an excursion to the mountains last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 上周末我们去山区进行了短途旅行。
words.en: An excursion is a short journey or trip, especially one taken as a leisure activity.

words.ex: The duration of the movie is two hours.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影的持续时间是两小时。
words.en: The duration of an event or state is the time during which it happens or exists.

words.ex: He took the elevator to the 10th floor.
words.ex_cn: 他乘电梯上了十楼。
words.en: An elevator is a device that moves people or goods up and down inside a building.

words.ex: The postage for this letter is one dollar.
words.ex_cn: 这封信的邮资是一美元。
words.en: The cost of sending a letter or package by post.

words.ex: He signed his name with a clear signature.
words.ex_cn: 他用清晰的签名签了名字。
words.en: A signature is a person's name written in a distinctive way as a form of identification in authorizing a document or letter.

words.ex: The address is 720 liberty street.
words.ex_cn: 地址是自由大街720号。
words.en: The state of being free within society from oppressive restrictions imposed by authority on one's way of life, behavior, or political views.

words.ex: He went on an adventure in the jungle.
words.ex_cn: 他去丛林里冒险。
words.en: An adventure is an exciting experience or undertaking that is typically bold, sometimes risky.

words.ex: The door opens automatically when you get close.
words.ex_cn: 当你靠近时，门会自动打开。
words.en: If something happens automatically, it happens as a part of the normal process or system, without needing to be started by someone.

words.ex: He took painkillers for his headache.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了止痛药来缓解头痛。
words.en: Painkillers are drugs used to reduce or eliminate pain without causing loss of consciousness.

words.tr: n. 航海；帆船运动； v. 航行；“sail”的现在分词；
words.ex: He loves sailing on the open sea.
words.ex_cn: 他热爱在公海上航海。
words.en: The activity or sport of moving across water in a boat that is propelled by the wind.

words.ex: He types fast on the keyboard.
words.ex_cn: 他打字很快，用的是键盘。
words.en: A keyboard is a panel of keys that operate a computer or typewriter.

words.ex: The transit of goods takes three days.
words.ex_cn: 货物的运输需要三天。
words.en: The act or process of passing through or across; the conveyance of people or goods from one place to another.

words.ex: The picnic was an enjoyable day with friends.
words.ex_cn: 野餐是和朋友一起度过的愉快一天。
words.en: Something that is enjoyable gives you pleasure.

words.ex: He loves snowboarding in the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在山上滑雪板。
words.en: Snowboarding is a winter sport that involves descending a slope that is covered with snow while standing on a snowboard, a flat board with bindings for the rider's feet.

words.ex: The landscape after the rain is very beautiful.
words.ex_cn: 雨后的景色非常美丽。
words.en: A landscape is all the visible features of an area of land, often considered in terms of their aesthetic appeal.

words.ex: He wears a helmet when he rides a bike.
words.ex_cn: 他骑自行车时戴头盔。
words.en: A helmet is a strong, hard hat which is worn to protect your head.

words.ex: He wore a scary mask at the Halloween party.
words.ex_cn: 他在万圣节派对上戴了一个可怕的面具。
words.en: A mask is a piece of cloth or other material that you wear over your face to hide or protect it.

words.ex: He ate a moderate amount of food.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了适量的食物。
words.en: If you moderate something or if it moderates, it becomes less extreme or violent, or if you moderate a discussion, you help the people in it to reach an agreement.

words.ex: He climbed the ladder to fix the roof.
words.ex_cn: 他爬梯子去修屋顶。
words.en: A ladder is a piece of equipment consisting of a series of steps or rungs fixed between two upright lengths of wood, metal, or rope, used for climbing up or down something.

words.ex: He showed great concentration while solving the math problem.
words.ex_cn: 他在解这道数学题时非常专注。
words.en: Concentration is the ability to focus all your attention on one thing without being distracted.

words.ex: The books are sorted into different categories.
words.ex_cn: 这些书被分成了不同的类别。
words.en: A category is a class or group of things, people, or ideas that have similar characteristics.

words.tr:
adj. 可变的；易变的；
n. 变量；
words.ex: The weather is variable in spring.
words.ex_cn: 春天的天气是多变的。
words.en: A variable is something that is likely to vary; something that is subject to variation.

words.tr: n. 桑拿浴室；桑拿浴；蒸汽浴
words.ex: He relaxes in the sauna after work.
words.ex_cn: 他下班后在桑拿房里放松。
words.en: A sauna is a small room used as a hot-air or steam bath for cleaning and refreshing the body.

words.ex: She works at a child-minding center near her home.
words.ex_cn: 她在离家近的一家儿童看护中心工作。
words.en: The act of looking after children, especially when their parents are not at home.

words.tr: n. 网球拍；喧闹；非法勾当；
words.ex: He bought a new racket for tennis.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一副新的网球拍。
words.en: A racket is a piece of equipment used in sports such as tennis or badminton, consisting of a handle and a round or oval frame with a network of strings stretched across it. It can also refer to a loud, unpleasant noise or a dishonest or fraudulent scheme.

words.tr:
n. 教练；长途客运汽车；
v. 训练；培训；
words.ex: The coach taught the team how to win.
words.ex_cn: 教练教球队如何获胜。
words.en: A coach is someone who trains a person or team in a particular sport. It also refers to a large, comfortable bus that carries passengers on long journeys.

words.ex: The drawer has two wooden handles.
words.ex_cn: 这个抽屉有两个木制把手。
words.en: Handles refers to the part of an object designed to be held or operated by hand, or the act of dealing with or controlling something.

words.ex: He wears a nylon jacket to stay dry.
words.ex_cn: 他穿一件尼龙夹克来保持干燥。
words.en: Nylon is a strong, elastic synthetic fiber used especially in the manufacture of clothing, ropes, and brushes.

words.tr:
n. 包；包裹；
v. 包装；
words.ex: He bought a package of cookies.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一包饼干。
words.en: A package is a wrapped container or a set of objects wrapped in paper or packed in a box.

words.ex: He kept the receipt for his new shoes.
words.ex_cn: 他保留了新鞋的收据。
words.en: A receipt is a piece of paper that you get from someone as proof that they have received money or goods from you.

words.ex: The waterfall makes a loud sound.
words.ex_cn: 瀑布发出很大的声音。
words.en: A waterfall is a place where water flows over the edge of a steep, high cliff in hills or mountains, and falls into a pool below.

words.ex: He is my business partner.
words.ex_cn: 他是我的商业合伙人。
words.en: A partner is someone who you are involved with in a particular activity, especially in business or in a personal relationship.

words.ex: He used a voucher to buy a coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他用一张代金券买了一杯咖啡。
words.en: A voucher is a piece of paper that can be used instead of money to pay for something, or that allows you to pay less than the usual price for something.

words.ex: He goes to the gym every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上去健身房。
words.en: A gym is a place equipped for physical exercise and training, especially for athletes or for people who want to keep fit.

words.tr: n. 便携式电脑；笔记本电脑；
words.ex: He uses a laptop to work from home.
words.ex_cn: 他用笔记本电脑在家工作。
words.en: A laptop is a computer which is small enough to be carried around easily and is designed for use outside an office.

words.ex: He does yoga every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上做瑜伽。
words.en: Yoga is a Hindu spiritual and ascetic discipline, a part of which, including breath control, simple meditation, and the adoption of specific bodily postures, is widely practiced for health and relaxation.

words.ex: He cut the bread with a knife.
words.ex_cn: 他用刀切面包。
words.en: A knife is a tool for cutting or a weapon, consisting of a flat piece of metal with a sharp edge on the end of a handle.

words.ex: He hurt his neck while lifting weights.
words.ex_cn: 他在举重时伤了脖子。
words.en: The part of a person's or animal's body connecting the head to the rest of the body.

words.ex: He put a mat on the floor to keep it clean.
words.ex_cn: 他在地上放了一块垫子以保持清洁。
words.en: A mat is a piece of thick fabric or other material that is placed on a floor or other surface to protect it or to provide a soft surface to stand or sit on.

words.ex: She put the apples in a plastic container.
words.ex_cn: 她把苹果放进了一个塑料容器里。
words.en: A container is something such as a box or bottle that is used to hold or store things in.

words.ex: We had dinner at a buffet with many dishes to choose from.
words.ex_cn: 我们在自助餐吃了晚饭，有很多菜可以选。
words.en: A buffet is a meal consisting of several dishes from which guests serve themselves. As a verb, to buffet means to strike repeatedly and violently.

words.ex: The photo showed an enlargement of the tiny letter.
words.ex_cn: 这张照片展示了那个小字母的放大版。
words.en: The act of making something larger or the state of being made larger.

words.ex: He works in a small studio near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他在公园附近的一个小工作室工作。
words.en: A studio is a room where an artist, photographer, or designer works, or a place where movies or television programs are made.

words.ex: The critic praised the new movie.
words.ex_cn: 这位评论家称赞了这部新电影。
words.en: A critic is a person who expresses opinions about the good and bad qualities of books, films, music, etc.

words.tr:
v. 作嗡嗡声；飞驰；陡升
n. 直线上升；激增；嗡嗡声
words.ex: The bee zooms around the flowers.
words.ex_cn: 蜜蜂在花丛中嗡嗡飞舞。
words.en: to move quickly or suddenly with a loud, low, continuous noise, or to make something do this

words.ex: The camera has a clear lens.
words.ex_cn: 这台相机有一个清晰的透镜。
words.en: A lens is a piece of curved glass or other transparent substance that is used in things such as cameras, telescopes, or pairs of glasses to make images larger or smaller.

words.ex: The city needs better infrastructure for roads and water.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市需要更好的道路和供水设施。
words.en: The basic physical and organizational structures and facilities (e.g., buildings, roads, power supplies) needed for the operation of a society or enterprise.

words.ex: The town lost electricity during the storm.
words.ex_cn: 风暴期间，这个城镇停电了。
words.en: A form of energy resulting from the existence of charged particles (such as electrons or protons), either statically as an accumulation of charge or dynamically as a current.

words.tr:
n. 度假胜地；手段；
v. 求助于；
words.ex: They went to a beach resort for their vacation.
words.ex_cn: 他们去一个海滨度假胜地度假。
words.en: If you resort to a particular course of action, you do it because you cannot see any other way of achieving what you want.

words.ex: The wound caused a serious infection.
words.ex_cn: 伤口引起了严重的感染。
words.en: An infection is a disease caused by microorganisms such as bacteria, viruses, or parasites invading the body.

words.ex: The children play near the fountain in the park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在公园的喷泉附近玩耍。
words.en: A fountain is a structure that squirts water into the air to create a visual or auditory effect, or a natural source of water.

words.tr:
n. 背心；马甲；汗衫
v. 授予；使穿衣
words.ex: He wears a black vest over his shirt.
words.ex_cn: 他穿着一件黑色背心，上面是衬衫。
words.en: A vest is a piece of clothing without sleeves that you wear over a shirt.

words.ex: He got a teaching qualification last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年获得了教师资格。
words.en: A qualification is a skill or type of experience that you need in order to do a particular job or activity.

words.ex: Many children suffer from poverty in poor countries.
words.ex_cn: 许多孩子在贫穷国家遭受贫困。
words.en: Poverty is the state of being extremely poor.

words.ex: His expectation was to pass the test.
words.ex_cn: 他的期待是通过考试。
words.en: An expectation is a belief about what might happen in the future, especially about something that you think is likely or that you hope will happen.

words.tr:
n. 胶；胶水；
v. 粘合；
words.ex: He used glue to stick the paper together.
words.ex_cn: 他用胶把纸粘在一起。
words.en: A sticky substance used for joining things together.

words.ex: The document uses a clean font.
words.ex_cn: 这个文档使用了一种简洁的字体。
words.en: A font is a set of printable or displayable text characters in a specific style and size.

words.ex: He is a reliable friend who always helps.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个可靠的朋友，总是帮忙。
words.en: Able to be trusted to do or provide what is needed or right.

words.ex: He plays the violin every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上拉小提琴。
words.en: A violin is a musical instrument with four strings, played with a bow.

words.tr: n. 制造业； v. 制造；“manufacture”的现在分词；
words.ex: Manufacturing is important for the country's economy.
words.ex_cn: 制造业对国家经济很重要。
words.en: The process of converting raw materials into finished products, especially by means of a large-scale industrial operation.

words.ex: She bought a new outfit for the party.
words.ex_cn: 她为派对买了一套新衣服。
words.en: An outfit is a set of clothes worn together, especially for a particular occasion or purpose.

words.tr:
n. 荫；阴影；
v. 遮蔽；
words.ex: The tree provides shade on a hot day.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树在炎热的日子提供荫凉。
words.en: Shade is an area where there is no direct sunlight, or something that provides protection from the sun. It can also refer to a slight difference in color, or to gradually change from one color or tone to another.

words.ex: It's a myth that eating late at night causes weight gain.
words.ex_cn: 晚上吃东西会导致发胖，这是一种错误观念。
words.en: A myth is a traditional story, especially one concerning the early history of a people or explaining some natural or social phenomenon, and typically involving supernatural beings or events.

words.ex: The harvested wheat was stored in the barn.
words.ex_cn: 收获的小麦被存放在谷仓里。
words.en: To harvest means to gather a crop or to receive the benefits of something after a period of effort or work.

words.ex: The door was opened and air came in.
words.ex_cn: 门是打开的，空气进来了。
words.en: To open something means to move or adjust it so that it is no longer closed, or to start an event or activity.

words.ex: The cleaned dishes were put back in the cabinet.
words.ex_cn: 已清洁的餐具被放回了橱柜。
words.en: Made something free from dirt, marks, or mess, especially by washing, wiping, or brushing.

words.tr: v. 扩大；扩张；更充分地阐述；“expand”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The company expanded its business to other countries.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司扩大了业务到其他国家。
words.en: If something expands or is expanded, it becomes larger.

words.ex: The cooled milk was ready to drink.
words.ex_cn: 冷却过的牛奶可以喝了。
words.en: Made or become less hot; having a lower temperature.

words.tr: adj. 密封的； v. 密封；“seal”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The sealed jar kept the food fresh.
words.ex_cn: 密封的罐子让食物保持新鲜。
words.en: Closed or secured with or as if with a seal.

words.ex: This segment of the book is very interesting.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的这一部分非常有趣。
words.en: A segment of something is one of the parts into which it is divided or from which it is formed.

words.tr: n. 伤残；失去能力；无能力；
words.ex: He has a disability that makes walking difficult.
words.ex_cn: 他有伤残，导致行走困难。
words.en: A disability is a physical or mental condition that limits a person's movements, senses, or activities.

words.ex: The boy hurt his spine when he fell from the tree.
words.ex_cn: 他从树上摔下来时伤到了脊柱。
words.en: The spine is the row of bones down the center of your back that supports your body and protects your spinal cord.

words.ex: The farmer tried to kill the pest with a spray.
words.ex_cn: 农民试图用喷雾杀死害虫。
words.en: A pest is an animal or insect that damages crops, food, or livestock, or is generally troublesome. It can also refer to a person or thing that causes annoyance or trouble.

words.tr: n. 要洗的衣物；洗衣店；
words.ex: I put the dirty laundry in the washing machine.
words.ex_cn: 我把脏衣服放进洗衣机里。
words.en: Laundry refers to the clothes and linens that need to be washed or that have just been washed. It can also refer to the place or business where clothes and linens are washed and ironed.

words.tr:
n. 调查；勘测；
v. 调查；勘测；
words.ex: The school did a survey about student lunch preferences.
words.ex_cn: 学校做了一项关于学生午餐偏好的调查。
words.en: A survey is a detailed study or inspection, especially as a means of collecting information about people's opinions or behavior.

words.ex: The court punished the man for rape.
words.ex_cn: 法院因强奸罪惩罚了那个男人。
words.en: Rape is the crime of forcing someone to have sex with you, especially by using violence.

words.ex: He drove the pegs into the ground to hold the tent.
words.ex_cn: 他把钉桩钉进地面以固定帐篷。
words.en: Pegs are small devices, usually made of wood or metal, used to fasten things or to hang things on.

words.ex: The workers are climbing the scaffold to paint the building.
words.ex_cn: 工人们正在爬脚手架去粉刷大楼。
words.en: A scaffold is a temporary structure erected to support workers and materials during the construction, repair, or cleaning of a building or other large structure. It can also refer to a raised wooden platform used formerly for the public execution of criminals.

words.ex: The fence is made of hazel.
words.ex_cn: 这个篱笆是用榛木做的。
words.en: Hazel is a small tree or bush that produces nuts, or a light brown color.

words.ex: He painted a portrait of his mother.
words.ex_cn: 他画了一幅他母亲的肖像。
words.en: A portrait is a painting, drawing, or photograph of a particular person.

words.ex: The poem uses symbolism to show love and loss.
words.ex_cn: 这首诗使用象征手法来表现爱与失去。
words.en: Symbolism is the use of symbols to represent ideas or qualities.

words.ex: The dog ran through the mud.
words.ex_cn: 狗跑过了泥地。
words.en: Mud is a sticky mixture of earth and water.

words.ex: He received a certificate for completing the course.
words.ex_cn: 他完成了课程后获得了证书。
words.en: A certificate is an official document attesting a fact, in particular.

words.ex: Water and oil are liquids.
words.ex_cn: 水和油是液体。
words.en: A liquid is a substance which is not solid but which flows and can be poured, for example water.

words.tr:
n. 塑料；
adj. 塑料的；
words.ex: The bottle is made of plastic.
words.ex_cn: 这个瓶子是塑料做的。
words.en: A plastic is a material which is produced from oil by a chemical process and which is used to make many objects. It is light in weight and does not break easily.

words.ex: The barn is used for storage of grain.
words.ex_cn: 这个谷仓用于粮食的贮存。
words.en: The act of storing something or the space where things are stored.

words.ex: She lives in Sweden.
words.ex_cn: 她住在瑞典。
words.en: Sweden is a Nordic country in Northern Europe known for its welfare state, high standard of living, and beautiful natural landscapes.

words.ex: He buys milk and bread at the grocery.
words.ex_cn: 他在杂货店买牛奶和面包。
words.en: A grocery is a store where food and small items for the house are sold.

words.ex: Children learn to socialise at school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在学校学习进行社交活动。
words.en: To socialise means to participate or to cause someone to participate in social activities; to make someone behave in a way that is acceptable to their society.

words.ex: She squeezed a lemon into her water.
words.ex_cn: 她把一个柠檬挤进水里。
words.en: A lemon is a bright yellow fruit with very sour juice. Lemons grow on trees in warm countries.

words.ex: Congratulations on your graduation!
words.ex_cn: 祝贺你毕业！
words.en: An expression of pleasure or joy in the success or good fortune of another.

words.tr:
v. 抽水；打气；
n. 泵；抽水机；打气机；
words.ex: He pumps water from the well every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上从井里抽水。
words.en: A pump is a device that moves fluids (liquids or gases), or sometimes slurries, by mechanical action. Pumps can be classified into three major groups according to the method they use to move the fluid: direct lift, displacement, and gravity pumps.

words.ex: She looked at herself in the mirror.
words.ex_cn: 她对着镜子看自己。
words.en: A mirror is a flat piece of glass which reflects light, so that when you look at it you can see yourself reflected in it.

words.ex: He uses a map to find the way.
words.ex_cn: 他用地图找路。
words.en: A map is a visual representation of an area, showing physical features, cities, roads, etc., typically on a flat surface.

words.ex: He enjoys birdwatching in the park every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都喜欢在公园观鸟。
words.en: The activity of observing birds in their natural habitat as a hobby.

words.ex: The police used fingerprint identification to find the suspect.
words.ex_cn: 警察使用指纹识别来找到嫌疑人。
words.en: Identification is the act of recognizing and naming someone or something, or the process of proving who or what someone or something is.

words.ex: He practices judo every afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 他每天下午练习柔道。
words.en: A sport of unarmed combat derived from jujitsu and intended to train the body and mind. It involves using holds and leverage to unbalance the opponent.

words.tr: n. 入学介绍；岗前训练；方向；取向；
words.ex: The school held an orientation for new students on Monday.
words.ex_cn: 学校在周一为新生举行了入学介绍。
words.en: The act of orienting or the state of being oriented; the determination of the relative position of something or someone (especially oneself).

words.ex: The instructor explained the math problem clearly.
words.ex_cn: 教员清楚地讲解了这道数学题。
words.en: An instructor is someone who teaches a skill or subject, especially in a college or university, or in a specialized field such as driving or skiing.

words.ex: This jacket is waterproof.
words.ex_cn: 这件夹克是防水的。
words.en: Something that is waterproof does not let water pass through it.

words.ex: He washed his hands to remove the dirt.
words.ex_cn: 他洗手以去除污垢。
words.en: Dirt is any substance that makes something unclean, such as mud or dust.

words.tr: v. 断裂；破裂；“crack”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 有裂纹的；
words.ex: The glass cracked when it fell on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 玻璃掉到地上时裂开了。
words.en: If something is cracked, it has lines on its surface because it is damaged.

words.tr: n. 矿泉疗养地；矿泉城；水疗中心；
words.ex: They went to the spa to relax and drink mineral water.
words.ex_cn: 他们去矿泉疗养地放松并饮用矿泉水。
words.en: A spa is a place where people go to improve their health and relax by having treatments such as massages and facials, and by exercising and swimming.

words.ex: He checks the calendar every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都看日历。
words.en: A calendar is a chart or device which displays the date and the day of the week, and often the whole of a particular year divided up into months, weeks, and days.

words.ex: He wiped his mouth with a napkin.
words.ex_cn: 他用纸巾擦了擦嘴。
words.en: A napkin is a piece of cloth or paper used at meals to protect your clothes and to wipe your mouth and fingers.

words.ex: There is a vacancy in the sales department.
words.ex_cn: 销售部门有一个空缺职位。
words.en: A vacancy is a position or job that is available for someone to fill.

words.ex: He works in a clerical job at the office.
words.ex_cn: 他在办公室做文书工作。
words.en: Clerical means relating to work that is done in an office, especially work that involves keeping records or accounts. It can also refer to the clergy or the religious leaders of a church.

words.ex: The health sector needs more funding.
words.ex_cn: 医疗部门需要更多资金。
words.en: A particular area of activity, especially one that is part of a larger area of activity or one that is considered separately from other areas.

words.ex: The math problem is complicated.
words.ex_cn: 这个数学问题很复杂。
words.en: Involving many different and confusing aspects.

words.ex: The administrative office handles school records.
words.ex_cn: 行政办公室负责管理学校档案。
words.en: Relating to the management of a company, organization, or institution.

words.ex: He uses a spreadsheet to count his money.
words.ex_cn: 他用电子表格来计算他的钱。
words.en: A spreadsheet is a computer program that is used for displaying and dealing with numbers. It shows numbers in rows and columns, and it is used especially for doing financial calculations and for creating graphs.

words.tr:
n. 洗涤槽；水槽；
v. （使）沉没；
words.ex: The dirty dishes are in the sink.
words.ex_cn: 脏盘子在水槽里。
words.en: If a boat sinks, or if something sinks it, it disappears below the surface of a mass of water.

words.ex: He cooks soup on the stove.
words.ex_cn: 他用炉子煮汤。
words.en: A stove is a piece of equipment which provides heat, either for cooking or for heating a room.

words.tr: adj. 令人沮丧的；令人泄气的；让人懊恼的； v. “frustrate”的现在分词；
words.ex: The slow internet is frustrating.
words.ex_cn: 网速慢让人沮丧。
words.en: If something is frustrating, it annoys you or makes you angry because you cannot do anything about the problems it causes.

words.ex: He plays violin in a local orchestra.
words.ex_cn: 他在一个本地管弦乐队中拉小提琴。
words.en: An orchestra is a large group of musicians who play a variety of different instruments together. Orchestras usually play classical music.

words.ex: She practices ballet every afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 她每天下午练习芭蕾舞。
words.en: Ballet is a type of performance dance that originated during the Italian Renaissance in the 15th century and later developed into a concert dance form in France and Russia. It has since become a widespread, highly technical form of dance with its own vocabulary based on French terminology. It has been globally influential and has defined the foundational techniques used in many other dance genres.

words.tr:
n. 业余爱好者；
adj. 业余的；
words.ex: He is an amateur who paints on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他是个周末画画的业余爱好者。
words.en: An amateur is someone who does something as a hobby and not as a job.

words.ex: He is a composer who writes music for movies.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位为电影作曲的作曲家。
words.en: A composer is a person who writes music, especially classical music.

words.ex: He put up posters on the wall.
words.ex_cn: 他在墙上贴了海报。
words.en: A poster is a large notice or picture that you stick on a wall or board, often in order to advertise something.

words.ex: He learned carpentry from his father.
words.ex_cn: 他从父亲那里学到了木工工作。
words.en: Carpentry is the activity of making and repairing wooden things.

words.ex: The lifeguard saved a boy from drowning.
words.ex_cn: 救生员救了一个差点溺水的男孩。
words.en: A lifeguard is a person who is responsible for the safety of people at a beach or swimming pool, and who rescues those who are in danger of drowning.

words.tr: n. 历史遗迹；纪念碑；不朽作品；
words.ex: The ancient monument attracts many tourists each year.
words.ex_cn: 这座古代历史遗迹每年吸引许多游客。
words.en: A monument is a large structure, usually made of stone, which is built to remind people of an important person or event.

words.tr: n. （有锁的）寄物柜；锁柜；上锁的人
words.ex: He put his books in the locker.
words.ex_cn: 他把书放在储物柜里。
words.en: A locker is a small storage compartment, typically in a public place such as a school, gym, or workplace, where individuals can store their personal belongings securely.

words.ex: He sits by the fireplace in winter.
words.ex_cn: 冬天他坐在壁炉旁。
words.en: A fireplace is a place built into a wall where you can have a fire, especially in a house.

words.ex: The occupancy of the hotel is high during summer.
words.ex_cn: 夏天酒店的占用率很高。
words.en: The act of occupying or the state of being occupied, especially the condition of being occupied by tenants or the period during which a property is occupied.

words.ex: His date of birth is June 5, 2000.
words.ex_cn: 他的出生日期是2000年6月5日。
words.en: The day, month, and year on which someone was born.

words.ex: He uses the internet cafe to check his email.
words.ex_cn: 他使用网吧来查看他的邮件。
words.en: An internet cafe is a place where you can pay to use a computer with internet access, usually by the hour.

words.tr: phrase. 保险类型；保险种类
words.ex: He bought a type of insurance for his car.
words.ex_cn: 他为他的车买了一种保险。
words.en: A policy that provides financial protection against specified risks or losses.

words.tr: phrase. 鱼缸；养鱼的水族箱
words.ex: He puts fish in the fish tank.
words.ex_cn: 他把鱼放在鱼缸里。
words.en: A fish tank is a container, typically made of glass or plastic, filled with water in which fish and other aquatic animals are kept.

words.tr: phrase. 会员资格限制；成员数量限制；会员权限限制
words.ex: The gym has a membership limitation of 500 people.
words.ex_cn: 这家健身房的会员人数限制为500人。
words.en: A restriction on the number or type of people who can become members of a particular group or organization.

words.tr: phrase. 规划会议；策划会议；筹备会议
words.ex: We had a planning meeting yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨天开了一次规划会议。
words.en: A planning meeting is a meeting where people discuss and make plans for future activities or projects.

words.tr: phrase. 戏剧工作坊；一种通过实践和互动活动进行戏剧创作、表演训练或戏剧教育的课程或活动
words.ex: He joined a drama workshop last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周参加了一个戏剧工作坊。
words.en: A drama workshop is a class or series of classes in which people learn about drama and practice acting.

words.ex: Children enjoy outdoor activities like running and climbing.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们喜欢户外活动，比如跑步和攀爬。
words.en: Activities that take place in the open air, outside of buildings.

words.tr: phrase. 团体存款；集体押金
words.ex: They made a group deposit to save for a trip.
words.ex_cn: 他们一起存了一笔钱用于旅行。
words.en: A sum of money paid by a group into a shared account, often for a common purpose.

words.ex: The club has low joining fees for new members.
words.ex_cn: 该俱乐部对新成员收取的入会费很低。
words.en: The amount of money that you have to pay to become a member of a club, organization, or society.

words.tr: 名词短语。舞蹈课程；舞蹈班
words.ex: He goes to dance classes every Saturday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周六去上舞蹈课。
words.en: Instructional sessions where participants learn various styles of dancing.

words.ex: He goes to the leisure centre every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每个周末都去休闲中心。
words.en: A leisure centre is a building where people go to keep fit or relax, typically containing facilities such as a gym, swimming pool, and sports courts.

words.tr: phrase. 圆桌；圆桌会议（指与会者地位平等、自由讨论的会议形式）
words.ex: They sat at round tables in the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 他们坐在教室里的圆桌旁。
words.en: Large, circular tables designed to facilitate group discussion and equal participation.

words.ex: He gave her a bunch of flowers on her birthday.
words.ex_cn: 他在她生日时送给她一束花。
words.en: A bunch of flowers refers to a collection of flowers that are tied or held together.

words.ex: The total deposit is $500.
words.ex_cn: 总存款是500美元。
words.en: The complete sum of money deposited, often in a financial or contractual context.

words.tr: phrase. 递送费；运费；配送费
words.ex: The delivery fee is five dollars.
words.ex_cn: 配送费是五美元。
words.en: A charge made for delivering goods or services.

words.tr: phrase. 特殊项目；特别事项
words.ex: The store sells special items for collectors.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店出售给收藏家的特殊物品。
words.en: Specific articles or features that are distinct or exceptional within a larger set.

words.ex: Tourists visit the beach in high seasons.
words.ex_cn: 游客在旺季去海滩。
words.en: The period of the year when a particular place is most popular with tourists, often characterized by higher prices and larger crowds.

words.tr: phrase. 乡村生活；乡间居住
words.ex: They enjoy country living because it is quiet and peaceful.
words.ex_cn: 他们喜欢乡村生活，因为那里安静又平和。
words.en: Country living refers to the lifestyle and activities associated with living in rural areas, often characterized by a closer connection to nature and a slower pace of life.

words.tr: phrase. 和平的环境；宁静的氛围
words.ex: The library offers a peaceful environment for studying.
words.ex_cn: 图书馆为学习提供了一个安静的环境。
words.en: A peaceful environment refers to a setting or atmosphere that is calm, quiet, and free from disturbance or conflict, conducive to peace and tranquility.

words.tr: 短语. 外出就餐；在餐馆吃饭
words.ex: They like eating out on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他们喜欢在周末外出吃饭。
words.en: The act of dining at a restaurant or somewhere other than one's home.

words.ex: He used his existing skills to fix the computer.
words.ex_cn: 他利用自己现有的技能修理了电脑。
words.en: Skills or abilities that a person already possesses.

words.tr: phrase. 房产中介；房屋代理人
words.ex: The house agent showed us three homes.
words.ex_cn: 房产中介带我们看了三套房子。
words.en: A house agent is a person or company that acts on behalf of another in selling, buying, renting, or managing property.

words.tr: phrase. 投资计划；投资方案；投资骗局
words.ex: He lost money in bad investment schemes.
words.ex_cn: 他在糟糕的投资计划中亏了钱。
words.en: Investment schemes refer to plans or strategies for investing money in order to make a profit. These can range from stocks and bonds to real estate and other ventures.

words.tr: phrase. 分行经理；部门主管
words.ex: The branch manager helps customers at the bank.
words.ex_cn: 分行经理在银行帮助顾客。
words.en: A branch manager is a person who is in charge of a particular branch of a company or organization, responsible for its overall performance and management.

words.ex: I need to buy house insurance.
words.ex_cn: 我需要购买房屋保险。
words.en: Insurance that provides compensation for damage or loss to a house and its contents.

words.ex: We used the side entrance to get into the building.
words.ex_cn: 我们从侧门进入大楼。
words.en: An alternative or secondary entry point to a building or property.

words.tr: phrase. 客户端工程师；负责客户端软件开发与维护的工程人员
words.ex: The client engineer fixed the software problem quickly.
words.ex_cn: 客户工程师迅速解决了软件问题。
words.en: A client engineer is a professional responsible for the development and maintenance of client-side applications, ensuring they meet the required specifications and provide a good user experience.

words.ex: He went to the post office to send a letter.
words.ex_cn: 他去邮局寄信。
words.en: A post office is a public department or corporation responsible for mail services, including the acceptance, transmission, and delivery of letters and parcels.

words.ex: He enjoys horse riding every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每个周末都喜欢骑马。
words.en: The activity of riding a horse, especially for pleasure or sport.

words.tr: phrase. 办公家具；办公室家具
words.ex: The company bought new office furniture last week.
words.ex_cn: 公司上周买了新的办公家具。
words.en: Office furniture refers to the furniture used in offices, including desks, chairs, filing cabinets, and other items necessary for office work.

words.tr: phrase. 热巧克力；巧克力热饮
words.ex: He drinks hot chocolate every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上喝热巧克力。
words.en: A hot beverage made from chocolate or cocoa powder, sugar, and milk or water, typically served warm.

words.tr: phrase. 高级的；先进的；高等的 n. 课程；教训 → 高级课程
words.ex: He took advanced lessons in math last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年上了高级数学课。
words.en: Instructional sessions designed for learners with a high degree of proficiency.

words.tr: phrase. 保暖的衣物；御寒服装
words.ex: He wears warm clothing in winter.
words.ex_cn: 他在冬天穿暖和的衣服。
words.en: Clothing designed to keep the body warm, especially in cold weather.

words.ex: The museum offers free entry on Sundays.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆在星期日免费入场。
words.en: The permission or right to enter a place or event without payment.

words.ex: The toy factory makes small cars for children.
words.ex_cn: 玩具工厂为孩子们制造小汽车。
words.en: A toy factory is a place where toys are manufactured.

words.tr: phrase. 大型滑梯；大型幻灯片；大型滑动
words.ex: The child loves to go down the large slide.
words.ex_cn: 孩子喜欢从大滑梯上滑下来。
words.en: A large, transparent sheet used with an overhead projector to display images or information.

words.ex: He stops at the petrol station to fill his car.
words.ex_cn: 他停在加油站给车加油。
words.en: A petrol station is a place where petrol is sold and where vehicles can be filled with petrol.

words.tr: phrase. 晚间的约会或预约
words.ex: I have an evening appointment at 7 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 我晚上七点有一个预约。
words.en: An evening appointment is a scheduled meeting or consultation that takes place in the late afternoon or night.

words.tr: phrase. 雇佣体检证明；用于证明个人健康状况适合就业的医疗文件
words.ex: He needs an employment medical certificate to start his new job.
words.ex_cn: 他需要一份就业体检证明才能开始新工作。
words.en: A document issued by a medical professional that confirms an individual's fitness for employment, often required by employers as part of the hiring process.

words.tr: phrase. 定期检查；例行检查
words.ex: He has a regular check every month.
words.ex_cn: 他每个月进行一次常规检查。
words.en: A routine examination or inspection to ensure that something is in order or functioning correctly.

words.ex: He got a sports injury while playing soccer.
words.ex_cn: 他在踢足球时受了运动损伤。
words.en: An injury that occurs as a result of participating in sports or physical activities.

words.ex: He has heart disease and must eat healthy food.
words.ex_cn: 他患有心脏病，必须吃健康的食物。
words.en: A condition that affects the heart and blood vessels, often leading to serious health issues.

words.ex: We visited a space museum last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 上周末我们参观了一个太空博物馆。
words.en: A space museum is a museum that focuses on the history and science of space exploration and astronomy.

words.ex: He puts on sun cream before going to the beach.
words.ex_cn: 他去海滩前涂上防晒霜。
words.en: A cream or lotion applied to the skin to protect it from the sun's ultraviolet rays.

words.tr: phrase. 个人关注；个别关照；专人照顾
words.ex: The teacher gives each student personal attention.
words.ex_cn: 老师给每个学生个别关注。
words.en: Personal attention refers to the individual care or consideration given to someone to meet their specific needs or preferences.

words.ex: The children are playing in the paddling pool.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们正在浅水池里玩耍。
words.en: A shallow pool for children to play in, especially one that can be filled with water and is portable.

words.ex: The house has central heating for winter.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子有中央供暖系统过冬。
words.en: A system that heats a building by sending hot water or steam through pipes to radiators in different rooms.

words.ex: He checked his bank statement last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚查看了他的银行对账单。
words.en: A bank statement is a document that shows all the transactions that have occurred in a bank account over a specific period of time, usually a month.

words.tr: phrase. 预订书籍；图书预约
words.ex: He made a book reservation at the library.
words.ex_cn: 他在图书馆预约了一本书。
words.en: n. A booking made in advance to ensure the availability of a book or other item.

words.tr: phrase. 白天气温；白天的温度
words.ex: The daytime temperature is hot today.
words.ex_cn: 今天的白天气温很热。
words.en: The temperature during the day, especially the highest temperature recorded in the 24-hour period.

words.ex: The tourists rode the cable car up the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 游客们乘坐缆车上了山。
words.en: A cable car is a vehicle that is pulled by a moving cable and is used for transporting people up and down mountains.

words.tr: phrase. 户外游泳池；露天泳池
words.ex: They swim in the outdoor swimming pool every summer.
words.ex_cn: 他们每年夏天都在户外游泳池游泳。
words.en: An outdoor swimming pool is a pool that is located outside, typically in a garden or yard, used for swimming.

words.ex: He is a baseball coach at the local school.
words.ex_cn: 他是当地学校的一名棒球教练。
words.en: A baseball coach is a person who trains and directs a baseball team.

words.ex: Fish live in a coral reef near the island.
words.ex_cn: 鱼生活在岛屿附近的珊瑚礁中。
words.en: A coral reef is a structure in the sea formed from the calcium carbonate skeletons of corals, typically found in warm, shallow waters.

words.tr: phrase. 岩石池；潮汐池（指海岸岩石间因退潮而形成的水池）
words.ex: The children found a rock pool with small fish.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们发现了一个有小鱼的潮水池。
words.en: A rock pool is a small pool of seawater that is found among rocks on the shore.

words.tr: phrase. 花园的维护；花园保养
words.ex: He does the maintenance of gardens every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周都进行花园的维护。
words.en: The upkeep and care of cultivated outdoor areas.

words.ex: The meeting will be held at the town hall.
words.ex_cn: 会议将在市政厅举行。
words.en: A town hall is a building used for the administration of local government, or a meeting at which a public official or political candidate addresses an audience.

words.tr: phrase. 性价比高的；物有所值的
words.ex: This phone is good value for the price.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机物有所值。
words.en: If something is good value, it is of high quality or worth the money that is spent on it.

words.ex: He put an ice pack on his knee after the injury.
words.ex_cn: 他在膝盖受伤后敷了一个冰袋。
words.en: A bag filled with ice or a gel that can be frozen, used to cool an injury or to keep food cold.

words.tr: phrase. 报警系统；警报装置
words.ex: The house has an alarm system to keep it safe.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子有一个报警系统来保障安全。
words.en: An alarm system is a system designed to detect intrusion – unauthorized entry – into a building or other areas such as a home or school.

words.tr: phrase. 订单部分；订购区域；订单栏目
words.ex: He went to the order section to pick up his food.
words.ex_cn: 他去订餐区取他的食物。
words.en: A part of a document, form, or system where requests or instructions are formally placed.

words.ex: He bought new walking boots for the hike.
words.ex_cn: 他为远足买了新的1058型徒步靴。
words.en: Walking boots are sturdy footwear designed for walking long distances, typically used for hiking or trekking.

words.tr: phrase. 高级水平；进阶程度；高等教育阶段
words.ex: He is at an advanced level in math.
words.ex_cn: 他的数学水平很高。
words.en: A stage of learning or difficulty that requires significant prior knowledge and expertise.

words.ex: The book keeper records all sales and expenses.
words.ex_cn: 记账员记录所有的销售和支出。
words.en: A book keeper is a person whose job is to keep records of the financial affairs of a business.

words.tr: phrase. 洗衣工作人员；负责洗涤事务的员工
words.ex: The washing staff clean clothes every morning.
words.ex_cn: 洗衣工作人员每天早上清洗衣服。
words.en: The washing staff refers to the group of employees responsible for washing and cleaning items, such as linens and clothes, in establishments like hotels and hospitals.

words.ex: They shouted, 'Welcome home!' when he walked through the door.
words.ex_cn: 当他走进门时，他们大喊：‘欢迎回家！’
words.en: A greeting used to express pleasure at someone's return to their home.

words.ex: We eat evening meals together as a family.
words.ex_cn: 我们一家人一起吃晚饭。
words.en: The main meal of the day, eaten in the evening.

words.tr: phrase. 公共医疗卫生服务
words.ex: The health service helps people get free check-ups.
words.ex_cn: 医疗服务帮助人们获得免费体检。
words.en: Health service refers to the medical services provided to the public, often by a government or private organization, aimed at maintaining or improving people's health.

words.tr: phrase. 老式的外观；过时的外表
words.ex: The house has an old-fashioned exterior.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子有一个老式的外观。
words.en: An architectural or design style that reflects past eras, often appearing outdated.

words.tr: phrase. 有限的停车位；停车受限
words.ex: There is limited parking near the school.
words.ex_cn: 学校附近停车位有限。
words.en: A situation where the number of available parking spaces is restricted, often leading to difficulties in finding a place to park.

words.ex: He gave me his name cards at the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议上给了我他的名片。
words.en: A small card printed or engraved with a person's name and often also with their job title, business address, and other contact information, used in business contexts.

words.tr: phrase. 服务经理；业务经理
words.ex: The service manager helps customers with their problems.
words.ex_cn: 服务经理帮助顾客解决他们的问题。
words.en: A service manager is a person responsible for overseeing the provision of services to customers, ensuring that the services meet the required standards and customer satisfaction.

words.tr: phrase. 私人公司；股份不公开公司
words.ex: He works for a private company.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家私营公司工作。
words.en: A private company is a business firm owned either by non-governmental organizations or by a relatively small number of shareholders or company members which does not offer or trade its company stock (shares) to the general public on the stock market exchanges, but rather the company's stock is offered, owned and traded or exchanged privately.

words.tr: phrase. 银色包装；银级套餐（常用于服务或产品分级中的中等档次）
words.ex: The gift came in a silver package.
words.ex_cn: 这份礼物是用银色包装的。
words.en: A premium or high-tier option within a range of products or services.

words.ex: This is my 588th family photo.
words.ex_cn: 这是我的第588张家庭合影。
words.en: A photograph of all the members of a family together.

words.ex: He uses energy saving bulbs at home.
words.ex_cn: 他在家里使用节能灯泡。
words.en: The act of saving energy, especially by using less electricity, gas, etc.

words.ex: He got his driving licence last month.
words.ex_cn: 他上个月拿到了驾照。
words.en: A driving licence is an official document permitting a specific individual to operate one or more types of motorized vehicles on public roads.

words.tr: phrase. 职位名称；职务头衔
words.ex: His job title is teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他的职位是老师。
words.en: The name given to a particular position or role within an organization, indicating the duties and responsibilities associated with it.

words.tr: phrase. 杂志的类型；刊物种类
words.ex: He reads a type of magazine about sports.
words.ex_cn: 他读一种关于体育的杂志。
words.en: A publication that focuses on a specific subject, interest, or industry.

words.ex: His starting salary is $30,000 per year.
words.ex_cn: 他的起薪是每年3万美元。
words.en: The initial amount of money that an employee is paid when they start a new job.

words.tr: phrase. 电话转接；呼叫转移
words.ex: The operator used calling diversion to send my call to another department.
words.ex_cn: 接线员使用电话转接将我的电话转接到另一个部门。
words.en: Calling diversion is a telecommunication service that allows users to redirect incoming calls to another telephone number.

words.tr: phrase. 更新护照；续签护照
words.ex: I need to renew my passport before the trip.
words.ex_cn: 我需要在旅行前更新我的护照。
words.en: To extend the validity of a passport, typically by applying for a new one before the old one expires.

words.tr: phrase. 当前地址；现居地址
words.ex: He wrote his current address on the form.
words.ex_cn: 他把现在的住址写在了表格上。
words.en: The place where someone is living or an organization is operating at the present time.

words.ex: I bought flowers at the 612 flower shop.
words.ex_cn: 我在612花店买了花。
words.en: A shop where flowers and ornamental plants are sold.

words.tr: phrase. 托儿所主管；幼儿园督导
words.ex: The nursery supervisor watches the children every day.
words.ex_cn: 托儿所主管每天照看孩子们。
words.en: A nursery supervisor is a person in charge of overseeing the operations and staff of a nursery, ensuring the well-being and development of the children.

words.tr: phrase. 金星；奖励用的金色星星贴纸（常用于表扬或激励）
words.ex: The teacher gives gold stars for good work.
words.ex_cn: 老师因为表现好而给金色星星。
words.en: A symbol of praise or achievement, often used in educational or motivational contexts.

words.ex: He went to the film festival last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周去了电影节。
words.en: A film festival is an organized, extended presentation of films in one or more cinemas or screening venues, usually in a single city or region.

words.tr: phrase. 特殊要求；特定需求
words.ex: He has a special requirement for his diet.
words.ex_cn: 他对饮食有特殊要求。
words.en: A specific condition or criterion that must be met, distinct from general expectations.

words.ex: He sits in the back row during class.
words.ex_cn: 他上课时坐在后排。
words.en: The rearmost section of a group, such as in a classroom or performance, often associated with less visibility.

words.ex: He wears dark trousers to work every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天穿深色长裤去上班。
words.en: Trousers that are black or very dark in colour, often worn for formal occasions.

words.tr: phrase. 家具设计师（指专门设计家具的专业人员）
words.ex: Furniture designers make chairs and tables.
words.ex_cn: 家具设计师制作椅子和桌子。
words.en: Furniture designers are professionals who design furniture, combining aesthetics, functionality, and consideration of the manufacturing process.

words.ex: The monthly rent is $800.
words.ex_cn: 月租金是800美元。
words.en: The amount of money that is paid every month for the use of a property.

words.tr: phrase. 首选职业；偏好的职业
words.ex: His preferred occupation is teaching.
words.ex_cn: 他理想的职业是教学。
words.en: A preferred occupation is a job or profession that someone likes more than others and would choose if possible.

words.tr: phrase. 以前的主要的；上一个主要的
words.ex: His previous major was biology.
words.ex_cn: 他先前的主修专业是生物学。
words.en: A field of study or academic discipline pursued before the current one, typically at a higher education level.

words.tr: phrase. 先前的工作经验；以往的工作经历
words.ex: He showed his previous working experience on his resume.
words.ex_cn: 他在简历上展示了他之前的工作经验。
words.en: The experience that someone has gained from working in the past, which is often considered when applying for a new job.

words.tr: phrase. 装饰用的气球；用于庆典或活动布置的彩色气球
words.ex: She bought decoration balloons for the party.
words.ex_cn: 她为派对买了装饰气球。
words.en: Balloons used for parties or events, often decorated with patterns or colours.

words.ex: I ordered a vegetable burger for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 我午餐点了一个蔬菜汉堡。
words.en: A vegetable burger is a type of burger that uses vegetables, grains, or legumes as the main ingredients instead of meat.

words.ex: Workers must follow safety regulations at the site.
words.ex_cn: 工人必须遵守现场的安全规定。
words.en: Rules or directives made and maintained by an authority to ensure safety.

words.ex: He bought return tickets for the flight.
words.ex_cn: 他买了往返机票。
words.en: Tickets for a journey that includes a return trip to the original point of departure.

words.ex: The computer showed an error message.
words.ex_cn: 电脑显示了一个错误信息。
words.en: A message displayed by a computer or other device to inform the user of an error that has occurred.

words.tr: phrase. 客户服务人员；负责处理客户咨询、投诉及提供服务支持的工作人员
words.ex: The customer service officer helped me with my refund.
words.ex_cn: 客服人员帮我处理了退款。
words.en: A customer service officer is a professional responsible for addressing customer inquiries, complaints, and providing information about products and services.

words.tr: phrase. 花园房；建在花园中的独立小屋，通常用作休闲室、办公室或客房
words.ex: He works in the garden room every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都在花园房间工作。
words.en: A garden room is a room in a house that is adjacent to a garden, designed to provide a space that combines the comfort of indoor living with the beauty and tranquility of the outdoors.

words.ex: He packed his sleeping bag for the camping trip.
words.ex_cn: 他为露营旅行打包了睡袋。
words.en: A sleeping bag is a warmly lined or padded bag for sleeping in, especially outdoors.

words.tr: phrase. 偏僻的地点；与世隔绝之处；孤立的小点
words.ex: He sat in an isolated spot by the lake.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在湖边一个偏僻的地方。
words.en: A place that is far from others and not easily reached or accessed.

words.ex: She uses the washing machine every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 她每星期天都用洗衣机。
words.en: A washing machine is a machine that washes clothes, sheets, and other items.

words.tr: phrase. 汽车牌照号码；车辆编号
words.ex: The car number is 12345.
words.ex_cn: 车牌号是12345。
words.en: The unique identifier assigned to a vehicle, typically displayed on a plate at the front and rear, used for official identification purposes.

words.ex: We went on a group trip to the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 我们去山区进行了一次团体旅行。
words.en: A journey or excursion made by a group of people.

words.tr: phrase. 自驾的；自行驾驶的（尤指租车服务）
words.ex: They went on a self drive trip across the country.
words.ex_cn: 他们进行了一次自驾游，横跨全国。
words.en: The act of driving a vehicle oneself, especially on a journey or vacation, without the need for a professional driver.

words.tr: phrase. 无烟房间；禁止吸烟的客房
words.ex: We booked a non-smoking room for our stay.
words.ex_cn: 我们为住宿预订了一间无烟房。
words.en: A room in which smoking is not allowed, designed to provide a smoke-free environment for guests.

words.ex: The children go to the culture centre to learn dance.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们去文化中心学习舞蹈。
words.en: A facility or venue dedicated to the promotion and display of artistic, cultural, or community activities.

words.tr: phrase. 在星空下的梦幻时光；指在夜晚星空下做梦或沉思的宁静时刻
words.ex: They sleep under stars in dreamtime.
words.ex_cn: 他们在星空下进入梦乡。
words.en: A period or state of imaginative exploration and creativity, often associated with night-time inspiration or storytelling.

words.tr: phrase. 现代作家；当代作者
words.ex: Modern authors write about everyday life.
words.ex_cn: 现代作家写关于日常生活。
words.en: Contemporary writers or literary figures whose works are currently influential or widely read.

words.ex: He picked up a long stick to reach the ball.
words.ex_cn: 他捡起一根长棍去够球。
words.en: A long, thin piece of wood or similar material, typically used as a support or as a tool.

words.ex: The hotel offers free parking for guests.
words.ex_cn: 酒店为客人提供免费停车。
words.en: Parking that does not require payment.

words.tr: phrase. 周报；每周收益；每周回报
words.ex: He sends his weekly return to his manager every Friday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周五向经理发送周报。
words.en: A return journey made within a week, especially in the context of travel or commuting.

words.tr: phrase. 额外的空间；多余的房间
words.ex: There is an extra room in our house.
words.ex_cn: 我们家多了一个房间。
words.en: Additional space or capacity beyond what is normally required or available.

words.tr: phrase. 银行间的转帐； 银行汇款
words.ex: He made a bank transfer to pay his rent.
words.ex_cn: 他通过银行转账支付了房租。
words.en: A bank transfer is a method of transferring money from one bank account to another.

words.tr: phrase. 很短的时间；短暂的期间
words.ex: He will be back in a short time.
words.ex_cn: 他一会儿就回来。
words.en: A brief period of time.

words.tr: phrase. 要求日期；规定日期；必填日期
words.ex: The required date is next Monday.
words.ex_cn: 所需的日期是下周一。
words.en: A specific day or time by which something must be completed or submitted.

words.tr: phrase. 住宿类型；指居住或停留的场所种类，如酒店、公寓、民宿等
words.ex: He chose a shared apartment as his accommodation type.
words.ex_cn: 他选择合租公寓作为他的住宿类型。
words.en: A category or kind of lodging or housing available for rent or use by guests or residents.

words.ex: He pays the bills and meals every month.
words.ex_cn: 他每个月支付账单和餐费。
words.en: Expenses related to food and the cost of living, such as rent, utilities, and groceries.

words.ex: He goes to the sports center every Saturday.
words.ex_cn: 他每个星期六都去体育中心。
words.en: A sports center is a place where people can go to participate in various sports and physical activities. It typically includes facilities such as gyms, swimming pools, and courts for games like basketball and tennis.

words.ex: The roadrunners run fast across the desert.
words.ex_cn: 哔哔鸟在沙漠中快速奔跑。
words.en: A roadrunner is a fast-running bird found in the deserts of the southwestern United States and Mexico, known for its distinctive appearance and speed.

words.tr: phrase. 职位要求；工作要求
words.ex: The job requirement is to speak English fluently.
words.ex_cn: 这份工作的要求是能流利地说英语。
words.en: A necessary skill, qualification, or experience that an employer expects a candidate to have for a specific job.

words.tr: phrase. 当前的职业；目前的工作
words.ex: His current occupation is a teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他目前的职业是老师。
words.en: Your present job or profession.

words.tr: phrase. 住院时长；停留时间；逗留期限
words.ex: The length of stay in hospital was only three days.
words.ex_cn: 住院时长只有三天。
words.en: The period of time that a person spends in a particular place, especially in a hospital or hotel.

words.tr: phrase. 住宿类型；居住设施种类
words.ex: He chose a type of accommodation near the school.
words.ex_cn: 他选择了一种靠近学校的住宿方式。
words.en: A category or kind of lodging or housing that is available for people to stay in, such as hotels, hostels, or rental apartments.

words.tr: phrase. 春季公园；春天时开放或景色宜人的公园
words.ex: We walk in spring park every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我们每天早上在春日公园散步。
words.en: A public park or recreational area that features natural springs, often used for leisure activities and relaxation.

words.ex: The starting date is next Monday.
words.ex_cn: 开始日期是下周一。
words.en: The date on which something begins.

words.tr: phrase. 咨询号码；参考号码
words.ex: Please call the hotline and give your reference number.
words.ex_cn: 请拨打热线并提供你的咨询号码。
words.en: A reference number is a unique identifier assigned to a specific transaction or document, used for tracking and identification purposes.

words.ex: The estimated value of the house is $300,000.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子的估价是30万美元。
words.en: An estimated value is a value that is calculated or guessed based on the available information.

words.tr: phrase. 家庭使用；供家庭使用的
words.ex: This tool is for family use only.
words.ex_cn: 这个工具仅供家庭使用。
words.en: Intended for use by all members of a household, typically for everyday domestic purposes.

words.ex: The pilot does a safety check before takeoff.
words.ex_cn: 飞行员在起飞前进行安全检查。
words.en: An inspection or examination to ensure that something is safe or in proper condition.

words.tr: phrase. 首选的设备；优先选用的装备
words.ex: The team used their preferred equipment for the experiment.
words.ex_cn: 团队在实验中使用了他们首选的设备。
words.en: Equipment that is chosen over others because it is considered better or more suitable for a particular purpose.

words.tr: phrase. 航班服务；飞行服务
words.ex: The flight service was slow and rude.
words.ex_cn: 航班服务又慢又粗鲁。
words.en: Flight service refers to the services provided to passengers during a flight, including meals, entertainment, and customer care.

words.tr: phrase. 非高峰时间；低谷时段
words.ex: The train is less crowded during off-peak time.
words.ex_cn: 在非高峰时段，火车人少一些。
words.en: A period when demand for something is lower than at other times, often resulting in lower prices.

words.tr: phrase. 最高价格；价格上限
words.ex: The government set a maximum price for bread.
words.ex_cn: 政府为面包设定了最高价格。
words.en: The highest price that can be charged for a product or service, often set by regulation or market conditions.

words.tr: phrase. 直升机旅行；乘坐直升机的行程
words.ex: We took a helicopter trip over the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 我们乘坐直升机飞越了山脉。
words.en: A journey or excursion made by helicopter, typically for sightseeing, transportation, or special occasions.

words.tr: phrase. 会员编号；成员号码
words.ex: He gave his membership number to the clerk.
words.ex_cn: 他把会员号给了店员。
words.en: A membership number is a unique identifier assigned to a member of an organization or club, used to access services or benefits.

words.ex: She buys organic food at the market.
words.ex_cn: 她在市场上购买有机食品。
words.en: Food produced without the use of chemical fertilizers, pesticides, or other artificial chemicals.

words.ex: He bought new sports equipment for the game.
words.ex_cn: 他为比赛买了新的体育器材。
words.en: The items used in sports or physical activities, such as balls, bats, gloves, and protective gear.

words.ex: The toy is made of poor quality plastic.
words.ex_cn: 这个玩具是用劣质塑料制成的。
words.en: Poor quality refers to something that does not meet the expected standards of excellence or is not of high quality.

words.tr: phrase. + n. 新鲜的产品；指刚生产或收获、未变质的食品或其他商品
words.ex: The market sells fresh products every morning.
words.ex_cn: 市场每天早上出售新鲜产品。
words.en: Fresh products refer to goods, especially food, that are recently harvested or produced and have not been preserved or processed.

words.ex: He practices organic farming on his small farm.
words.ex_cn: 他在自己的小农场上从事有机农业。
words.en: Organic farming is a method of crop and livestock production that involves much more than choosing not to use pesticides, fertilizers, genetically modified organisms, antibiotics, and growth hormones.

words.tr: phrase. 自行车道；骑行路线
words.ex: He rides his bike on a quiet cycling route.
words.ex_cn: 他骑自行车在一条安静的骑行路线上传。
words.en: A designated path or course for bicycles, often marked and maintained for safety and convenience.

words.ex: He improved his language skill by practicing every day.
words.ex_cn: 他通过每天练习提高了语言技能。
words.en: The ability to use a language effectively for communication.

words.tr: phrase. 团体折扣；集体优惠
words.ex: The hotel offers a group discount for five or more people.
words.ex_cn: 酒店对五人或以上的团体提供折扣。
words.en: A reduction in price given to a group of people purchasing together.

words.ex: He took a night flight to New York.
words.ex_cn: 他乘坐了夜间航班去纽约。
words.en: A flight that takes place during the night.

words.tr: phrase. 白山（常指美国新罕布什尔州的白山山脉，或泛指白雪覆盖的山）
words.ex: They hiked up the white mountain last summer.
words.ex_cn: 去年夏天，他们徒步登上了白山。
words.en: A mountain with a white appearance, typically due to snow or light-colored rock, often used as a proper name for specific peaks.

words.ex: He emptied the dust bag of the vacuum cleaner.
words.ex_cn: 他清空了吸尘器的集尘袋。
words.en: A dust bag is a bag that collects dust and dirt in a vacuum cleaner or a protective cover that prevents dust from settling on an object.

words.ex: They played golf on the golf court every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他们每个周末都在高尔夫球场打高尔夫。
words.en: A golf court is a large, open area of land where the game of golf is played, typically consisting of a series of holes, each with a tee, fairway, and green.

words.ex: He loves rock climbing on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在周末攀岩。
words.en: Rock climbing is the sport or activity of climbing steep rock surfaces, especially with the help of ropes and special equipment.

words.tr: phrase. 友好的面孔；友善的人们
words.ex: The teachers have friendly faces.
words.ex_cn: 老师们有着友善的面容。
words.en: Showing kindness and pleasantness towards others.

words.ex: He eats no nuts because he is allergic.
words.ex_cn: 他不吃任何坚果，因为他过敏。
words.en: Indicates that a product or food item does not contain any nuts, often to prevent allergic reactions.

words.tr: phrase. 杂货店；食品杂货商店
words.ex: They buy food at grocery stores.
words.ex_cn: 他们在杂货店买食物。
words.en: A grocery store is a retail store that primarily sells food, either fresh or packaged, and other household supplies.

words.tr: phrase. 鸡蛋盒；蛋托（用于盛放鸡蛋的纸质或塑料容器）
words.ex: He put the eggs back into the egg cartons.
words.ex_cn: 他把鸡蛋放回了蛋盒里。
words.en: A box or container designed to hold and protect eggs, typically made of cardboard or plastic.

words.ex: He threw the juice bottles into the bin.
words.ex_cn: 他把果汁瓶扔进了垃圾桶。
words.en: Containers specifically designed to hold juice.

words.ex: The electricity supply stopped during the storm.
words.ex_cn: 暴风雨期间电力供应中断了。
words.en: The provision of electricity to power homes, businesses, and public services.

words.ex: The company has a strong protection policy for customer data.
words.ex_cn: 该公司对客户数据有强大的保护政策。
words.en: A protection policy refers to a set of measures or strategies designed to safeguard the interests, rights, or welfare of a particular group, sector, or entity against external threats or competition.

words.tr: phrase. 团体预订折扣；集体订票优惠
words.ex: We got a group booking discount for our family trip.
words.ex_cn: 我们为家庭旅行获得了团体预订折扣。
words.en: A reduction in price offered when multiple people book a service together, such as a flight or hotel stay.

words.ex: He took sick pay when he had a fever.
words.ex_cn: 他发烧时请了病假工资。
words.en: Sick pay is money paid by an employer to an employee who is unable to work because of illness.

words.tr: phrase. 货车司机；驾驶厢式货车的人
words.ex: The van driver delivers packages every morning.
words.ex_cn: 货车司机每天早上送货。
words.en: A van driver is a person who drives a van, typically as their job.

words.ex: He wears leather shoes to work.
words.ex_cn: 他穿皮鞋去上班。
words.en: Shoes made of leather material, typically for formal or semi-formal occasions.

words.ex: He works for an advertising company in New York.
words.ex_cn: 他在纽约的一家广告公司工作。
words.en: An advertising company is a business firm that creates, plans, and handles advertising for its clients.

words.tr: phrase. 教学场所；授课地点
words.ex: The school found a new teaching venue for the art class.
words.ex_cn: 学校为美术课找到了一个新的教学场所。
words.en: A place where teaching activities are conducted.

words.ex: The total payment is $500.
words.ex_cn: 总付款是500美元。
words.en: The full amount of money that is paid for something.

words.tr: phrase. 素食；不含肉类或鱼类的食物
words.ex: He eats vegetarian food every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都吃素食。
words.en: Food that does not contain meat or fish, and sometimes other animal products, especially for moral, religious, or health reasons.

words.tr: phrase. + n. 不同的表演者
words.ex: Different performers sang on the stage last night.
words.ex_cn: 昨晚有不同的表演者在舞台上演唱。
words.en: Performers who are not the same as each other, often in a show or event.

words.tr: phrase. 新歌剧；现代歌剧；新式歌剧作品
words.ex: They are watching a new opera this evening.
words.ex_cn: 他们今晚要看一部新歌剧。
words.en: A new opera refers to a recently composed opera, often characterized by innovative themes, music, and staging techniques.

words.tr: phrase. 冰箱型号；指冰箱的具体型号或款式
words.ex: He bought a new fridge model last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周买了一个新的冰箱型号。
words.en: A specific type or version of a refrigerator, distinguished by its features, size, design, or manufacturer.

words.tr: phrase. 顶置安装；顶部支架；上部固定装置
words.ex: He uses a top mount sink in his kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 他在厨房里使用一个台面安装的水槽。
words.en: A top mount refers to something that is installed or positioned at the top of a structure or device, such as a top mount freezer in a refrigerator.

words.tr: phrase. 财务损失；经济损失
words.ex: The company had a financial loss last year.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司去年遭受了财务损失。
words.en: A financial loss is a loss of money or decrease in financial value.

words.tr: 架子上、遭受极大痛苦；处于极度焦虑或折磨之中
words.ex: The prisoner was on the rack, screaming in pain.
words.ex_cn: 囚犯被放在刑架上，痛苦地尖叫。
words.en: A state of extreme tension or anxiety, as if being stretched or tortured physically.

words.tr: phrase. 长带子；长肩带；长皮带
words.ex: She carries a long strap on her shoulder.
words.ex_cn: 她肩上背着一条长带子。
words.en: A long strap is a strip of material, such as leather or fabric, that is longer in length and used to carry, secure, or fasten items.

words.ex: He wears a leather jacket in winter.
words.ex_cn: 他冬天穿皮夹克。
