words.en: A leather jacket is a jacket-length coat that is usually worn on top of other apparel, and which is made from the tanned hide of various animals. The leather material is typically dyed black, or various shades of brown, but a wide range of colors is possible.

words.ex: The total value of the apples is ten dollars.
words.ex_cn: 这些苹果的总价值是十美元。
words.en: The complete worth or amount of something, especially when calculated in terms of money.

words.tr: phrase. 城市外围的公共区域；公共郊区
words.ex: The children play soccer on the public outskirts near the city border.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在城市边界附近的公共外围区域踢足球。
words.en: The outer areas of a town or city, away from the center.

words.tr: phrase. 客户服务；顾客服务
words.ex: The customer service helped me fix my order.
words.ex_cn: 客服帮助我解决了我的订单问题。
words.en: The assistance and advice provided by a company to those people who buy or use its products or services.

words.ex: He sent the package by international express.
words.ex_cn: 他通过国际快递寄出了包裹。
words.en: International express refers to a fast delivery service that sends packages or documents across countries.

words.ex: He paid the postal fee to send the letter.
words.ex_cn: 他支付了邮费来寄这封信。
words.en: The charge for sending mail or packages through the postal service.

words.tr: phrase. 丢失的邮件；遗失的信件
words.ex: He found some lost mails in the office drawer.
words.ex_cn: 他在办公室抽屉里找到了一些丢失的邮件。
words.en: Mail that has been misplaced or failed to reach its intended recipient.

words.tr: phrase. 身份识别码；身份代码编号
words.ex: Please enter your id code numbers to log in.
words.ex_cn: 请输入你的身份识别码以登录。
words.en: A unique sequence of letters or numbers used to identify a person, item, or record.

words.tr: phrase. 学生折扣；专为学生提供的价格优惠
words.ex: The student discount saves money on bus tickets.
words.ex_cn: 学生折扣可以节省公交车票的钱。
words.en: A reduction in price offered to students, typically upon presentation of a valid student ID.

words.ex: I wear comfortable shoes to walk all day.
words.ex_cn: 我穿舒适的鞋子走一整天。
words.en: Footwear designed to be worn without causing discomfort or pain.

words.tr: phrase. 白天的课程；日间班
words.ex: He attends daytime class every Monday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周一都上白天的课。
words.en: A class that is scheduled during the day, typically in the morning or afternoon.

words.tr: phrase. 货币价值；金钱的购买力或效用
words.ex: The value of money changes over time.
words.ex_cn: 货币的价值会随时间变化。
words.en: The worth of money in terms of what it can buy, considering factors like inflation and purchasing power.

words.tr: phrase. 在运输中；在途中；在转运过程中
words.ex: The package is in transit.
words.ex_cn: 这个包裹正在运输途中。
words.en: If someone or something is in transit, they are travelling or being taken from one place to another.

words.tr: phrase. 等待时长；等候时间
words.ex: The length of waiting was too long.
words.ex_cn: 等待的时间太长了。
words.en: The duration of time spent waiting for something to happen or someone to arrive.

words.tr: phrase. 电子游戏中心；电子游乐场
words.ex: The children play video games at the electronic game centre.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在电子游戏中心玩电子游戏。
words.en: An establishment where people can play video games on arcade machines or consoles.

words.tr: phrase. 免费的食谱；无需付费即可获取的烹饪配方
words.ex: You can download a free recipe from the website.
words.ex_cn: 你可以从网站上下载一份免费的食谱。
words.en: A set of instructions for preparing a dish that is available at no cost.

words.tr: phrase. 亚洲烹饪课程；教授亚洲菜系制作方法的烹饪班
words.ex: She takes an asian cooking class every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 她每周末上一节亚洲烹饪课。
words.en: A class that teaches the techniques and recipes of Asian cuisine.

words.ex: The meeting will be held at the conference centre.
words.ex_cn: 会议将在会议中心举行。
words.en: A conference centre is a building or complex designed to host conferences and meetings, often equipped with facilities such as meeting rooms, auditoriums, and exhibition spaces.

words.tr: phrase. 商业公司；从事商业活动的企业组织
words.ex: Many business companies hire new workers every year.
words.ex_cn: 许多公司每年都会雇佣新员工。
words.en: Organizations engaged in commercial, industrial, or professional activities.

words.tr: phrase. 不方便的地点；位置不便之处
words.ex: The hotel has an inconvenient location near the airport.
words.ex_cn: 这家酒店的位置不方便，靠近机场。
words.en: A place that is not easy to reach or not suitable for a particular purpose.

words.tr: phrase. 基本套餐；基础组合
words.ex: He bought the basic package for $10.
words.ex_cn: 他花了10美元买了基础套餐。
words.en: The most fundamental or standard version of a product or service, often with limited features.

words.tr: phrase. 良好的表现；出色的发挥
words.ex: He showed good performance in the math test.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学考试中表现很好。
words.en: A good performance refers to an act or instance of performing a task or function with success or excellence.

words.tr: phrase. 公开演出；公开展示；公众表演
words.ex: He will give a public show tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天将举办一场公开表演。
words.en: A performance or display intended for viewing by the general public.

words.tr: phrase. 声乐课；发声训练课程
words.ex: He takes a vocal class every Wednesday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周三上声乐课。
words.en: A category of singing voice, such as soprano or bass, based on range and timbre.

words.ex: The course fee is fifty dollars.
words.ex_cn: 这门课的费用是五十美元。
words.en: The amount of money that must be paid to enroll in a course or program of study.

words.tr: phrase. 个人导师；私人导师
words.ex: He has a personal tutor to help him with math.
words.ex_cn: 他请了一位私人导师来帮他学习数学。
words.en: A personal tutor is someone who gives private lessons to a student, often to help them with a particular subject or to prepare for an exam.

words.ex: The ozone layer protects us from the sun's harmful rays.
words.ex_cn: 臭氧层保护我们免受太阳有害射线的伤害。
words.en: The ozone layer is a layer in the Earth's stratosphere that contains a high concentration of ozone (O3) molecules, which absorb most of the Sun's harmful ultraviolet radiation.

words.tr: phrase. 沿海道路；沿海岸线修建的道路
words.ex: The car drove slowly on the coastal roads.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在沿海公路上缓慢行驶。
words.en: Roads situated along or near a coastline, often scenic but potentially prone to erosion.

words.ex: He went to the changing room to put on his shoes.
words.ex_cn: 他去更衣室穿鞋。
words.en: A changing room is a room where people can change their clothes, for example before and after sports or at a store.

words.tr: phrase. 额外的运输费用；附加的交通成本
words.ex: The extra transportation cost was fifty dollars.
words.ex_cn: 额外的运输费用是五十美元。
words.en: An additional fee charged for transporting goods or people beyond the standard rate.

words.ex: I bought this book for personal use.
words.ex_cn: 我买这本书是供个人使用的。
words.en: Use of an item or service for one's own private purposes, not for business or public sharing.

words.ex: He walked through the side gate to avoid the crowd.
words.ex_cn: 他从侧门走过，以避开人群。
words.en: A gate at the side of a building or property, providing an alternative entrance or exit.

words.tr: phrase. 绿色出行；环保的骑行或交通方式
words.ex: Biking to work is a green ride.
words.ex_cn: 骑自行车上班是一种绿色出行。
words.en: An environmentally friendly mode of transport, typically using low-emission vehicles or active travel.

words.ex: He put the child seat in the back of the car.
words.ex_cn: 他把儿童安全座椅放在车后座。
words.en: A child seat is a specially designed seat for children to use in vehicles, which provides protection in the event of a crash.

words.tr: phrase. 职业介绍所；就业服务机构
words.ex: He found a job through a job agency.
words.ex_cn: 他通过一家职业介绍所找到了工作。
words.en: A job agency is a business that helps people find employment and employers find workers.

words.ex: The company hired temporary staff for the holiday season.
words.ex_cn: 公司为假期季节雇佣了临时工。
words.en: Temporary staff refers to employees who are hired on a non-permanent basis to meet the short-term needs of a business or organization.

words.tr: phrase. 注册流程；登记程序
words.ex: He completed the registration process last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周完成了注册流程。
words.en: The series of steps required to officially enroll or apply for something, often involving forms and checks.

words.tr: phrase. 机构代表；代理机构的代表人员
words.ex: Agency representatives visited the school last week.
words.ex_cn: 机构代表上周访问了这所学校。
words.en: Agency representatives are individuals who act on behalf of an organization or agency, representing its interests and policies in various forums and discussions.

words.tr: phrase. 人际交往能力；人际沟通技巧
words.ex: He has good interpersonal skills.
words.ex_cn: 他有良好的人际交往能力。
words.en: The ability to communicate or interact well with other people.

words.tr: phrase. 懂电脑；电脑操作技术
words.ex: He is computer literate and can use Excel well.
words.ex_cn: 他懂电脑，能很好地使用Excel。
words.en: Having sufficient knowledge and skill to be able to use computers and related technology efficiently.

words.tr: phrase. 季票；（在一定期限内可多次使用的）通票
words.ex: He buys a season ticket for the football matches.
words.ex_cn: 他购买了足球比赛的季票。
words.en: A season ticket is a ticket that allows the holder to attend a specified number of events, such as sports games or concerts, within a certain period, usually a season, for a single price.

words.tr: phrase. 赛跑者；美洲走鹃（一种生活在北美沙漠地区的鸟类）
words.ex: The road runner ran fast across the desert.
words.ex_cn: 赛跑者快速跑过沙漠。
words.en: A road runner is a fast-running bird that lives in the deserts of North America, known for its speed and the distinctive crest on its head.

words.ex: He paddles a canoe on the lake.
words.ex_cn: 他划着独木舟在湖上航行。
words.en: A canoe is a small, narrow boat that you move through the water using a paddle.

words.tr: n. 标签；“label”的复数； v. 贴标签；
words.ex: The bottles have clear labels.
words.ex_cn: 这些瓶子上有清晰的标签。
words.en: A label is a piece of paper, plastic, or other material which is attached to an object and gives information about it.

words.tr: n. 奢华；奢侈品；难得的享受；
words.ex: She bought a luxury dress for the party.
words.ex_cn: 她为派对买了一件奢华的裙子。
words.en: Luxury is very great comfort, especially among beautiful and expensive surroundings.

words.ex: The police put the thief in a lock-up.
words.ex_cn: 警察把小偷关进了拘留所。
words.en: A lock-up is a place where people are kept temporarily in custody, especially a police station with cells for suspects. It can also refer to a period during which shares cannot be traded after an initial public offering.

words.ex: The ferries take people across the river every hour.
words.ex_cn: 渡船每小时运送人们过河。
words.en: A ferry is a boat that transports passengers and sometimes also vehicles, usually across rivers or short stretches of sea.

words.ex: This chair is very comfortable.
words.ex_cn: 这把椅子非常舒适。
words.en: If a piece of furniture or an item of clothing is comfortable, it makes you feel physically relaxed when you use it or wear it, for example because it is soft.

words.ex: The museum focuses on the preservation of old books.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆专注于旧书的保存。
words.en: The act of keeping something in its original state or in good condition.

words.tr: n. 权威；官方机构；权力；权威人士；当局；
words.ex: The teacher is an authority on ancient history.
words.ex_cn: 这位老师是古代史方面的权威。
words.en: The power to make decisions or enforce rules.

words.ex: A pink flamingo stands in the shallow water.
words.ex_cn: 一只粉红色的火烈鸟站在浅水中。
words.en: A flamingo is a large bird with pink feathers, long thin legs, a long neck, and a beak that curves downwards. Flamingos live near water in warm countries.

words.ex: He walks on the trails every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上在小径上散步。
words.en: Trails can refer to marks left by the passage of someone or something, or paths through rough country.

words.ex: The village is at an altitude of 2,000 meters.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄的海拔是2000米。
words.en: The height of an object or point in relation to sea level or ground level.

words.ex: The desert has little vegetation.
words.ex_cn: 这个沙漠植被很少。
words.en: Vegetation refers to plants in general, or the plants that are found in a particular area. It can also refer to a life that is dull or inactive, often due to illness or lack of exercise.

words.ex: He practices calligraphy every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上练习书法。
words.en: Calligraphy is the art of producing decorative handwriting or lettering with a pen or brush.

words.ex: The layout of the room makes it feel bigger.
words.ex_cn: 房间的布局让它显得更大。
words.en: The way in which the parts of something are arranged or laid out.

words.tr:
n. 格式；
v. 格式化；
words.ex: The file is in PDF format.
words.ex_cn: 这个文件是PDF格式。
words.en: The way in which something is arranged or set out.

words.tr: n. 洪水泛滥； v. 淹没；“flood”的现在分词；
words.ex: The heavy rain caused flooding in the city.
words.ex_cn: 大雨导致了城市洪水泛滥。
words.en: Flooding refers to the overflow of water onto land that is normally dry, often caused by heavy rainfall, melting snow, or the failure of dams or levees.

words.ex: He lives in a rural village with no big shops.
words.ex_cn: 他住在没有大商店的农村村庄里。
words.en: Rural areas are areas which are not towns or cities. They are often farming or agricultural areas.

words.tr: adj. 勤勉的；努力工作的
words.ex: He is hard-working and always finishes his homework on time.
words.ex_cn: 他很勤奋，总是按时完成作业。
words.en: Someone who is hard-working always puts a lot of effort and care into their work.

words.ex: He used a torch to find his keys in the dark.
words.ex_cn: 他用手电筒在黑暗中找钥匙。
words.en: A torch is a stick with a flame on one end that is used as a source of light, or a portable battery-powered electric lamp.

words.tr:
n. 袋子；
v. 劫掠；
words.ex: He carried the apples in a burlap sack.
words.ex_cn: 他把苹果装在一个麻布袋里。
words.en: A sack is a large bag made of rough woven material, used for storing or carrying goods. It can also refer to the act of dismissing someone from employment or the act of looting a place.

words.ex: They bought souvenirs from the gift shop.
words.ex_cn: 他们从礼品店买了纪念品。
words.en: Objects that you buy or keep to remind yourself of a special occasion or a place you have visited.

words.tr:
n. 漏斗；
v. 输送；
words.ex: He poured the oil through a funnel.
words.ex_cn: 他把油通过漏斗倒了进去。
words.en: A funnel is an object with a wide, circular top and a narrow tube at the bottom, used for pouring liquids or powders into containers with small openings.

words.tr: n. 会合地点；约会；集会
words.ex: They will rendezvous at the park at 6 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 他们将在晚上6点在公园会合。
words.en: A rendezvous is a meeting that has been arranged between people, often secretly.

words.ex: The company is doing vetting for new employees.
words.ex_cn: 公司正在对新员工进行背景审查。
words.en: The process of carefully and critically examining someone or something, especially to ensure suitability or safety.

words.ex: He sent an acknowledgement email after receiving the gift.
words.ex_cn: 他收到礼物后发了一封确认邮件。
words.en: An acknowledgement is a statement or action which recognizes that something exists or is true.

words.ex: The park protects many kinds of wildlife.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园保护许多种类的野生生物。
words.en: Wildlife refers to animals and plants that live and grow in natural conditions.

words.tr: n. （校外）学生宿舍；旅社；招待所；
words.ex: The students live in a cheap hostel near the university.
words.ex_cn: 学生们住在大学附近的一家便宜的学生宿舍里。
words.en: A hostel is a budget-oriented, shared-room accommodation that attracts a diverse clientele, including backpackers, students, and travelers seeking an economical place to stay.

words.ex: The children love the water-ride at the amusement park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们喜欢游乐园里的水上设施。
words.en: A water-ride is an amusement ride that involves water, typically found in theme parks or water parks, designed to provide entertainment and refreshment to its riders.

words.ex: He rode a rollercoaster at the amusement park.
words.ex_cn: 他在游乐园坐了过山车。
words.en: A rollercoaster is an amusement ride consisting of a series of cars that travel quickly along a winding track, typically with steep inclines and declines, providing sensations of excitement and fear.

words.ex: They celebrated their wedding anniversary with dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他们用晚餐庆祝结婚纪念日。
words.en: An anniversary is a date which is remembered or celebrated because a special event happened on that date in a previous year.

words.ex: The committee meets every Monday.
words.ex_cn: 委员会每周一开会。
words.en: A committee is a group of people who are chosen to do a particular job or make decisions on behalf of a larger group.

words.ex: We travel during off-peak hours to save money.
words.ex_cn: 我们在非高峰时段出行以节省费用。
words.en: Used to describe a time when something is less busy or less active, especially a time when fewer people are using a service or traveling.

words.ex: He dried his hands with a towel.
words.ex_cn: 他用毛巾擦干手。
words.en: A towel is a piece of thick soft cloth that you use to dry yourself with.

words.ex: The hotel offers an all-in package with meals and Wi-Fi.
words.ex_cn: 这家酒店提供包含餐食和Wi-Fi的全包服务。
words.en: Involving all one's resources, effort, or commitment.

words.ex: The hovercraft moves quickly over water.
words.ex_cn: 气垫船在水面上快速移动。
words.en: A hovercraft is a vehicle that travels quickly over land or water by floating on a cushion of air that it creates.

words.ex: The car is roadworthy after the repair.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车修好后可以上路了。
words.en: If a vehicle is roadworthy, it is in a suitable condition to be driven on the road.

words.ex: He overfilled the cup with water.
words.ex_cn: 他把杯子装得水都溢出来了。
words.en: To fill something beyond its capacity or beyond what is necessary.

words.ex: He loves archaeology and digs old artifacts.
words.ex_cn: 他热爱考古学，挖掘古代文物。
words.en: Archaeology is the study of the societies and peoples of the past by examining the remains of their buildings, tools, and other objects.

words.ex: The teacher gave a classification of animals into mammals and birds.
words.ex_cn: 老师将动物分为哺乳动物和鸟类。
words.en: The action or process of classifying something according to shared qualities or characteristics.

words.ex: He finished his coursework last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周完成了他的课程作业。
words.en: Coursework refers to the work that students do during a course of study, which is often assessed as part of their final grade.

words.tr: n. 越橘；小红莓；蔓越莓；蔓越橘
words.ex: He eats cranberry sauce with turkey at Thanksgiving.
words.ex_cn: 他在感恩节吃火鸡配蔓越莓酱。
words.en: A cranberry is a small, red, acid berry used in cooking.

words.tr:
n. 纪录片；
adj. 文书的；
words.ex: We watched a documentary about pandas last night.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨晚看了一部关于熊猫的纪录片。
words.en: A documentary is a film or television or radio programme that gives factual information about a particular subject.

words.ex: He threw the trash into the dustbin.
words.ex_cn: 他把垃圾扔进了垃圾桶。
words.en: A dustbin is a container for waste, especially one that is kept outside a house or other building.

words.ex: The children threw garbage on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们把垃圾扔在地上。
words.en: Waste material; unwanted or undesired material.

words.ex: He washed his hands to remove the dirt.
words.ex_cn: 他洗手以去除污垢。
words.en: Dirt is any substance that makes something unclean, such as mud or dust.

words.ex: He visits the fernery every morning to water the plants.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都去蕨类植物园给植物浇水。
words.en: A fernery is a place where ferns are grown, often as part of a botanical garden or conservatory.

words.ex: The teacher gave me the corrections for my essay.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我作文的修改意见。
words.en: Changes that are made to something in order to correct or improve it.

words.ex: He is learning theoretical physics at university.
words.ex_cn: 他正在大学学习理论物理。
words.en: A theoretical study or explanation is based on or uses the ideas and abstract principles of a subject, rather than the practical aspects or uses of it.

words.ex: This region has many mountains.
words.ex_cn: 这个地区有很多山。
words.en: A region is a large area of land that is different from other areas of land, for example because it is one of the different parts of a country with its own customs and characteristics, or because it has a particular geographical feature.

words.ex: The teacher gave us a math assignment.
words.ex_cn: 老师给我们布置了一份数学作业。
words.en: An assignment is a task or piece of work that you are given to do, especially as part of your job or studies.

words.tr:
adj. 微型的；
n. 微型画；小型模型；
words.ex: He bought a miniature car for his collection.
words.ex_cn: 他为他的收藏买了一辆微型汽车。
words.en: A miniature is a very small detailed painting, often a portrait. It can also refer to a small-scale model or representation of something.

words.ex: He ate a biscuit with tea.
words.ex_cn: 他喝茶时吃了一块饼干。
words.en: A biscuit is a small, flat cake that is crisp and usually sweet.

words.ex: The cows are grazing in the meadow.
words.ex_cn: 牛群正在草地上吃草。
words.en: A meadow is a field with grass and often wild flowers in it.

words.ex: The digestive system breaks down food.
words.ex_cn: 消化系统分解食物。
words.en: Relating to the process of digesting food.

words.ex: He uses fertilizer to help his plants grow.
words.ex_cn: 他用肥料帮助植物生长。
words.en: A substance that is added to soil to improve the growth of plants.

words.ex: The rabbit jumps over the small fence.
words.ex_cn: 兔子跳过了小篱笆。
words.en: A rabbit is a small furry animal with long ears. Rabbits are sometimes kept as pets.

words.tr: n. 垃圾；无价值的东西；
words.ex: The trash bin is full.
words.ex_cn: 垃圾桶满了。
words.en: Waste material or unwanted things that are thrown away.

words.ex: Eating vegetables gives you good nutrition.
words.ex_cn: 吃蔬菜能提供良好的营养。
words.en: The process of providing or obtaining the food necessary for health and growth.

words.tr: n. 变老；老化； v. “age”的现在分词；
words.ex: Aging is a natural part of life.
words.ex_cn: 变老是生命的一部分。
words.en: The process of becoming older or more mature.

words.ex: The flowers grow in a hothouse.
words.ex_cn: 这些花在温室里生长。
words.en: A hothouse is a building made of glass in which plants that need protection from cold weather are grown.

words.tr: n. 栖息地；居留地；产地；
words.ex: The panda's habitat is in the mountains of China.
words.ex_cn: 熊猫的栖息地在中国的山区。
words.en: The natural environment in which a species or group of species lives.

words.ex: Follow the procedure step by step.
words.ex_cn: 一步一步地按照步骤进行。
words.en: A procedure is a way of doing something, especially the usual or correct way.

words.tr:
n. 预算；预算金额；
adj. 廉价的；花钱少的；
v. 为 ... 做预算；
words.ex: We made a budget for our vacation.
words.ex_cn: 我们为旅行制定了一个预算。
words.en: A budget is a plan that shows how much money a person or organization will earn and how much they will need or be able to spend.

words.ex: He made a proposal to improve the school lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他提出了一个改善学校午餐的提案。
words.en: A proposal is a plan or suggestion, especially a formal one that is put forward for people to think about and decide upon.

words.ex: Children play on the pavement after school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们放学后在人行道上玩耍。
words.en: A pavement is a path with a hard surface, usually by the side of a road, that people walk on.

words.ex: There is a restriction on smoking in this building.
words.ex_cn: 这栋楼里禁止吸烟。
words.en: A restriction is an official rule that limits what you can do or that limits the amount or size of something.

words.ex: She learned cookery from her grandmother.
words.ex_cn: 她向祖母学习烹调法。
words.en: Cookery is the activity or skill of preparing and cooking food.

words.ex: Bread and rice are rich in carbohydrate.
words.ex_cn: 面包和米饭富含碳水化合物。
words.en: A carbohydrate is a substance found in foods such as bread, potatoes, and rice which provides your body with heat and energy and which consists of carbon, hydrogen, and oxygen.

words.ex: The change in her mood was noticeable.
words.ex_cn: 她情绪的变化显而易见。
words.en: Something that is noticeable is very obvious, so that it is easy to see, hear, or recognize.

words.ex: The fog reduced the visibility on the highway.
words.ex_cn: 雾降低了高速公路上的可见性。
words.en: The condition of being able to see or be seen; the degree to which something can be seen, especially in weather conditions.

words.ex: Traffic congestion caused delays on the highway.
words.ex_cn: 交通堵塞导致了高速公路的延误。
words.en: Congestion refers to the state of being overcrowded, especially with traffic or people, or the condition of being blocked or clogged.

words.tr:
v. 生气；用烟熏；冒烟
n. 烟雾；烟气；愤怒；烦恼
words.ex: He fumed when he saw the mess.
words.ex_cn: 他看到一团糟时生气了。
words.en: Fume refers to gas, smoke, or vapor that smells strongly or is dangerous to inhale. It can also mean to emit gas, smoke, or vapor, or to be very angry.

words.ex: He will modify the plan tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会更改计划。
words.en: To change something slightly, especially in order to make it more suitable for a particular purpose.

words.ex: He lost his fortune in the stock market.
words.ex_cn: 他在股市中失去了他的财产。
words.en: A large amount of money or assets; chance or luck as an external force in human affairs.

words.ex: A snake is a reptile.
words.ex_cn: 蛇是一种爬行动物。
words.en: A reptile is a cold-blooded vertebrate of the class Reptilia, including snakes, lizards, crocodiles, turtles, and tortoises. They are characterized by their scaly skin and the fact that they lay eggs on land.

words.ex: The country expanded its territory after the war.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家在战争后扩大了它的领土。
words.en: An area of land that is controlled by a particular country, ruler, or military force.

words.ex: They are monogamous and have been married for 20 years.
words.ex_cn: 他们是专一的，已经结婚20年了。
words.en: Being monogamous means having only one sexual partner at a time.

words.ex: He showed avoidance of difficult math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他回避困难的数学问题。
words.en: The act of keeping away from or preventing something from happening.

words.ex: His aspiration is to become a doctor.
words.ex_cn: 他的渴望是成为一名医生。
words.en: A strong desire to achieve something high or great.

words.tr: adj. 需氧的；好氧的；有氧的；
words.ex: Running is an aerobic exercise.
words.ex_cn: 跑步是有氧运动。
words.en: Aerobic exercise is physical exercise of relatively low intensity that depends primarily on the aerobic energy-generating process.

words.ex: The team went on an expedition to the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 这支队伍去山上探险了。
words.en: An expedition is an organized journey that is made for a particular purpose such as exploration.

words.ex: He likes math because it is easy.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢数学，因为它很简单。
words.en: Math is the study of numbers, quantities, and shapes.

words.ex: He looked up the number in the phonebook.
words.ex_cn: 他在电话簿里查找了那个号码。
words.en: A phonebook is a book that contains an alphabetical list of the names, addresses, and telephone numbers of the people in a particular area.

words.ex: Plants need nitrogen to grow.
words.ex_cn: 植物需要氮来生长。
words.en: A chemical element with the symbol N and atomic number 7. It is a colorless, odorless, tasteless gas that is the most plentiful element in Earth's atmosphere and is a constituent of all living tissues.

words.tr:
n. 架子；支架；齿条；破坏
v. 折磨；使痛苦；放在架上；累计（得分）
words.ex: He put the books on the rack.
words.ex_cn: 他把书放在架子上。
words.en: A rack is a frame or shelf, usually with bars or hooks, that is used for holding things or for hanging things on. As a verb, to rack something means to cause great pain or suffering to someone.

words.ex: He bought an eggplant at the market.
words.ex_cn: 他在市场上买了一个茄子。
words.en: An eggplant is a plant with large, egg-shaped, dark purple fruit that is eaten as a vegetable.

words.ex: He is allergic to shellfish.
words.ex_cn: 他对贝类过敏。
words.en: Shellfish are sea creatures that live in shells and are eaten as food.

words.ex: I bought fresh bread from the bakery.
words.ex_cn: 我从面包房买了新鲜面包。
words.en: A bakery is a place where bread, cakes, and pastries are made or sold.

words.ex: He is an adviser to the government.
words.ex_cn: 他是政府的顾问。
words.en: An adviser is a person who gives advice, especially someone who knows a lot about a particular subject.

words.tr: n. 车辆；交通工具；媒介；
words.ex: The vehicle stopped at the red light.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车在红灯前停了下来。
words.en: A vehicle is a machine such as a car, bus, or truck which has an engine and is used to carry people or goods from place to place.

words.ex: The lorry carried boxes to the warehouse.
words.ex_cn: 卡车把箱子运到了仓库。
words.en: A lorry is a large vehicle that is used to transport goods by road.

words.ex: The road closure caused an inconvenience to commuters.
words.ex_cn: 道路封闭给通勤者带来了不便。
words.en: Inconvenience refers to the state or quality of being inconvenient; trouble or difficulty caused to one's personal requirements or comfort.

words.ex: The software has five different modules.
words.ex_cn: 这个软件有五个不同的模块。
words.en: A module is one of the separate parts of a course of study, especially at a college or university.

words.ex: I bought a newspaper at the newsagent's.
words.ex_cn: 我在报刊亭买了一份报纸。
words.en: A shop or stall selling newspapers, magazines, and sometimes also stationery and sweets.

words.ex: The new policy is for the promotion of clean energy.
words.ex_cn: 这项新政策是为了促进清洁能源。
words.en: A promotion is a move to a more important job or rank in a company or organization.

words.ex: The transformation of the old factory into a park made the city nicer.
words.ex_cn: 把旧工厂改造成公园让城市变得更美了。
words.en: A transformation is a complete change in the appearance, form, or nature of something or someone.

words.ex: The villagers submitted petitions to the government for better roads.
words.ex_cn: 村民们向政府提交了请恩书，要求改善道路。
words.en: A petition is a document signed by a lot of people which asks a government or other official group to do a particular thing. If you petition someone in authority, you make a formal request to them.

words.ex: He makes occasional visits to his grandparents.
words.ex_cn: 他偶尔去看望祖父母。
words.en: Occasional means happening or done sometimes, but not regularly or often.

words.ex: The fence marks the boundary between the two gardens.
words.ex_cn: 这道围栏标志着两个花园的分界线。
words.en: A boundary is a real or imagined line that marks the edge or limit of something.

words.ex: The stars are visible at night.
words.ex_cn: 夜晚可以看到星星。
words.en: If something is visible, it can be seen.

words.tr: n. 迷宫；错综复杂的曲径；
words.ex: The children got lost in the maze.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在迷宫里迷路了。
words.en: A maze is a complex system of paths or passages in which it is easy to get lost.

words.tr: adj. 圆圈的；环形的；循环的；
words.ex: The table has a circular top.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子有一个圆形的桌面。
words.en: Something that is circular is shaped like a circle.

words.tr: n. 灌木篱笆；（复数）对冲；
words.ex: The garden is surrounded by tall hedges.
words.ex_cn: 花园被高高的灌木篱笆围住。
words.en: A hedge is a row of bushes or small trees, usually along the edge of a garden, field, or road. As a verb, to hedge means to avoid giving a direct answer or to protect oneself against financial loss.

words.ex: The gardeners water the plants every morning.
words.ex_cn: 园丁们每天早上给植物浇水。
words.en: A gardener is a person who is employed to take care of the gardens of a large house or park.

words.ex: The police discovered a scheme to steal money.
words.ex_cn: 警方发现了一个偷钱的阴谋。
words.en: A scheme is a plan or arrangement, especially one produced by a government or other organization, or a secret plan to do something, especially something illegal or dishonest.

words.ex: The warden checks the prison every morning.
words.ex_cn: 狱长每天早上检查监狱。
words.en: A warden is a person who is responsible for the supervision of a particular place or thing, or for ensuring that laws or rules are obeyed.

words.ex: The minority group voted for change.
words.ex_cn: 少数群体投票支持变革。
words.en: A minority is a group of people within a community or country who are different from the majority of the people there in race, religion, or political beliefs.

words.tr: adj. 支持的；支援的；给予帮助的；
words.ex: My parents are supportive when I study hard.
words.ex_cn: 当我努力学习时，我的父母总是支持我。
words.en: If you are supportive, you are kind and helpful to someone at a difficult or unhappy time in their life.

words.ex: The movie was fantastic!
words.ex_cn: 这部电影极好！
words.en: If you describe something as fantastic, you are emphasizing that you think it is very good or that you like it a lot.

words.ex: They visited three countries and saw many beautiful destinations.
words.ex_cn: 他们访问了三个国家，看到了许多美丽的景点。
words.en: A destination is the place to which someone or something is going or being sent.

words.ex: The movie is fascinating because it shows strange aliens.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影极有吸引力，因为它展示了奇怪的外星人。
words.en: If you describe something as fascinating, you find it very interesting and attractive, and your thoughts tend to concentrate on it.

words.ex: You have three options to choose from.
words.ex_cn: 你有三个选项可以选择。
words.en: An option is something that you can choose to do in preference to one or more alternatives.

words.tr:
v. 补充；
n. 补充物；附加费；
words.ex: He supplements his income by teaching part-time.
words.ex_cn: 他通过兼职教学来补充收入。
words.en: A supplement is something that is added to something else in order to make it complete or better.

words.tr: n. 替代选择；替代选择（alternative 的复数）；
words.ex: We need to find better alternatives to plastic.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要找到比塑料更好的替代选择。
words.en: An alternative is something that you can choose to do or use instead of something else.

words.ex: The parliament passed a new law about education.
words.ex_cn: 国会通过了一项关于教育的新法律。
words.en: A parliament is a legislative body of government, typically composed of elected representatives, that is responsible for making laws and representing the interests of the people.

words.ex: We walked along the promenade by the sea.
words.ex_cn: 我们在海边的步行区散步。
words.en: A promenade is a leisurely walk, especially one taken in a public place for pleasure or display.

words.tr:
v. 突出；强调；高光；
n. 最突出的部分；
words.ex: The teacher highlighted the key words in the text.
words.ex_cn: 老师把文中的关键词突出了。
words.en: To highlight something means to make it stand out or to emphasize it, often because it is important or interesting.

words.ex: The castle is a medieval building.
words.ex_cn: 这座城堡是一座中世纪的建筑。
words.en: Relating to the Middle Ages, the period in European history from about the 5th century to the 15th century.

words.ex: The subcommittee met to discuss the budget.
words.ex_cn: 小组委员会开会讨论预算。
words.en: A subcommittee is a smaller committee formed from a main committee to concentrate on a specific task or area.

words.ex: The report gives an overview of the project.
words.ex_cn: 这份报告对项目进行了概述。
words.en: An overview is a general summary or review of a subject.

words.ex: The store offers an assortment of snacks.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店提供各种各样的零食。
words.en: An assortment is a group of similar things that are of different types or sizes.

words.ex: The wheelchair goes up the ramp easily.
words.ex_cn: 轮椅可以轻松地走上坡道。
words.en: A ramp is a sloping surface connecting two levels, such as a road or a path.

words.tr: adj. 恒定的；不变的；持续的；
words.ex: The temperature is constant in this room.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间的温度是恒定的。
words.en: Something that is constant happens all the time or is always there.

words.tr:
n. 弯曲处；
v. （使）弯曲；
words.ex: The car turned at the bend in the road.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在道路的拐弯处转弯了。
words.en: To bend something means to change its shape so that it is no longer straight but curved.

words.ex: The stream flows quietly through the forest.
words.ex_cn: 小溪静静地流过森林。
words.en: A stream is a small, narrow river. It can also refer to a continuous flow of liquid, air, or gas, or a continuous flow of data or information.

words.ex: He went for a walk irrespective of the rain.
words.ex_cn: 他不顾下雨去散步了。
words.en: If something is done or happens irrespective of particular factors, it is not influenced or affected by them.

words.ex: The storm caused disastrous damage to the village.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴给村庄造成了灾难性的破坏。
words.en: If you describe something as disastrous, you mean that it is very unfortunate or unsuccessful.

words.ex: He lives in a tropical island near the equator.
words.ex_cn: 他住在赤道附近的一个热带岛屿上。
words.en: relating to or situated in or characteristic of the tropics (the region on either side of the equator)

words.ex: I am grateful for your help.
words.ex_cn: 我感激你的帮助。
words.en: If you are grateful for something that someone has given you or done for you, you have warm, friendly feelings towards them and wish to thank them.

words.tr: phrase. 太阳能泵；利用太阳能驱动的水泵
words.ex: The farm uses a solar pump to water the crops.
words.ex_cn: 这个农场使用太阳能泵给庄稼浇水。
words.en: A solar pump is a pump running on electricity generated by photovoltaic panels or the radiated thermal energy available from collected sunlight as opposed to grid electricity or diesel run water pumps.

words.tr: phrase. 城市花园；指在城市环境中开辟的用于种植植物或蔬菜的园地
words.ex: They grow vegetables in an urban garden.
words.ex_cn: 他们在城市花园里种植蔬菜。
words.en: An urban garden is a space in a city where plants are grown, often for food, in order to make use of limited space and to bring greenery into urban areas.

words.ex: The visitor centre gives maps and information.
words.ex_cn: 游客中心提供地图和信息。
words.en: A visitor centre is a place where tourists can get information about the area they are visiting, including maps, guides, and advice on what to see and do.

words.tr: phrase. 特别节目；特色功能；特辑
words.ex: The TV show has a special feature about space exploration.
words.ex_cn: 这个电视节目有一个关于太空探索的特别节目。
words.en: A special feature is a distinctive attribute or aspect of something.

words.tr: phrase. 无人陪伴的儿童；无成人陪同的未成年人
words.ex: The shelter helps unaccompanied children find their families.
words.ex_cn: 这个庇护所帮助无成人陪伴的儿童寻找他们的家人。
words.en: Children who are traveling without an adult.

words.ex: The park does not allow under-age children to ride the roller coaster.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园不允许未成年儿童乘坐过山车。
words.en: Children who are below the legal age of majority, typically under 18 years old.

words.ex: He drives a racing car on the track.
words.ex_cn: 他在赛道上开一辆赛车。
words.en: A racing car is a car designed for speed and performance in competitive racing events.

words.ex: He filled out a comment card after the meal.
words.ex_cn: 他在用餐后填写了一张意见卡。
words.en: A card provided for customers or visitors to write their comments or feedback on a service or product.

words.ex: He filled out the booking form for the hotel.
words.ex_cn: 他填写了酒店的预订表格。
words.en: A document used to reserve or book a service, such as a hotel room or flight.

words.tr: phrase. 小屋的钥匙；舱室的钥匙
words.ex: He lost the cabin keys before the trip.
words.ex_cn: 他在旅行前弄丢了小木屋的钥匙。
words.en: A set of keys or keychain used to access or lock a cabin, typically for a specific room or building.

words.ex: The hotel offers room services like breakfast and cleaning.
words.ex_cn: 这家酒店提供客房服务，如早餐和清洁。
words.en: Room service refers to the service provided by a hotel where food and drinks can be ordered and delivered to guests' rooms.

words.tr: 短语. 在正式程序之后；在礼节性手续完成后
words.ex: He signed the contract after formality.
words.ex_cn: 他在正式程序之后签署了合同。
words.en: After the initial required procedures or ceremonies are completed.

words.ex: He watched a music video on his phone.
words.ex_cn: 他在他的手机上看了一个音乐视频。
words.en: A music video is a short film or video that integrates a song with imagery, and is produced for promotional or artistic purposes.

words.tr: phrase. 摄影师；摄像师（负责操作摄像机的专业人员）
words.ex: The camera man is filming the parade.
words.ex_cn: 摄像师正在拍摄游行。
words.en: A person whose job is to operate a camera, especially in film or television production.

words.ex: The traffic noise keeps me awake at night.
words.ex_cn: 交通噪音让我晚上睡不着。
words.en: Traffic noise refers to the sound produced by vehicles on the road, including cars, trucks, motorcycles, and buses, which can be a source of environmental pollution.

words.tr: phrase. 雕塑花园；陈列雕塑作品的户外园林
words.ex: They walked in the sculpture garden after lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他们午饭后在雕塑花园里散步。
words.en: A sculpture garden is an outdoor garden area designed to showcase sculptures, often in a natural setting.

words.ex: He loves creating oil painting on canvas.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在画布上创作油画艺术。
words.en: An oil painting is a picture that has been painted using oil paints.

words.tr: phrase. 检疫服务；隔离检疫部门
words.ex: The quarantine service checked all arriving travelers.
words.ex_cn: 检疫服务检查了所有入境旅客。
words.en: A quarantine service refers to the measures and facilities provided by authorities to isolate and monitor individuals or animals that may have been exposed to contagious diseases to prevent the spread of those diseases.

words.tr: phrase. 邮政物品；邮递物件
words.ex: He sent postal items to his friend abroad.
words.ex_cn: 他给国外的朋友寄了邮件物品。
words.en: Items that are sent through the postal system, such as letters and packages.

words.ex: They plant seeds in the garden every spring.
words.ex_cn: 他们每年春天都在花园里种种子。
words.en: To sow seeds in soil to grow plants, often used metaphorically for initiating ideas or projects.

words.ex: We enjoy live music at the park on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 我们喜欢在周末去公园听现场音乐。
words.en: Music that is performed in front of an audience, as opposed to music that is recorded and listened to at home.

words.tr: phrase. 会合点；集合地点；会面地点
words.ex: The park is our meeting point at 5 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 公园是我们下午五点的集合点。
words.en: A meeting point is a place where people arrange to meet.

words.tr: phrase. 手工艺品展览会；手作市集
words.ex: They sell handmade toys at the craft fair.
words.ex_cn: 他们在手工艺品展上出售手工玩具。
words.en: A craft fair is an event where people sell goods they have made by hand, such as jewelry, pottery, and textiles.

words.tr: phrase. 边缘舞台；非主流表演场地（通常指在艺术节等活动中非正式或小型的演出场所）
words.ex: The band performed on the fringe stage at the festival.
words.ex_cn: 这支乐队在音乐节的边缘舞台演出。
words.en: A fringe stage refers to a non-mainstream or experimental theater stage, often featuring unconventional performances.

words.tr: phrase. 展商入口；参展商进入的通道
words.ex: The exhibitor entrance is behind the building.
words.ex_cn: 参展商入口在大楼后面。
words.en: The designated entry point for individuals or companies displaying products or services at an event.

words.ex: He wears an arm badge to show his team role.
words.ex_cn: 他佩戴臂章来表明自己的团队角色。
words.en: A decorative or identifying emblem worn on the upper arm.

words.ex: He submitted his academic record to the university.
words.ex_cn: 他把他的学业成绩提交给了大学。
words.en: A document that provides a detailed account of a student's academic performance, including grades, courses taken, and degrees awarded.

words.ex: He is the class representative for Grade 8.
words.ex_cn: 他是八年级的班级代表。
words.en: A class representative is a student elected by their classmates to represent their interests and communicate with teachers and school administration.

words.tr: phrase. 本地艺术家；当地艺人
words.ex: Local artists paint colorful murals on the walls.
words.ex_cn: 本地艺术家在墙上画彩色壁画。
words.en: Local artists refer to artists who are based in or originate from a particular area or community.

words.tr: phrase. 水上出租车；河上的士（在河流或水道中运营的载客小艇）
words.ex: We took a river taxi to cross the river.
words.ex_cn: 我们乘了一艘河上出租车过河。
words.en: A boat service that operates like a taxi, taking passengers along a river to their desired destinations.

words.ex: He was late because of a traffic jam.
words.ex_cn: 他因为交通堵塞迟到了。
words.en: A traffic jam is a long line of vehicles that cannot move forward because there is too much traffic, or because the road is blocked by something.

words.tr: phrase. 交通信号灯；红绿灯
words.ex: The car stopped at the traffic lights.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在交通信号灯前停了下来。
words.en: A set of automatically operated coloured lights, typically red, amber, and green, for controlling traffic at road junctions, pedestrian crossings, and roundabouts.

words.ex: The calling fee is five dollars per minute.
words.ex_cn: 通话费是每分钟五美元。
words.en: A charge made by a telephone company for the use of its services to make a call.

words.tr: phrase. 计算机故障；电脑崩溃
words.ex: The computer breakdown caused us to lose our work.
words.ex_cn: 电脑故障导致我们丢失了工作。
words.en: A situation where a computer system stops working properly, often requiring technical support to fix.

words.ex: The express trains arrive faster than local trains.
words.ex_cn: 特快列车比普通列车到得更快。
words.en: Express trains are a type of passenger train that make a small number of stops, usually at major stations, and are thus able to reach their destinations more quickly than local trains that stop at every station.

words.ex: The trees bent in the high winds.
words.ex_cn: 树木在强风中弯曲。
words.en: High winds refer to strong winds that can cause damage or disruption.

words.ex: He eats lunch in the self-cafeteria every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天在自助餐厅吃午饭。
words.en: A self-service dining area where customers select and prepare their own food, often in a casual setting.

words.tr: phrase. 本地英雄；当地名人；深受当地人崇拜或尊敬的人物
words.ex: He is a local hero for saving the child from the fire.
words.ex_cn: 他因从火灾中救出孩子而成为本地英雄。
words.en: A local hero is someone who is admired for their courage, outstanding achievements, or noble qualities, especially within their own community.

words.ex: He likes european painting from the 18th century.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢18世纪的欧洲绘画。
words.en: European painting refers to the visual art produced in Europe from the early medieval period to the present day, encompassing a wide range of styles, movements, and techniques.

words.ex: The teacher created a quiet learning zone for students to focus.
words.ex_cn: 老师创建了一个安静的学习区，让学生们专心学习。
words.en: An area designated for the purpose of studying or acquiring knowledge, often characterized by resources and an environment conducive to learning.

words.ex: He found an old historical photograph in his attic.
words.ex_cn: 他在阁楼上发现了一张旧的历史照片。
words.en: A photograph that captures or represents a moment, event, or scene from the past, often used for educational or archival purposes.

words.tr: phrase. 电影院区域；电影放映区
words.ex: We went to the cinema zone to watch a movie.
words.ex_cn: 我们去电影院区域看电影。
words.en: An area designated for cinemas, typically within a larger entertainment or shopping complex, where movies are shown.

words.ex: He drinks coffee at the coffee shop every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上在咖啡店喝咖啡。
words.en: A coffee shop is a small restaurant where drinks and snacks are sold.

words.ex: He bought new garden tools to clean the yard.
words.ex_cn: 他买了新的园艺工具来清理院子。
words.en: Tools used in gardening for various tasks such as planting, pruning, and weeding.

words.tr: phrase. 花园用的花盆；种植花卉或植物的容器
words.ex: She watered the flowers in the garden pots.
words.ex_cn: 她给花园盆里的花浇水。
words.en: Garden pots are containers used for growing plants, flowers, or herbs in a garden setting.

words.ex: He drinks tap water every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天喝自来水。
words.en: Water that comes out of a tap, especially as opposed to bottled water.

words.tr: phrase. 专业知识；专业技能知识
words.ex: He uses his professional knowledge to solve work problems.
words.ex_cn: 他运用自己的专业知识来解决工作问题。
words.en: Professional knowledge refers to the specialized knowledge and skills required in a particular profession or field of work.

words.ex: The school provides special buses for students.
words.ex_cn: 学校为学生提供专用公交车。
words.en: Buses that are designated for specific purposes or groups, such as transportation for the elderly, disabled, or for school children.

words.tr: phrase. 教育设施；教育机构提供的用于教学和支持学习的各种资源和场所
words.ex: The school has good education facilities.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校有良好的教育设施。
words.en: Education facilities refer to the physical resources and environments designed to support teaching and learning processes.

words.ex: He filled out the order form for the books.
words.ex_cn: 他填了书籍的订购单。
words.en: A document used to request goods or services, detailing the items desired, quantities, and other relevant information.

words.tr: phrase. 支票号码；核对数字
words.ex: Please write the check number on the receipt.
words.ex_cn: 请在收据上写下支票号码。
words.en: A check number is a unique number printed on a check to identify it.

words.tr: phrase. 已签署的交货单；指收货方签字确认收到货物的单据
words.ex: He signed the delivery note after receiving the package.
words.ex_cn: 他收到包裹后签了送货单。
words.en: A document signed by the recipient upon receiving goods, serving as proof of delivery.

words.tr: phrase. 缺乏吸引力的外观；不讨人喜欢的外表
words.ex: The old house had an unappealing appearance with peeling paint and broken windows.
words.ex_cn: 这栋老房子有着缺乏吸引力的外观，油漆剥落，窗户破损。
words.en: An appearance that is not attractive or pleasing.

words.tr: phrase. 黑天鹅（指极罕见且难以预测的重大事件，常用于比喻出人意料的突发事件）
words.ex: Black swans are rare and surprising events that nobody expects.
words.ex_cn: 黑天鹅是没人预料到的罕见且令人惊讶的事件。
words.en: Black swans are events that are rare, unpredictable, and have a major impact. The term was popularized by Nassim Nicholas Taleb in his book 'The Black Swan'.

words.tr: phrase. 历史展览；展示历史文物或事件的展出活动
words.ex: The museum opened a historical exhibition last week.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆上周举办了一个历史展览。
words.en: A display or presentation of objects, documents, or other items of historical interest, typically organized in a museum or gallery setting to educate the public about past events, cultures, or people.

words.ex: He ate a hot meal after work.
words.ex_cn: 他下班后吃了一顿热饭。
words.en: A hot meal is food that has been cooked and is served warm, providing comfort and nourishment.

words.ex: The head office is in New York.
words.ex_cn: 总部在纽约。
words.en: The main office or center of control of a business or organization, where the most important decisions are made.

words.ex: The students practice in the music room.
words.ex_cn: 学生们在音乐室练习。
words.en: A room equipped for the practice or performance of music.

words.ex: The principal gave us a classroom tour.
words.ex_cn: 校长带我们参观了教室。
words.en: A guided walk-through of a classroom, showing its layout, resources, and features.

words.tr: phrase. 茶和咖啡（两种常见饮品）
words.ex: He drinks tea and coffee every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上喝茶和咖啡。
words.en: Tea and coffee refer to the two most widely consumed hot beverages in the world, known for their stimulating effects due to caffeine content.

words.tr: phrase. 国际象棋俱乐部；下棋社团
words.ex: He joins the chess club after school.
words.ex_cn: 他放学后加入国际象棋俱乐部。
words.en: A chess club is an organization where people meet to play chess, often to improve their skills and compete in tournaments.

words.tr: phrase. 月刊杂志；每月出版的期刊
words.ex: He reads monthly magazines about science.
words.ex_cn: 他阅读关于科学的月刊杂志。
words.en: Periodicals published and sold on a monthly basis.

words.ex: The forest protects many kinds of animal life.
words.ex_cn: 这片森林保护着许多种类的动物生命。
words.en: The existence and activities of animals in their natural environment.

words.ex: They went to a social event last night.
words.ex_cn: 他们昨晚去参加了一个社交活动。
words.en: A social event is a gathering of people for the purpose of socializing, entertainment, or celebration.

words.ex: The company publishes an annual report every year.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司每年发布一份年度报告。
words.en: A document prepared by a company at the end of each year, giving details of its financial performance and activities over the year.

words.ex: He keeps spare socks in his drawer.
words.ex_cn: 他把备用袜子放在抽屉里。
words.en: Spare socks are extra socks that you keep with you in case you need to change your socks.

words.tr: phrase. 完全阻断；全面封锁
words.ex: The total block stopped the traffic.
words.ex_cn: 整个路障阻断了交通。
words.en: A complete obstruction or stoppage of movement or access.

words.ex: We visited the local museum last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我们上周末参观了当地博物馆。
words.en: A small museum that focuses on the history, culture, or artifacts of a specific town, city, or region.

words.tr: phrase. 次要项目；辅助性工程
words.ex: He is working on a secondary project after finishing the main one.
words.ex_cn: 他在完成主要项目后，正在做一个次要项目。
words.en: A secondary project refers to a project of lesser importance or priority compared to the main projects within an organization or team.

words.tr: phrase. 傍晚；下午较晚的时段（通常指下午3点至6点左右）
words.ex: We had tea in the late afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 我们在傍晚时分喝了茶。
words.en: The period of the day from about 3 p.m. to sunset.

words.ex: He entered the house through the back entrance.
words.ex_cn: 他从后门进了房子。
words.en: An entrance at the back of a building, typically less formal or used for service purposes.

words.ex: The box has enough storage space for toys.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子有足够的存储空间来放玩具。
words.en: The area or capacity available for storing data, files, or other materials in a computer or other device.

words.tr: phrase. 紧急按钮；应急按钮（用于在紧急情况下迅速触发警报或求助的装置）
words.ex: He pressed the emergency button when the car stopped.
words.ex_cn: 当车停下时，他按下了紧急按钮。
words.en: A button that is used to signal an emergency situation, typically to summon help or activate an alarm.

words.ex: They bathe in a hot spring every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他们每天早上在温泉里洗澡。
words.en: A hot spring is a natural spring of water whose temperature is higher than that of the surrounding area, often heated by geothermal activity.

words.tr: phrase. 残疾人；身体或精神有障碍的人群
words.ex: Disabled people need equal access to schools.
words.ex_cn: 残障人士需要平等获得教育的机会。
words.en: People who have a physical or mental condition that limits their movements, senses, or activities.

words.ex: We need to finish the project in a specific period.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要在特定的时间内完成这个项目。
words.en: A specific period refers to a particular and defined time frame.

words.tr: phrase. 最短期限；最小周期；最低期限
words.ex: The minimum period for the contract is one year.
words.ex_cn: 合同的最短期限是一年。
words.en: The shortest possible duration or time required.

words.ex: You should have a health check every year.
words.ex_cn: 你应该每年做一次健康检查。
words.en: A health check is a medical examination to test your general state of health.

words.ex: He bought new sports equipment for the game.
words.ex_cn: 他为比赛买了新的体育器材。
words.en: The items used in sports or physical activities, such as balls, bats, gloves, and protective gear.

words.ex: The meeting will be held at the town hall.
words.ex_cn: 会议将在市政厅举行。
words.en: A town hall is a building used for the administration of local government, or a meeting at which a public official or political candidate addresses an audience.

words.ex: The baby kangaroo jumps close to its mother.
words.ex_cn: 小袋鼠在妈妈旁边跳来跳去。
words.en: A baby kangaroo, known as a joey, is the young of a kangaroo, typically living in its mother's pouch.

words.ex: He works a part-time job after school.
words.ex_cn: 他放学后做一份兼职工作。
words.en: A part-time job is a job in which you work fewer hours each week than people who have a full-time job.

words.tr: phrase. 商业课程；商务课程（指教授商业管理、市场营销、财务等相关知识的课程）
words.ex: He takes business courses to learn how to run a shop.
words.ex_cn: 他上商业课程来学习如何经营一家商店。
words.en: Educational programs focused on commercial or managerial subjects.

words.tr: phrase. 高级职员；资深员工
words.ex: The senior staff attends weekly meetings.
words.ex_cn: 高级员工参加每周会议。
words.en: Senior staff refers to employees who hold higher positions within an organization, often having more experience, responsibility, and authority than their junior counterparts.

words.ex: The boat sailed through the English Channel.
words.ex_cn: 船驶过了英吉利海峡。
words.en: The English Channel is the body of water that separates southern England from northern France and links the southern part of the North Sea to the Atlantic Ocean.

words.tr: phrase. 热带地区；位于赤道两侧、南北回归线之间的气候炎热区域
words.ex: The tropical zone has hot weather all year.
words.ex_cn: 热带地区全年天气炎热。
words.en: The tropical zone refers to the region of the Earth surrounding the equator, characterized by warm climate and significant biodiversity.

words.tr: phrase. 塔景；从塔上看到的景色
words.ex: We saw the city from the tower view.
words.ex_cn: 我们从塔楼的观景处看到了城市。
words.en: A view from a high structure, offering a broad perspective.

words.tr: phrase. 大象区域；指专门用于大象活动或保护的特定区域，如保护区或动物园中的大象栖息地
words.ex: The elephant zone is far from the visitor center.
words.ex_cn: 大象区离游客中心很远。
words.en: A designated area for elephants, often in a zoo or sanctuary.

words.ex: He bought a ticket at the travel centre.
words.ex_cn: 他在旅行中心买了一张票。
words.en: A place where tourists can obtain information and services related to travel.

words.tr: phrase. 旅游套餐；包含交通、住宿等服务的旅行打包产品
words.ex: He booked a travel package for his vacation.
words.ex_cn: 他为假期预订了一个旅行套餐。
words.en: A travel package is a combination of travel services such as transportation, accommodation, and sometimes meals and activities, sold together at a single price.

words.tr: phrase. 预算旅行；经济型旅行
words.ex: They planned a budget trip to the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 他们计划了一次预算有限的登山旅行。
words.en: A budget trip refers to a journey planned with a focus on minimizing expenses, often involving careful planning and cost-saving strategies to ensure affordability without sacrificing the quality of the travel experience.

words.ex: They went to the beach during the long vacation.
words.ex_cn: 他们在长假期间去了海滩。
words.en: A long vacation refers to an extended period of time off from work or studies, typically used for relaxation, travel, or personal projects.

words.tr: phrase. 支持性的氛围；鼓励的、给予帮助的环境
words.ex: The teacher creates a supportive atmosphere in the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 老师在课堂上营造了支持性的氛围。
words.en: A supportive atmosphere is an environment in which people feel encouraged and backed by others, making it conducive to positive outcomes.

words.ex: The boxes are in the store room.
words.ex_cn: 箱子在储藏室里。
words.en: A room where items are stored.

words.ex: He uses the coffee machine every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都用咖啡机。
words.en: A coffee machine is a device used to brew coffee. It can range from a simple manual device to a complex automatic machine.

words.ex: She works at the front desk of the hotel.
words.ex_cn: 她在酒店的前台工作。
words.en: The front desk is the place in a hotel, office building, or other establishment where visitors are greeted and dealt with.

words.tr: phrase. 座位区；供人就座的区域
words.ex: The seating area has three chairs and a small table.
words.ex_cn: 座位区有三把椅子和一张小桌子。
words.en: A seating area is a designated space with seats, typically in a public venue, where people can sit.

words.tr: phrase. 当地居民；本地住户
words.ex: Local residents walk their dogs in the park every morning.
words.ex_cn: 当地居民每天早上在公园遛狗。
words.en: People who live in a particular area or community.

words.tr: phrase. 棋盘游戏；桌上游戏
words.ex: We play board games every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我们每个周末都玩桌游。
words.en: Board games are games that are played by moving pieces around on a board, according to a set of rules. They are typically played by two or more players.

words.ex: He went to the massage room after work.
words.ex_cn: 他下班后去了按摩室。
words.en: A room equipped for providing massage services.

words.tr: phrase. 长度相等的；等长的
words.ex: The two sticks have equal length.
words.ex_cn: 这两根棍子长度相等。
words.en: Having the same measurement in length.

words.tr: phrase. 培训课程；训练课程
words.ex: He joined a training course last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周参加了一个培训课程。
words.en: A training course is a series of lessons or lectures teaching the skills that you need for a particular job or activity.

words.tr: phrase. 辅导费；教学指导费用
words.ex: He paid the tutorial fee for math help.
words.ex_cn: 他支付了数学辅导的费用。
words.en: A charge for instruction or guidance provided in a tutorial setting.

words.ex: He works as an administration officer in the school office.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校办公室担任行政官员。
words.en: An administration officer is responsible for managing the daily operations and administrative tasks within an organization or department.

words.ex: The security officer checks bags at the door.
words.ex_cn: 保安人员在门口检查包。
words.en: A security officer is a person whose job is to protect a place, people, or property from danger, theft, or other risks.

words.ex: The school had a fire drill this morning.
words.ex_cn: 学校今天早上进行了消防演习。
words.en: A fire drill is a practice of the emergency procedures to be used in case of fire.

words.tr: phrase. 制作卡片；手工制卡
words.ex: She enjoys card making for her friends' birthdays.
words.ex_cn: 她喜欢为朋友的生日做卡片。
words.en: The activity or hobby of creating greeting cards or other types of cards, often by hand and with decorative elements.

words.tr: phrase. 内部装饰业；室内设计
words.ex: He works in interior design for luxury homes.
words.ex_cn: 他从事豪华住宅的内部装饰业。
words.en: Interior design is the art or process of designing the interior decoration of a room or building.

words.ex: He likes water colour painting on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在周末画水彩画。
words.en: A painting method using pigments mixed with water to create transparent and luminous effects.

words.tr: phrase. 场地变更；地点更改
words.ex: The venue change made the event harder to find.
words.ex_cn: 场地变更让活动更难找到了。
words.en: The relocation of an event or activity to a different location.

words.tr: phrase. 最低年龄；法定最小年龄
words.ex: The minimum age to drive is 18.
words.ex_cn: 开车的最低年龄是18岁。
words.en: The youngest age at which a person is allowed by law to do a particular thing.

words.tr: phrase. 区域竞争；地区性比赛
words.ex: The students joined a regional competition to win a scholarship.
words.ex_cn: 学生们参加了一场区域竞争以赢得奖学金。
words.en: A contest or rivalry among participants from a specific area or region.

words.tr: phrase. 特价；特别优惠的价格
words.ex: The store offers a special price on milk this week.
words.ex_cn: 这家店本周对牛奶有特价。
words.en: A special price is a reduced price offered for a product or service for a limited period of time.

words.tr: phrase. 混龄的；不同年龄混合的
words.ex: The school has mixed age classes.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校有混合年龄的班级。
words.en: Involving or consisting of people or things of different ages.

words.tr: phrase. 政府基金；由政府设立或资助用于特定公共目的的资金
words.ex: The government fund helps poor students buy books.
words.ex_cn: 政府资金帮助贫困学生买书。
words.en: A government fund refers to money set aside by a government for a specific purpose, such as supporting public services, infrastructure projects, or social welfare programs.

words.ex: The local community cleaned the park together.
words.ex_cn: 当地社区一起清理了公园。
words.en: A local community is a group of people living in the same place or having a particular characteristic in common, often sharing interests and goals.

words.tr: phrase. 控制室；中央控制室（用于监控和操作设备或系统的房间）
words.ex: The operator works in the control room.
words.ex_cn: 操作员在控制室工作。
words.en: A room from which a place, operation, or activity is monitored and controlled.

words.ex: We sat in the waiting room for an hour.
words.ex_cn: 我们在候诊室坐了一个小时。
words.en: A room provided for the use of people who are waiting, as for an appointment or service.

words.tr: phrase. 杯子清洁；清洗杯子的过程
words.ex: She is doing cup cleaning after breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 她早餐后在清洗杯子。
words.en: The act of washing cups, typically in a kitchen or dining setting.

words.ex: They work for animal protection every day.
words.ex_cn: 他们每天为动物保护而工作。
words.en: The act of safeguarding animals from harm, abuse, and exploitation, ensuring their welfare and rights are respected.

words.ex: He pressed the reset button to restart the computer.
words.ex_cn: 他按了重置按钮来重启电脑。
words.en: A reset button is a button on a computer or other electronic device that you press to make the device start working again.

words.tr: phrase. 经验技能；指通过实际经历或实践获得的能力和技巧
words.ex: He has strong experience skills from working in many countries.
words.ex_cn: 他通过在许多国家工作积累了丰富的经验技能。
words.en: Abilities and knowledge gained through direct participation in activities.

words.ex: Please give me your contact number.
words.ex_cn: 请给我你的联系电话。
words.en: A contact number is a telephone number at which a person or organization can be reached.

words.tr: phrase. 美术馆；艺术博物馆
words.ex: We visited an art museum last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我们上周末参观了一家艺术博物馆。
words.en: An art museum is a building where works of art are displayed to the public.

words.tr: phrase. 令人惊叹的景色；极美的视野
words.ex: The mountain has a stunning view at sunrise.
words.ex_cn: 这座山在日出时有着令人惊叹的景色。
words.en: A stunning view is a scene or landscape that is extremely beautiful and impressive.

words.tr: phrase. 街头艺术；指在公共空间（如墙壁、街道）创作的视觉艺术，常具社会或政治表达性质
words.ex: He paints street art on the walls of the city.
words.ex_cn: 他在城市的墙上画街头艺术。
words.en: Street art is visual art created in public locations, usually unsanctioned artwork executed outside of the context of traditional art venues. Other terms for this type of art include 'independent public art', 'post-graffiti', and 'neo-graffiti', and is closely related with urban art and guerrilla art.

words.ex: He enjoys horseback riding on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在周末骑马。
words.en: The activity of riding a horse, especially for enjoyment or as a form of exercise.

words.tr: phrase. 帐篷住宿；以帐篷形式提供的临时居所
words.ex: We stayed in tented accommodation near the lake.
words.ex_cn: 我们住在湖边的帐篷住宿里。
words.en: Tented accommodation refers to a form of lodging where guests stay in tents, often equipped with some of the amenities of a hotel, providing a blend of outdoor adventure and comfort.

words.ex: Wild animals live in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 野生动物生活在森林里。
words.en: Animals that live in a natural, undomesticated state, especially those not tamed or domesticated by humans.

words.tr: phrase. 压力水平；紧张程度
words.ex: His stress level is high after work.
words.ex_cn: 他下班后压力很大。
words.en: The degree of stress experienced by an individual, often measured to assess psychological and physical health.

words.tr: phrase. 化装舞会所穿着的服装
words.ex: The children wore fancy dress to the party.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们穿着奇装异服去参加派对。
words.en: Clothing worn to impersonate someone or something, often at a party or event.

words.ex: We bought a family ticket for the zoo.
words.ex_cn: 我们买了一张家庭票去动物园。
words.en: A family ticket is a type of admission ticket that allows a group of people, typically consisting of two adults and a certain number of children, to enter an event or venue at a reduced rate compared to purchasing individual tickets.

words.ex: They practice music in the concert room.
words.ex_cn: 他们在音乐厅里练习音乐。
words.en: A room designed for the performance of concerts, typically equipped with seating for an audience and designed with good acoustics.

words.ex: The station does weather observing every hour.
words.ex_cn: 这个站点每小时进行气象监测。
words.en: The practice of monitoring and recording atmospheric conditions.

words.tr: phrase. 免费交通；免费运输
words.ex: The school provides free transportation for students.
words.ex_cn: 学校为学生提供免费交通。
words.en: Transportation services provided without charge to the user.

words.ex: He goes to the fitness centre every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上去健身中心。
words.en: A fitness centre is a place where people go to do physical exercise and keep fit, often equipped with various gym equipment.

words.tr: phrase. 厚实的裤子；加厚长裤（通常用于保暖或户外活动）
words.ex: He wears thick trousers in winter.
words.ex_cn: 他在冬天穿厚裤子。
words.en: Thick trousers are pants made of heavy material, designed to provide extra warmth and protection against cold weather.

words.ex: The shuttle bus takes us to the airport every hour.
words.ex_cn: 班车每小时接送我们去机场。
words.en: A shuttle bus is a bus that travels regularly between two places, especially a bus that takes people to and from an airport or between different parts of a city.

words.tr: phrase. 虚拟志愿者；指通过互联网远程参与志愿活动的人
words.ex: He is a virtual volunteer who helps kids online.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名在线帮助孩子的虚拟志愿者。
words.en: A person who offers services to an organization or cause without being physically present, typically performing tasks remotely using digital tools.

words.ex: We go to the farm to feed animals every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我们每个周末去农场喂动物。
words.en: Provide food to animals, typically as part of their daily care or routine.

words.ex: He works at a cake factory.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家蛋糕工厂工作。
words.en: A cake factory is a place where cakes are produced in large quantities.

words.tr: phrase. 烟雾报警器；烟感警报装置
words.ex: The smoke alarm went off at night.
words.ex_cn: 夜里的烟雾报警器响了。
words.en: A smoke alarm is a device that makes a loud noise to warn people when it detects smoke, indicating a possible fire.

words.ex: The soldiers stood at the lookout point to watch for enemies.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们站在侦查哨观察敌人的动向。
words.en: A place that provides a wide and clear view of the surrounding area, often used for observation or sightseeing.

words.ex: The children are enjoying face painting at the party.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在派对上享受着面部彩绘。
words.en: The activity or art of painting designs or pictures on someone's face, typically for entertainment or as part of a costume.

words.tr: phrase. 会员制餐厅；仅限会员就餐的餐馆
words.ex: This member restaurant requires a yearly membership to eat here.
words.ex_cn: 这家会员制餐厅需要年费会员才能用餐。
words.en: A restaurant that offers special services or discounts to its members, typically requiring a membership to access.

words.tr: phrase. 画廊商店；美术馆内的销售店铺
words.ex: She bought a painting from the gallery shop.
words.ex_cn: 她从画廊商店买了一幅画。
words.en: A gallery shop is a store that sells artworks, often located within or associated with an art gallery.

words.ex: He puts leftovers in food containers.
words.ex_cn: 他把剩饭放在食品容器里。
words.en: Containers specifically designed for storing, preserving, or transporting food.

words.tr: phrase. + n. 好的鞋子；质量优良的鞋
words.ex: He wears good shoes to walk every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天穿好鞋子走路。
words.en: Footwear that is comfortable, durable, and appropriate for its intended use.

words.tr: phrase. 正式服装；礼服，指在正式场合穿着的庄重服饰
words.ex: He wears formal clothes to the wedding.
words.ex_cn: 他穿正装去参加婚礼。
words.en: Clothing that is suitable for formal occasions, such as suits for men and evening dresses for women.

words.ex: They watched a dance show on TV last night.
words.ex_cn: 他们昨晚在电视上看了一个舞蹈表演。
words.en: A performance in which dancers perform choreographed movements to music, often in front of an audience.

words.tr: phrase. 交货单；送货单（随货物一起提供的文件，列明所送物品的详情）
words.ex: The driver gave me a delivery note.
words.ex_cn: 司机给了我一张送货单。
words.en: A delivery note is a document that accompanies a shipment of goods and lists the description, quantity, and other relevant details of the goods being delivered.

words.ex: He loves mountain climbing on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在周末去登山。
words.en: The activity or sport of climbing mountains.

words.tr: phrase. 乘坐长途汽车的旅行；长途汽车旅行
words.ex: We went on a coach trip to the seaside.
words.ex_cn: 我们去海边进行了一次长途汽车旅行。
words.en: A journey made by a group of people on a bus, especially for pleasure.

words.ex: The bush fire burned many trees.
words.ex_cn: 灌木大火烧毁了许多树木。
words.en: A bush fire is a fire that burns in the bush, which is an area of wild land covered with trees and shrubs.

words.tr: phrase. 吸引区域；吸引力范围；指某个具有吸引力的地方或区域，能吸引人群或游客前往
words.ex: The beach is the main attraction zone for tourists.
words.ex_cn: 海滩是游客的主要吸引区域。
words.en: An area or region characterized by a strong pull or appeal, often used in the context of tourism, marketing, or physics to denote areas that draw attention, interest, or physical entities towards them.

words.ex: He can handle animals gently on the farm.
words.ex_cn: 他可以在农场温柔地对待动物。
words.en: To manage or interact with animals, often requiring specific techniques.

words.tr: phrase. 良好的洗漱设施；良好的洗涤设备
words.ex: The hotel has good washing facilities.
words.ex_cn: 这家酒店有很好的洗衣设施。
words.en: Adequate and convenient places for washing clothes or personal items.

words.ex: The doctor ran a trial to test the new medicine.
words.ex_cn: 医生进行了试验来测试这种新药。
words.en: A trial is a formal meeting in a law court, at which a judge and jury listen to evidence and decide whether a person is guilty of a crime.

words.ex: He drove with a provisional license until he passed the test.
words.ex_cn: 他在通过考试前一直持临时证件驾驶。
words.en: A provisional license is a temporary driving license issued to individuals who are learning to drive, allowing them to drive under certain conditions before obtaining a full driving license.

words.tr: phrase. 实用理论；可用于实际的理论
words.ex: This course teaches practical theory for everyday problem solving.
words.ex_cn: 这门课程教授解决日常问题的实用理论。
words.en: Knowledge that is both useful in real situations and based on principles.

words.tr: phrase. 椒盐脆饼工厂；专门生产椒盐卷饼的工厂
words.ex: He works at a pretzel factory in Pennsylvania.
words.ex_cn: 他在宾夕法尼亚州的一家椒盐卷饼工厂工作。
words.en: A place where pretzels are manufactured in large quantities.

words.tr: phrase. 乘火车旅行；火车旅程
words.ex: We took a train ride to the city last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 上周末我们坐火车去城里了。
words.en: A journey made by train.

words.tr: phrase. 准备茶点；准备点心和饮料
words.ex: She will prepare refreshments for the party.
words.ex_cn: 她将为派对准备点心和饮料。
words.en: To arrange and provide drinks and light snacks for guests or events.

words.ex: The weather forecast says it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 天气预报说明天会下雨。
words.en: A weather forecast is a statement saying what the weather is expected to be like the next day or for the next few days.

words.ex: The hot balloon floated high in the sky.
words.ex_cn: 热气球在天空中飘浮。
words.en: A large, gas-filled balloon designed to carry passengers through the air.

words.tr: phrase. 家庭快速通道票（通常指主题公园或景点中允许家庭快速通行并减少排队时间的门票）
words.ex: We bought a family-fast-line track ticket to skip the long queue at the amusement park.
words.ex_cn: 我们买了一张家庭快速通道票，以避开游乐园的长队。
words.en: A discounted ticket for a family group on a fast-moving railway line.

words.tr: phrase. 快速通道票；优先通道票
words.ex: He bought a fast line ticket to skip the queue.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一张快速通道票来排队。
words.en: A ticket that allows travel on a high-speed rail line, typically offering faster journeys than standard services.

words.tr: phrase. 牛仔表演骑乘；一种展示牛仔骑术和套索技巧的表演活动中的骑马环节
words.ex: The cowboy show ride is fun for kids.
words.ex_cn: 牛仔表演骑乘对孩子们来说很有趣。
words.en: A theatrical or televised performance featuring cowboys, often including riding, roping, and other frontier activities.

words.tr: phrase. 草药治疗；植物疗法
words.ex: He uses herbal treatment for his cold.
words.ex_cn: 他用草药治疗他的感冒。
words.en: The use of plants or plant extracts for medicinal purposes, often as an alternative to conventional medicine.

words.ex: We went to the skating rink on Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 我们周日去了滑冰场。
words.en: A skating rink is a specially prepared surface of ice, or of a hard material, for people to skate on.

words.tr: phrase. 一对一教练；私人教练
words.ex: He has a one-to-one coach for swimming.
words.ex_cn: 他有一对一的游泳教练。
words.en: A coaching relationship in which one coach works exclusively with one client, providing personalized guidance and support tailored to the individual's specific goals and needs.

words.tr: phrase. 试销价；推广价；新产品上市优惠价格
words.ex: The store offers an introductory price of $5 for this product.
words.ex_cn: 这家店为这个产品提供5美元的促销价。
words.en: An introductory price is a special low price that is charged for a new product or service for a limited period of time to attract customers.

words.ex: He goes to the gym room every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上去健身房。
words.en: A room or space equipped with exercise machines and weights for physical training.

words.tr: phrase. 心脏监视器；用于监测心率和心律的医疗设备
words.ex: The doctor checked the patient's heart monitor.
words.ex_cn: 医生检查了病人的心脏监护仪。
words.en: A device used to monitor the activity of the heart.

words.ex: He got a free massage after the workout.
words.ex_cn: 他锻炼后得到了一次免费按摩。
words.en: A complimentary or no-cost therapeutic treatment involving the manipulation of muscles and soft tissues to relieve tension and promote relaxation.

words.ex: He drinks water from his water bottle every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天从水瓶里喝水。
words.en: A water bottle is a container that is used to hold water, liquids or other beverages for consumption.

words.tr: phrase. 海滩前排景观；指可以直接看到海滩的视野或位置
words.ex: The hotel has a beach front view.
words.ex_cn: 这家酒店拥有海滩正面景观。
words.en: A view of the beach from a location directly adjacent to the shoreline, typically from a building or property.

words.tr: phrase. + n. 明亮的织物；色彩鲜艳的布料
words.ex: She wears a bright fabric dress to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿着一件鲜艳布料的裙子去参加派对。
words.en: A fabric that reflects light well, often with a shiny or luminous surface, making it visually striking and eye-catching.

words.ex: He is a well-known singer in China.
words.ex_cn: 他在中国是一位著名的歌手。
words.en: A well-known singer is someone who is famous for singing and is recognized by many people.

words.tr: phrase. 瓶子收藏；收集的瓶子
words.ex: He has a bottle collection from his travels.
words.ex_cn: 他有一个从旅行中收集的瓶子收藏。
words.en: A set of bottles, typically of similar type or origin, gathered together for display, study, or use.

words.ex: The printer needs a new ink cartridge.
words.ex_cn: 打印机需要一个新的墨盒。
words.en: An ink cartridge is a replaceable component of an inkjet printer that contains the ink (and sometimes the print head itself) that is spread on paper during printing.

words.ex: We had lunch in the picnic area.
words.ex_cn: 我们在野餐区吃了午饭。
words.en: A picnic area is a designated space, usually in a park or similar outdoor setting, where people can eat meals they have brought with them, often on a blanket or at provided tables.

words.tr: phrase. 餐券；饭票；赖以谋生的人或事物；经济来源
words.ex: He used a meal ticket to get lunch at the cafeteria.
words.ex_cn: 他用一张餐券在食堂吃了午饭。
words.en: A meal ticket is something that provides someone with a means of earning a living or obtaining food.

words.ex: The car has high fuel consumption.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车油耗很高。
words.en: The amount of fuel used by a vehicle or machine over a certain period or distance.

words.ex: He changed the oil filter in his car.
words.ex_cn: 他换了自己汽车的机油滤清器。
words.en: An oil filter is a filter designed to remove contaminants from engine oil, transmission oil, lubricating oil, or hydraulic oil.

words.tr: phrase. 全球旅行；环球旅行
words.ex: He loves global travel and visits new countries every year.
words.ex_cn: 他热爱全球旅行，每年都会去新的国家。
words.en: The act of traveling around the world.

words.tr: phrase. 仪表失效；仪器丢失
words.ex: The pilot suffered a loss of instruments during the storm.
words.ex_cn: 飞行员在风暴中失去了仪器。
words.en: The loss of instruments refers to the disappearance or misplacement of tools, devices, or equipment, often in a professional or technical context.

words.ex: He tries to steer the boat through the waves.
words.ex_cn: 他试图把船驶过波浪。
words.en: Direct the course of a boat by using its steering mechanism, such as a rudder or wheel, to navigate through water.

words.tr: phrase. 海洋动物；生活在海洋中的动物
words.ex: Marine animals live in the ocean.
words.ex_cn: 海洋动物生活在海洋中。
words.en: Marine animals are organisms that live in the ocean or depend on the ocean for their survival.

words.tr: phrase. 海洋史；航海史；海事史
words.ex: He loves reading marine history books.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢读海洋历史书籍。
words.en: The study and record of human interaction with the sea, including exploration, trade, and naval events.

words.tr: phrase. 草地营地；位于草地上的露营地点
words.ex: We set up our tent at the meadow campsite near the lake.
words.ex_cn: 我们在湖边的草地露营地搭起了帐篷。
words.en: A meadow campsite refers to a camping area located in a meadow, offering a natural and serene environment for outdoor activities.

words.tr: phrase. 拖车式活动房屋住宅区；房车营地
words.ex: We stayed at a caravan park near the beach.
words.ex_cn: 我们住在海滩附近的一个房车公园。
words.en: A caravan park is a place where people can stay in caravans, often with facilities such as toilets, showers, and sometimes entertainment.

words.tr: phrase. 绿色休息室；环保休息区（通常指注重环保设计或可持续理念的休闲空间）
words.ex: They sit in the green lounge after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他们晚饭后坐在绿色的休息室里。
words.en: A casual, comfortable room or area decorated with green tones or plants, often for relaxation.

words.tr: phrase. 取款机；现金提款机（用于从银行账户中提取现金的自动机器）
words.ex: He withdrew money from the cash point.
words.ex_cn: 他从自动取款机取了钱。
words.en: A cash point is a machine, usually in a wall outside a bank, from which you can take money out of your bank account using a special card.

words.tr: phrase. 未注册的出租车；非法营运的出租车
words.ex: He took an unregistered taxi to the airport.
words.ex_cn: 他乘坐了一辆无牌照的出租车去机场。
words.en: A taxi that has not been officially registered with the local transportation authority.

words.ex: He threw the plastic bag into the bin.
words.ex_cn: 他把塑料袋扔进了垃圾桶。
words.en: A plastic bag is a type of container made of thin, flexible, plastic film, nonwoven fabric, or plastic textile. They are used for containing and transporting goods such as foods, produce, powders, ice, magazines, chemicals, and waste. It is a common form of packaging.

words.tr: phrase. 必修的模块；必须完成的课程单元
words.ex: All students must take the compulsory modules in the first year.
words.ex_cn: 所有学生在第一年都必须修读这些必修模块。
words.en: Compulsory modules are the parts of a course that all students must study.

words.ex: He focuses on objective matters in the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议上专注于客观事项。
words.en: A subject or issue that is factual, unbiased, and relevant to the main point of discussion.

words.tr: phrase. 最终得分；比赛的最终结果
words.ex: His final score was 95 out of 100.
words.ex_cn: 他的最终得分是100分中的95分。
words.en: The final score is the result at the end of a game, competition, or other event, showing the total points, goals, etc., achieved by each participant or team.

words.tr: phrase. 古代历史；过去的事情（常指早已过时或不再相关的事）
words.ex: He thinks that ancient history is boring.
