words.en: Arrows are long, thin weapons that are shot from a bow. They have a sharp point at one end and usually feathers at the other end to help them fly straight.

words.ex: He read three articles about history.
words.ex_cn: 他读了三篇关于历史的文章。
words.en: An article is a piece of writing on a particular subject in a newspaper, magazine, or journal. It can also refer to a particular item or object, especially one of a set, or a clause in a legal document.

words.ex: The athletes run fast in the race.
words.ex_cn: 运动员们在比赛中跑得很快。
words.en: A person who is proficient in sports and other forms of physical exercise.

words.tr: phrase. 澳大利亚艺术家（指来自澳大利亚的从事艺术创作的人，如画家、音乐家、雕塑家等）
words.ex: Australian artists paint beautiful landscapes.
words.ex_cn: 澳大利亚艺术家们画美丽的风景。
words.en: Artists from Australia, often referring to individuals or groups whose work is recognized within the national or international art scene.

words.ex: Australians love surfing at the beach.
words.ex_cn: 澳大利亚人喜欢在海滩冲浪。
words.en: Australians are people from Australia, a country in the southern hemisphere.

words.ex: He wears his school badges on his jacket.
words.ex_cn: 他把学校的证章戴在夹克上。
words.en: A badge is a small piece of metal, plastic, or cloth which you wear in order to show that you support a particular movement, belong to a particular group, or have achieved something.

words.ex: She carries her books in bags.
words.ex_cn: 她把书放在包里。
words.en: A bag is a container made of flexible material with an opening at the top, used for carrying things.

words.ex: I eat bananas for breakfast every day.
words.ex_cn: 我每天早餐吃香蕉。
words.en: If someone is bananas, they are extremely angry or crazy about something.

words.ex: He works at a local bank.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家本地银行工作。
words.en: A bank is an institution where people or businesses can keep their money or borrow money. It can also refer to the land alongside a river or lake.

words.ex: Children ride bicycles in the park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在公园里骑自行车。
words.en: A bicycle is a vehicle with two wheels which you ride by sitting on it and pushing two pedals with your feet.

words.ex: The boats are floating on the lake.
words.ex_cn: 船在湖上漂浮。
words.en: A boat is a vehicle for travelling on water, especially one that is small enough to be carried on a ship or to float on a river or lake.

words.ex: The boys are playing soccer in the park.
words.ex_cn: 这些男孩正在公园里踢足球。
words.en: Boys are male children or young men.

words.tr: n. 树枝；分支；分公司；分支；“branch”的复数；
words.ex: The wind blew down the branches of the tree.
words.ex_cn: 风把树的树枝吹落了。
words.en: The parts of a tree that grow out from the trunk and have leaves, flowers, or fruit on them.

words.ex: His belt has a shiny buckle.
words.ex_cn: 他的皮带有一个闪亮的带扣。
words.en: Buckles can refer to a clasp for fastening two ends, as of a belt or strap, or the act of fastening or bending under pressure.

words.ex: I bought bunches of bananas at the market.
words.ex_cn: 我在市场买了几大串香蕉。
words.en: A bunch of things is a number of them, especially a large number.

words.ex: The family stayed in wooden cabins near the lake.
words.ex_cn: 这家人住在湖边的小木屋里。
words.en: Small, simple houses or rooms, especially those made of wood and located in a rural or wild area.

words.ex: He does calculations every day for his job.
words.ex_cn: 他每天为工作做计算。
words.en: Calculations are mathematical determinations of the size or number of something.

words.tr: n. 照相机；摄像机；“camera”的复数；
words.ex: The children took cameras to the park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们带了照相机去公园。
words.en: A camera is a piece of equipment that is used for taking photographs, making films, or producing television pictures.

words.ex: These cases show how the rule works.
words.ex_cn: 这些事例展示了规则是如何运作的。
words.en: A case is a particular situation or example of something.

words.tr: n. 细胞；牢房；单元格；“cell”的复数；
words.ex: Plants are made of many cells.
words.ex_cn: 植物由许多细胞组成。
words.en: The basic structural and functional unit of all organisms; a device that delivers an electric current as the result of a chemical reaction; a small room in which a prisoner is locked up.

words.ex: He has good chances to win the game.
words.ex_cn: 他有很大的机会赢得比赛。
words.en: The likelihood of something happening; an opportunity to do or achieve something.

words.ex: The store has three checkouts open on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店周末开放三个收银台。
words.en: The place in a shop, especially a large food shop, where you pay for your goods.

words.ex: He writes cheques to pay for groceries.
words.ex_cn: 他用支票支付食品杂货费用。
words.en: A cheque is a printed form on which you write an amount of money and who it is to be paid to. Your bank then pays the money to that person from your account.

words.ex: He eats chocolates every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都吃巧克力。
words.en: Chocolates are sweet foods made from cocoa beans, often eaten as a treat or given as a gift.

words.ex: The circumstances made it hard to leave.
words.ex_cn: 这种情况让他很难离开。
words.en: The conditions or facts that affect a situation and how it develops.

words.ex: Many cities have busy streets and tall buildings.
words.ex_cn: 许多城市都有繁忙的街道和高楼。
words.en: A city is a large town.

words.ex: He joins a book clubs after work.
words.ex_cn: 他下班后加入了一个读书俱乐部。
words.en: A club is an organization of people with a common purpose or interest, who meet regularly and take part in shared activities. It can also refer to a heavy stick with a thick end, used as a weapon.

words.ex: Many companies hire new graduates each year.
words.ex_cn: 许多公司每年雇佣新毕业生。
words.en: A company is a business organization that makes money by producing or selling goods or services.

words.ex: The bike has many components like wheels and pedals.
words.ex_cn: 这辆自行车有很多部件，比如轮子和踏板。
words.en: Components are the parts that make up a whole system or machine.

words.tr: n. 电脑；计算机；“computer”的复数；
words.ex: Computers help students do math faster.
words.ex_cn: 电脑帮助学生更快地做数学题。
words.en: A computer is an electronic machine that can store and deal with large amounts of information.

words.ex: The company made concessions to avoid a strike.
words.ex_cn: 公司做出了让步以避免罢工。
words.en: If you make a concession to someone, you agree to let them do or have something, especially in order to end an argument or conflict.

words.ex: The company hired consultants to fix the problem.
words.ex_cn: 公司聘请了顾问来解决问题。
words.en: Consultants are people who provide expert advice professionally.

words.ex: Consumers buy food and clothes every week.
words.ex_cn: 消费者每周购买食物和衣服。
words.en: People who buy goods or services for their own use.

words.ex: The contents of the book are easy to understand.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的内容很容易理解。
words.en: The things that are contained within something, especially a written work or a container.

words.tr: n. 成本；费用；“cost”的复数； v. 花费；
words.ex: The costs of buying a new car are high.
words.ex_cn: 买一辆新车的成本很高。
words.en: Costs refer to the amount of money that is required to purchase, produce, or maintain something, or the effort, loss, or sacrifice necessary to achieve or obtain something.

words.ex: The shop welcomes many customers every day.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店每天欢迎许多顾客。
words.en: People or organizations that buy goods or services from a store or business.

words.ex: The seasons follow a yearly cycle.
words.ex_cn: 季节遵循一年一度的周期。
words.en: Cycles refer to a series of events that are regularly repeated in the same order, or a complete sequence of a recurring phenomenon such as the phases of the moon. It can also mean to ride a bicycle.

words.ex: He made good deals at the market.
words.ex_cn: 他在市场上做了几笔不错的交易。
words.en: Deals can refer to agreements or arrangements between parties, especially in business, or the act of distributing or handling something.

words.ex: They make important decisions every day.
words.ex_cn: 他们每天都在做重要的决定。
words.en: A decision is a choice that you make about something after thinking about several possibilities.

words.tr: 短语. 10度（温度或角度单位）
words.ex: The temperature is 10 degrees today.
words.ex_cn: 今天气温是10度。
words.en: An angle or temperature measurement equal to ten degrees.

words.ex: He works in the math departments at the university.
words.ex_cn: 他在大学的数学系工作。
words.en: A department is one of the sections in an organization such as a government, business, or university. Departments are often responsible for a particular area of work or study.

words.tr: n. 细节；“detail”的复数； v. 详细说明；
words.ex: Can you give me the details of the meeting?
words.ex_cn: 你能给我会议的细节吗？
words.en: The word 'details' refers to the individual facts or elements that make up a larger whole. It is often used to describe the specific aspects or components of a subject that are important for understanding it fully.

words.ex: The school bought new devices for the students.
words.ex_cn: 学校为学生们购买了新的设备。
words.en: A device is an object that has been invented for a particular purpose, for example for recording or measuring something.

words.ex: He faces many difficulties in math class.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学课上遇到很多困难。
words.en: Difficulties refer to problems or situations that are hard to deal with or understand.

words.ex: The distances between the towns are very long.
words.ex_cn: 这些城镇之间的距离很远。
words.en: The amount of space between two places or things; the state of being far apart in space or time.

words.ex: The city has many districts.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市有许多地区。
words.en: A district is a part of a country, city, or town that is recognized as a separate unit because of a particular characteristic.

words.ex: The divisions between the two groups are clear.
words.ex_cn: 这两个群体之间的分开很明显。
words.en: Divisions are the parts into which something is divided or the act of dividing something.

words.ex: She bought three eggs at the market.
words.ex_cn: 她在市场上买了三个蛋。
words.en: Eggs are oval objects that are produced by a female bird and which contain a baby bird. Chickens' eggs are often eaten as food.

words.ex: He wrote three short essays about his travels.
words.ex_cn: 他写了三篇关于他旅行的短随笔。
words.en: A short piece of writing on a particular subject, often expressing personal views.

words.ex: The city hosts many art exhibitions every year.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市每年举办许多艺术展览。
words.en: A public display of works of art or other items of interest, held in an art gallery or museum or at a trade fair.

words.ex: He closed his eyes to rest.
words.ex_cn: 他闭上眼睛休息。
words.en: The eyes are the organs of sight. They detect light and convert it into electro-chemical impulses in neurons.

words.ex: The school has good facilities for sports.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校有良好的体育设施。
words.en: Facilities are buildings, pieces of equipment, or services that are provided for a particular purpose.

words.ex: Poor diet and lack of sleep are factors in his illness.
words.ex_cn: 饮食不良和睡眠不足是他生病的因素。
words.en: A factor is one of the things that affects an event, a decision, or a situation.

words.ex: The facts show that he was not at the scene.
words.ex_cn: 事实表明他当时不在现场。
words.en: A fact is a piece of information that is known to be true.

words.ex: Children develop faculties for learning quickly.
words.ex_cn: 儿童发展出快速学习的能力。
words.en: The abilities or powers possessed by a person, especially those of the mind; the teaching staff of a university or college, or of one of its departments.

words.ex: The farmers work in the fields every morning.
words.ex_cn: 农夫们每天早上在田里工作。
words.en: People who own or manage a farm.

words.ex: The farmers work on farms every day.
words.ex_cn: 农民每天在农场工作。
words.en: A farm is an area of land, or sometimes a building, where crops are grown or animals are kept.

words.tr: n. 特征；特点；面貌特征；“feature”的复数； v. 以…为特色；
words.ex: The features of this phone are very useful.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机的特征非常有用。
words.en: A feature of something is an interesting or important part or characteristic of it.

words.ex: The bike gears help you ride faster on hills.
words.ex_cn: 自行车的传动装置帮助你在上坡时骑得更快。
words.en: Gears are wheels with teeth around the edge that mesh together to transmit power in machinery.

words.ex: My grandmas bake cookies every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 我的祖母们每个星期天都烤饼干。
words.en: The mother of one's father or mother.

words.ex: My grandpas told me stories when I was young.
words.ex_cn: 我小时候，祖父给我讲过故事。
words.en: Grandpas is the plural form of grandpa, referring to one's grandfathers.

words.ex: The students are divided into small groups.
words.ex_cn: 学生们被分成几个小组。
words.en: A group of people or things is a number of people or things which are together in one place at one time.

words.ex: The growers harvest tomatoes every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这些种植者每天早上收获番茄。
words.en: Growers are people or companies that grow crops or plants, especially for sale.

words.ex: He signed the guarantees before receiving the loan.
words.ex_cn: 他在收到贷款前签署了保证书。
words.en: A guarantee is a formal promise that something will be done or will happen, especially a written promise by a company to repair or change a product that develops a fault within a particular period of time.

words.ex: He has good habits every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都有好习惯。
words.en: A habit is something that you do often or regularly.

words.ex: The children played on the hillsides after school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们放学后在山坡上玩耍。
words.en: The sides of a hill.

words.ex: He hung the coat on the hooks.
words.ex_cn: 他把外套挂在挂钩上。
words.en: A hook is a curved piece of metal or other hard material that is used for catching or holding things, or a method of attracting someone's interest or attention.

words.ex: These industries make cars and phones.
words.ex_cn: 这些行业制造汽车和手机。
words.en: Industries are groups of companies that produce goods or provide services that are similar or related to each other.

words.ex: The lab has many scientific instruments.
words.ex_cn: 实验室有许多科学仪器。
words.en: An instrument is a tool or device used for a particular task, especially for scientific, medical, or technical work.

words.ex: The news reported many issues last week.
words.ex_cn: 新闻报道了上周的许多事件。
words.en: An issue is an important subject or problem that people are discussing or arguing about.

words.ex: He attends three lectures every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周上三节讲课。
words.en: Lectures are talks that are given to a group of people to teach them about a particular subject, often as part of a university or college course.

words.ex: Each link in the chain is important.
words.ex_cn: 链条中的每一个环节都很重要。
words.en: If there is a link between two things or situations, there is a relationship between them.

words.tr: n. 管理者；经理；“manager”的复数；
words.ex: The managers plan the work for their teams.
words.ex_cn: 管理者为他们的团队规划工作。
words.en: Managers are people who are responsible for controlling or administering all or part of a company or similar organization.

words.ex: He eats mangoes every summer.
words.ex_cn: 他每年夏天都吃芒果。
words.en: Mangoes are sweet, juicy fruits that are popular in tropical regions.

words.ex: Manufactures in this country have grown rapidly.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家的制造业增长迅速。
words.en: To manufacture something means to make it in a factory, usually in large quantities.

words.tr: n. 标记；记号；“mark”的复数； v. 做标记；
words.ex: The teacher put marks on the paper to show correct answers.
words.ex_cn: 老师在纸上做了标记来表示正确答案。
words.en: Marks can refer to symbols or signs used to indicate something, grades or scores given to students' work, or physical traces left by something. As a verb, it means to make a mark on something, to grade or score something, or to pay attention to something.

words.ex: The measurements of the room were taken by the builder.
words.ex_cn: 建筑工人测量了房间的尺寸。
words.en: Measurements refer to the size, length, or amount of something, as established by measuring.

words.ex: The club has 751 members.
words.ex_cn: 这个俱乐部有751名成员。
words.en: A member is a person who belongs to a group such as a club, political party, or organization.

words.ex: I look at old photos to remember my childhood memories.
words.ex_cn: 我看着老照片来回忆我的童年记忆。
words.en: Memories are things that you remember about the past.

words.ex: He uses simple methods to solve math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他用简单的方法解决数学问题。
words.en: A method is a particular way of doing something.

words.ex: The movements for clean water grew stronger last year.
words.ex_cn: 去年，清洁用水的活动变得更强烈了。
words.en: Movements refer to the act or process of moving or being moved; a change of position or place. It can also denote a group of people working together to advance their shared political, social, or artistic ideas.

words.tr: v. 需要； n. 需求；需要；“need”的复数；
words.ex: He needs help with his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他需要帮助做作业。
words.en: If you need something, you must have it because it is essential.

words.ex: He eats nuts every morning for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃坚果当早餐。
words.en: If you say that someone is nuts, you mean that they are crazy. Nuts are hard-shelled fruits of some trees.

words.ex: The boy picked up the objects on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 男孩捡起了地上的物品。
words.en: Objects are physical things that you can see and touch. In grammar, an object is a noun, pronoun, or noun phrase that receives the action of a verb or is affected by it.

words.ex: He has overdrafts on his bank account.
words.ex_cn: 他的银行账户有透支。
words.en: An overdraft occurs when money is withdrawn from a bank account and the available balance goes below zero.

words.ex: The museum displays many old paintings.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆展出了许多古老的绘画。
words.en: Paintings are pictures that are made using paint.

words.tr: n. 论文；文件；报纸；考卷；文章；“paper”的复数；
words.ex: He wrote three papers about climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他写了三篇关于气候变化的论文。
words.en: Papers are documents containing information, such as reports, essays, or newspapers.

words.ex: The car has many parts.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车有很多部分。
words.en: Parts refer to pieces or segments of something larger, components of a machine or device, roles in a performance, areas or regions, or talents or abilities.

words.ex: The passengers waited quietly for the train.
words.ex_cn: 乘客们安静地等待火车。
words.en: Passengers are people who are traveling in a vehicle but are not operating it.

words.ex: He bought three new pens for school.
words.ex_cn: 他为学校买了三支新笔。
words.en: A pen is an instrument for writing or drawing with ink, typically consisting of a metal nib or ball, or a nylon tip, fitted into a metal or plastic holder.

words.ex: He ate two pieces of bread.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了两片面包。
words.en: A piece is a part or a section of something larger, or an individual item that is considered separately from the whole.

words.ex: He takes two pills every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃两粒药丸。
words.en: Small solid round mass of medicine that you swallow without chewing.

words.ex: He visits many places during his trip.
words.ex_cn: 他在旅行期间去了很多地方。
words.en: Places refer to specific areas or locations, which can be physical locations or positions within a sequence or order.

words.ex: The workers live on large plantations.
words.ex_cn: 工人们住在大型种植园里。
words.en: A plantation is a large piece of land, especially in a tropical country, where crops such as coffee, sugar, rubber, etc. are grown.

words.ex: He listed the main points of the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他列出了会议的主要要点。
words.en: A point is a detail, aspect, or quality of something or someone. It can also refer to the sharp end of something or a unit of scoring in games and sports. As a verb, it means to direct someone's attention towards something by extending one's finger or something held in one's hand.

words.ex: The government changed its education policies.
words.ex_cn: 政府改变了它的教育政策。
words.en: Policies are principles, rules, and guidelines formulated or adopted by an organization to reach its long-term goals and typically published in a booklet or other form that is widely accessible.

words.ex: The positions of the trees are marked on the map.
words.ex_cn: 这些树的位置在地图上标了出来。
words.en: A position is a particular point or place in physical space, or a particular situation or status in a process or competition.

words.ex: The prices of fruits went up last week.
words.ex_cn: 上周水果的价格上涨了。
words.en: The amount of money expected, required, or given in payment for something.

words.ex: He has many problems with math.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学上有很多问题。
words.en: A problem is a situation that is unsatisfactory and causes difficulties for people.

words.ex: The store sells many new products.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店出售许多新产品。
words.en: Goods or services that are produced and sold, especially in large quantities.

words.ex: I watch TV programs every evening.
words.ex_cn: 我每天晚上看电视节目。
words.en: A program is a set of instructions that a computer follows in order to perform a particular task.

words.ex: He bought the book for study purposes.
words.ex_cn: 他买这本书是为了学习目的。
words.en: The reason for which something is done or created or for which something exists.

words.ex: The recipe needs small quantities of sugar and salt.
words.ex_cn: 这个食谱需要少量的糖和盐。
words.en: Quantities refer to the amount or number of something, especially that can be measured or counted.

words.ex: He answered all the questions correctly.
words.ex_cn: 他全部答对了这些问题。
words.en: Questions are sentences or phrases that ask for information, opinions, or instructions.

words.ex: He gave two reasons for being late.
words.ex_cn: 他给出了两个迟到的原因。
words.en: A cause, explanation, or justification for an action or event.

words.tr: n. 记录；“record”的复数； v. 记录；
words.ex: The school keeps records of all student grades.
words.ex_cn: 学校保存所有学生成绩的记录。
words.en: Records refer to information that has been written down or stored on a computer, or to the process of storing information in this way. It can also refer to a musical recording or the act of making a musical recording.

words.ex: We served refreshments after the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 会议后我们提供了茶点。
words.en: Light snacks and drinks served to guests or participants at an event.

words.ex: The museum sells low-cost reproductions of famous paintings.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆出售著名画作的廉价再制造品。
words.en: Reproductions are copies of original works, especially works of art, or the process of making such copies. In biology, it refers to the production of offspring by a sexual or asexual process.

words.ex: The job has strict requirements.
words.ex_cn: 这份工作有严格的要求。
words.en: A set of necessary conditions, qualifications, or specifications that must be met or fulfilled for a particular purpose, role, or process.

words.tr: n. 结果；成绩；比分；计算的结果；“result”的复数； v. 起因；导致；
words.ex: The results of the test were good.
words.ex_cn: 这次测试的结果很好。
words.en: Results are the outcomes or consequences of actions, events, or processes.

words.ex: The retailers sell clothes at low prices.
words.ex_cn: 这些零售商以低价出售衣服。
words.en: Retailers are businesses that sell goods directly to the public in relatively small quantities for use or consumption rather than for resale.

words.ex: The hotel has many clean rooms.
words.ex_cn: 这家酒店有许多干净的房间。
words.en: Rooms refer to the spaces within a building that are separated by walls, floors, and ceilings, used for living, working, or storage.

words.ex: The books are arranged in rows on the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 书在架子上排成行。
words.en: A series of objects, people, or data arranged in a line or sequence, often used in contexts like seating, planting, or data organization.

words.ex: The company's sales increased last month.
words.ex_cn: 该公司上个月的销售额增加了。
words.en: The exchange of a commodity for money; the action of selling something.

words.ex: There are many empty seats in the theater.
words.ex_cn: 剧院里有许多空座位。
words.en: A seat is a place where you can sit, especially a chair or other piece of furniture designed for sitting on, or the part of a chair or other object on which you sit.

words.ex: He ran 100 meters in 9 seconds.
words.ex_cn: 他用9秒跑完了100米。
words.en: A second is one of the sixty parts that a minute is divided into. People often say 'a second' to mean a very short time.

words.ex: The restaurant offered three servings of soup.
words.ex_cn: 餐厅提供了三份汤。
words.en: A serving is an amount of food that is given to one person at a meal.

words.ex: The books are on the shelves.
words.ex_cn: 书在架子上。
words.en: Shelves are flat, horizontal surfaces or supports that are fixed to a wall or built into a piece of furniture, used for storing or displaying things.

words.ex: The ships sail across the ocean.
words.ex_cn: 这些船在海洋上航行。
words.en: A ship is a large boat for travelling on water, especially across the sea. Ships are used for carrying people or goods.

words.ex: The shoppers bought apples and bread at the market.
words.ex_cn: 顾客们在市场买了苹果和面包。
words.en: People who are shopping or intending to shop.

words.ex: There are many shops on this street.
words.ex_cn: 这条街上有很多商店。
words.en: Shops are places where goods are sold to the public. As a verb, to shop means to visit shops to buy goods.

words.ex: They bought souvenirs from the gift shop.
words.ex_cn: 他们从礼品店买了纪念品。
words.en: Objects that you buy or keep to remind yourself of a special occasion or a place you have visited.

words.ex: The spectators cheered loudly when the goal was scored.
words.ex_cn: 当进球发生时，观众大声欢呼。
words.en: Spectators are people who watch an event, show, game, or activity, often as part of an audience.

words.ex: The sportsmen trained hard for the Olympics.
words.ex_cn: 运动员们为奥运会刻苦训练。
words.en: A sportsman is a man who takes part in sports, especially as a profession.

words.ex: The project has three main stages.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目有三个主要阶段。
words.en: A stage is a particular point or period in the development or progress of something. It can also refer to a raised platform on which actors, entertainers, or speakers perform.

words.ex: He walked up the stairs to his bedroom.
words.ex_cn: 他走上楼梯去他的卧室。
words.en: A set of steps leading from one floor of a building to another, typically inside the building.

words.ex: He took three steps to reach the door.
words.ex_cn: 他走了三步就到了门边。
words.en: A step is one of a series of actions that you take in order to achieve something.

words.tr: n. 商店；“store”的复数； v. 贮藏；
words.ex: There are many stores on this street.
words.ex_cn: 这条街上有很多商店。
words.en: A place where merchandise is offered for sale; also, the act of keeping something for future use.

words.ex: Too many stresses can make you tired.
words.ex_cn: 太多的压力会让你感到疲惫。
words.en: Stresses can refer to pressures or tensions that affect individuals or materials, or it can denote the emphasis placed on certain words or parts of words in speech.

words.ex: The students are reading books in the library.
words.ex_cn: 学生们在图书馆里读书。
words.en: A student is a person who is studying at a university, college, or school.

words.tr: n. 研究；学习；“study”的复数； v. 研究；学习；
words.ex: His studies show that sleep helps memory.
words.ex_cn: 他的研究显示睡眠有助于记忆。
words.en: The act of learning or acquiring knowledge, especially from books or through systematic investigation.

words.tr: n. 对象；学科；主题；“subject”的复数；
words.ex: The subjects of the painting are two children playing.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画的对象是两个玩耍的孩子。
words.en: Subjects can refer to topics of study or discussion, the people or things that are being discussed or considered, or the people who are ruled by a king or queen.

words.ex: The dishonest man tricked the suckers into giving him their money.
words.ex_cn: 那个不诚实的人骗了那些易受骗的人，让他们把钱给了他。
words.en: Suckers are people who are easily deceived or tricked, or the parts of some animals or plants that allow them to stick to surfaces.

words.ex: He packed two suitcases for the trip.
words.ex_cn: 他为这次旅行打包了两个行李箱。
words.en: A suitcase is a case with a handle, used for carrying clothes and possessions when you are traveling.

words.ex: We buy food at supermarkets every week.
words.ex_cn: 我们每周都在超市买食物。
words.en: A supermarket is a large self-service shop selling foods and household goods.

words.ex: The government raised tariffs on imported cars.
words.ex_cn: 政府提高了进口汽车的税率。
words.en: A tariff is a tax or duty to be paid on a particular class of imports or exports.

words.ex: He learned new techniques to fix the machine.
words.ex_cn: 他学会了新的技术来修理这台机器。
words.en: Techniques are methods or ways of doing something, especially those that require skill.

words.tr: n. 术语；条款；期间；学期；“term”的复数；
words.ex: The book explains the terms of computer science.
words.ex_cn: 这本书解释了计算机科学的术语。
words.en: Terms refer to the conditions that are set for an agreement or the words used to describe specific things in a particular field.

words.ex: He read the texts before the class.
words.ex_cn: 他在课前读了这些文本。
words.en: Texts are written or printed materials that provide information or serve as a basis for discussion, study, or performance.

words.ex: I bought some things at the store.
words.ex_cn: 我在商店买了一些东西。
words.en: Objects, items, or matters that are not specifically named.

words.ex: His thoughts are clear and simple.
words.ex_cn: 他的想法清晰而简单。
words.en: The process of thinking; the ideas or opinions that result from thinking.

words.ex: He bought two tickets for the movie.
words.ex_cn: 他买了两张电影票。
words.en: A ticket is a piece of paper or card that gives the holder a certain right, especially to enter a place, travel by public transport, or participate in an event.

words.ex: The toilets are clean and open now.
words.ex_cn: 厕所现在干净且开放。
words.en: A toilet is a large bowl connected to the plumbing and used by people to get rid of waste from their bodies.

words.ex: He watches online tutorials to learn coding.
words.ex_cn: 他观看在线教程来学习编程。
words.en: A tutorial is a period of teaching given by a tutor to an individual or a small group of students.

words.tr: n. 价值观；道德标准；价值；（数）值；“value”的复数； v. 重视；珍视；
words.ex: My family teaches me important values like honesty and kindness.
words.ex_cn: 我的家人教给我诚实和善良等重要的价值观。
words.en: The principles or standards of behavior; one's judgment of what is important in life.

words.ex: I eat vegetables every day for health.
words.ex_cn: 为了健康，我每天都吃蔬菜。
words.en: Plants or parts of plants that are eaten as food, typically as accompaniment to meat or fish.

words.ex: He watches videos on YouTube every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天在YouTube上看视频。
words.en: Videos are recordings of moving visual images made digitally or on videotape.

words.tr: n. 观点；见解；“view”的复数； v. 审视；
words.ex: His views on education are very different from mine.
words.ex_cn: 他对教育的观点与我的非常不同。
words.en: The way in which someone sees or considers something; an opinion or belief.

words.ex: She eats fruits to get vitamins.
words.ex_cn: 她吃水果来获取维生素。
words.en: Vitamins are substances that are found in foods and are necessary for normal growth and health.

words.ex: The sailors completed long voyages across the ocean.
words.ex_cn: 水手们完成了横跨海洋的长途航行。
words.en: A voyage is a long journey, especially by sea or in space.

words.tr: n. 工作日；平日；“weekday”的复数；
words.ex: I go to work on weekdays.
words.ex_cn: 我在工作日去上班。
words.en: The days from Monday to Friday, considered as a group.

words.ex: The car has four wheels.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车有四个轮子。
words.en: Circular objects that revolve on an axle and are fixed below vehicles to enable them to move over the ground.

words.ex: There are 31 women in the meeting room.
words.ex_cn: 会议室里有31名女性。
words.en: Women are adult human females.

words.tr: n. 工人；工作者；员工；“worker”的复数；
words.ex: The workers finished their shift at 6 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 工人们在下午六点完成了他们的班次。
words.en: People who are employed in manual or industrial work.

words.ex: Children enjoy outdoor activities after school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们喜欢放学后参加户外活动。
words.en: Activities are things that people do in order to achieve a particular result or to have fun.

words.ex: The administrators fixed the website error.
words.ex_cn: 管理员修复了网站的错误。
words.en: Administrators are people whose job is to manage and organize the affairs of a business or institution.

words.ex: The children love to see animals at the zoo.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们喜欢在动物园看动物。
words.en: Animals are living creatures such as dogs, lions, and dolphins. They are not plants, and they can usually move around and react to their surroundings.

words.ex: The teacher checked the answers on the test.
words.ex_cn: 老师检查了试卷上的答案。
words.en: An answer is a response to a question, problem, or situation. It can be a solution to a problem or a reply to a question.

words.ex: The school interviewed many applicants.
words.ex_cn: 学校面试了许多申请人。
words.en: An applicant is someone who applies for something such as a job or a place at a college.

words.ex: He finishes his assignments every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上完成作业。
words.en: Tasks or pieces of work that are assigned to someone, especially as part of their studies or job.

words.ex: The flowers are on the balconies.
words.ex_cn: 花在阳台上。
words.en: A balcony is a platform on the outside of a building, enclosed by walls or balustrades, supported by columns or console brackets. The platform is projecting from the wall of a building, usually above the ground floor.

words.ex: The birds fly high in the sky.
words.ex_cn: 鸟儿在天空中高飞。
words.en: A bird is a creature with feathers and wings. Female birds lay eggs, and most birds can fly.

words.ex: I read three books last week.
words.ex_cn: 我上周读了三本书。
words.en: A book is a number of pieces of paper, usually with words printed on them, which are fastened together and fixed inside a cover of stronger paper or cardboard.

words.ex: He wore heavy boots to walk in the snow.
words.ex_cn: 他穿了厚重的靴子在雪地里走路。
words.en: Boots are a type of footwear that covers the foot and extends up the leg, sometimes to the knee or even the hip. They are typically made of leather or rubber and are worn for protection against cold, wet, or rugged terrain.

words.ex: The children laugh as they see bubbles in the water.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们看到水里的泡泡时笑了。
words.en: A bubble is a thin ball of liquid enclosing air or another gas.

words.ex: The fireworks made bright bursts in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 烟花在夜空中发出明亮的爆炸。
words.en: 1. If something bursts or if you burst it, it suddenly breaks open or splits open and the air or other substance inside it comes out. 2. If a place is bursting with people or things, it is full of them.

words.ex: The cars are parked near the house.
words.ex_cn: 汽车停在房子附近。
words.en: A car is a motor vehicle with four wheels, usually propelled by an internal combustion engine and designed to carry a small number of passengers.

words.ex: He bought three cds at the store.
words.ex_cn: 他在商店买了三张光盘。
words.en: Compact Discs: optical data storage media used for audio, software, or other digital information.

words.ex: He faces many challenges every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天面临许多挑战。
words.en: A challenge is something new and difficult which requires great effort and determination.

words.ex: She donates money to charities every month.
words.ex_cn: 她每个月都向慈善机构捐款。
words.en: Organizations that help people in need, especially by providing money, food, or other forms of assistance.

words.ex: The children are playing in the park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们正在公园里玩耍。
words.en: Children are people who are not yet adults, typically those who are under the age of 18.

words.tr: n. 教练；长途客运汽车；“coach”的复数； v. 培训；
words.ex: The coaches helped the team win the match.
words.ex_cn: 教练们帮助球队赢得了比赛。
words.en: A coach is someone who trains a person or team in a sport. Coaches are also the vehicles that carry passengers over long distances.

words.ex: Many students apply to colleges after high school.
words.ex_cn: 许多学生在高中毕业后申请大学。
words.en: Colleges are institutions of higher education that provide undergraduate and sometimes postgraduate education.

words.ex: Many countries have beautiful beaches.
words.ex_cn: 许多国家有美丽的海滩。
words.en: A country is a nation with its own government, occupying a particular territory.

words.ex: He takes three courses this semester.
words.ex_cn: 他这学期上三门课。
words.en: A course is a series of lessons or lectures on a particular subject.

words.ex: Farmers grow crops like wheat and corn.
words.ex_cn: 农民种植小麦和玉米等农作物。
words.en: Crops are plants such as wheat and potatoes that are grown in large quantities for food.

words.ex: She pulled the curtains to block the sunlight.
words.ex_cn: 她拉上窗帘以挡住阳光。
words.en: Curtains are pieces of material that hang from the top of a window and can be drawn across it to cover it.

words.ex: The dams hold back the river water.
words.ex_cn: 这些大坝拦住了河水。
words.en: A dam is a barrier that stops or restricts the flow of water or underground streams. Reservoirs created by dams not only suppress floods but also provide water for activities such as irrigation, human consumption, industrial use, aquaculture, and navigability.

words.tr: n. 截止期限；最后期限；
words.ex: Students must meet the deadlines for their assignments.
words.ex_cn: 学生必须在作业的截止期限前完成。
words.en: A deadline is a time or date before which a particular task must be finished or a particular thing must be done.

words.ex: The road was closed, so we took detours to get home.
words.ex_cn: 路被封了，所以我们绕道回家。
words.en: If you make a detour on a journey, you go by a route which is not the shortest way, because you want to avoid something such as a traffic jam, or because there is something you want to do on the way.

words.ex: I use dictionaries to learn new words.
words.ex_cn: 我用字典学习新单词。
words.en: A dictionary is a book or electronic resource that lists the words of a language (typically in alphabetical order) and gives their meaning, or gives the equivalent words in a different language, often also providing information about pronunciation, origin, and usage.

words.ex: There are differences between the two phones.
words.ex_cn: 这两部手机之间有差异。
words.en: Differences refer to the ways in which people or things are not the same as each other.

words.ex: He followed the directions to find the park.
words.ex_cn: 他按照方向找到了公园。
words.en: Directions refer to the way in which someone or something moves, faces, or is aimed; guidance or instruction on how to do something or reach a place.

words.ex: They are writing dissertations for their PhD.
words.ex_cn: 他们正在为自己的博士学位写论文。
words.en: A dissertation is a long piece of writing on a particular subject, especially one written for a university degree.

words.ex: Phone notifications are common distractions while studying.
words.ex_cn: 手机通知是学习时常见的分心因素。
words.en: Something that prevents someone from concentrating on something else.

words.ex: The road had many diversions because of the construction.
words.ex_cn: 由于施工，这条路有许多转向。
words.en: Diversions are activities that turn your attention away from something else, especially something that is boring or unpleasant.

words.ex: He watches documentaries about animals on TV.
words.ex_cn: 他看电视上关于动物的纪录片。
words.en: A documentary is a film or television or radio programme that gives detailed information about a particular subject.

words.ex: The children feed donkeys at the farm.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在农场喂驴。
words.en: Donkeys are domesticated animals used primarily as working animals for transporting goods or people.

words.ex: The doors are open.
words.ex_cn: 门是开着的。
words.en: A door is a piece of wood, glass, or metal, which is moved to open and close the entrance to a building, room, cupboard, or vehicle.

words.ex: The drivers are waiting at the bus stop.
words.ex_cn: 司机们正在公交车站等候。
words.en: A driver is a person who drives a vehicle, or a software component that controls or communicates with a hardware device.

words.ex: His duties include answering phones and filing papers.
words.ex_cn: 他的职务包括接电话和整理文件。
words.en: Duties are tasks or responsibilities that someone is required to perform, often as part of their job or role.

words.ex: He made many errors in his math homework.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学作业中犯了很多错误。
words.en: Mistakes or inaccuracies, especially those that are the result of a failure to follow a set of rules or standards.

words.ex: We walk in the park on evenings.
words.ex_cn: 我们在夜晚去公园散步。
words.en: The period of time at the end of the day, usually from about 6 p.m. to bedtime.

words.ex: The events happened last week.
words.ex_cn: 这些事件发生在上周。
words.en: Events are things that happen, especially important things.

words.ex: He shows examples of good writing.
words.ex_cn: 他展示了优秀写作的例子。
words.en: Instances or samples that illustrate a point, demonstrate a concept, or serve as models.

words.tr: n. 期望；估计；所希望的东西；“expectation”的复数；
words.ex: His parents had high expectations for his grades.
words.ex_cn: 他的父母对他的成绩有很高的期望。
words.en: Your beliefs about what will happen in the future, especially about whether something good or bad will happen.

words.ex: The explorers traveled to unknown lands.
words.ex_cn: 这些探险家前往了未知的土地。
words.en: Explorers are people who travel to places about which very little is known, in order to discover what is there.

words.ex: Many families gather for dinner on Sundays.
words.ex_cn: 许多家庭在星期天聚在一起吃晚饭。
words.en: A family is a group of people who are related to each other, especially parents and their children.

words.ex: My favourites are pizza and ice cream.
words.ex_cn: 我的最爱是披萨和冰淇淋。
words.en: Favourites refers to something or someone that is preferred over others or liked more than others.

words.tr: n. 数字；人物；体形；“figure”的复数；
words.ex: The figures show a rise in sales this month.
words.ex_cn: 这些数字显示本月销售额有所上升。
words.en: A figure is a number or a person, especially a well-known one. It can also refer to a shape or form, especially that of a person.

words.tr: n. (调查或研究的）结果；发现；
words.ex: The study's findings show that sleep helps memory.
words.ex_cn: 这项研究的结果表明，睡眠有助于记忆。
words.en: The results of an investigation or research; something that is discovered.

words.ex: The candle flickers in the wind.
words.ex_cn: 蜡烛在风中闪烁。
words.en: To flicker means to burn or shine unsteadily, or to appear briefly or intermittently.

words.ex: The flights to Paris are full today.
words.ex_cn: 今天飞往巴黎的航班都满了。
words.en: A flight is a journey made by flying, especially in an aircraft.

words.ex: The children are playing on the floors.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在地板上玩耍。
words.en: The floors of a building are the different levels of it.

words.tr: n. 形式；表格；“form”的复数； v. 组成；
words.ex: The art show displayed many forms of sculpture.
words.ex_cn: 艺术展展示了多种形式的雕塑。
words.en: Forms can refer to the shape or structure of something, or it can mean to make or shape something. It can also refer to a document with spaces in which to write.

words.ex: I play soccer with my friends every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我每个周末都和朋友一起踢足球。
words.en: A friend is someone who you know well and like, but who is not related to you.

words.ex: The functions of the brain are still being studied by scientists.
words.ex_cn: 大脑的功能正在被科学家们研究。
words.en: The purpose that something is designed to have or the role that someone or something has in a situation, system, or organization.

words.ex: Geographers study maps and rivers.
words.ex_cn: 地理学家研究地图和河流。
words.en: A geographer is a scientist whose area of study is geography, the study of Earth's physical environment and human habitat.

words.ex: The river flows through deep gorges.
words.ex_cn: 河流流经深邃的峡谷。
words.en: A gorge is a deep, narrow valley with steep sides, often with a river running through it. As a verb, to gorge means to eat greedily and to excess.

words.tr: n. 补助金；津贴；“grant”的复数；
words.ex: The government gives grants to students who need money for school.
words.ex_cn: 政府向需要钱上学的学生提供补助金。
words.en: If someone in authority grants you something, or if something is granted to you, you are allowed to have it.

words.tr: n. 导游；指南；“guide”的复数； v. 指导；指引；
words.ex: The guides showed us the ancient ruins.
words.ex_cn: 导游带我们参观了古代遗址。
words.en: If you guide someone, you show them the way to a place or you help them to do something by explaining or showing them how to do it.

words.ex: Hey guys, let's go play soccer.
words.ex_cn: 嘿，伙计们，我们去踢足球吧。
words.en: Guys is a term used to refer to a group of people, typically men, but can also be used for mixed groups. It's a casual way to address friends or acquaintances.

words.ex: He gets headaches after long hours of screen time.
words.ex_cn: 他长时间看屏幕后会头痛。
words.en: Headaches are pains in your head that can make you feel uncomfortable and can be caused by various factors such as stress, illness, or tension.

words.ex: His hobbies include reading and playing guitar.
words.ex_cn: 他的爱好包括阅读和弹吉他。
words.en: An activity or interest pursued for pleasure or relaxation and not as a main occupation.

words.ex: He shared some good ideas for the project.
words.ex_cn: 他为这个项目分享了一些好主意。
words.en: Thoughts or suggestions as to a possible course of action.

words.ex: Children have wild imaginations.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们有丰富的想象力。
words.en: The ability to form pictures or ideas in your mind of things that are new, exciting, or not real.

words.ex: The improvements in his English helped him pass the test.
words.ex_cn: 他英语的改善帮助他通过了考试。
words.en: Improvements are changes that make something better or more satisfactory.

words.ex: Each individuals has unique thoughts.
words.ex_cn: 每个个体都有独特的想法。
words.en: Individuals are single human beings as distinct from a group, class, or family.

words.ex: The pipes meet at the injunctions.
words.ex_cn: 管道在连接处相接。
words.en: An injunction is a court order, usually one telling someone not to do something.

words.tr: phrase. 利益集团；利益团体；利益群体
words.ex: Interest groups talk to the government about laws.
words.ex_cn: 利益集团向政府谈论法律。
words.en: Interest groups are organizations of people who have a common interest and work together to protect and promote that interest by influencing public policy.

words.ex: The phone calls caused many interruptions.
words.ex_cn: 电话造成了许多打扰。
words.en: Interruptions refer to the act of stopping something from continuing in its usual way by causing a break or a pause.

words.ex: He tells jokes to make his friends laugh.
words.ex_cn: 他讲笑话让朋友们笑。
words.en: Jokes are things that someone says to cause amusement or laughter, especially a story with a funny punchline.

words.ex: He lost his keys and can't get into the house.
words.ex_cn: 他丢了钥匙，进不了家门。
words.en: Keys are small pieces of shaped metal which you insert into a lock and turn in order to lock or unlock something such as a door or a drawer. They can also refer to the buttons on a computer keyboard or the answers to a test or puzzle.

words.ex: The kids are playing in the park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们正在公园里玩耍。
words.en: Children or young people.

words.ex: The children saw many lakes during their trip.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在旅行中看到了许多湖。
words.en: A lake is a large area of water surrounded by land.

words.ex: The child has two strong legs.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子有两条强壮的腿。
words.en: Legs are the limbs on which a person or animal walks and stands.

words.ex: He writes letters to his grandma every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周给奶奶写信。
words.en: Letters are written symbols that represent sounds in a language. They are used to form words and sentences in written communication.

words.tr: n. 水平；等级；级别；层次；“level”的复数；
words.ex: The levels of noise in the room were too high.
words.ex_cn: 房间里的噪音水平太高了。
words.en: Levels refer to the height of something or the position of something in a scale of quantity or quality.

words.tr: n. 线；界线；绳；（剧本中的）台词；“line”的复数；
words.ex: The artist drew straight lines on the paper.
words.ex_cn: 艺术家在纸上画了直线。
words.en: Lines can refer to long, narrow marks or bands, a connected series of people or things, or the words an actor speaks in a performance.

words.ex: He forgot the keys to the locks.
words.ex_cn: 他忘了锁的钥匙。
words.en: Locks are devices used to secure doors, containers, etc., and can also refer to sections of a canal or river where the water level changes, controlled by gates.

words.ex: He reads magazines about sports every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周读关于体育的杂志。
words.en: A magazine is a publication with a paper cover which is issued regularly, usually every week or every month, and which contains articles, stories, photographs, and advertisements.

words.ex: He bought new maps for his road trip.
words.ex_cn: 他为他的公路旅行买了新地图。
words.en: A map is a representation of an area of land or sea showing physical features, cities, roads, etc.

words.tr: n. 事情；物质；问题；麻烦；“matter”的复数
words.ex: These matters are important to him.
words.ex_cn: 这些事情对他很重要。
words.en: Matters refer to subjects or situations that are under consideration or discussion.

words.ex: The cows graze in the meadows near the village.
words.ex_cn: 牛群在村庄附近的草地上吃草。
words.en: A meadow is a field with grass and often wild flowers in it.

words.tr: n. 一餐；一顿饭；“meal”的复数；
words.ex: We eat three meals a day.
words.ex_cn: 我们一天吃三餐。
words.en: A meal is an occasion when people sit down to eat food, especially breakfast, lunch, or dinner.

words.ex: The baby reached important milestones in her first year.
words.ex_cn: 这个婴儿在她出生后的第一年达到了重要的成长里程碑。
words.en: A milestone is a significant event or stage in the development of something. It can also refer to a stone set up beside a road to mark the distance in miles to a particular place.

words.ex: Children have curious minds.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们有好奇的头脑。
words.en: The element of a person that enables them to be aware of the world and their experiences, to think, and to feel; the faculty of consciousness and thought.

words.ex: The muggers stole her bag in the park.
words.ex_cn: 劫匪在公园里抢走了她的包。
words.en: Muggers are people who attack and rob others in public places.

words.tr: n. 姓名；名称；“name”的复数； v. 说出…的名字；
words.ex: He wrote down the names of all the students.
words.ex_cn: 他写下了所有学生的姓名。
words.en: A name is a word or set of words by which a person, animal, place, or thing is known, addressed, or referred to.

words.ex: He reads newspapers every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上读报纸。
words.en: Newspapers are publications printed on paper and issued regularly, containing news, articles, advertisements, and other information.

words.ex: He reads novels every night before bed.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上睡觉前都读小说。
words.en: A novel is a long written story about imaginary characters and events.

words.ex: The officers help run the public schools.
words.ex_cn: 这些公务员帮助管理公立学校。
words.en: An officer is a person in a position of authority in the armed forces, or in a government or other organization.

words.ex: The offices are on the second floor.
words.ex_cn: 办公室在二楼。
words.en: A room, set of rooms, or building used as a place for commercial, professional, or bureaucratic work.

words.tr:
adv. 在户外；在野外；
n. 野外；旷野；郊外；
words.ex: The children love to play outdoors.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们喜欢在户外玩耍。
words.en: If something happens outdoors, it happens outside in the fresh air rather than in a building.

words.ex: They live on the outskirts of the city.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在城市的郊区。
words.en: The outskirts of a city or town are the parts of it that are farthest away from its center.

words.ex: Five persons waited for the bus.
words.ex_cn: 五个人在等公交车。
words.en: Persons is the plural of person, referring to human beings considered as individuals.

words.ex: The children drew colorful pictures on paper.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在纸上画了五颜六色的图画。
words.en: A picture is a visual representation of something, such as a photograph, drawing, or painting.

words.ex: The pioneers built houses in the wild land.
words.ex_cn: 这些先驱者在荒地上建造了房屋。
words.en: Pioneers are people who are among the first to enter and settle in a new area, or who are among the first to do something new and develop new ideas, methods, etc.

words.tr: n. 植物；发电厂；工厂；作物；“plant”的复数；
words.ex: Plants need sunlight and water to grow.
words.ex_cn: 植物需要阳光和水来生长。
words.en: Plants are living organisms that typically grow in soil and have leaves, stems, and roots. They are essential for the environment as they produce oxygen and provide food for many animals.

words.ex: We watched three plays last week.
words.ex_cn: 我们上周看了三部戏剧。
words.en: To engage in activity for enjoyment and recreation rather than a serious or practical purpose.

words.ex: He lost all his possessions in the fire.
words.ex_cn: 他在火灾中失去了所有财产。
words.en: The things that you own or have with you at a particular time.

words.ex: You need math skills as prerequisites for this course.
words.ex_cn: 你需要数学技能作为这门课程的必要条件。
words.en: Something that is required as a prior condition for something else to happen or exist.

words.ex: The factory increased its productions last year.
words.ex_cn: 去年这家工厂增加了制作量。
words.en: The process of making or growing something to be sold, especially in large quantities.

words.ex: I watch TV programmes every evening.
words.ex_cn: 我每天晚上看电视节目。
words.en: A series of coded software instructions to control the operation of a computer or other machine.

words.ex: He got promotions after working hard for two years.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作两年后得到了提升。
words.en: The act of raising someone to a higher position or rank, or the activities involved in making a product or service known and encouraging people to buy it.

words.ex: The children jumped in the puddles after the rain.
words.ex_cn: 雨后，孩子们跳进了水坑里。
words.en: A small pool of liquid, especially of rainwater on the ground.

words.ex: He showed his qualifications for the job.
words.ex_cn: 他展示了自己胜任这份工作的资格。
words.en: The skills, qualities, or experience that you need in order to do something.

words.ex: The customers made several queries about the new product.
words.ex_cn: 顾客们对新产品提出了几个要求。
words.en: A query is a question or a doubt that you ask about something.

words.ex: The students filled out questionnaires about their habits.
words.ex_cn: 学生们填写了关于他们习惯的问卷。
words.en: A set of printed or written questions with a choice of answers, devised for the purposes of a survey or statistical study.

words.ex: The boys are listening to radios in the car.
words.ex_cn: 男孩们正在车里听收音机。
words.en: A radio is the piece of equipment that you use in order to listen to radio programmes.

words.tr: n. 介绍信；参考；引用；提及；“reference”的复数；
words.ex: He gave me three references for the job.
words.ex_cn: 他给我提供了三封介绍信用于这份工作。
words.en: References are mentions of something or someone, or the act of looking at something for information.

words.ex: The children drew maps of different regions.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们画了不同地区的地图。
words.en: A large indefinite location on the surface of the Earth.

words.tr: n. 报告；报道；“report”的复数； v. 报告；报道；
words.ex: The students handed in their science reports yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 学生们昨天交上了他们的科学报告。
words.en: Reports are detailed accounts or statements about a particular subject, especially one that is investigated or analyzed. They can also refer to the act of reporting or the process of gathering and presenting information.

words.ex: The city builds reservoirs to store rainwater.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市建造蓄水库来储存雨水。
words.en: A reservoir is a large natural or artificial lake used as a source of water supply.

words.ex: The school needs more resources for students.
words.ex_cn: 学校需要为学生提供更多的资源。
words.en: Resources are materials, money, and other assets that can be used to function effectively.

words.tr: n. 被调查者；受访者；“respondent”的复数；
words.ex: The respondents answered the survey questions honestly.
words.ex_cn: 被调查者诚实地回答了调查问题。
words.en: Respondents are people who reply to something such as a survey or questionnaire.

words.ex: Many restaurants close early on Mondays.
words.ex_cn: 许多餐厅在周一早早关门。
words.en: A restaurant is a place where you can eat a meal and pay for it. In restaurants, your food is usually served to you at your table by a waiter or waitress.

words.ex: He follows the same routines every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都遵循同样的惯例。
words.en: A routine is a sequence of actions regularly followed; a fixed program.

words.ex: The school has strict rules about uniforms.
words.ex_cn: 学校对校服有严格的规定。
words.en: Rules are statements that tell you what is or is not allowed in a particular situation or game, or instructions about how to behave or do something.

words.ex: The schools are open every weekday.
words.ex_cn: 这些学校每个工作日都开放。
words.en: A school is an institution designed for the teaching of students under the direction of teachers.

words.ex: The screens show clear images.
words.ex_cn: 这些屏幕显示清晰的图像。
words.en: Screens are flat surfaces on which pictures or data are displayed. They can also refer to the act of showing a film or movie, or to the process of examining people or things in order to decide if they are suitable for a particular purpose.

words.tr: n. 研讨会；专题讨论；“seminar”的复数；
words.ex: Students attend seminars to discuss research topics.
words.ex_cn: 学生们参加研讨会来讨论研究话题。
words.en: A seminar is a meeting where a group of people discuss a particular subject or topic, often in an academic or professional setting.

words.ex: The seniors gave us advice about how to succeed in school.
words.ex_cn: 前辈们给了我们关于如何在学校取得成功的建议。
words.en: Seniors are people who are older or of a higher rank than others in a particular group or organization.

words.ex: We have math sessions every Tuesday.
words.ex_cn: 我们每周二有数学课。
words.en: A session is a period of time devoted to a particular activity, such as a meeting, a course of study, or a period of therapy.

words.ex: Boys and girls are different sexes.
words.ex_cn: 男孩和女孩是不同的性别。
words.en: The term 'sexes' refers to the two main categories (male and female) into which humans and many other living things are divided on the basis of their reproductive functions.

words.ex: He filled out the sheets with his name and address.
words.ex_cn: 他在这几张表格上填上了自己的姓名和地址。
words.en: Sheets refer to large pieces of thin material used especially on beds or as a covering for something.

words.ex: He wears shorts to the beach.
words.ex_cn: 他穿短裤去海滩。
words.en: Shorts are a piece of clothing that you wear on the lower part of your body, which do not cover your legs completely.

words.ex: The children shows a magic show at school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在学校表演魔术。
words.en: If you show something to someone, you let them see it or give it to them. If you show someone how to do something, you do it yourself so that they can watch you and learn how to do it.

words.ex: The children saw snakes in the zoo.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在动物园里看到了蛇。
words.en: A snake is a long, thin creature with no legs that slides along the ground.

words.ex: He put on his socks before leaving the house.
words.ex_cn: 他出门前穿上了袜子。
words.en: A piece of clothing which covers your foot and lower part of your leg, usually made of wool or cotton.

words.ex: Farmers care for the soils to grow healthy crops.
words.ex_cn: 农民照料土地以种植健康的庄稼。
words.en: Soil is the substance on the surface of the earth in which plants grow. It consists of rock and mineral particles mixed with decayed organic matter.

words.tr: n. 来源；出处；源泉；源头；提供资料者；“source”的复数；
words.ex: Water comes from natural sources like rivers and rain.
words.ex_cn: 水来自河流和雨水等自然来源。
words.en: Sources refer to the origins or places from which something comes or is obtained. They can be people, books, documents, etc., that provide information.

words.ex: The students play basketball in the sports hall.
words.ex_cn: 学生们在体育馆打篮球。
words.en: A large room or building designed for indoor sports activities.

words.ex: Flowers bloom in springs.
words.ex_cn: 花朵在春天绽放。
words.en: Springs can refer to the season of spring, a source of water coming out of the ground, a device that returns to its original shape after being compressed or stretched, or the act of jumping or leaping.

words.ex: He worked three short stints at different companies.
words.ex_cn: 他在不同的公司短暂工作过三次，每次都有定额。
words.en: If you do something without stint, you do it as much as is necessary or desirable, without holding back.

words.ex: He uses simple strategies to solve math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他使用简单的策略来解决数学问题。
words.en: A strategy is a plan or method chosen to bring about a desired future, such as achieving a goal or solving a problem.

words.ex: The streets are busy with cars and people.
words.ex_cn: 街道上汽车和行人很多。
words.en: The streets refer to public roads in a city, town, or village, typically with houses and buildings on one or both sides.

words.ex: The school has a new grading system.
words.ex_cn: 学校有一个新的评分系统。
words.en: A system is a way of working, organizing, or doing something which follows a fixed plan or set of rules. You can use system to refer to an organization or institution that is organized in this way.

words.ex: He found old music tapes in the drawer.
words.ex_cn: 他在抽屉里找到了旧的音乐磁带。
words.en: Tapes are long, narrow strips of material, such as plastic, that are used for recording sounds or images or for fastening things together.

words.tr:
n. 品味；味觉；味道；
v. 有 ...味道；
words.ex: Her tastes in music are very different from mine.
words.ex_cn: 她在音乐方面的品味与我的完全不同。
words.en: If you taste something, you eat or drink a small amount of it in order to try its flavor, for example, to see if you like it or not.

words.ex: The teachers help students learn math.
words.ex_cn: 教师帮助学生学习数学。
words.en: A teacher is a person who teaches, especially in a school.

words.tr: n. 时期；时间；次数；倍；“time”的复数； prep. 乘以；
words.ex: The times of ancient Rome were very different from today.
words.ex_cn: 古罗马时期与今天大不相同。
words.en: Times refers to the measurement of periods in which events occur, the number of occasions something happens, a period in history, or a multiplication factor.

words.tr: n. 工具；刀具；器具；“tool”的复数；
words.ex: He uses simple tools to fix the chair.
words.ex_cn: 他用简单的工具修理椅子。
words.en: Tools are objects such as hammers, screwdrivers, or saws that you use to help you do a particular type of work.

words.ex: We discussed many topics in class today.
words.ex_cn: 今天我们课堂上讨论了很多话题。
words.en: Subjects or themes that are discussed, written about, or studied.

words.tr: n. 旅游者；观光者；“tourist”的复数；
words.ex: Many tourists visit the Great Wall every year.
words.ex_cn: 每年有许多旅游者参观长城。
words.en: Tourists are people who are visiting a place for pleasure and interest, especially when they are on holiday.

words.ex: He wears blue trousers to work.
words.ex_cn: 他上班穿蓝色的裤子。
words.en: Trousers are a piece of clothing that you wear over your body from the waist downwards, and that cover each leg separately.

words.tr: n. 导师；家庭教师；“tutor”的复数；
words.ex: The students meet their tutors every week.
words.ex_cn: 学生们每周都见他们的导师。
words.en: A tutor is someone who gives private lessons to one student or a very small group of students. As a verb, to tutor means to teach someone privately.

words.ex: The kids are watching tvs in the living room.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们正在客厅看电视。
words.en: The plural form of television, referring to multiple television sets.

words.ex: The concerts will be held at different venues across the city.
words.ex_cn: 音乐会将在城市的不同场地举行。
words.en: A venue is the place where an event or meeting happens.

words.ex: The viewers watched the show last night.
words.ex_cn: 观众昨晚观看了这个节目。
words.en: People who watch television, a film, a video, etc.

words.ex: The museum gets many visits every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 这个博物馆每个周末都迎来许多参观者。
words.en: If you visit someone, you go to see them and spend time with them. If you visit a place, you go there for a short time.

words.ex: He buys new watches every year.
words.ex_cn: 他每年都会买新手表。
words.en: If you watch someone or something, you look at them, usually for a period of time, and pay attention to what is happening.

words.ex: The children love to watch the waterfalls near the park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们喜欢看公园附近的瀑布。
words.en: A waterfall is a place where water flows over the edge of a steep, high cliff in hills or mountains, and falls into a pool below.

words.tr: n. 窗户；窗口；电脑窗口；“window”的复数；
words.ex: The children are looking out of the windows.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们正从窗户往外看。
words.en: Windows is an operating system developed by Microsoft, which allows users to manage files and run applications on their computers.

words.tr: n. 风；“wind”的复数； v. 蜿蜒；
words.ex: The winds blew strongly last night.
words.ex_cn: 昨晚风刮得很猛烈。
words.en: n. The movement of air, especially when it is strong enough to be felt or to move things; v. To twist or turn something around itself or something else.

words.ex: The bird spread its wings and flew away.
words.ex_cn: 鸟张开翅膀飞走了。
words.en: The wings of a bird or insect are the two parts of its body that it uses for flying.

words.tr: n. 单词；字；话语；“word”的复数；
words.ex: He learned new words every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天学习新单词。
words.en: Words are the basic units of language used to communicate ideas.

words.tr: n. 优势；有利条件；“advantage”的复数； v. 有利于；
words.ex: The advantages of walking to school are clear.
words.ex_cn: 步行上学的优势很明显。
words.en: An advantage is a condition or circumstance that puts one in a favorable or superior position.

words.ex: Small problems at work can cause big aggravations.
words.ex_cn: 工作中的小问题可能会引起很大的烦恼。
words.en: Factors or events that make a problem, situation, or condition worse or more serious.

words.ex: Smartphones have many useful applications.
words.ex_cn: 智能手机有许多有用的程序。
words.en: An application is a formal request to be considered for a position or to be allowed to do or have something, submitted to an authority, institution, or organization. It can also refer to the practical use or relevance of something, or a program or piece of software designed to fulfill a particular purpose.

words.tr: n. 模样；面貌；方面；朝向；“aspect”的复数；
words.ex: The aspects of the old house still look charming.
words.ex_cn: 这所老房子的外貌仍然很迷人。
words.en: a particular part or feature of something

words.ex: My friends are my backups when I feel sad.
words.ex_cn: 当我感到难过时，朋友们就是我的帮助。
words.en: Backups refer to copies of files or other items made for the purpose of having a means to restore the original in case it is lost or damaged. It can also refer to people or things that are ready to provide support or take over if needed.

words.tr: n. 浴室；洗手间；“bathroom”的复数；
words.ex: The hotel has clean bathrooms on every floor.
words.ex_cn: 这家酒店每层都有干净的浴室。
words.en: A room containing a bath or shower and typically also a washbasin and a toilet.

words.ex: The house has three bedrooms.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子有三间卧室。
words.en: The plural form of 'bedroom', referring to more than one room in a house or apartment used for sleeping.

words.ex: There are two beds in the room.
words.ex_cn: 房间里有两张床。
words.en: A piece of furniture for sleep or rest, typically a framework with a mattress and coverings.

words.ex: The buildings are tall and old.
words.ex_cn: 这些建筑又高又旧。
words.en: A building is a structure that has a roof and walls and stands more or less permanently in one place.

words.ex: The burglars broke into the house at night.
words.ex_cn: 窃贼在晚上闯入了房子。
words.en: Burglars are people who illegally enter buildings in order to steal things.

words.tr: v. 引起；导致； n. 原因；事业；“cause”的复数；
words.ex: Smoking causes lung problems.
words.ex_cn: 吸烟会引起肺部问题。
words.en: The reason why something, especially something bad, happens.

words.ex: The ceilings in the old house were very high.
words.ex_cn: 老房子的天花板很高。
words.en: The upper interior surface of a room or other similar compartment.

words.ex: He got his driving certificates last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周拿到了他的驾驶执照。
words.en: A certificate is an official document that gives details to show that something is true or has been done, or that shows someone has passed an examination or achieved a qualification.

words.tr: n. 椅子；“chair”的复数； v. 主持；
words.ex: The students sat on the chairs in the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 学生们坐在教室的椅子上。
words.en: A chair is a piece of furniture for one person to sit on, with a back and usually four legs.

words.ex: The mother hen protects her chicks.
words.ex_cn: 母鸡保护她的小鸡。
words.en: Young birds, especially of domestic fowl.

words.ex: The climates in northern countries are cold in winter.
words.ex_cn: 北欧国家的天气在冬天很冷。
words.en: The weather conditions prevailing in an area in general or over a long period.

words.ex: The two companies made combinations to develop new technology.
words.ex_cn: 两家公司合作开发新技术。
words.en: A combination is a mixture of different things or people.

words.ex: He reads the comments on the video.
words.ex_cn: 他阅读视频下的评论。
words.en: Comments are statements that express someone's opinion or reaction to something.

words.ex: The plants grow well under good conditions.
words.ex_cn: 植物在良好的条件下生长得很好。
words.en: The circumstances or factors affecting the way in which people live or work, especially with regard to their well-being.

words.tr: n. 约束；限制；拘束；“constraint”的复数；
words.ex: The budget puts constraints on our spending.
words.ex_cn: 预算对我们的支出施加了限制。
words.en: Constraints are things that limit or restrict what you can do.

words.ex: The covers of the books are colorful.
words.ex_cn: 这些书的封面是五颜六色的。
words.en: To cover something means to place something else over it, often to protect or hide it, or to include or deal with a particular subject or area.

words.ex: Crocodiles live in rivers and swamps.
words.ex_cn: 鳄鱼生活在河流和沼泽中。
words.en: Crocodiles are large aquatic reptiles that live throughout the tropics in Africa, Asia, the Americas and Australia.

words.ex: The sofa has soft cushions.
words.ex_cn: 沙发上有柔软的靠垫。
words.en: Cushions are soft objects that are used to make a seat or bed more comfortable, or to support a part of the body.

words.ex: We wrote the dates on the calendar.
words.ex_cn: 我们把日期写在日历上。
words.en: Particular days of the month or year, often specified for events, meetings, or deadlines.

words.tr: n. 设计者；构思者；“designer”的复数；
words.ex: The designers created a new dress for the fashion show.
words.ex_cn: 这些设计者为时装秀设计了一条新裙子。
words.en: Designers are people who plan the look or workings of something prior to it being made, by preparing drawings or plans.

words.tr: n. 不利；劣势；短处；“disadvantage”的复数；
words.ex: The disadvantages of living in the city are high costs and noise.
words.ex_cn: 住在城市里的不利之处是高昂的费用和噪音。
words.en: A disadvantage is a factor which makes someone or something less useful, acceptable, or successful than other people or things.

words.ex: The doctors helped the sick child.
words.ex_cn: 医生们帮助了生病的孩子。
words.en: A doctor is a person who is qualified in medicine and treats people who are ill.

words.tr: n. 影响；效果；效应；作用；“effect”的复数；
words.ex: The effects of pollution are harmful to animals.
words.ex_cn: 污染对动物有有害的影响。
words.en: Effects refer to the results or consequences of an action or other cause.

words.ex: He calls 911 for emergencies.
words.ex_cn: 他有紧急情况时拨打911。
words.en: Emergencies are serious, unexpected, and often dangerous situations requiring immediate action.

words.ex: The fans cheered loudly when their favorite singer appeared.
words.ex_cn: 当他们最喜欢的歌手出现时，粉丝们大声欢呼。
words.en: A fan is someone who admires and supports a person, sport, sports team, or entertainment activity.

words.ex: He avoids fats to stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 他避免吃脂肪以保持健康。
words.en: Fats are substances such as butter and oil that are found in food and are used by the body to store energy.

words.ex: Her favours go to the quiet students.
words.ex_cn: 她更喜爱安静的学生。
words.en: If you regard something or someone with favour, you like or support them. It can also mean a kind or helpful act that you do for someone.

words.ex: The bird lost some feathers in the wind.
words.ex_cn: 这只鸟在风中掉了一些羽毛。
words.en: Feathers are the soft, light coverings that grow on a bird's body.

words.ex: He organized all his files on the computer.
words.ex_cn: 他把电脑上的所有文件都整理好了。
words.en: n. A file is a box or a folded piece of heavy paper or plastic in which letters or documents are kept. v. If you file a document, you put it in the correct file. If you file a formal or legal accusation, complaint, or request, you make it officially.

words.ex: She bought some flowers for her mom.
words.ex_cn: 她为妈妈买了一些花。
words.en: The seed-bearing part of a plant, consisting of reproductive organs that are typically surrounded by a brightly colored corolla and a green calyx.

words.ex: He buys new gadgets every month.
words.ex_cn: 他每个月都买新小器具。
words.en: A gadget is a small tool or device that has a particular function, often something new or innovative.

words.ex: The cars are parked in the garages.
words.ex_cn: 汽车停在车库里。
words.en: A building or part of a building where vehicles, especially cars, are kept when not in use or being repaired.

words.ex: She gave her friends gifts on Christmas.
words.ex_cn: 她在圣诞节给了朋友们礼物。
words.en: A gift is something that you give someone as a present.

words.ex: He wears hats every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都戴帽子。
words.en: Hats are head coverings, often worn for protection against the elements, for ceremonial reasons, for safety, or as a fashion accessory.

words.ex: He hurt his heels while running.
words.ex_cn: 他跑步时伤了足跟。
words.en: The lower part of a shoe, boot, etc., that is under the back part of the foot.

words.ex: The horse moved its hindquarters to the left.
words.ex_cn: 马把后躯往左移动。
words.en: The back part of an animal, including the legs.

words.ex: The door opens because the hinges are loose.
words.ex_cn: 门能打开是因为铰链松了。
words.en: A hinge is a piece of metal, wood, or plastic that is used to join two things together so that one of them can swing or move freely.

words.ex: The houses near the park are small.
words.ex_cn: 公园附近的房子很小。
words.en: A building for human habitation, especially one that is lived in by a family or small group of people.

words.ex: Many housewives cook meals for their families every day.
words.ex_cn: 许多家庭主妇每天为家人做饭。
words.en: A housewife is a woman who spends her time managing the household, caring for the children, and performing domestic tasks, rather than working for a salary outside the home.

words.ex: The hospital uses incubators for premature babies.
words.ex_cn: 医院用保温箱照顾早产儿。
words.en: An incubator is a device in which eggs are hatched artificially or in which premature babies are kept in controlled conditions. It can also refer to a place, especially with support staff and equipment, made available at low rent to new small businesses.

words.ex: The weather indicators show rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 这些天气指标显示明天会下雨。
words.en: Indicators are signs or measurements that show you what condition something is in or how it is changing.

words.ex: His intents were clear: to help and not to harm.
words.ex_cn: 他的意图很明确：要帮助，而不是伤害。
words.en: If you are intent on doing something, you are determined to do it.

words.ex: He has three interviews this week.
words.ex_cn: 他这周有三场面试。
words.en: An interview is a formal meeting at which someone is asked questions in order to find out if they are suitable for a job or a course of study, or in order to find out their opinions or experiences.

words.ex: He looked through the keyholes to see inside the room.
words.ex_cn: 他通过钥匙孔往房间里看。
words.en: A keyhole is the hole in a lock that you put a key in.

words.ex: The kitchens are clean and bright.
words.ex_cn: 厨房干净又明亮。
words.en: A kitchen is a room or part of a room used for cooking and food preparation in a dwelling or in a commercial establishment.

words.ex: There are three laundries in the small town.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇里有三家洗衣店。
words.en: Places where clothes and linens can be washed and ironed.

words.ex: The ligaments connect bones to each other.
words.ex_cn: 韧带将骨头连接在一起。
words.en: Ligaments are bands of tough, elastic connective tissue that connect bones to other bones in a joint, providing support and limiting movement.

words.ex: He wrote a note in the margins of the book.
words.ex_cn: 他在书的空白处写了一个注释。
words.en: The outer limits or edges of something; the difference between the cost of a product or service and the selling price of it.

words.tr: n. 普通老百姓；民众；平民大众；普通老百姓，民众，平民大众（注意复数形式）；
words.ex: The masses want better healthcare and education.
words.ex_cn: 普通老百姓想要更好的医疗和教育。
words.en: The masses refer to the large body of people in a society or community, especially when regarded as a political or social force.

words.ex: The builder bought new materials for the house.
words.ex_cn: 建筑工人为房子买了新材料。
words.en: Materials are substances or things used to make or build something, or to provide information or evidence.

words.ex: He buys meats from the local market.
words.ex_cn: 他从当地市场买肉。
words.en: Meats refer to the flesh of animals used as food, especially that of mammals and birds.

words.tr: n. 修改；变更；改进；“modification”的复数；
words.ex: The teacher made some modifications to the test.
words.ex_cn: 老师对试卷做了一些修改。
words.en: Changes made to something in order to improve it or make it more suitable for a particular purpose.

words.tr: n. 月（month 的复数形式）
words.ex: He waited for months to get his visa.
words.ex_cn: 他等了好几个月才拿到签证。
words.en: A month is one of the twelve periods of time that a year is divided into, for example January or February.

words.ex: I drink coffee every mornings.
words.ex_cn: 我每天早晨喝咖啡。
words.en: The early part of the day, from sunrise to noon.

words.ex: He exercises to strengthen his muscles.
words.ex_cn: 他锻炼以增强肌肉。
words.en: Muscles are the tissues in the body that allow you to move by contracting and relaxing.

words.tr: n. 笔记；音调；便条；注释；“note”的复数； v. 谈论；留意；
words.ex: I took notes during the science class.
words.ex_cn: 我在科学课上做了笔记。
words.en: Notes are pieces of information that you write down so that you can remember them later, or short pieces of writing that give you information about a particular subject.

words.ex: Ostriches run very fast on the grassland.
words.ex_cn: 鸵鸟在草原上跑得很快。
words.en: Ostriches are large flightless birds native to Africa. They are the largest living species of bird and lay the largest eggs of any living land animal.

words.ex: We went on many outings in the mountains last summer.
words.ex_cn: 去年夏天，我们去山上进行了许多远足。
words.en: Outings refer to short trips or excursions, especially those taken for pleasure or education.

words.ex: My parents go to work every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我的父母每天早上去上班。
words.en: Your parents are your mother and father.

words.ex: The doctors care for many patients every day.
words.ex_cn: 医生每天照顾许多病人。
words.en: People who are receiving medical treatment or care, especially in a hospital.

words.ex: There are many possibilities for your future.
words.ex_cn: 你的未来有很多可能性。
words.en: The range of things that can happen or be done.

words.tr: n. 业务；练习；实践；惯常做法；“practice”的复数；
words.ex: The company improves its business practices every year.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司每年都会改进其业务。
words.en: The act of doing something regularly or repeatedly to improve skill or to follow a custom or law.

words.ex: The practitioners are learning how to treat patients in the hospital.
words.ex_cn: 这些实习者正在医院学习如何治疗病人。
words.en: A practitioner is a person who regularly does a particular activity, especially one that requires skill.

words.ex: She bought ten presents for her friends.
words.ex_cn: 她为朋友们买了十份礼物。
words.en: If you present someone with something such as a prize or document, or if you present it to them, you formally give it to them.

words.ex: He sold his properties to buy a new house.
words.ex_cn: 他卖掉了自己的财产来买一栋新房子。
words.en: Properties are qualities or features that belong naturally to something; they can also refer to buildings or land owned by someone.

words.ex: The teacher helps the pupils with their math homework.
words.ex_cn: 老师帮助学生们做数学作业。
words.en: Pupils are the students in a school or the circular openings in the center of the eyes that adjust in size to control the amount of light entering the eyes.

words.tr: n. 疗法；纠正办法；“remedy”的复数；
words.ex: Natural remedies can help with colds.
words.ex_cn: 自然疗法可以帮助治疗感冒。
words.en: Remedies are methods or treatments intended to correct or improve a situation or condition.

words.ex: The teacher read all the responses from the students.
words.ex_cn: 老师读了所有学生的回答。
words.en: Answers, reactions, or replies to a question, statement, or stimulus.

words.ex: He bought a roll of paper towels.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一卷纸巾。
words.en: Rolls can refer to the action of moving or causing to move in a particular direction by turning over and over on an axis, or it can refer to a list or register, especially of names. It can also denote a small, usually round loaf of bread.

words.ex: The roofs of the houses are covered with snow.
words.ex_cn: 房子的屋顶上覆盖着雪。
words.en: The outer covering of a building or vehicle that protects it from the weather.

words.ex: We go to the park on saturdays.
words.ex_cn: 我们在星期六去公园。
words.en: Saturdays refers to the day of the week following Friday and preceding Sunday, often considered a day of rest and leisure in many cultures.

words.ex: The hotel provides excellent services.
words.ex_cn: 这家酒店提供出色的服务。
words.en: Services are systems or organizations that provide something that the public needs, such as transport, communications, or utilities like electricity and water.

words.ex: The cats sleep in the shades under the tree.
words.ex_cn: 猫在树下的阴凉处睡觉。
words.en: Shades refer to the darkness or coolness caused by the blocking of direct sunlight, or the different degrees of lightness or darkness of a color.
