words.ex: The children learned about different shapes like circles and squares.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们学习了圆形和正方形等不同的外形。
words.en: Shapes refer to the external form, appearance, or outline of someone or something. It can also mean to give a particular form or shape to something.

words.ex: He bought shares in a tech company.
words.ex_cn: 他购买了一家科技公司的股份。
words.en: Shares are units of ownership in a company or financial asset that provide for an equal distribution in any profits, if any are declared, in the form of dividends.

words.ex: He bought new shoes for school.
words.ex_cn: 他为上学买了新鞋子。
words.en: Shoes are objects which you wear on your feet. They cover most of your foot and you wear them over socks or stockings.

words.ex: Smokers often have a cough in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 吸烟者早上常常咳嗽。
words.en: People who smoke tobacco regularly.

words.ex: He loves playing sports after school.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢放学后参加体育运动。
words.en: Sports are physical activities or games, often competitive and organized, that involve skill and physical exertion.

words.ex: Many families live in the suburbs to have more space.
words.ex_cn: 许多家庭住在郊区以获得更多的空间。
words.en: The suburbs are the residential areas on the outskirts of a city or large town.

words.ex: The sufferers received help from the charity.
words.ex_cn: 受害者得到了慈善机构的帮助。
words.en: People who are experiencing pain, illness, or hardship.

words.ex: He gave me some suggestions about how to improve my writing.
words.ex_cn: 他给了我一些关于如何提高写作的建议。
words.en: Suggestions are ideas or proposals offered for consideration or action.

words.ex: We go to the park on sundays.
words.ex_cn: 我们在星期天去公园。
words.en: Sundays refer to the day of the week following Saturday and before Monday, often considered a day of rest and worship in many cultures.

words.ex: The hospital performs many surgeries every week.
words.ex_cn: 这家医院每周进行许多手术。
words.en: Surgeries are medical procedures in which a doctor cuts open a patient's body in order to repair, remove, or replace a diseased or damaged part.

words.tr: n. 桌子；台子；表格；“table”的复数；
words.ex: The children sat at the tables to eat lunch.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们坐在桌子旁吃午餐。
words.en: A piece of furniture with a flat top and one or more legs, providing a level surface for eating, writing, or working.

words.ex: He finishes his tasks before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭前完成他的任务。
words.en: Activities or pieces of work that need to be completed, often as part of a job or project.

words.ex: He takes trips to the beach every summer.
words.ex_cn: 他每年夏天都去海边旅行。
words.en: If you trip when you are walking, you knock your foot against something and fall or nearly fall.

words.ex: There are different types of dogs.
words.ex_cn: 有不同类型的狗。
words.en: A type is a category of things or people that have similar characteristics.

words.ex: The weather shows many variations in spring.
words.ex_cn: 春天的天气有很多变化。
words.en: A variation is a difference or change in the usual or expected amount, form, or condition of something.

words.tr: n. 海浪；浪潮；波；“wave”的复数； v. 挥手；挥动；
words.ex: The waves crashed against the shore.
words.ex_cn: 海浪拍打着海岸。
words.en: Waves are the way in which something such as sound, light, or radio signals travel.

words.ex: I play soccer with my friends on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 我在周末和朋友们踢足球。
words.en: The period from Friday evening to Sunday night, especially regarded as a time for leisure.

words.ex: His actions showed he was serious.
words.ex_cn: 他的行动表明他是认真的。
words.en: The things that someone does in order to achieve a particular purpose or to deal with a situation.

words.ex: His acts were very kind to everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他的行为对每个人都非常友善。
words.en: Acts can refer to the deeds or actions performed by someone, or it can denote a formal written law passed by a legislative body. As a verb, it means to do something or to perform a role in a play, movie, etc.

words.tr: n. 数量；数额；“amount”的复数； v. 总计；等于；
words.ex: The amounts of water in the two bottles are different.
words.ex_cn: 两个瓶子里的水量不同。
words.en: A quantity of something, especially the total of a thing or things in number, size, value, or extent.

words.tr: n. 途径；方法；“approach”的复数； v. 接近；靠近；
words.ex: Different approaches can solve the same problem.
words.ex_cn: 不同的途径可以解决同一个问题。
words.en: To come near or nearer to something or someone in space, time, quality, or amount.

words.ex: He majored in arts at university.
words.ex_cn: 他在大学主修人文学科。
words.en: The arts are activities such as music, painting, literature, film, and dance, which people can take part in for enjoyment, or to create works which express important meanings or ideas.

words.tr: n. 当局；官方；权威；“authority”的复数；
words.ex: The authorities closed the park for safety reasons.
words.ex_cn: 当局为了安全原因关闭了公园。
words.en: The people or organizations that are in charge of a particular country or area and have the power to make laws and enforce them.

words.ex: The children played with colorful balloons at the party.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在派对上玩彩色气球。
words.en: A balloon is a small, thin, rubber bag that you blow air into so that it becomes larger and rounder or longer. Balloons are used as toys or decorations.

words.ex: He said it with a smile, but his words had barbs.
words.ex_cn: 他说这话时带着微笑，但话语中带有讽刺。
words.en: Sharp projections or points, especially those on a fishhook or arrow, designed to prevent easy removal; also refers to a pointed, often hurtful remark.

words.tr: n. 基本因素（或原理、原则、规律等）；
words.ex: He learned the basics of math before moving on to harder topics.
words.ex_cn: 他在学习更难的主题之前，先掌握了数学的基本原理。
words.en: The basics of something are its simplest and most important aspects, which you need to know in order to understand it or do it.

words.ex: We walked on the beaches at sunset.
words.ex_cn: 我们在日落时漫步在海滩上。
words.en: A beach is a landform alongside a body of water which consists of loose particles. The particles composing a beach are typically made from rock, such as sand, gravel, shingle, pebbles, or cobblestones.

words.tr: v. 叫；打电话； n. 打电话；“call”的复数；
words.ex: He calls his dog every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上叫他的狗。
words.en: To call someone means to telephone them. To call something means to give it a particular name or description.

words.ex: He is holding three cards in his hand.
words.ex_cn: 他手里拿着三张牌。
words.en: Cards are pieces of stiff paper or thin cardboard, often with a picture on one side, which are used for playing games or for sending messages.

words.ex: The fisherman showed his catches from the morning trip.
words.ex_cn: 渔夫展示了他早晨捕获的渔获物。
words.en: To catch means to capture or seize something after a chase or search.

words.ex: The town had celebrations for the holiday.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇为节日举行了庆祝活动。
words.en: Celebrations refer to special social events, ceremonies, or parties that are organized in order to celebrate something.

words.ex: The shops are in the town centres.
words.ex_cn: 商店在城镇中心。
words.en: A centre is a point or part that is equally distant from all sides, ends, or surfaces of something; the middle. It can also refer to a place where a particular activity or service is concentrated.

words.ex: The building has stood for centuries.
words.ex_cn: 这座建筑已经屹立了几个世纪。
words.en: A century is a period of one hundred years. Centuries are used as a way to divide up the timeline of history into manageable sections.

words.tr: n. 变化；变革；“change”的复数； v. 变化；变革；
words.ex: The changes in weather affect our mood.
words.ex_cn: 天气的变化影响我们的情绪。
words.en: Changes refer to the act or instance of making or becoming different, or the money returned when the amount given in payment is more than the cost.

words.ex: The children are excited to see the circuses this weekend.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们很兴奋这个周末要看马戏团表演。
words.en: A circus is a group of performers, often including clowns, acrobats, and trained animals, that travels to different places to entertain people with their performances.

words.tr: n. 颜色；“colour”的复数； v. 着色；
words.ex: The children love to paint with bright colours.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们喜欢用鲜艳的颜色画画。
words.en: Colours are the different hues that can be seen by the human eye, resulting from the way objects reflect or emit light.

words.ex: The study reached two main conclusions.
words.ex_cn: 这项研究得出了两个主要结论。
words.en: A conclusion is the last part of something, its end or result. When you write a paper, you always end by summing up your arguments and drawing a conclusion.

words.ex: His mistakes had serious consequences.
words.ex_cn: 他的错误带来了严重的后果。
words.en: The results or effects of actions or conditions.

words.tr: n. 村舍；小屋；小别墅；“cottage”的复数；
words.ex: The tourists stayed in small cottages near the lake.
words.ex_cn: 游客们住在湖边的小村舍里。
words.en: A cottage is a small house, especially in the country.

words.ex: The forest is full of strange creatures.
words.ex_cn: 森林里充满了奇怪的生物。
words.en: A creature is a living thing that can move around, such as an animal.

words.ex: The police caught the men who committed crimes.
words.ex_cn: 警察抓到了那些犯下罪行的人。
words.en: Crimes are illegal actions or activities for which a person can be punished by law.

words.ex: The sun shines on the crystals and makes them sparkle.
words.ex_cn: 阳光照在晶体上，使它们闪闪发光。
words.en: Crystals are solid materials whose constituents (such as atoms, molecules, or ions) are arranged in a highly ordered microscopic structure, forming a crystal lattice that extends in all directions.

words.ex: He waits for days to get a reply.
words.ex_cn: 他等了好几天才得到回复。
words.en: Days refer to the time between sunrise and sunset, or a period of 24 hours.

words.ex: The developments in technology help people live better.
words.ex_cn: 科技的发展帮助人们生活得更好。
words.en: The process of developing or being developed; a new and advanced product or idea.

words.tr: n. 展示；陈列；“display”的复数； v. 展示；陈列；
words.ex: The museum has new displays of ancient artifacts.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆有新的古代文物展示。
words.en: If you display something that you want people to see, you put it in a particular place, so that people can see it easily.

words.ex: He has five dollars in his pocket.
words.ex_cn: 他口袋里有五美元。
words.en: The basic monetary unit of the United States, Canada, Australia, and certain countries in the Pacific, Caribbean, Southeast Asia, Africa, and South America.

words.ex: The drawbacks of this phone are high price and short battery.
words.ex_cn: 这款手机的缺点是价格高和电池续航短。
words.en: A drawback is a feature that makes something less effective than it could be.

words.ex: He bought three drinks at the café.
words.ex_cn: 他在咖啡馆买了三杯饮料。
words.en: Drinks refer to liquids that can be consumed, typically including water, tea, coffee, and alcoholic beverages. As a verb, it means to take liquid into the mouth and swallow it.

words.tr: n. 雇员；受雇者；“employee”的复数；
words.ex: The company treats all employees with respect.
words.ex_cn: 公司尊重所有雇员。
words.en: Employees are people who are hired to provide services to a company or another person in exchange for compensation, typically in the form of wages or salary.

words.ex: He is preparing for his exams this week.
words.ex_cn: 他这周正在为考试做准备。
words.en: An exam is a formal test that you take to show your knowledge or ability in a particular subject, or to obtain a qualification.

words.ex: The students do experiments in the science lab.
words.ex_cn: 学生们在科学实验室做实验。
words.en: A scientific test or procedure carried out under controlled conditions to discover, demonstrate, or test a hypothesis, theory, or known law.

words.ex: The extensions of the building added more space.
words.ex_cn: 这座建筑的延伸部分增加了更多空间。
words.en: An extension is a part that is added to something to enlarge or prolong it; a continuation.

words.tr: n. 电影；薄薄的一层；底片；“film”的复数； v. 拍摄电影；
words.ex: I watch films every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我每个周末都看电影。
words.en: Films are stories or events recorded by a camera as a set of moving images and shown in a cinema or on television.

words.ex: The shark uses its fins to swim quickly.
words.ex_cn: 鲨鱼用它的鳍快速游泳。
words.en: Plural form of fin, which refers to a thin flat part that sticks out from the body of a fish, used for swimming and balance.

words.ex: They live in a small flat near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在公园附近的一间小公寓里。
words.en: Flats are apartments that are usually on one floor of a building. They can also refer to women's shoes with a very low heel or no heel.

words.ex: The school needs more funds to buy new books.
words.ex_cn: 学校需要更多资金来购买新书。
words.en: Funds are amounts of money that are available to be spent, especially money that is set aside for a specific purpose.

words.ex: Children love playing games after school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们喜欢放学后玩游戏。
words.en: Games are activities or sports that involve skill, chance, or endurance on the part of two or more persons who play according to a set of rules, usually for their own amusement or for that of spectators.

words.ex: The children play in the gardens after school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们放学后在花园里玩耍。
words.en: An area of land, often near a house, used for growing flowers, fruit, or vegetables, and often containing an area of grass.

words.ex: He sets new goals every month.
words.ex_cn: 他每个月都设定新的目标。
words.en: An aim or desired result that a person or a group of people works towards achieving.

words.ex: The guest arrived at the party early.
words.ex_cn: 客人早早到了派对。
words.en: A guest is someone who is visiting a place or attending an event by invitation, without having a permanent role there.

words.ex: Strong gusts blew the leaves across the yard.
words.ex_cn: 一阵阵强风把树叶吹得满院子都是。
words.en: A gust is a sudden, strong rush of wind.

words.ex: The school held the concert in the halls.
words.ex_cn: 学校在礼堂举行了音乐会。
words.en: A large room or building used for public gatherings, concerts, or other events.

words.ex: Many high-rises stand in the city center.
words.ex_cn: 许多高楼矗立在市中心。
words.en: High-rises are tall buildings, typically residential or office buildings, that are significantly taller than the surrounding structures.

words.ex: The shirt has small holes.
words.ex_cn: 这件衬衫上有小洞。
words.en: A hole is a hollow space in something solid, with an opening on one side.

words.ex: We go to the beach during holidays.
words.ex_cn: 我们在假期去海滩。
words.en: Holidays are days when people do not go to work or school, especially because of a religious or national celebration.

words.ex: The children ride horses in the park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在公园里骑马。
words.en: Horses are large animals with four legs, a mane, and a tail, which people ride or use to pull vehicles or carry loads.

words.ex: The store is open for hours every day.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店每天开放24小时。
words.en: A period of time equal to a twenty-fourth part of a day and night and divided into 60 minutes.

words.ex: The hovercrafts move fast over water.
words.ex_cn: 气垫船在水面上快速移动。
words.en: A hovercraft is a vehicle that can travel over land and water. It floats above the surface it is traveling over on a cushion of air.

words.ex: Humans need water to survive.
words.ex_cn: 人类需要水来生存。
words.en: Human beings collectively; the human race.

words.ex: There were many incidents at the school last month.
words.ex_cn: 上个月学校发生了许多事件。
words.en: An incident is an event, especially one that is unusual, important, or violent.

words.ex: She sent out eight invitations for her birthday party.
words.ex_cn: 她为生日派对寄出了八份邀请函。
words.en: An invitation is a written or spoken request to come to an event such as a party, a meal, or a meeting.

words.ex: He found two new jobs last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周找到了两份新工作。
words.en: A job is the work that someone does regularly in order to earn money.

words.ex: The bag weighs five kilograms.
words.ex_cn: 这个包重五公斤。
words.en: The base unit of mass in the International System of Units, used for measuring weight.

words.tr: n. 叶；叶片；“leaf”的复数； v. 留下；离开；离去；
words.ex: The tree loses its leaves in autumn.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树在秋天落叶。
words.en: Leaves are the main organs of photosynthesis and transpiration in higher plants, usually green and flat, attached to the stems or branches. As a verb, it is the third person singular present tense of 'leave', meaning to go away from a place.

words.ex: The lengths of the two sticks are different.
words.ex_cn: 这两根棍子的长度不同。
words.en: The measurement or extent of something from end to end; the greater of two or the greatest of three dimensions of a body.

words.tr: n. 生活；生命；“life”的复数； v. 居住；生活；
words.ex: Their lives are simple but happy.
words.ex_cn: 他们的生活简单但幸福。
words.en: The condition that distinguishes animals and plants from inorganic matter, including the capacity for growth, reproduction, functional activity, and continual change preceding death; the existence of an individual human being or animal.

words.ex: The map shows the locations of all the restaurants.
words.ex_cn: 这张地图显示了所有餐厅的位置。
words.en: A location is the place where something happens or is situated.

words.ex: There are 745 markets in the city.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市有745个市场。
words.en: Places or systems where goods and services are bought and sold.

words.ex: He runs 100 metres in 12 seconds.
words.ex_cn: 他12秒跑完100米。
words.en: A unit of length equal to 100 centimetres.

words.ex: Millions of people watch the game every year.
words.ex_cn: 每年有数百万人观看这场比赛。
words.en: The number equivalent to the product of a thousand and a thousand; 1,000,000 or 10⁶.

words.tr: n. 矿物；矿物质；“mineral”的复数；
words.ex: Rock contains many minerals like quartz and feldspar.
words.ex_cn: 岩石中含有许多矿物，如石英和长石。
words.en: Minerals are solid substances that are formed naturally in the earth and are not of animal or vegetable origin.

words.ex: I walked to the station in minutes.
words.ex_cn: 我十分钟内走到了车站。
words.en: Minutes are the official written record of what was said and decided at a meeting.

words.ex: I cherish every moment with my family.
words.ex_cn: 我珍惜与家人在一起的每一个瞬间。
words.en: A moment is a very short period of time.

words.ex: I hate mondays because they are long and tiring.
words.ex_cn: 我讨厌星期一，因为它们又长又累。
words.en: The first day of the working week in many Western countries, often associated with the start of work.

words.ex: The fisherman mended his nets by the sea.
words.ex_cn: 渔夫在海边修补他的网。
words.en: Nets are devices made from threads or ropes that are woven together, used for catching fish or other animals, or for various other purposes such as in sports or to protect against insects.

words.ex: He wrote down the numbers on the paper.
words.ex_cn: 他把数字写在了纸上。
words.en: Numbers are symbols or words used to represent quantities or values in mathematics, counting, or identification.

words.tr: v. 提议； n. 提议；“offer”的复数；
words.ex: He offers to help me with my homework.
words.ex_cn: 他提议帮我做作业。
words.en: If you offer something to someone, you ask them if they would like to have it or use it.

words.ex: I like red ones more than blue ones.
words.ex_cn: 我更喜欢红色的那些，而不是蓝色的那些。
words.en: Used to refer to a person or thing previously mentioned or easily identified.

words.ex: The operators add two numbers together.
words.ex_cn: 这些运算符将两个数字相加。
words.en: Operators are people who operate or manage a machine, business, or system. In mathematics and computing, an operator is a symbol that represents an operation to be performed on one or more operands.

words.ex: He has many options for his future.
words.ex_cn: 他未来有很多选择。
words.en: Choices or alternatives available in a particular situation.

words.ex: Many organisations help poor children.
words.ex_cn: 许多组织帮助贫困儿童。
words.en: An organisation is a group of people who work together in an organized way for a shared purpose.

words.ex: He helped others without asking for anything.
words.ex_cn: 他帮助别人，没有要求任何回报。
words.en: Used to refer to additional people or things of the same type as those already mentioned or known about.

words.ex: The owners of the house fixed the roof.
words.ex_cn: 房子的物主修了屋顶。
words.en: An owner is someone who owns something.

words.tr: phrase. 回形针；纸夹（用于固定纸张的金属或塑料小夹子）
words.ex: He bought some paper clips to hold the papers together.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一些回形针来夹住文件。
words.en: Paper clips are small pieces of bent wire or plastic used for holding sheets of paper together.

words.ex: The performances at the theater were amazing.
words.ex_cn: 剧院的演出非常精彩。
words.en: Performances refer to the act of presenting a form of entertainment, such as a play, concert, or other artistic presentation, or the manner in which someone or something functions.

words.ex: The performers danced on stage last night.
words.ex_cn: 昨晚演出者们在舞台上跳舞。
words.en: Performers are individuals who entertain an audience by acting, singing, dancing, or playing music.

words.ex: My pets are a cat and a dog.
words.ex_cn: 我的宠物是一只猫和一只狗。
words.en: Animals kept for companionship or pleasure.

words.ex: I put the photos on the table.
words.ex_cn: 我把照片放在桌子上。
words.en: Photos are images taken by a camera and recorded on a photosensitive surface or digitally.

words.ex: The book costs ten pounds.
words.ex_cn: 这本书售价十英镑。
words.en: A unit of weight equal to 16 ounces (453.592 grams). Also, the basic monetary unit of the UK, equal to 100 pence.

words.tr: n. （企业或机构使用的）房屋及土地；“premise”的复数；
words.ex: The company owns its premises in the city center.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司拥有位于市中心的房产和土地。
words.en: The buildings and land that a business or organization uses.

words.ex: The puppeteers moved the strings to make the dolls dance.
words.ex_cn: 木偶操纵者拉动绳子，让玩偶跳舞。
words.en: A puppeteer is a person who manipulates puppets in a performance.

words.ex: The children laughed at the colorful puppets on stage.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们笑了，看着舞台上色彩鲜艳的木偶。
words.en: A puppet is a doll that you can move by pulling strings that are attached to it or by putting your hand inside it and moving your fingers.

words.ex: The purists prefer the original version.
words.ex_cn: 纯粹主义者更喜欢原版。
words.en: Purists are people who insist on following traditional rules or styles, especially in language, art, or music, and who oppose any form of change or innovation.

words.tr: n. 小测验；知识竞赛；“quiz”的复数；
words.ex: The teacher gave us five quizzes this week.
words.ex_cn: 老师这周给了我们五次小测验。
words.en: A quiz is a test, game, or competition in which someone answers questions.

words.ex: The railways connect many cities in the country.
words.ex_cn: 铁路连接了这个国家的许多城市。
words.en: A railway is a route between two places along which trains travel on steel rails.

words.ex: The doctor gave me some health recommendations.
words.ex_cn: 医生给我一些健康建议。
words.en: Recommendations are suggestions or proposals about the best course of action to take, especially those given by someone in authority or with expertise.

words.ex: They have a good relationship with their neighbors.
words.ex_cn: 他们和邻居关系很好。
words.en: A relationship is the way in which two or more people or things are connected, or the state of being connected.

words.ex: The rivers flow into the sea.
words.ex_cn: 河流流入大海。
words.en: Rivers are large natural streams of water flowing in a channel to the sea, a lake, or another river.

words.ex: The scientist tested the samples for bacteria.
words.ex_cn: 科学家对这些样本进行了细菌检测。
words.en: A sample is a small quantity of something that is taken to represent the whole.

words.ex: I ate two sandwiches for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 我午餐吃了两个三明治。
words.en: A sandwich is two slices of bread with a layer of food such as cheese or meat between them.

words.ex: The scales of the problem are much bigger than we thought.
words.ex_cn: 这个问题的程度比我们想象的要大得多。
words.en: A measuring device for weighing, or the balance between opposing forces.

words.ex: Many school-leavers find it hard to get a job without a diploma.
words.ex_cn: 许多中途辍学者在没有文凭的情况下很难找到工作。
words.en: School-leavers are young people who have just left school, especially those who have completed their secondary education and are about to enter the workforce or further education.

words.ex: He likes sciences like biology and chemistry.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢生物和化学等科学。
words.en: The systematic study of the structure and behavior of the physical and natural world through observation and experiment.

words.ex: The fisherman sails across the seas every day.
words.ex_cn: 渔夫每天航行在海上。
words.en: The large body of salt water that covers most of the earth's surface.

words.ex: The book has five sections.
words.ex_cn: 这本书有五个部分。
words.en: A section is a distinct part or subdivision of something, such as a document, a city, or an object.

words.ex: The cake was divided into four segments.
words.ex_cn: 蛋糕被分成了四部分。
words.en: A segment is one of several parts that together make up a whole thing, which could be a piece of fruit, a market, or a television program.

words.ex: Sharks live in the deep ocean.
words.ex_cn: 鲨鱼生活在深海中。
words.en: Sharks are a group of elasmobranch fish characterized by a cartilaginous skeleton, five to seven gill slits on the sides of the head, and pectoral fins that are not fused to the head.

words.ex: The triangle has three sides.
words.ex_cn: 这个三角形有三条边。
words.en: The outer parts of an object, area, or surface, especially when regarded as facing a particular direction.

words.ex: The ancient sites attract many tourists.
words.ex_cn: 这些古代场所吸引了许多游客。
words.en: A site is a piece of ground that is used for a particular purpose or where a particular thing happens.

words.tr: n. 技能；技巧；技术；“skill”的复数；
words.ex: He developed many skills through practice.
words.ex_cn: 他通过练习掌握了多种技能。
words.en: Skills are the abilities and knowledge that you need in order to do a job or activity.

words.ex: Children like to eat snacks after school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们喜欢在放学后吃零食。
words.en: Snacks are small amounts of food that are eaten between meals.

words.ex: He likes all sorts of music.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢各种各样的音乐。
words.en: If you talk about a particular sort of something, you are talking about a class of things that have particular features in common and that belong to a larger group of related things.

words.ex: He gave three speeches last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周做了三场演说。
words.en: Speeches are formal addresses or discourses delivered to an audience.

words.ex: The horses live in the stables near the farm.
words.ex_cn: 马住在农场附近的马厩里。
words.en: A building in which horses are kept.

words.ex: The school has high standards for homework.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校对作业有很高的标准。
words.en: Standards are levels of quality or achievement, especially ones that are considered acceptable or desirable.

words.ex: The children picked up sticks from the ground.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们从地上捡起了棍子。
words.en: A stick is a thin piece of wood that has fallen or been cut from a tree. Sticks are used for various purposes, such as fuel, for building, or for making things. In sports, a stick is a long, thin piece of wood that is used to hit or control the ball in games such as hockey or lacrosse.

words.tr: n. 支持者；拥护者；“supporter”的复数；
words.ex: The supporters cheered loudly for their team.
words.ex_cn: 支持者们为他们的球队大声欢呼。
words.en: People who support a particular person, group, or idea.

words.ex: The children are playing in their natural surroundings.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们正在他们的自然环境中玩耍。
words.en: The things and conditions around a person, place, or thing.

words.tr: n. 调查；勘测；“survey”的复数； v. 调查；勘测；
words.ex: The school did surveys about student lunch preferences.
words.ex_cn: 学校做了关于学生午餐偏好的调查。
words.en: Surveys are a method of gathering information from a sample of people, traditionally with the intention of generalizing the results to a larger population.

words.ex: The swans are swimming in the lake.
words.ex_cn: 天鹅正在湖里游泳。
words.en: Swans are large aquatic birds closely related to geese and ducks. They are known for their grace, both in water and in flight.

words.ex: The swimmers train every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这些游泳者每天早上训练。
words.en: People who swim, especially as a sport or for enjoyment.

words.ex: The tenants pay rent every month.
words.ex_cn: 这些房客每个月交房租。
words.en: Tenants are people who rent a place to live or work in.

words.ex: We have math class on thursdays.
words.ex_cn: 我们在星期四有数学课。
words.en: Every Thursday; on Thursdays.

words.ex: The tips of the trees touched the clouds.
words.ex_cn: 树的末端触到了云朵。
words.en: Tips can refer to a small amount of money given to someone for performing a service, a piece of advice, or the pointed end of something. As a verb, it means to give a tip, to tilt, or to touch lightly.

words.ex: The small towns are quiet and peaceful.
words.ex_cn: 这些小镇安静而平和。
words.en: A town is a place with many streets and buildings, where people live and work. It is larger than a village but smaller than a city.

words.ex: The bank recorded all transactions yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 银行昨天记录了所有交易。
words.en: Transactions are the actions or processes of buying, selling, or exchanging goods, services, or money.

words.ex: Travelers carry maps to find their way.
words.ex_cn: 旅行者带着地图找路。
words.en: People who are traveling, especially those who are on a journey.

words.ex: The children play under the trees.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在树下玩耍。
words.en: A tree is a tall plant that has a wooden trunk and branches that grow from its upper part.

words.ex: The magician showed some magic tricks.
words.ex_cn: 魔术师表演了一些魔术把戏。
words.en: A trick is a clever or skillful action that someone does in order to entertain or deceive people.

words.ex: The victims were helped by volunteers.
words.ex_cn: 受害者得到了志愿者的帮助。
words.en: A victim is someone who has been hurt or killed by someone or something, or someone who has suffered because of a bad situation.

words.ex: The children walk to school from small villages.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们从各个小村庄步行去上学。
words.en: Small communities in rural areas, typically smaller than a town.

words.ex: He enjoys long walks in the park.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在公园里长时间散步。
words.en: To move along on foot; advance by steps.

words.ex: He waited for weeks to get a reply.
words.ex_cn: 他等了好几个星期才等到回复。
words.en: A week is a period of seven days.

words.tr: v. 起作用；（使）工作；（使）运转； n. 作品；工厂；全部事物；“work”的复数；
words.ex: This medicine works well for headaches.
words.ex_cn: 这种药对头痛很有效。
words.en: The term 'works' can refer to a factory, the output of an artist or writer, a construction project, or a mechanical device.

words.ex: The students asked their advisors for help with their projects.
words.ex_cn: 学生们向他们的顾问寻求项目帮助。
words.en: Advisors are people who give advice, especially someone whose job is to give advice on a particular subject.

words.tr: n. 代理；代理处；“agency”的复数；
words.ex: The agencies help people find houses.
words.ex_cn: 这些代理帮助人们找房子。
words.en: An agency is a business which provides a service on behalf of other businesses.

words.tr: n. 角；角度；角落；看问题的角度；“angle”的复数；
words.ex: The triangle has three angles.
words.ex_cn: 这个三角形有三个角。
words.en: An angle is the space between two lines or surfaces that meet, measured in degrees. It can also refer to a particular way of approaching something or a point of view.

words.ex: The architects designed a tall building.
words.ex_cn: 建筑师设计了一座高楼。
words.en: An architect is a person who designs buildings and advises in their construction.

words.ex: We made final arrangements for the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 我们为会议做了最后的安排。
words.en: Arrangements are plans and preparations that you make so that something will happen or be possible.

words.ex: The teacher asked her assistants to hand out the books.
words.ex_cn: 老师请她的助手分发书籍。
words.en: A person who helps in particular work, often in a subordinate role.

words.ex: The experiment is based on simple assumptions.
words.ex_cn: 这个实验基于简单的假定。
words.en: An assumption is something that you assume to be the case, even without proof.

words.tr: n. 态度；姿势（复数形式）；
words.ex: His attitudes toward homework are very positive.
words.ex_cn: 他对作业的态度非常积极。
words.en: An attitude is a way of thinking or feeling about something, especially as shown by your behavior.

words.ex: The babies are sleeping in the crib.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿们正在婴儿床里睡觉。
words.en: Very young children, especially those who cannot yet walk or talk.

words.ex: He went to the bars after work.
words.ex_cn: 他下班后去了酒吧。
words.en: A bar is a place where alcoholic drinks are served. It can also refer to a long, straight piece of metal or wood.

words.tr: n. 利益；好处；“benefit”的复数； v. 有益于；有助于；
words.ex: The benefits of exercise are clear.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼的好处是显而易见的。
words.en: Benefits are advantages or profits that you get from something, especially advantages that you get from the government or from your employer, such as money or health insurance.

words.ex: The children ride bikes to school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们骑自行车去学校。
words.en: Bikes are two-wheeled vehicles that you ride by pushing the pedals with your feet.

words.ex: He pays his bills every Friday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周五支付账单。
words.en: A bill is a written statement of money that you owe for goods or services.

words.ex: The hotel confirmed all bookings for tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 酒店确认了所有明天的预订。
words.en: Bookings refer to the act of reserving something, such as a hotel room, a flight, or a ticket for an event, in advance.

words.ex: He collects old bottles from the beach.
words.ex_cn: 他从海滩收集旧瓶子。
words.en: A bottle is a container, typically made of glass or plastic, with a narrow neck, used for storing drinks or other liquids.

words.ex: The kids played with cardboard boxes.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们玩纸板箱子。
words.en: A box is a container with a flat base and sides, typically square or rectangular and having a lid.

words.ex: The pipes have dangerous build-ups of dirt.
words.ex_cn: 管道里有危险的污垢堆积。
words.en: The process of gradually increasing or developing something, or the result of this process.

words.ex: The car's bumpers were damaged in the accident.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车的保险杠在事故中损坏了。
words.en: Bumpers are bars at the front and back of a vehicle that reduce damage if the vehicle hits something.

words.ex: Many small businesses open near schools.
words.ex_cn: 许多小生意在学校附近开张。
words.en: Businesses are organizations that produce or sell goods or services in order to make a profit.

words.ex: There were many cancellations of flights yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 昨天有很多航班被取消。
words.en: The act of deciding that something that was officially planned will not happen.

words.ex: The books are sorted into different categories.
words.ex_cn: 这些书被分成了不同的类别。
words.en: A category is a class or group of things, people, or ideas that have similar characteristics.

words.ex: He uses cd-roms to store his photos.
words.ex_cn: 他用光盘来存储照片。
words.en: A CD-ROM is a compact disc on which a large amount of digital information can be stored and read but not altered.

words.ex: He read the first three chapters of the book.
words.ex_cn: 他读了这本书的前三章。
words.en: A chapter is one of the parts that a book is divided into. Each chapter has a number, and sometimes a title.

words.ex: The students in my classes are very friendly.
words.ex_cn: 我班上的学生都很友好。
words.en: A group of students who are taught together at school, college, or university.

words.ex: He found some coins in his pocket.
words.ex_cn: 他在口袋里发现了一些硬币。
words.en: Coins are small, flat, round pieces of metal used as money.

words.ex: The communities near the park hold weekly meetings.
words.ex_cn: 公园附近的社区每周举行会议。
words.en: Communities are groups of people who live in the same area or who have the same interests, religion, or nationality.

words.ex: He won three competitions last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年赢得了三场比赛。
words.en: Competitions are events in which people or teams compete against each other in order to win.

words.ex: His concerns about the exam made him nervous.
words.ex_cn: 他对考试的担心让他感到紧张。
words.en: If something concerns you, it worries you; something that concerns you is something that you think is important and that you are interested in.

words.ex: Congratulations on your graduation!
words.ex_cn: 祝贺你毕业！
words.en: An expression of pleasure or joy in the success or good fortune of another.

words.ex: He lost his contacts after moving to a new city.
words.ex_cn: 他搬到新城市后失去了联系。
words.en: People you know who can help you, especially in your work.

words.tr: n. 容器；集装箱；“container”的复数；
words.ex: The boxes are containers for the toys.
words.ex_cn: 这些盒子是装玩具的容器。
words.en: A container is something such as a box or bottle that is used to hold or store things in.

words.tr: n. 复制品；副本；“copy”的复数； v. 复制；拷贝；
words.ex: He bought two copies of the book.
words.ex_cn: 他买了两本这本书的复制品。
words.en: Copies are duplicates of an original document, artwork, or other items made by various methods such as photocopying, printing, or digital replication.

words.ex: The babies slept in small cots near their parents.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿们睡在父母旁边的儿童摇床里。
words.en: A cot is a small, portable bed for a baby, typically with barred or latticed sides.

words.ex: He drinks coffee from two cups every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上用两个杯子喝咖啡。
words.en: A cup is a small round container that you drink from. Cups usually have handles and are made from china or plastic.

words.ex: The currents in the river are strong.
words.ex_cn: 河里的水流很强劲。
words.en: Currents refer to the flow of water, air, or electricity in a particular direction. It can also mean the general tendency or course of events or opinions.

words.ex: He works with databases to store information.
words.ex_cn: 他使用数据库来存储信息。
words.en: A structured set of data held in a computer, especially one that is accessible in various ways.

words.ex: We had discussions about homework every day.
words.ex_cn: 我们每天都有关于作业的讨论。
words.en: Discussions are conversations or debates about a specific topic.

words.ex: She cooked many delicious dishes for the party.
words.ex_cn: 她为派对做了许多美味的菜肴。
words.en: Plates, bowls, cups, etc., used for serving and eating food, or the food served in them.

words.tr: n. 文件；公文；文献；“document”的复数；
words.ex: He filed all the documents in the drawer.
words.ex_cn: 他把所有文件都放在抽屉里了。
words.en: Documents are written, drawn, or printed materials that provide information or evidence.

words.ex: He keeps his dvds in a box on the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 他把他的DVD放在架子上的盒子里。
words.en: Digital Versatile Discs or Digital Video Discs, a digital optical disc storage format.

words.ex: The edges of the paper are torn.
words.ex_cn: 纸的边缘撕破了。
words.en: The outer or furthest point of something.

words.tr: n. 散发；排放；放射；“emission”的复数
words.ex: Cars produce harmful emissions.
words.ex_cn: 汽车产生有害的排放物。
words.en: Emissions are substances that are sent out into the air, especially by vehicles or industrial processes.

words.ex: The weather in that region goes from extremes of heat to extremes of cold.
words.ex_cn: 那个地区的天气从酷热到严寒，变化极端。
words.en: Extremes are the furthest or highest degree of something, often used to describe situations or conditions that are at the very limit of what is possible or acceptable.

words.ex: The school charges small fees for books.
words.ex_cn: 学校对书籍收取少量费用。
words.en: A fee is a sum of money that you pay to be allowed to do something.

words.tr:
n. 财政；资金；
v. 提供资金；
words.ex: The government is managing its finances carefully.
words.ex_cn: 政府正在谨慎地管理其财政。
words.en: Finances refers to the management of large amounts of money, especially by governments or large companies.

words.ex: He counted the coins with his fingers.
words.ex_cn: 他用手指数硬币。
words.en: Fingers are the long thin parts on the end of your hand that you use to hold things.

words.ex: She buys fresh foods at the market every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 她每周末在市场买新鲜食品。
words.en: Foods are substances that people or animals eat or drink, or that plants absorb, to maintain life and growth.

words.ex: The forces of nature can be very powerful.
words.ex_cn: 自然的力量可能非常强大。
words.en: Forces refer to the capacity to do work or cause physical change; energy, strength, or active power.

words.ex: The store sells many kinds of goods.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店出售各种商品。
words.en: Goods are items that are made to be sold.

words.ex: He tightened his grips on the handle.
words.ex_cn: 他紧紧握住了把手。
words.en: The act of holding something tightly or the ability to understand something.

words.tr: n. 印刷品；讲义；施舍物；救济品；“handout”的复数；
words.ex: The teacher gave out handouts for the lesson.
words.ex_cn: 老师发了这节课的印刷品。
words.en: Handouts are papers containing information or tasks that are given to people, especially students, to help them learn or understand something.

words.ex: Her hopes are to become a doctor.
words.ex_cn: 她的希望是成为一名医生。
words.en: If you hope that something is true, or if you hope for something, you want it to be true or to happen, and you usually believe that it is possible or likely.

words.ex: The survey asked householder about their energy use.
words.ex_cn: 这项调查询问了户主他们的能源使用情况。
words.en: A householder is a person who owns or rents a house; the head of a household.

words.ex: Hundreds of people attended the festival.
words.ex_cn: 数以百计的人参加了这个节日。
words.en: A large but unspecified number, typically more than one hundred.

words.tr: n. 倡议；新方案（initiative 的复数形式）；
words.ex: The government launched new initiatives to help small businesses.
words.ex_cn: 政府推出了新的倡议来帮助小企业。
words.en: An initiative is an important act or statement that is intended to solve a problem.

words.ex: He shared some new insights about the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他分享了关于这个问题的一些新见解。
words.en: The ability to understand and realize what people or situations are really like.

words.tr: n. 指令；说明；指示；“instruction”的复数；
words.ex: Follow the instructions on the box.
words.ex_cn: 按照盒子上的指令操作。
words.en: Instructions are detailed information about how to do something, especially how to use a piece of equipment or perform a task.

words.ex: He made many investments in stocks.
words.ex_cn: 他做了很多股票投资。
words.en: An investment is an amount of money that you invest, or the thing that you invest it in.

words.tr: n. 物品；商品；项目；条款；“item”的复数；
words.ex: These items are on the table.
words.ex_cn: 这些物品在桌子上。
words.en: Objects or articles that are used for a particular purpose or are present in a situation.

words.ex: He put the jam in jars.
words.ex_cn: 他把果酱装进了罐子里。
words.en: A jar is a wide-mouthed container, typically made of glass or pottery, used for storing food or other items. As a verb, to jar means to cause a sudden shock or jolt.

words.ex: His journeys across the mountains were long but beautiful.
words.ex_cn: 他穿越群山的旅程漫长却美丽。
words.en: A journey is the act of traveling from one place to another, especially when involving a considerable distance; a trip.

words.ex: The juniors played basketball after school.
words.ex_cn: 年少者们放学后打篮球。
words.en: Juniors refers to individuals who are younger or of a lower rank or position, often used in educational contexts to denote students in their third year of study or in workplaces to refer to employees with less experience or lower status.

words.ex: This apple has 95 kilocalories.
words.ex_cn: 这个苹果有95千卡。
words.en: A kilocalorie is a unit of energy of 1,000 calories, especially as a measure of the energy value of foods.

words.ex: There are many kinds of apples in the store.
words.ex_cn: 商店里有各种各样的苹果。
words.en: Kinds refer to types or categories of things or people that share common characteristics.

words.ex: The cake has three layers.
words.ex_cn: 这个蛋糕有三层。
words.en: Layers refer to sheets, quantities, or thicknesses of material, typically one of several, covering a surface or body. It can also refer to a person or thing that lays something, especially in a particular way.

words.ex: The lecturers give clear explanations in class.
words.ex_cn: 讲师们在课堂上给出清晰的解释。
words.en: Lecturers are people who give lectures, especially at a university or college.

words.ex: He takes piano lessons every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周上钢琴课。
words.en: A lesson is a period of time in which someone is taught about a particular subject or how to do something.

words.ex: He goes to libraries to read books.
words.ex_cn: 他去图书馆读书。
words.en: A place where books, magazines, and other materials (such as videos and musical recordings) are available for people to use or borrow.

words.ex: He loads the truck with boxes.
words.ex_cn: 他把箱子装上卡车。
words.en: A large quantity or number.

words.ex: The makers of this phone are very creative.
words.ex_cn: 这款手机的制造者非常有创造力。
words.en: People or companies that make or produce something.

words.ex: Map-makers draw old maps with great care.
words.ex_cn: 制图者仔细地绘制旧地图。
words.en: Map-makers are individuals or professionals who create maps, combining geographical information with artistic skills to represent areas of the earth.

words.ex: The matches start next week.
words.ex_cn: 比赛下周开始。
words.en: A match is a contest in which people or teams compete against each other in a sport or game. It can also refer to a short, thin piece of wood or cardboard used to light a fire.

words.ex: We have meetings every Monday.
words.ex_cn: 我们每周一都有会议。
words.en: A meeting is an event in which a group of people come together to discuss things or make decisions.

words.ex: The men are working in the garden.
words.ex_cn: 这些男人正在花园里干活。
words.en: Men are adult human males. The term is used to distinguish them from women or boys.

words.ex: He checked his messages on the phone.
words.ex_cn: 他查看了手机上的信息。
words.en: A message is a piece of information or a request that you send to someone or leave for them when you cannot speak to them directly.

words.ex: He made many mistakes in his math test.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学考试中犯了很多错误。
words.en: An action or judgment that is misguided or wrong.

words.ex: The scientists built models to predict weather changes.
words.ex_cn: 科学家们建立了模型来预测天气变化。
words.en: A model is a representation of something, often on a smaller scale, or a person who poses for an artist or photographer.

words.ex: The software has five different modules.
words.ex_cn: 这个软件有五个不同的模块。
words.en: A module is one of the separate parts of a course of study, especially at a college or university.

words.tr: n. 否定的观点；底片；“negative”的复数；
words.ex: He only sees the negatives in every situation.
words.ex_cn: 他总是看到每件事的负面观点。
words.en: Negatives refer to statements or situations that express denial, disagreement, or refusal, or to the opposite of something considered positive.

words.ex: He looks for new opportunities every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都在寻找新的机会。
words.en: A time or set of circumstances that makes it possible to do something.

words.ex: The children are holding their pencils.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们拿着他们的铅笔。
words.en: Pencils are instruments for writing or drawing, consisting of a thin stick of graphite or a similar substance enclosed in a cylinder of wood or fixed in a metal or plastic case.

words.ex: Many old people rely on their pensions to live.
words.ex_cn: 许多老人依靠他们的退休金生活。
words.en: A pension is a sum of money paid regularly by the government or a private company to a person who does not work any more because they are old or have become ill.

words.tr: n. 整形外科；外科修补术；“plastic”的复数；
words.ex: He went to the hospital for plastics after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故发生后，他去医院做了整形外科手术。
words.en: Plastics are materials which are produced from oil by a chemical process and which are used to make many objects. They are light in weight and do not break easily.

words.ex: The players trained hard before the match.
words.ex_cn: 运动员们在比赛前刻苦训练。
words.en: People who participate in a game or sport, or who perform in a musical or theatrical production.

words.ex: Postgraduates are doing research in the lab.
words.ex_cn: 研究生正在实验室做研究。
words.en: Students who have completed a first degree and are studying or doing research at a more advanced level.

words.ex: He made pretensions that he was too busy to help.
words.ex_cn: 他借口太忙了，无法帮忙。
words.en: If you say that someone has pretensions, you mean that they claim or pretend to have a particular quality, status, or ability, often without justification.

words.tr: n. 打印机；印刷厂；“printer”的复数；
words.ex: The office bought three new printers.
words.ex_cn: 办公室买了三台新打印机。
words.en: A printer is a machine that prints text or pictures onto paper, especially one linked to a computer.

words.tr: n. 奖赏；奖品；奖金；捕获物；“prize”的复数；
words.ex: He won three prizes for his science project.
words.ex_cn: 他因科学项目赢得了三个奖赏。
words.en: A prize is something valuable, such as money or a trophy, that is given to someone who wins a competition or who has done outstanding work.

words.ex: The processes of cooking and cleaning take time.
words.ex_cn: 烹饪和清洁的过程需要时间。
words.en: A process is a series of actions which are carried out in order to achieve a particular result. It can also refer to a natural series of changes or a method of doing or making something, especially one that is used in industry.

words.ex: The soldiers received their daily rations at noon.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们中午领到了他们的日常口粮。
words.en: A fixed amount of a commodity officially allowed to each person during a time of shortage, as in wartime.

words.ex: He asked two referees to write letters for his job application.
words.ex_cn: 他请了两位证明人为他的工作申请写推荐信。
words.en: Referees are officials who ensure that the rules of a game or sport are followed and who make decisions during the game.

words.ex: Researchers study how plants grow.
words.ex_cn: 研究人员研究植物如何生长。
words.en: People who carry out academic or scientific research.

words.ex: He rides the bus to work every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天乘公交车去上班。
words.en: To sit on and control the movement of an animal, especially a horse, or to travel in a vehicle, especially as a passenger.

words.tr: n. 风险；“risk”的复数； v. 冒……风险；
words.ex: He knows the risks of climbing that mountain.
words.ex_cn: 他知道爬那座山的风险。
words.en: The possibility of something bad happening.

words.ex: The roads are busy in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 早上的道路很繁忙。
words.en: A road is a long piece of hard ground which is built between two places so that people can drive or ride easily from one place to the other.

words.tr: n. 储蓄金；存款；“saving”的复数；
words.ex: He used his savings to buy a new bike.
words.ex_cn: 他用他的储蓄买了一辆新自行车。
words.en: Money that someone has saved, especially in a bank or official scheme.

words.ex: Scientists study the stars and planets.
words.ex_cn: 科学家研究恒星和行星。
words.en: A scientist is someone who has studied science and whose job is to teach or do research in science.

words.ex: He bought two new shirts.
words.ex_cn: 他买了两件新衬衫。
words.en: A shirt is a piece of clothing that you wear on the upper part of your body. Shirts have a collar, sleeves, and buttons down the front.

words.ex: The road has many signs for directions.
words.ex_cn: 这条路有很多方向标记。
words.en: A sign is a mark or shape that always has a particular meaning, for example in mathematics or music. Signs can also be gestures or movements that you make with your hands or head to give someone information, instructions, or a warning. In addition, a sign can be an event, fact, or situation that shows that something exists, is happening, or may happen in the future.

words.ex: The children pull sledges down the snowy hill.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们拉着雪橇从积雪的山坡上滑下。
words.en: A sledge is a vehicle on runners for conveying loads or passengers over snow or ice, either pushed or pulled, or drawn by horses, dogs, or a motor vehicle.

words.ex: We need better solutions for clean water.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要更好的清洁用水的解决办法。
words.en: A solution to a problem or difficult situation is a way of dealing with it so that the difficulty is removed.

words.ex: The speaker told a funny story.
words.ex_cn: 说话者讲了一个有趣的故事。
words.en: A speaker is someone who speaks, especially someone who gives a speech or makes a presentation.

words.ex: He made clear statements about his plans.
words.ex_cn: 他对自己的计划做了明确的陈述。
words.en: A statement is something that you say or write which gives information in a formal or definite way.

words.ex: The train stops at five stations.
words.ex_cn: 火车在五个车站停靠。
words.en: A station is a place where trains, buses, or other vehicles regularly stop so that passengers can get on or off, or goods can be loaded or unloaded. It can also refer to a building or buildings at such a place, or to a company that broadcasts radio or television programmes.

words.tr: n. 储备；股票；“stock”的复数； v. 备有；
words.ex: The store has large stocks of canned food.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店有大量罐头食品的储备。
words.en: Stocks are shares in the ownership of a company, which can be bought and sold on the stock market.

words.ex: We go to the beach every summers.
words.ex_cn: 我们每年夏天都去海滩。
words.en: The warmest season of the year, between spring and autumn, characterized by long days and warm weather.

words.tr: n. 生活必需品；日用品；生活必需品，日用品（注意复数）；
words.ex: The family bought supplies like food, water, and soap.
words.ex_cn: 这家人买了食物、水和肥皂等生活必需品。
words.en: Supplies are the things that are needed for a particular purpose or that are used or consumed in a particular situation.

words.tr: n. 会谈；‘“talk”的复数； v. 谈话；
words.ex: The talks between the two countries ended peacefully.
words.ex_cn: 两国之间的会谈和平结束。
words.en: Talks are formal discussions or negotiations between two or more parties, often with the aim of reaching an agreement or solving a problem.

words.ex: He aims at his targets every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都在瞄准他的目标。
words.en: A target is something at which someone is aiming a weapon or other object.

words.ex: The teams worked together to win the game.
words.ex_cn: 这些团队合作赢得了比赛。
words.en: A team is a group of people who work together on a particular task or project.

words.ex: Telecommunications connect people across the world.
words.ex_cn: 电信连接了全世界的人们。
words.en: Telecommunications is the technology of sending signals and messages over long distances using electronic means, such as radio, telephone, television, and the internet.

words.ex: The testers checked the new phone for bugs.
words.ex_cn: 测试器检查了新手机的漏洞。
words.en: Testers are individuals or devices that test or examine something, especially new products or systems, to assess their performance or reliability.

words.ex: Toddlers love to play with colorful blocks.
words.ex_cn: 幼儿喜欢玩彩色积木。
words.en: Toddlers are young children who are just beginning to walk.

words.ex: The truck can carry ten tons of sand.
words.ex_cn: 这辆卡车可以载十吨沙子。
words.en: A ton is a unit of weight equal to 2,000 pounds in the US and 2,240 pounds in the UK. Informally, it can also mean a large amount or number.

words.ex: They went on tours to see famous cities.
words.ex_cn: 他们去旅行参观著名城市。
words.en: If someone tours, they go on a journey or trip, usually for pleasure, visiting several different places in an area.

words.ex: He travels to Spain every summer.
words.ex_cn: 他每年夏天都去西班牙旅行。
words.en: Travels can refer to the act of moving from one place to another, especially over a long distance, or the journeys someone makes to different places, often for pleasure or business. It can also refer to the written accounts of such journeys.

words.ex: Social media trends change quickly.
words.ex_cn: 社交媒体的趋势变化很快。
words.en: A trend is a general development or change in a situation or in the way that people are behaving.

words.ex: They carry umbrellas when it rains.
words.ex_cn: 天下雨时，他们带雨伞。
words.en: A device consisting of a circular canopy of fabric on a folding metal frame, used as protection against rain or sometimes sun.

words.ex: Undergraduates are learning basic math this semester.
words.ex_cn: 本科生这学期正在学习基础数学。
words.en: Undergraduates are students at a university or college who are studying for their first degree.

words.ex: Many universities offer free math courses.
words.ex_cn: 许多大学提供免费的数学课程。
words.en: A university is an institution where students study for degrees and where academic research is done.

words.ex: He uses a calculator for math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他用计算器做数学题。
words.en: To employ for some purpose; put into service; make use of.

words.ex: There are many vacancies in the city hospital.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市医院有很多空缺职位。
words.en: Vacancies refer to positions or spaces that are not filled or occupied.

words.tr: n. 方式；方法；方面；路线；“way”的复数；
words.ex: There are many ways to solve this problem.
words.ex_cn: 解决这个问题有很多方式。
words.en: Ways refers to methods, means, or paths by which something is done or achieved.

words.ex: Whales swim in the deep ocean.
words.ex_cn: 鲸在深海中游动。
words.en: Whales are large marine mammals that live in the ocean. They are known for their size and are among the largest animals on Earth.

words.ex: The actors performed a funny play last night.
words.ex_cn: 男演员们昨晚表演了一出滑稽的戏剧。
words.en: An actor is a person whose profession is acting on the stage, in films, or on television.

words.ex: The attendants clapped when the speaker finished.
words.ex_cn: 出席者们在演讲者结束时鼓掌。
words.en: People who are present at an event, meeting, or function, or who accompany and assist someone.

words.ex: The audiences laughed at the funny show.
words.ex_cn: 观众们被这个有趣的节目逗笑了。
words.en: The group of people who watch, listen to, or read a particular type of entertainment or information.

words.ex: My aunts visited me last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我的阿姨们上周末来看我了。
words.en: The sister of one's father or mother; the wife of one's uncle.

words.ex: The woodcutter swung his axes to cut down the tree.
words.ex_cn: 伐木工挥动他的斧头砍倒了那棵树。
words.en: A straight line about which a body or geometric figure rotates or may be supposed to rotate; a tool with a heavy bladed head mounted across a handle, used for chopping wood.

words.ex: The children saw wild beasts in the zoo.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在动物园里看到了野兽。
words.en: A beast is a large and dangerous animal, or a cruel and brutal person.

words.ex: The class is for beginners who want to learn English.
words.ex_cn: 这个课程是给想学英语的初学者的。
words.en: A beginner is someone who has just started learning to do something and cannot do it very well yet.

words.ex: The beginnings of the project were very simple.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目的起点非常简单。
words.en: The early stages or initial parts of something.

words.tr: n. 电话亭；摊位；“booth”的复数；
words.ex: He called his friend from a phone booth.
words.ex_cn: 他从一个电话亭给朋友打了电话。
words.en: A booth is a small enclosed area where goods are sold or services are provided at a fair or market.

words.ex: Botanists study plants in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 植物学家在森林里研究植物。
words.en: A botanist is a scientist who studies plants, including their physiology, structure, genetics, ecology, distribution, classification, and economic importance.

words.ex: He built a wall with red bricks.
words.ex_cn: 他用红砖砌了一堵墙。
words.en: Bricks are rectangular blocks of baked clay used for building walls and houses.

words.ex: My brothers play soccer every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我的兄弟们每个周末都踢足球。
words.en: A brother is a man or boy in relation to other sons and daughters of his parents.

words.ex: Many students think about their careers early in life.
words.ex_cn: 许多学生在年轻时就思考自己的职业。
words.en: A career is the job or series of jobs that you do during your working life, especially if you continue to get better jobs and earn more money.

words.ex: He still listens to old cassettes.
words.ex_cn: 他仍然听旧磁带。
words.en: A cassette is a small flat case containing a very long strip of magnetic material that is used to record sound or pictures. Cassettes are played on a cassette player or recorder.

words.ex: The children visited old castles in the countryside.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们参观了乡村里的古老城堡。
words.en: A castle is a large building with thick, high walls. Castles were built by important people, such as kings, in former times, especially for protection during wars.

words.ex: The library has new catalogues for books.
words.ex_cn: 图书馆有新的图书目录。
words.en: A catalogue is a list of things such as the goods you can buy from a particular company, the objects in a museum, or the books in a library.

words.ex: The explorers walked through dark caverns.
words.ex_cn: 探险者们走进了黑暗的洞穴。
words.en: Large caves or a series of connected chambers in a cave.

words.ex: The chefs prepared a delicious dinner for the guests.
words.ex_cn: 厨师们为客人准备了一顿美味的晚餐。
words.en: A chef is a professional cook, typically the chief cook in a restaurant or hotel.

words.ex: He has many choices for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚餐有很多选择。
words.en: Choices are the different things that you can choose from or the act of choosing between them.

words.ex: The colonizers took land from the native people.
words.ex_cn: 殖民者从原住民手中夺取了土地。
words.en: Colonizers are people who establish a colony or colonies in a country or area.

words.ex: We went to two concerts last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我们上周末去了两场音乐会。
words.en: A concert is a performance of music by one or more musicians or singers, which usually takes place in the evening.

words.ex: It is a convention to shake hands when you meet someone.
words.ex_cn: 见面时握手是一种惯例。
words.en: A convention is a way of behaving that is considered to be correct or polite by most people in a society, or a large formal meeting of people who do a particular job or have a similar interest.

words.ex: The delegates vote on new rules.
words.ex_cn: 代表们对新规则进行投票。
words.en: A delegate is a person who is chosen or elected to vote or make decisions on behalf of a group of people, especially at a conference or a meeting.

words.ex: The teacher asked for simple descriptions of the animals.
words.ex_cn: 老师要求对这些动物做出简单的描述。
words.en: Descriptions are detailed accounts or explanations of something.

words.ex: The ships are waiting at the docks.
words.ex_cn: 船只正在码头等待。
words.en: Docks are areas of water in a port where ships are loaded, unloaded, or repaired.

words.ex: The old dwellings were small but cozy.
words.ex_cn: 这些旧住处虽然小，但很温馨。
words.en: Dwellings are houses or places where people live.

words.ex: The city has many factories that make cars.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市有许多制造汽车的工厂。
words.en: Factories are buildings or groups of buildings where goods are manufactured or assembled chiefly by machine.

words.ex: The bus fares are too high this year.
words.ex_cn: 今年公交车费太高了。
words.en: The money that you pay for a journey that you make, for example, in a bus, train, or taxi. Also, to get along in a specified way.

words.ex: My feet hurt after walking all day.
words.ex_cn: 我走了一整天，脚很疼。
words.en: The plural of foot, which is the lower extremity of the leg below the ankle, on which a person stands or walks. Also, a unit of linear measure equal to 12 inches (30.48 cm).

words.ex: Females are more likely to study biology than physics.
words.ex_cn: 女性更有可能学习生物而不是物理。
words.en: Females are individuals of the sex that can bear offspring or produce eggs, distinguished biologically by the production of gametes (ova) that can be fertilized by male gametes.

words.ex: The fires burned brightly in the night.
words.ex_cn: 夜晚的火势熊熊燃烧。
words.en: Fires are the result of combustion, producing heat and light. They can occur naturally or be caused by human activity.

words.ex: The pond has many fishes.
words.ex_cn: 池塘里有很多鱼。
words.en: Fishes are aquatic vertebrates that are typically cold-blooded, covered with scales, and equipped with two sets of paired fins and several unpaired fins.

words.ex: The company has many fleets of delivery trucks.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司有许多车队的送货卡车。
words.en: A fleet is a group of ships, or all of the ships in a country's navy, or a group of vehicles or aircraft under the control of one company or organization.

words.ex: The glass broke into fragments on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 玻璃摔在地上成了碎片。
words.en: Pieces of something that has been broken or separated from a whole.

words.ex: He eats fruits every day for health.
words.ex_cn: 他为了健康每天吃水果。
words.en: The edible product of a plant or tree, consisting of the seed and its envelope, especially the latter when it is juicy or pulpy.

words.tr: n. 绅士；先生；有教养的人；“gentleman”的复数；
words.ex: The gentlemen shook hands politely.
words.ex_cn: 这些绅士礼貌地握了手。
words.en: A gentleman is a man who is considerate and courteous, especially towards women. He is often seen as someone who adheres to high standards of behavior.

words.ex: The goats eat grass on the hill.
words.ex_cn: 山羊在山上吃草。
words.en: Goats are animals that are related to sheep. They are often kept for their milk, meat, or wool.

words.tr: n. 祖父母；外祖父母；爷爷奶奶；
words.ex: I visit my grandparents every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我每个周末都去看望我的祖父母。
words.en: Grandparents are the parents of a person's father or mother.

words.ex: The children are playing on the grounds.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在操场上玩耍。
words.en: Grounds can refer to the land surrounding a large building, such as a school or a hospital, or the reasons or justifications for a particular action or belief.

words.ex: He washed his hands before eating.
words.ex_cn: 他在吃饭前洗手了。
words.en: The word 'hands' refers to the parts of the body at the end of the arms that are used for holding, moving, touching, and feeling things. It can also mean help or assistance, skill in doing something, or the pointers on a clock.

words.ex: The horse walked quietly on its hooves.
words.ex_cn: 马用它的蹄子安静地走路。
words.en: The plural of hoof, the hard part of the foot of some animals, such as horses, cows, etc.

words.ex: Hunter-gatherers lived in small groups and moved often.
words.ex_cn: 狩猎采集者生活在小群体中，经常迁徙。
words.en: Hunter-gatherers are people who live by hunting wild animals and gathering wild plants, rather than by farming or keeping animals.

words.ex: The hunters walked through the forest to find deer.
words.ex_cn: 猎人们穿过森林寻找鹿。
words.en: A hunter is a person who hunts wild animals for food or as a sport.

words.ex: Scientists test many hypotheses to find the truth.
words.ex_cn: 科学家们测试许多假说以寻找真相。
words.en: A hypothesis is an idea or explanation for something that is based on known facts but has not yet been proved.

words.ex: He showed me his images from the trip.
words.ex_cn: 他给我看了他旅行时拍的照片。
words.en: Pictures or photographs, especially those created electronically.

words.ex: The company introduced many innovations to improve its products.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司推出了许多革新来改进其产品。
words.en: Innovations refer to new methods, ideas, or products that are introduced and significantly improve or change a particular area.

words.ex: The interviewees answered the questions honestly.
words.ex_cn: 这些面试者诚实地回答了问题。
words.en: Interviewees are the people who are being interviewed, especially for a job or for a television or radio program.

words.ex: The history book describes ancient invasions by nomadic tribes.
words.ex_cn: 这本历史书描述了古代游牧民族的入侵。
words.en: An invasion is an instance of invading a country or region with an armed force.

words.ex: The inventors created a new machine.
words.ex_cn: 这些发明家创造了一台新机器。
words.en: People who invent new things or processes.

words.ex: The islands are far from the mainland.
words.ex_cn: 这些岛屿远离大陆。
words.en: An island is a piece of land that is completely surrounded by water.

words.ex: He reads science journals every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周都读科学期刊。
words.en: A journal is a magazine, especially one that deals with a specialized subject, or a daily record of events or business.

words.ex: He runs five kilometers every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上跑五公里。
words.en: A kilometer is a unit of length in the metric system, equal to one thousand meters.

words.ex: The ladies are talking in the park.
words.ex_cn: 这些女士们正在公园里聊天。
words.en: Used as a polite or respectful way of addressing or referring to women.

words.ex: The landlords raised the rent last month.
words.ex_cn: 房东上个月提高了租金。
words.en: A landlord is a person who owns and rents land such as a house, apartment, or condo.

words.tr: n. 笔记本电脑；“laptop”的复数；
words.ex: Students use laptops to take notes in class.
words.ex_cn: 学生用笔记本电脑在课堂上做笔记。
words.en: A laptop is a small, portable computer that you can use on your lap.

words.ex: The leaders of the team made a good decision.
words.ex_cn: 团队的领袖做出了一个正确的决定。
words.en: Leaders are people who guide or direct others, often in a political, business, or organizational context. They are responsible for making decisions, setting goals, and motivating others to achieve those goals.

words.ex: The lions sleep under the tree.
words.ex_cn: 狮子在树下睡觉。
words.en: Lions are large, powerful carnivores of the family Felidae, often referred to as the 'king of the jungle'.

words.ex: The teacher gave each student a manual for the science lab.
words.ex_cn: 老师给每位学生发了一本科学实验室的手册。
words.en: A manual is a book which tells you how to do something or how a piece of machinery works.

words.ex: The merchants sell fruit at the market.
words.ex_cn: 商人们在市场卖水果。
words.en: Merchants are people who buy and sell goods, especially in large amounts.

words.ex: The moneylenders gave loans to poor farmers.
words.ex_cn: 放贷者向贫困的农民提供了贷款。
words.en: Moneylenders are individuals or groups who lend money, especially to those who are unable to obtain loans from traditional financial institutions, often charging high interest rates.

words.ex: I like to watch movies on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢在周末看电影。
words.en: A movie is a film that you watch at a cinema or on television.

words.ex: Children love to visit museums on school trips.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们喜欢在学校旅行时参观博物馆。
words.en: A museum is a building where a large number of interesting and valuable objects, such as works of art or historical items, are kept, studied, and displayed to the public.

words.ex: The newcomers are learning the rules of the school.
words.ex_cn: 新来的人正在学习学校的规则。
words.en: Newcomers are people who have recently arrived in a place or started an activity.

words.ex: He made careful observations about the birds.
words.ex_cn: 他仔细观察了这些鸟。
words.en: The act of noticing or watching something carefully, in order to gain information.

words.ex: The origins of this tradition are very old.
words.ex_cn: 这个传统的起源非常久远。
words.en: The origins of something are the causes or reasons that explain why it began to exist.

words.ex: Children play in the parks after school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们放学后在公园里玩耍。
words.en: A park is a large area of land with grass and trees, usually in a town, where people go in order to relax and enjoy themselves.

words.ex: I bought two new phones for my family.
words.ex_cn: 我为我的家人买了两部新电话。
words.en: A phone is a device that you use to talk to someone who is in another place, by dialling a number and speaking into it.

words.ex: She washed the pots after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 她晚饭后洗了罐子。
words.en: Containers made of various materials, typically round and deep, used for holding liquids or plants.

words.ex: He likes to drink beer in local pubs.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在当地的酒馆喝啤酒。
words.en: Pubs are places where alcoholic drinks are served and people gather to drink and socialize.

words.ex: He wound the fishing line onto the reels.
words.ex_cn: 他把鱼线绕到卷线筒上。
words.en: A reel is a cylinder on which film, wire, thread, or other flexible materials can be wound. As a verb, to reel means to wind something on a reel or to stagger or sway as if about to fall.

words.ex: He has good relations with his coworkers.
words.ex_cn: 他和同事关系很好。
words.en: Relations refer to the way in which two or more people, groups, countries, etc., talk to, behave toward, and deal with each other.

words.ex: He made reservations for a table at the restaurant.
words.ex_cn: 他为餐厅的桌子做了保留。
words.en: If you have reservations about something, you are not sure that it is entirely good or right.

words.ex: The game has age restrictions.
words.ex_cn: 这个游戏有年龄约束。
words.en: Restrictions are rules or laws that limit what you can do or what can happen.

words.ex: The romans built many roads and bridges.
words.ex_cn: 罗马人修建了许多道路和桥梁。
words.en: The term 'Romans' can refer to the people of ancient Rome or to a book in the New Testament of the Bible, which is a letter written by the Apostle Paul to the Christians in Rome.

words.ex: The movie has many exciting scenes.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影有很多激动人心的场景。
words.en: Scenes refer to the places where events or actions occur, or the views or sights that can be seen in a particular place.

words.ex: He made new schemes to save money.
words.ex_cn: 他制定了新的计划来省钱。
words.en: A scheme is a plan or arrangement, especially one produced by a government or other organization, or a secret and dishonest plan.

words.ex: He watched the whole series of the show.
words.ex_cn: 他看完了这部剧的整个系列。
words.en: A series of things or events is a number of them that come one after the other.

words.ex: The British established settlements in North America.
words.ex_cn: 英国人在北美建立了殖民地。
words.en: Settlements refer to the act of settling or the state of being settled. It can mean the resolution of a dispute, the establishment of people in a new country or area, or the agreement reached in a legal case.

words.ex: The settlers built houses near the river.
words.ex_cn: 殖民者在河边建造了房屋。
words.en: Settlers are people who go to live in a new country or area.

words.ex: The town built shelters for people during the storm.
words.ex_cn: 镇上为人们在风暴期间建造了避难所。
words.en: A shelter is a small building or covered place which is made to protect people from bad weather or danger.

words.ex: The dog splashes water while drinking.
words.ex_cn: 狗喝水时溅起水花。
words.en: If a liquid splashes or if you splash a liquid, it falls on or hits something or someone in a series of small drops.

words.ex: The doctor put in ten stitches to close the wound.
words.ex_cn: 医生缝了十针来缝合伤口。
words.en: Stitches are the pieces of thread that have been used to sew the edges of a wound together.

words.ex: The bridge has strong structures to support weight.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥有坚固的结构来承受重量。
words.en: Structures refer to the arrangement of and relations between the parts or elements of something complex. They can also denote buildings or other constructions standing as a whole.

words.tr: n. 副标题；字幕；“subtitle”的复数；
words.ex: The movie has English subtitles.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影有英文字幕。
words.en: Subtitles are words shown at the bottom of a film or television screen that translate or transcribe the dialogue or narrative.

words.ex: These technologies help people work faster.
words.ex_cn: 这些技术帮助人们更快地工作。
words.en: Technologies refer to the application of scientific knowledge for practical purposes, especially in industry.

words.tr: n. 测试；“test”的复数； v. 考验；
words.ex: The students took math tests last week.
words.ex_cn: 学生们上周参加了数学测试。
words.en: A test is a series of questions, problems, or practical tasks to gauge someone's knowledge, experience, or ability.

words.ex: He bought a new textbook for math class.
words.ex_cn: 他为数学课买了一本新教科书。
words.en: A textbook is a book containing a comprehensive compilation of content in a branch of study with the intention of explaining it. Textbooks are produced to meet the needs of educators, usually at educational institutions.

words.ex: The children visited two theaters last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们上周末参观了两个剧场。
words.en: A theater is a building with a stage in it, on which plays, shows, and other performances take place.

words.ex: He laid new tiles in the bathroom.
words.ex_cn: 他在浴室铺了新的瓷砖。
words.en: Tiles are flat, usually square or rectangular pieces of baked clay, carpet, cork, or other material, used for covering roofs, floors, walls, or other surfaces.

words.ex: The tops of the jars are sealed tightly.
words.ex_cn: 罐子的盖子都密封得很严。
words.en: The best or most excellent.

words.ex: The trains arrive every hour.
words.ex_cn: 火车每小时到达一次。
words.en: To train means to teach someone the skills of a particular job or activity, or to be taught these skills. It can also refer to a series of connected railway carriages or wagons moved by a locomotive or by integral motors.

words.ex: The tribes live in the forest far from cities.
words.ex_cn: 这些部落生活在远离城市的森林里。
words.en: A tribe is a social group consisting of people of the same race or nationality who share the same customs, traditions, and language.

words.ex: He wears white t-shirts every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都穿白色T恤。
words.en: A T-shirt is a style of fabric shirt named after the T shape of its body and sleeves. Traditionally, it has short sleeves and a round neckline, known as a crew neck, which lacks a collar.

words.ex: My uncles come to visit every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 我的叔叔们每个星期天都来拜访。
words.en: The brother of one's father or mother or the husband of one's aunt.

words.ex: There are many varieties of apples in the market.
words.ex_cn: 市场上有各种各样的苹果。
words.en: Varieties refers to the quality or state of being different or diverse; the absence of uniformity, sameness, or monotony.

words.ex: The vessels sailed across the sea.
words.ex_cn: 这些船航行在海上。
words.en: A vessel is a ship or large boat, or a container for holding liquids, or a tube that carries blood through the body.

words.ex: The visitors came to see the museum.
words.ex_cn: 客人来参观博物馆。
words.en: Visitors are people who come to see a place or person, often temporarily, for a specific purpose such as sightseeing, business, or social reasons.

words.ex: The walls are white.
words.ex_cn: 墙是白色的。
words.en: A wall is a vertical structure, often made of stone or brick, that divides or encloses an area of land.

words.tr: n. 车间；工场；研讨会；“workshop”的复数
words.ex: He attends workshops on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他在周末参加研讨会。
words.en: A workshop is a room or building where things are made or repaired using tools or machinery. It can also refer to a meeting at which a group of people engage in intensive discussion and activity on a particular subject or project.

words.ex: He dreams of other worlds.
words.ex_cn: 他梦想着其他世界。
words.en: The term 'worlds' refers to the earth and all life on it, including human civilization, or a particular group of living things and the environment they live in. It can also denote a particular domain or sphere of activity.

words.ex: The writers are working on a new book.
words.ex_cn: 这些作家正在写一本新书。
words.en: A writer is a person who writes books, stories, or articles as a job or regular occupation.

words.ex: The city is divided into different zones for shopping and living.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市被划分为不同的购物和居住地带。
words.en: An area or stretch of land having a particular characteristic, purpose, or use, or subject to particular restrictions.

words.ex: His achievements in science won many awards.
words.ex_cn: 他在科学上的成就赢得了许多奖项。
words.en: Achievements are things that someone has succeeded in doing, especially after a lot of effort.

words.ex: Adults need more sleep than children.
words.ex_cn: 成人比孩子需要更多的睡眠。
words.en: An adult is a person who is fully grown or developed.

words.ex: The ants are carrying food to their nest.
words.ex_cn: 蚂蚁正在把食物搬回蚁巢。
words.en: Ants are small insects that live in large groups called colonies. They are known for their strong work ethic and ability to work together.

words.ex: They live in small apartments near the city center.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在靠近市中心的小公寓里。
words.en: A set of rooms for living in, usually on one floor of a large building.

words.tr: n. 猿（ape 的复数形式）
words.ex: The apes are climbing trees in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 这些猿猴正在森林里爬树。
words.en: Apes are a group of primates that includes gorillas, chimpanzees, and orangutans. They are known for their intelligence and are closely related to humans.

words.ex: The city has many famous attractions for tourists.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市有许多著名的旅游胜地。
words.en: things that interest or please people, or qualities that something has that make people like it

words.ex: He uses binoculars to watch birds in the park.
words.ex_cn: 他用望远镜在公园里看鸟。
words.en: Binoculars are an instrument that you hold up to your eyes to look at objects that are far away. It consists of two small telescopes joined together.

words.ex: The cat sleeps on the blankets every afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 这只猫每天下午都睡在毯子上。
words.en: A blanket is a large piece of thick cloth, especially one which you put on a bed to keep you warm.

words.ex: He carries water in buckets.
words.ex_cn: 他用桶提水。
words.en: A bucket is a round container with a handle, used for carrying liquids or other materials.

words.ex: He eats bread and rice for carbohydrates.
words.ex_cn: 他吃面包和米饭来获取碳水化合物。
words.en: Carbohydrates are substances, found in certain kinds of food, that provide your body with heat and energy and are made up of carbon, hydrogen, and oxygen.

words.ex: The living room has soft carpets.
words.ex_cn: 客厅里有柔软的地毯。
words.en: Carpets are thick woven materials for covering floors.

words.ex: The ancient temple has beautiful stone carvings.
words.ex_cn: 这座古老的寺庙有精美的石刻。
words.en: Carvings are objects or designs that have been cut out of a material such as wood or stone, often as a form of artistic expression.

words.ex: The children explored dark caves with flashlights.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们用手电筒探索了黑暗的洞穴。
words.en: A cave is a large hole in the side of a cliff or hill, or under the ground. If something caves, it falls inward or collapses.

words.ex: The cellists played softly in the orchestra.
words.ex_cn: 大提琴手们在管弦乐队中轻柔地演奏。
words.en: A cellist is someone who plays the cello.

words.ex: The dog is on a long chain.
words.ex_cn: 狗被一条长链拴着。
